chapters.title: Chapter 351: Spare Me, Hero Ding! Green Bamboo Elder
paragraphs: At this moment, all these young people were cheering excitedly.

Among them were some young girls in the springtime of youth. After witnessing this battle, hearing others talk about Ding Ling’s feats, and seeing Ding Ling himself, with his extraordinary bearing and heroic spirit soaring to the sky, filled with gallant and intrepid heroism, he truly displayed the unrivaled spirit of a fine young man!
He was simply a walking hormone!
Some young girls blushed and their hearts raced as they watched, unable to contain their screams.
Less reserved girls went so far as to proactively ask for phone numbers and contact information. To them, marrying Ding Ling would undoubtedly lead to a bright and promising future!
They knew that some people were willing to offer a billion to learn martial arts from Ding Ling, yet Ding Ling remained unfazed and unmoved.
Such a young man! It’s highly likely that he is indeed a scion of a Hidden Clan!
Just think about it.
Ding Ling had wealth, looks, elegance, martial arts skills, potential, and fame...
Which woman wouldn’t be tempted?
If one succeeds in dating Ding Ling, she would undoubtedly become an internet celebrity in the real world! And at that time, cashing in the benefits would surely be lucrative!
Upon thinking about it.
Many profit-driven women couldn’t help but regard Ding Ling as a walking treasure.
Ding Ling’s eye twitched incessantly.
He paid no mind to these players whose style was inconsistent with ancient ways.
However, he firmly believed.
In a year or two, players’ styles would definitely undergo another big change.
Because that’s exactly how it was in the Three Kingdoms World.
Many players, after establishing families and careers in the Three Kingdoms World, were greatly influenced by ancient people, and their speech and behavior became increasingly ancient-like.
The number of players in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World was far fewer than in the Three Kingdoms World.
They were surrounded by more ancient people.
Thus, they would only be more influenced!
You become the company you keep.
An unchanging truth since ancient times.
Da-da!

Ding Ling carried two Divine Swords on his back, holding a massive Drumming Golden Hammer in his hand, walking with a majestic stride, his deep eyes seemed to contain a universe. Wherever he went, apart from occasional outbursts from the players, it was silent all around.
Soon enough.
Ding Ling reached the tavern.
Looking closely.
He saw that Qu Feiyan and a few others had already come downstairs and were at the tavern’s entrance, confronting several experts from the Mount Song Sect.
Those Mount Song Sect experts saw that Ding Ling had returned unharmed and their expressions changed drastically, turning to flee.
"Trying to run?"
Ding Ling sneered, activated the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, and casually threw it!
Rumble!
The Drumming Golden Hammer was flung out by him, sparking and flashing all the way down like a giant Thunder Dragon descending to the human world, roaring as it went, boom!
It struck straight on the backs of several Mount Song Sect experts, shattering their bones and breaking their sinews on the spot! They died instantly without even a scream.
The other elite members of the Mount Song Sect who were about to flee saw this, turned pale, and after exchanging glances, they fell to their knees in front of Ding Ling with a thud:
"Mount Song Sect’s Thirteen Grand Protectors Divine Whip Deng Bafeng, pays respect to Hero Ding!"
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidate Deng Bafeng.]

[Annotation: Deng Bafeng witnessed the scenes of you killing Zuo Lengchan and battling Li Yuanba, already trembling with fear! However, seeing how your battle with Li Yuanba had not resulted in a clear victor, he was tempted to kill Qu Feiyan and others to regain the lost prestige of the Mount Song Sect.
Thereby gaining the support of the Mount Song Sect and seizing the position of Sect Leader.
But seeing you return unscathed and killing the White-haired Immortal Elder Bo Chen of the Thirteen Grand Protectors with one blow, petrified him. He didn’t dare run nor resist anymore.]
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidate Bo Chen.]

[Annotation: As a First-class Expert of the Mount Song Sect, Bo Chen was unstoppable and unchallenged! He intended to take advantage of the situation to kill Qu Feiyan and others to gain fame and benefits, but was unexpectedly killed with a single hammer swing. He died unwilling, resentful, regretful, and in despair.]
Two Achievement Medals secured.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[1: Defeat more than 20 plane-level experts: 13/20.]
Previously, it was 11.
Now, after killing Zuo Lengchan and Bo Chen, moved up by two small steps.
However, killing Li Yuanba did not trigger any prompt.
It seems Li Yuanba is not considered a character from The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World plane.
Thump thump thump!

Deng Bafeng saw Ding Ling merely looking at him without speaking, and grew increasingly fearful. His eyes rolled around and he started kowtowing desperately, bloodied his forehead, paying no heed, only begging aloud:
"Spare me, Hero Ding, spare me..."
Compared to the iron-willed heroic men like Xu Sheng from the Three Kingdoms World.
Deng Bafeng was truly a coward.

But this world lacked nothing more than these cowardly individuals afraid of death. Ding Ling understood, but that didn’t mean he would spare the Mount Song Sect’s people. Awoken by the kowtowing and cries, coming back to his senses, he glanced indifferently at Deng Bafeng and said:
"How many people and resources do you have in the Mount Song Sect?"
"Th-there are quite a few."
Deng Bafeng was stunned for a moment, then hastily replied.
"Gather your people, organize them. Lead me to the Mount Song Sect right now."
The Mount Song Sect is not far from Luoyang.
With a fast horse and whip, it won’t take a day to reach.

Thinking of how the Mount Song Sect had gathered numerous experts from both black and white paths, there must be plenty of treasure, just right to seize to enrich oneself, allowing the sixth drop of True Water to completely transform.
At the same time, he could also sweep through the First-class Experts of the Mount Song Sect.
Accelerating the completion of Task 1.
He could also accelerate the completion of Task 3, and so forth.
Ding Ling originally intended to go to the Huashan Sect.

But since such a situation arose with the Mount Song Sect halfway, Ding Ling thought of Li Yuanba and Zuo Lengchan both being dead. There’s no reason for him to leave behind such great benefits of the Mount Song Sect and not take them, only to watch them get divided and seized by others later, right?
The time to go is now, to spur on the horse and head there quickly.
To seize everything from the Mount Song Sect.
While making himself swiftly powerful, it could also enable Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, Lin Pingzhi, and others to strengthen quickly. Such a good opportunity, how could Ding Ling pass it up.
"Yes, yes, yes!"
Deng Bafeng didn’t dare utter a single word of dissent.

Under Ding Ling’s cold gaze, he was initially planning to decline once or twice, but as the words reached his lips, he immediately uttered a string of ’Yes, yes, yes’, feeling utterly startled by Ding Ling’s look, and cold sweat broke out on his back!
When Ding Ling turned around to communicate with Qu Feiyan and others.
His previously anxious heart relaxed a bit:
"Ding Ling is truly terrifying. His aura is lofty, profound, and unpredictable. Just one glance from him, and I nearly couldn’t breathe. I don’t know if it’s psychological or something else."
But after being deterred by Ding Ling like that.
Deng Bafeng was completely obedient, not daring to make any moves, following Ding Ling’s instructions to the letter.
"Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan saw Ding Ling turn his head back towards her, and her face lit up as she sweetly called out.
A narrow escape from death.
After many trials and tribulations.
The battle at the tavern.
This allowed Qu Feiyan to see things and people more clearly.

At this moment, she even started to feel that nothing else mattered, as long as one is alive, and as long as Brother Ding is alive, being able to see her Brother Ding every day is the most beautiful, the best, and the happiest thing.
"Ding Ling (Master)."
Consort Yhu, Lin Pingzhi, Huang Zhonggong, and others also gazed at Ding Ling with excitement, calling out:
"How are you, are you okay?!"
"Seeing Ding Ling untouched, surely he’s alright. I really didn’t expect to encounter so much bloodshed on this trip to Luoyang!"
’If it weren’t for Ding Ling, we would have already gone to see King Yama. Alas, it’s embarrassing; we could only watch Ding Ling fight without being able to help. This feeling is really unpleasant.’
After the excitement.
Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and others were either reflecting, feeling ashamed, or embarrassed.
Even though Ding Ling said there was nothing wrong, their emotions were still turbulent and could not calm down.
The longer they were with Ding Ling.
The more they felt like they were useless.
The recent battle made it especially evident.
Aside from watching, they could do nothing. Even the antidote was procured with Ding Ling’s help.
But speaking of the poisoning incident.
Huang Zhonggong was puzzled as to why Ding Ling remained unharmed.
Ding Ling said:
"Besides the effects of the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine, it’s related to my Medicine King Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, and other Supreme Skills becoming natural instincts."
Huang Zhonggong and others, upon hearing this, were envious.
Having so many Supreme Skills ingrained as natural instincts is truly rare.
But then they thought of Ding Ling’s unrivaled talent, and while understanding, they felt inferior.
Consort Yhu had just watched the fight, observing clearly.
She increasingly felt that Ding Ling’s combat abilities far surpassed Xiang Yu, leading her to admire and respect Ding Ling even more.
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan were beside her, observing clearly, feeling more joy and pride.
In their view, Ding Ling was their master (Brother Ding). The more their master (Brother Ding) was admired and respected, the more honored they felt!
"Let’s go."
After chatting with Qu Feiyan and the others for a while.
He glanced at the innkeeper, huddled in a corner, tearlessly regretting.
Ding Ling shook his head, not intervening further.
The innkeeper, knowing that Zuo Lengchan planned to kill people on the second floor, still allowed him to proceed, though Ding Ling did not understand the reasoning or the cause.
No matter if the innkeeper was threatened, intimidated, or coerced by Zuo Lengchan and had no choice but to comply, or if there were other reasons.
He did it and must face the consequences.
Ding Ling didn’t trouble him.
He simply prepared to ride away.
The horses were brought by Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan, and the others. It was obvious they were ready to leave Luoyang City at any moment.
Unexpectedly.
Just as Ding Ling and his group mounted their horses.
An elegant old man with a bamboo basket on his back waved from the crowd, shouting:
"Hero Ding, please wait."
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling looked sideways.
"Hero Ding can call me the Green Bamboo Elder."
The old man smiled gently, looking very amicable.
Ding Ling suddenly understood.
He had heard prompts previously about receiving recognition from the Green Bamboo Elder. He was curious as to where Ren Yingying and the Green Bamboo Elder were watching the battle from.
He glanced around earlier, not seeing them, then moved on his way.
Unexpectedly.
The Green Bamboo Elder was here waiting.

"My lady has been waiting for Hero Ding in Luoyang for a long time. Unexpectedly, Zuo Lengchan intercepted you. Alas, after this battle, Luoyang is shaken. Hero Ding, you shouldn’t linger here for long. Come with me. I have a way to quickly get you out of Luoyang City."

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Saintess Ren Yingying
paragraphs: The Battle of Luoyang City.
Countless deaths and injuries!
Corpses were scattered all over.
Rivers of blood flowed.
Such a shocking event spread throughout the land of Luoyang at an extremely fast pace.
Moreover, the battle between Ding Ling and Li Yuanba lasted quite long.
So, now some soldiers in Luoyang City have learned of the matter, and they are mobilizing troops, preparing to capture Ding Ling.
This was said by the Green Bamboo Elder.
What exactly is going on?
Ding Ling is not sure.
However, Ding Ling thought that this was the Great Ming world, and it seemed normal for a general to be furious and want to capture him.
Ding Ling also did not want to clash with the Great Ming Dynasty.
Naturally, he chose the 36th stratagem: running away is the best strategy!
He chose to leave with the Green Bamboo Elder.
Of course, Deng Bafeng and others from the Mount Songh Sect must also gather and leave with them.
Ding Ling also planned to have them lead the way to the Mount Songh Sect together.
On the way.
The Green Bamboo Elder followed alongside Ding Ling and said aloud:

"The generals of the Great Ming are very brave and good at battle. General Wang, who is stationed in Luoyang City, is a formidable warrior, but he also witnessed from afar the battle between you and Li Yuanba.
He was so scared that he broke out in a sweat, and his spine turned cold."
"How do you know this?"
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t help but ask.
"Ha ha."
The Green Bamboo Elder smiled slightly and stroked his beard, saying:

"I am an old acquaintance of General Wang, and he told me personally. He does not want to clash with Hero Ding, knowing full well that a peerless hero like Hero Ding cannot be captured by mere thousands or tens of thousands of troops.
But he has to give an explanation to the common people.
So, he will surely put on a show.
He hopes I can pass on the message to Hero Ding. He means no harm. He hopes that both sides can go their separate ways. Once we part, it is best not to meet again."
General Wang saying such words.
Clearly shows he was scared!

One must know that at the level of powers like Li Yuanba and Ding Ling, entering a battle array is like entering an uninhabited realm! Not to mention ten thousand men, even a hundred thousand men, in front of such peerless ’fierce men’ like Ding Ling and Li Yuanba, they can only kneel!
Because people like Ding Ling and Li Yuanba are not just unmatched in strength.
Their endurance, physique, and defense have reached a terrifying level!
Who can last longer?
Most likely, all ten thousand of Luoyang City’s defending troops would be knocked down by Ding Ling! Yet Ding Ling would still be safe and sound!
General Wang evidently has remarkable cultivation, seeing this, how dare he provoke Ding Ling?
He couldn’t be more eager for Ding Ling, this godly figure, to go as far away as possible!
"So, as long as we cooperate well with General Wang, we can leave without anyone knowing."
The Green Bamboo Elder laughed and said:

"General Wang hopes we can be a bit discreet, avoid the main roads, and take some side paths. There are many side paths in Luoyang City. Once the situation calms down, later on, General Wang will collaborate with us to escort Hero Ding out of the city gate."
Ding Ling nodded, noncommittally.
At his current level of power.
Indeed, he does not fear ten thousand troops!
He once served as the Guardian God and First-Rank Prince in the Three Kingdoms.
In this world, he naturally has no interest in becoming a prince.
He only wants to become the strongest, shatter the void, and travel to another world, seeking more powerful martial arts, and continuously grow stronger.
Until he achieves immortality.
Truly invincible!
Two hours later.
With General Wang’s cooperation, Ding Ling and his party left the city.
After walking more than a dozen miles.
They came upon a refined and elegant courtyard.
The Green Bamboo Elder introduced:
"This is where my aunt is currently recuperating. Come in with me."
He stepped forward and knocked on the heavy wooden gate of the courtyard. After a few muffled sounds, a charming girl opened the door, poking her head out, and said:
"Green Bamboo Elder, has Hero Ding arrived?"
"Yes, yes."
The Green Bamboo Elder stepped aside to reveal Ding Ling and the others:
"See for yourself."

The charming girl was indeed overjoyed upon seeing Ding Ling. She reached out, about to grab Ding Ling’s arm, but then suddenly pulled back, somewhat embarrassed, yet looking at Ding Ling with admiration:
"The world’s number one, Hero Ding, truly an extraordinary, heroic figure! My lady will surely be very pleased to see you."
"Let’s go inside first."
The Green Bamboo Elder coughed dryly.
The charming girl realized and quickly smiled, leading the way, occasionally calling back to Ding Ling.
In her eyes, heart, and mouth, it seemed like it was all Ding Ling.
Completely ignoring people like Huang Zhonggong, Ding Jian, and others.

These people, once heroic figures themselves, naturally felt a bit melancholic being ignored. But thinking about Ding Ling’s abilities, greatness, and fearsome prowess, they became resigned. Putting oneself in their shoes, if they were in her place, they would probably only have eyes and heart for Ding Ling too.
Because compared to Ding Ling.
They weren’t even qualified to be supporting roles.
The gap was too vast.
Describing it as an abyssal difference wouldn’t be excessive at all.

Qu Feiyan and Lin Pingzhi witnessed this and felt joy in their hearts. In their eyes, Ding Ling was everything. Especially Qu Feiyan, who longed for her Brother Ding; Ding Ling receiving praise brought her more happiness and joy than receiving praise herself.
Tap tap!
The group walked on the stone-paved road.
Before long.
They arrived at the living room.
"Please wait a moment."
The girl prepared tea for Ding Ling and his companions, then covered her mouth with a laugh and said:
"My lady is probably doing her makeup now. I’ll go call her to meet the guests."
"Thank you.
Ding Ling said.
"Hero Ding, you are too kind"
The girl was flattered:
"It is my honor to serve you."
After saying this.
She gracefully went to the inner room to find her lady.
It took just a moment.
The charming girl led out a woman with a graceful and slender figure.
The woman had a face like white jade, incredibly beautiful, a rare beauty in the world.
Her eyes swept over Ding Ling and his group like autumn water, finally fixing on Ding Ling. She lightly opened her lips:
"Hero Ding?"
"Hero Ding is a title I dare not claim. My surname is Ding, given name Ling. You may call me Ding Ling."
Ding Ling, presentable and composed, sat at the left seat of honor, bearing the likeness of a mountain and the aura of an abyss, catching the eye of anyone upon first glance and drawing admiration.
This kind of presence is not something ordinary people possess.
The extraordinary beauty was not stingy with her praise, smiling slightly, she said:

"Before, seeing Hero Ding’s figure and demeanor from afar was already astonishing. Seeing you up close now, it’s as if I’m in the presence of greatness! Just from your poise and charisma, Hero Ding could stand at the pinnacle of the world, overlooking all living beings."
Huang Zhonggong and the others drank tea below, each with a slightly peculiar expression as they looked at the young woman.
This was because they recognized who she was.
Not someone else.
It was the renowned Saintess Ren Yingying of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect.
Daughter of the previous Sect Leader Ren Woxing!
This Saintess, decisive and intelligent, was rumored to have been born with a Seven-Aperture Exquisite Heart.

sentences.text: The Battle of Luoyang City.
Countless deaths and injuries!
Corpses were scattered all over.
Rivers of blood flowed.
Such a shocking event spread throughout the land of Luoyang at an extremely fast pace.
Moreover, the battle between Ding Ling and Li Yuanba lasted quite long.
So, now some soldiers in Luoyang City have learned of the matter, and they are mobilizing troops, preparing to capture Ding Ling.
This was said by the Green Bamboo Elder.
What exactly is going on?
Ding Ling is not sure.
However, Ding Ling thought that this was the Great Ming world, and it seemed normal for a general to be furious and want to capture him.
Ding Ling also did not want to clash with the Great Ming Dynasty.
Naturally, he chose the 36th stratagem: running away is the best strategy!
He chose to leave with the Green Bamboo Elder.
Of course, Deng Bafeng and others from the Mount Songh Sect must also gather and leave with them.
Ding Ling also planned to have them lead the way to the Mount Songh Sect together.
On the way.
The Green Bamboo Elder followed alongside Ding Ling and said aloud:
"The generals of the Great Ming are very brave and good at battle.
General Wang, who is stationed in Luoyang City, is a formidable warrior, but he also witnessed from afar the battle between you and Li Yuanba.
He was so scared that he broke out in a sweat, and his spine turned cold."
"How do you know this?"
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t help but ask.
"Ha ha."
The Green Bamboo Elder smiled slightly and stroked his beard, saying:
"I am an old acquaintance of General Wang, and he told me personally.
He does not want to clash with Hero Ding, knowing full well that a peerless hero like Hero Ding cannot be captured by mere thousands or tens of thousands of troops.
But he has to give an explanation to the common people.
So, he will surely put on a show.
He hopes I can pass on the message to Hero Ding.
He means no harm.
He hopes that both sides can go their separate ways.
Once we part, it is best not to meet again."
General Wang saying such words.
Clearly shows he was scared!
One must know that at the level of powers like Li Yuanba and Ding Ling, entering a battle array is like entering an uninhabited realm!
Not to mention ten thousand men, even a hundred thousand men, in front of such peerless ’fierce men’ like Ding Ling and Li Yuanba, they can only kneel!
Because people like Ding Ling and Li Yuanba are not just unmatched in strength.
Their endurance, physique, and defense have reached a terrifying level!
Who can last longer?
Most likely, all ten thousand of Luoyang City’s defending troops would be knocked down by Ding Ling!
Yet Ding Ling would still be safe and sound!
General Wang evidently has remarkable cultivation, seeing this, how dare he provoke Ding Ling?
He couldn’t be more eager for Ding Ling, this godly figure, to go as far away as possible!
"So, as long as we cooperate well with General Wang, we can leave without anyone knowing."
The Green Bamboo Elder laughed and said:
"General Wang hopes we can be a bit discreet, avoid the main roads, and take some side paths.
There are many side paths in Luoyang City.
Once the situation calms down, later on, General Wang will collaborate with us to escort Hero Ding out of the city gate."
Ding Ling nodded, noncommittally.
At his current level of power.
Indeed, he does not fear ten thousand troops!
He once served as the Guardian God and First-Rank Prince in the Three Kingdoms.
In this world, he naturally has no interest in becoming a prince.
He only wants to become the strongest, shatter the void, and travel to another world, seeking more powerful martial arts, and continuously grow stronger.
Until he achieves immortality.
Truly invincible!
Two hours later.
With General Wang’s cooperation, Ding Ling and his party left the city.
After walking more than a dozen miles.
They came upon a refined and elegant courtyard.
The Green Bamboo Elder introduced:
"This is where my aunt is currently recuperating.
Come in with me."
He stepped forward and knocked on the heavy wooden gate of the courtyard.
After a few muffled sounds, a charming girl opened the door, poking her head out, and said:
"Green Bamboo Elder, has Hero Ding arrived?"
"Yes, yes."
The Green Bamboo Elder stepped aside to reveal Ding Ling and the others:
"See for yourself."
The charming girl was indeed overjoyed upon seeing Ding Ling.
She reached out, about to grab Ding Ling’s arm, but then suddenly pulled back, somewhat embarrassed, yet looking at Ding Ling with admiration:
"The world’s number one, Hero Ding, truly an extraordinary, heroic figure!
My lady will surely be very pleased to see you."
"Let’s go inside first."
The Green Bamboo Elder coughed dryly.
The charming girl realized and quickly smiled, leading the way, occasionally calling back to Ding Ling.
In her eyes, heart, and mouth, it seemed like it was all Ding Ling.
Completely ignoring people like Huang Zhonggong, Ding Jian, and others.
These people, once heroic figures themselves, naturally felt a bit melancholic being ignored.
But thinking about Ding Ling’s abilities, greatness, and fearsome prowess, they became resigned.
Putting oneself in their shoes, if they were in her place, they would probably only have eyes and heart for Ding Ling too.
Because compared to Ding Ling.
They weren’t even qualified to be supporting roles.
The gap was too vast.
Describing it as an abyssal difference wouldn’t be excessive at all.
Qu Feiyan and Lin Pingzhi witnessed this and felt joy in their hearts.
In their eyes, Ding Ling was everything.
Especially Qu Feiyan, who longed for her Brother Ding; Ding Ling receiving praise brought her more happiness and joy than receiving praise herself.
Tap tap!
The group walked on the stone-paved road.
Before long.
They arrived at the living room.
"Please wait a moment."
The girl prepared tea for Ding Ling and his companions, then covered her mouth with a laugh and said:
"My lady is probably doing her makeup now.
I’ll go call her to meet the guests."
"Thank you.
Ding Ling said.
"Hero Ding, you are too kind"
The girl was flattered:
"It is my honor to serve you."
After saying this.
She gracefully went to the inner room to find her lady.
It took just a moment.
The charming girl led out a woman with a graceful and slender figure.
The woman had a face like white jade, incredibly beautiful, a rare beauty in the world.
Her eyes swept over Ding Ling and his group like autumn water, finally fixing on Ding Ling.
She lightly opened her lips:
"Hero Ding?"
"Hero Ding is a title I dare not claim.
My surname is Ding, given name Ling.
You may call me Ding Ling."
Ding Ling, presentable and composed, sat at the left seat of honor, bearing the likeness of a mountain and the aura of an abyss, catching the eye of anyone upon first glance and drawing admiration.
This kind of presence is not something ordinary people possess.
The extraordinary beauty was not stingy with her praise, smiling slightly, she said:
"Before, seeing Hero Ding’s figure and demeanor from afar was already astonishing.
Seeing you up close now, it’s as if I’m in the presence of greatness!
Just from your poise and charisma, Hero Ding could stand at the pinnacle of the world, overlooking all living beings."
Huang Zhonggong and the others drank tea below, each with a slightly peculiar expression as they looked at the young woman.
This was because they recognized who she was.
Not someone else.
It was the renowned Saintess Ren Yingying of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect.
Daughter of the previous Sect Leader Ren Woxing!
This Saintess, decisive and intelligent, was rumored to have been born with a Seven-Aperture Exquisite Heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Linghu Chong’s Mixed Emotions
paragraphs: However, such a supreme woman.
Actually started flattering Ding Ling.
This inevitably made Huang Zhonggong and Dan Qingsheng feel dazed, thinking how unpredictable life can be!
Ding Ling and Ren Yingying’s conversation was rather smooth and natural.
Ren Yingying was a woman who knew how to talk. Under her intentional flattery and accommodation, their conversation naturally became pleasant, comfortable, and perfect.
Thus went on for half an hour.
Only then did Ren Yingying shift the topic, saying:
"Hero Ding knows I am called Ren Yingying, so you must have guessed who I am."
"Naturally."
Ding Ling nodded:
"The famous Saintess of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect. It must be you."
"Correct."
Ren Yingying slightly raised her eyebrows, chuckling charmingly, just about to say something, when the previous maid suddenly came out and said:
"Saintess, Young Master Linghu has arrived."
"Oh?"
Ren Yingying had no choice but to pause the conversation, saying:
"Is it Linghu Chong? Let him in."
She glanced at Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding shouldn’t mind, right?"
"You are the Saintess of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect; you don’t mind being with someone from the Huashan Sect, why would I mind?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
But he felt slightly surprised in his heart.
This storyline was completely different from the original.
How could Linghu Chong still be entangled with Ren Yingying?
It’s truly a strange event!
Could it be that Linghu Chong and Ren Yingying really have a romantic fate?
Ding Ling glanced at Ren Yingying, indeed a rare beauty. Any normal man would feel moved upon seeing her. Her looks completely matched the descriptions in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer!
But she bore no resemblance at all to the Ren Yingying in the TV series.
Such a beautiful woman.
In terms of appearance, she wasn’t much inferior to Xiao Qiao, showing just how breathtaking her beauty was.

When Ding Ling first saw her, his heart couldn’t help but skip a beat, but after his time in the Three Kingdoms World, being around Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao every day, he had developed a great resistance to beauties.
He no longer had the loser mentality of losing control over a beauty at first sight.
To him now.
If someone didn’t match his values and couldn’t make him genuinely admire them, just having an exceptionally beautiful exterior wasn’t enough to move him!
He was not that kind of lecherous man.
But a man with principles and vision.
Tap tap!
Accompanied by the sound of disorderly footsteps.
A man with sword-like brows on a square face, carefree and uninhibited, entered the living room under the maid’s lead.
This man was none other than Linghu Chong.

He seemed to have drunk wine, his face slightly flushed, appearing somewhat tipsy, striding quickly, not regarding this as a guest place, he walked to the center of the living room with poise and grace, slightly raising his head, his eyes looked at Ren Yingying, and laughed:
"That granny left me in the back courtyard without care. I’ve been waiting for you for over half an hour. Did you forget about me?"
Ren Yingying seemed to remember the appointment with Linghu Chong then, her face heating up slightly in embarrassment:
"Brother Linghu, I apologize. I’ve been focused on hosting Hero Ding, so I forgot about your matter. Please don’t mind."
"Hero Ding?"
Linghu Chong was taken aback:
"Which Hero Ding?"
"Haha."
Ren Yingying’s delicate white fingers pointed towards Ding Ling:
"That’s him. The invincible, unparalleled, world’s unrivaled Hero Ding Ling!"
"Ding Ling?!"

Linghu Chong’s heart skipped a beat, and whatever drunkenness he felt disappeared like cold water dousing him, he instantly sobered up, turning his eyes swiftly to the left, and indeed, the man he found unsettling, a man he still couldn’t like even after thinking for so long, sat in the left chief seat!
This man was Ding Ling.
Recently famed, widely heralded as the foremost hero in Jianghu Martial Arts!

When he first entered the living room, he was slightly tipsy and only had eyes for Ren Yingying, failing to notice Ding Ling there. Now, having seen him, his expression subtly changed, and he became slightly uncomfortable.
"Brother Linghu, please have a seat."
Ren Yingying smiled, gesturing for Linghu Chong to sit at the right chief seat.
Now separated from Ding Ling, there was less risk of a major conflict:
"Since you’ve arrived, after I finish my business with Ding Ling, I’ll talk with you."
Her sparkling almond-shaped eyes gazed at Linghu Chong, seemingly speaking:
"Brother Linghu, you don’t mind, do you?
"Not at all, not at all."
Linghu Chong felt quite uneasy, but with Ren Yingying directly addressing him, he couldn’t express it and had to pretend to laugh jovially:
"You two talk first. I’ll enjoy some wine here, which is indeed a great pleasure in the world."
"That’s good then."

Seeing this, Ren Yingying smiled slightly, as beautiful as a blooming peony, dazzling Linghu Chong, who momentarily became dazed, only to see Ren Yingying give him a simple glance then focus all her attention on Ding Ling, causing a slight twinge of jealousy in his heart.
Especially following that.
Seeing Ren Yingying showering Ding Ling with all kinds of praise, appreciation, and admiration without reservation.
This made Linghu Chong’s eyes bloodshot with jealousy, biting his teeth until they cracked audibly.
Fearing others would notice his anomaly, he buried his head slightly, sipping wine.
Becoming tipsy again.
He observed Ren Yingying’s flower-like charming smiling face, facing Ding Ling directly, her gem-like almond eyes fixated on Ding Ling, seemingly engraving him in her heart.
The sourness, envy, jealousy, and resentment surged through his mind, turning over a five-flavor bottle of emotions!
All kinds of flavors, sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, salty, flooded his heart.
For a moment.
He really felt like sitting on pins and needles, incredibly uncomfortable.
Once more.
Ren Yingying personally invited Ding Ling for a grand plan.
Ding Ling smiled and declined.
Ren Yingying didn’t get angry but suggested playing music with Ding Ling.

Thus Ding Ling brought out the "Smiling Proudly in the World" piece and performed a qin and flute duet with Ren Yingying, momentarily creating a harmonious scene that left onlookers staring in a daze.

It was Linghu Chong’s first time hearing such a rousing and melodic tune, stirring his emotions, and seeing Ren Yingying’s affectionate gaze solely fixed on Ding Ling, stirred his anger, the spinning drunkenness made him lose his mind.
He unexpectedly disregarded everything, banged the table, drew his sword, pointing at Ding Ling, saying loudly:

"Ding Ling, it is said that you excel in Martial Arts, whether archery, sword technique, or palm technique, you’re deemed the world’s number one. I lost to you before, but I’m not convinced. I’d like to solicit your expertise in sword techniques."
"Brother Linghu."
Ren Yingying was surprised and a bit displeased.
She thought she had reached a critical moment in talks with Ding Ling, and Linghu Chong’s interference puzzled her.
She regretted letting him attend this feast.
Ren Yingying felt a bit remorseful.

chapters.title: Chapter 354: Profound Celestial Finger Freezes Treasure Sword
paragraphs: Linghu Chong seems to have noticed the significant change in Ren Yingying’s attitude towards him.
He couldn’t help but feel increasingly bitter and distressed.
After wandering to Luoyang,
by chance he met Ren Yingying, went through life and death together, and it can be said that, in Linghu Chong’s eyes, Ren Yingying was no longer just an ordinary friend.
She had become a key figure, second only to his little junior sister.
Ren Yingying also seemed to highly value him.

These days she had been with him, chatting and laughing, discussing martial arts, playing the zither, or drinking, while being incredibly joyful, making Linghu Chong momentarily forget about all the unpleasant things that happened on Huashan.
He seemed to regard this place as a place to heal both physical and emotional wounds.
Just when he was deeply immersed and couldn’t extricate himself.
Ding Ling arrived.
Ren Yingying’s attention immediately shifted from him to Ding Ling.
How could Linghu Chong accept such a huge disparity?
His heart was bitter, and driven by irrational drunkenness, challenging Ding Ling was hardly surprising.
Ding Ling was somewhat surprised, but did not stand up, merely gazing at Linghu Chong with profound eyes and a calm face:
"Why should I accept your challenge?"
"Exactly."
Qu Feiyan also recognized Linghu Chong and said crisply:

"I remember you. A disciple of Huashan Sect who calls a filthy thief Tian Boguang brother! You really lack shame; previously Brother Ding spared your life, yet you want to compete again? What are you going to compete with?
If you are accidentally stabbed to death, the people from Huashan Sect will come to blame Brother Ding, this will never end.
Wouldn’t Brother Ding be at a great disadvantage?"

Linghu Chong also recognized the ’sharp-tongued’ Qu Feiyan, he became even more furious and resentful, especially when she mentioned his dealings with Tian Boguang in front of Ren Yingying, he was furious and embarrassed to the extreme.
In an instant, he disregarded his status, sprang up, and thrust a sword towards Qu Feiyan:
"Let me see how much Kung Fu you have, little girl with a sharp tongue."
"Humph!"
Ding Ling snorted coldly, gathered his energy, and pointed forward.
Profound Celestial Finger!

A wave of icy cold frost transformed into a white vapor stream, in the sound of a swoosh, it hit Linghu Chong’s treasure sword a few meters away, the cold air rapidly froze the treasure sword, even threatening to freeze Linghu Chong’s arm and body.
Linghu Chong shivered from the cold, his drunkenness immediately waned by three points, and upon realizing what had happened, he couldn’t help but groan and let go.
Plop!
The treasure sword fell to the ground.
Thump thump! It bounced a couple of times and then lay still.
Stomp stomp!
Linghu Chong rapidly retreated two steps.
Qu Feiyan was ashamed and furious, glanced gratefully at Ding Ling, then looked at Linghu Chong and said:

"A disciple from a respectable sect! Not only calling a filthy thief brother but also only knowing to bully the weak. Is a person like this also worthy of being called a righteous sect? I think it’s even worse than an evil sect!"
"You, you!"

Linghu Chong was furious at Qu Feiyan’s insult, he recalled earlier events at a tavern in Mount Heng Territory, his face fluctuated between green and white, and his gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly. He endured the pain of his frozen arm, walked aside, faced Ding Ling, and said loudly:

"I won’t bully the young girl anymore. I want a proper competition with Hero Ding, to prevent anyone from saying again that I bully the weak. You, Hero Ding, have peerless martial arts, surely you are not weak."
"Why should I compete with you?"
"What reason do you have not to compete with me?"
Linghu Chong flared with anger, pointing at Ding Ling:
"You have humiliated me publicly several times! I want revenge!"
"You speak directly and straightforwardly."
Ding Ling stood up, slightly looking down at Linghu Chong, said indifferently:
"You want to compete with me in sword technique?"
"Indeed."
Linghu Chong’s eyes shone brightly, his voice high and proud:
"I believe my sword technique is not bad and absolutely not weaker than yours. I want to defeat you in sword technique. Let you see what truly deserves to be called the number one sword technique!"
"Linghu Chong!"
Ren Yingying was somewhat unhappy, directly calling out Linghu Chong’s name:
"Is it right to provoke my guest like this?"
"I’m not provoking."

Seeing Ren Yingying’s attitude towards him growing colder, Linghu Chong’s heart likewise grew cold, he couldn’t help but think of the little junior sister on Huashan, and increasingly yearned for her, comparing her to Ren Yingying, his little junior sister was ultimately more important.
Thinking of this.
He no longer insisted on Ren Yingying’s attitude toward him, and turned to leave:
"Saintess is right. It’s indeed inappropriate for me to stay here. I’ll leave now."
He didn’t say hypocritical words like visiting another day.
Even the way he addressed Ren Yingying changed.
He didn’t want the treasure sword on the ground anymore.
Turned around and staggered away.
Ren Yingying watched, her expression a bit complicated, but did not stop him, only looking at Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding, I hope Linghu Chong did not cause you any displeasure. I truly did not intentionally arrange for him to provoke you. I really didn’t expect him to be so impulsive. It was my mistake."
That was indeed true.
She momentarily forgot her promise to Linghu Chong.
When Linghu Chong came to find her, she also felt a bit embarrassed, so she let Linghu Chong wait in the living room to deal with things with him after the current matter.
Unexpectedly.
Linghu Chong’s reaction towards Ding Ling was so intense.
Observing from this incident.
Linghu Chong had definitely been displeased with Ding Ling for a long time, and it exploded under pressure at this moment, which seemed understandable.
Ren Yingying’s heart was turbulent, somewhat annoyed.
Linghu Chong’s sudden outburst seemed to have tainted this negotiation.
She wondered what Ding Ling would think of her.
To prevent Ding Ling’s misunderstanding.
She explained repeatedly.
Ding Ling naturally understood, merely smiled with reassurance, indicating it was fine.
After Linghu Chong left and glanced back at this scene, his heart couldn’t help but tighten.
He smiled bitterly, thinking:
"Oh, Linghu Chong, who do you think you are? How can you believe Ren Yingying, this Saintess of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, would truly look up to you and fall for you!
Comparing yourself to Ding Ling. What advantages do you have?
People would look up to Ding Ling, place their bets on Ding Ling, focus on Ding Ling, what are you causing a stir here for? Ah~~"
Linghu Chong let out a long sigh.
The hazy drunkenness completely dissipated.
He turned his head away, not looking back, and walked afar.
He had ultimately overestimated his position in Ren Yingying’s heart.
Comparing himself to Ding Ling.
In Ren Yingying’s heart, he was probably worthless.
"Hero Ding Ling!!"
Linghu Chong’s eyes flashed with dread, hatred, and vigilance:

"I, Linghu Chong, will one day surpass you! And defeat you face to face, to show you, Ren Yingying, and all the heroes in the world, what truly deserves to be called a master of sword technique, what truly deserves to be called a young talent!"

Ding Ling was somewhat surprised, but did not stand up, merely gazing at Linghu Chong with profound eyes and a calm face:
"Why should I accept your challenge?"
"Exactly."
Qu Feiyan also recognized Linghu Chong and said crisply:
"I remember you.
A disciple of Huashan Sect who calls a filthy thief Tian Boguang brother!
You really lack shame; previously Brother Ding spared your life, yet you want to compete again?
What are you going to compete with?
If you are accidentally stabbed to death, the people from Huashan Sect will come to blame Brother Ding, this will never end.
Wouldn’t Brother Ding be at a great disadvantage?"

Linghu Chong also recognized the ’sharp-tongued’ Qu Feiyan, he became even more furious and resentful, especially when she mentioned his dealings with Tian Boguang in front of Ren Yingying, he was furious and embarrassed to the extreme.
In an instant, he disregarded his status, sprang up, and thrust a sword towards Qu Feiyan:
"Let me see how much Kung Fu you have, little girl with a sharp tongue."
"Humph!"
Ding Ling snorted coldly, gathered his energy, and pointed forward.
Profound Celestial Finger!

A wave of icy cold frost transformed into a white vapor stream, in the sound of a swoosh, it hit Linghu Chong’s treasure sword a few meters away, the cold air rapidly froze the treasure sword, even threatening to freeze Linghu Chong’s arm and body.
Linghu Chong shivered from the cold, his drunkenness immediately waned by three points, and upon realizing what had happened, he couldn’t help but groan and let go.
Plop!
The treasure sword fell to the ground.
Thump thump!
It bounced a couple of times and then lay still.
Stomp stomp!
Linghu Chong rapidly retreated two steps.
Qu Feiyan was ashamed and furious, glanced gratefully at Ding Ling, then looked at Linghu Chong and said:
"A disciple from a respectable sect!
Not only calling a filthy thief brother but also only knowing to bully the weak.
Is a person like this also worthy of being called a righteous sect?
I think it’s even worse than an evil sect!"
"You, you!"

Linghu Chong was furious at Qu Feiyan’s insult, he recalled earlier events at a tavern in Mount Heng Territory, his face fluctuated between green and white, and his gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly.
He endured the pain of his frozen arm, walked aside, faced Ding Ling, and said loudly:
"I won’t bully the young girl anymore.
I want a proper competition with Hero Ding, to prevent anyone from saying again that I bully the weak.
You, Hero Ding, have peerless martial arts, surely you are not weak."
"Why should I compete with you?"
"What reason do you have not to compete with me?"
Linghu Chong flared with anger, pointing at Ding Ling:
"You have humiliated me publicly several times!
I want revenge!"
"You speak directly and straightforwardly."
Ding Ling stood up, slightly looking down at Linghu Chong, said indifferently:
"You want to compete with me in sword technique?"
"Indeed."
Linghu Chong’s eyes shone brightly, his voice high and proud:
"I believe my sword technique is not bad and absolutely not weaker than yours.
I want to defeat you in sword technique.
Let you see what truly deserves to be called the number one sword technique!"
"Linghu Chong!"
Ren Yingying was somewhat unhappy, directly calling out Linghu Chong’s name:
"Is it right to provoke my guest like this?"
"I’m not provoking."

Seeing Ren Yingying’s attitude towards him growing colder, Linghu Chong’s heart likewise grew cold, he couldn’t help but think of the little junior sister on Huashan, and increasingly yearned for her, comparing her to Ren Yingying, his little junior sister was ultimately more important.
Thinking of this.
He no longer insisted on Ren Yingying’s attitude toward him, and turned to leave:
"Saintess is right.
It’s indeed inappropriate for me to stay here.
I’ll leave now."
He didn’t say hypocritical words like visiting another day.
Even the way he addressed Ren Yingying changed.
He didn’t want the treasure sword on the ground anymore.
Turned around and staggered away.
Ren Yingying watched, her expression a bit complicated, but did not stop him, only looking at Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding, I hope Linghu Chong did not cause you any displeasure.
I truly did not intentionally arrange for him to provoke you.
I really didn’t expect him to be so impulsive.
It was my mistake."
That was indeed true.
She momentarily forgot her promise to Linghu Chong.
When Linghu Chong came to find her, she also felt a bit embarrassed, so she let Linghu Chong wait in the living room to deal with things with him after the current matter.
Unexpectedly.
Linghu Chong’s reaction towards Ding Ling was so intense.
Observing from this incident.
Linghu Chong had definitely been displeased with Ding Ling for a long time, and it exploded under pressure at this moment, which seemed understandable.
Ren Yingying’s heart was turbulent, somewhat annoyed.
Linghu Chong’s sudden outburst seemed to have tainted this negotiation.
She wondered what Ding Ling would think of her.
To prevent Ding Ling’s misunderstanding.
She explained repeatedly.
Ding Ling naturally understood, merely smiled with reassurance, indicating it was fine.
After Linghu Chong left and glanced back at this scene, his heart couldn’t help but tighten.
He smiled bitterly, thinking:
"Oh, Linghu Chong, who do you think you are?
How can you believe Ren Yingying, this Saintess of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, would truly look up to you and fall for you!
Comparing yourself to Ding Ling.
What advantages do you have?
People would look up to Ding Ling, place their bets on Ding Ling, focus on Ding Ling, what are you causing a stir here for?
Ah~~"
Linghu Chong let out a long sigh.
The hazy drunkenness completely dissipated.
He turned his head away, not looking back, and walked afar.
He had ultimately overestimated his position in Ren Yingying’s heart.
Comparing himself to Ding Ling.
In Ren Yingying’s heart, he was probably worthless.
"Hero Ding Ling!!"
Linghu Chong’s eyes flashed with dread, hatred, and vigilance:
"I, Linghu Chong, will one day surpass you!

And defeat you face to face, to show you, Ren Yingying, and all the heroes in the world, what truly deserves to be called a master of sword technique, what truly deserves to be called a young talent!"

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Promise and Oath
paragraphs: Ding Ling had no idea what Linghu Chong was thinking.
But even if he knew, he wouldn’t care much.
If he got on his nerves,
he’d slap him to death.
Clean and tidy!
He didn’t kill him on the spot for two reasons: firstly, he felt shedding blood as a guest was inappropriate;

secondly, since Linghu Chong could possibly be an inheritor of the Dugu Nine Swords, if he killed Linghu Chong, and players spread the news, once Feng Qingyang found out, it would create a rift, and he wouldn’t pass on the Dugu Nine Swords to him, wouldn’t that be troublesome?

Thirdly, he originally wanted to see whether Linghu Chong indeed knew the Dugu Nine Swords, and if he did, provoking Linghu Chong and gambling with Dugu Nine Swords as a stake wasn’t a bad idea, but it seemed this thought was in vain.
Ren Yingying cared too much about Ding Ling’s thoughts and face.
She scolded Linghu Chong just to protect Ding Ling.

This made Linghu Chong’s heart grow cold, and he lost interest in dueling, abandoning his sword and leaving. Ding Ling couldn’t possibly chase after Linghu Chong, yelling to fight and kill at that moment.
’Forget it, Linghu Chong is extremely weak, I can crush him with a flick of the wrist, there’s no rush.’
Ding Ling stopped thinking about Linghu Chong.
In the blink of an eye,
a day had passed.
During this day,
Ren Yingying repeatedly made friendly gestures.
And discussed subjects beyond martial arts, like music, chess, calligraphy, and painting with Ding Ling!
As a result, Ren Yingying was naturally disappointed.
Yet she wasn’t frustrated; instead, she grew more excited, happier, and in front of everyone praised Ding Ling more than once:
"I’ve long heard Hero Ding, you’re the All-Purpose King, and now I see the rumors are true! You’re truly incredible. I’m beginning to idolize you."
Qu Feiyan, watching and listening from the side, couldn’t help but roll her eyes.
Consort Yhu, seeing this, covered her mouth and lightly laughed, gently shaking Qu Feiyan’s arm, signaling her not to take it to heart.
Qu Feiyan naturally didn’t take it to heart.
She just thought Ren Yingying was somewhat exaggerated. Was this the same scheming, extraordinary Saintess in her memory and impression?!
She found it incredible.
But thinking of her Brother Ding’s extraordinary abilities.
She was reassured.
Her Brother Ding wasn’t scared of poison, and someone like Zuo Lengchan was easily killed when he was prepared.
It’s understandable for Ren Yingying to go all out to recruit him.
Yet it was so exaggerated.
A bit unladylike, is this really okay?
Is this okay?
Ren Yingying wasn’t sure either.
She didn’t want to act this way.
But thinking of her father’s countless exhortations, she had no choice but to calm down and continue negotiating with Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling simply wouldn’t budge.
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but start questioning herself:
"Has my charm declined to the point where men can ignore me?!"
She was so proactive.
Even took the initiative to hold Ding Ling’s hand when he was about to leave, her intentions were more than obvious.
Yet Ding Ling remained unmoved.
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but grow more anxious and worried, and after chatting for two hours,
Ding Ling said, ’I’ve stayed a day, I must leave today.’
Ren Yingying finally couldn’t hold back, stepped forward to block Ding Ling, and said seriously:

"Hero Ding, let’s be straightforward. I’ll speak honestly. We’ve spent countless resources on you because we sincerely hope you’ll join us. Help us defeat Dongfang Bubai, unite Jianghu, and return Jianghu to a peaceful time!
I believe my father can accomplish this!
And I hope you can join us.
Once you join, you’ll be second to none. You can even become the Sun and Moon Divine Sect’s Vice Sect Leader. This is clearly stated in the latest letter my father sent me.
I hope you won’t reject right away, but consider it carefully."
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"Thank you, Sect Leader Ren and Miss Ren, for your kindness. I’ve thought about it carefully. I’m not suited to join the Sun and Moon Divine Sect."
"Why?!"
Ren Yingying was shocked, her color changed:
"Is it because you look down on the Sun and Moon Divine Sect and consider us a Demon Sect? Or do you look down on my father and me?"
"Neither,"
Ding Ling answered frankly:
"My ambition is to shatter the void. Perhaps soon, I’ll leave this world. Joining the Sun and Moon Divine Sect really isn’t necessary."
"Truly?"
"It’s naturally true."
"This, this..."
For a moment, Ren Yingying couldn’t help but be dazed, her mind was a chaotic mess, filled with thoughts of ’how did things turn out this way, what should I do now?’
She was out of ideas for the moment, but she just didn’t want to let Ding Ling go.
Ding Ling was helpless.
He couldn’t bring himself to attack Ren Yingying.
Ren Yingying had been too kind to him.
Various gifts, great medicine, tonic wines.
Even when staying here as a guest, he was given the utmost hospitality.
With such considerate attention, how could Ding Ling bear to act?
He could only contemplate for a while, then coughed lightly and said helplessly:

"I can’t guarantee other things. Within a few months, I will certainly seek out Dongfang Bubai once and defeat him head-on. Consider this repaying some of Sect Leader Ren’s and Miss Ren’s great kindness. How about that?"
"This..."
Ren Yingying hesitated.
"I am determined not to join the Sun and Moon Divine Sect because I won’t be in this world for long."
Seeing Ding Ling mention this again.
Considering Ding Ling’s status as a Void Shatterer.
Seeing Qu Feiyan’s desolate expression.
Ren Yingying was sure Ding Ling wasn’t lying, and for a moment, she couldn’t help feeling complex emotions, her Sea of Consciousness filled with turbulent thoughts!
After spending just over a day with Ding Ling,
Ren Yingying was completely won over by Ding Ling.
She initially planned to capture Ding Ling’s heart.

In the end, her own heart was almost captured by Ding Ling, leading her to secretly sigh, scolding herself for being incompetent, not having a single skill that could compare to Ding Ling’s and after being repeatedly subdued and suppressed, she couldn’t help developing an inexplicable fondness for Ding Ling.
She knew this might be an extraordinary admiration for the opposite sex.
She rarely admired someone like this.
Ding Ling was the first and the only one.
So, when she saw Ding Ling really about to leave,
her heart inevitably felt empty, and a strong unwillingness to part arose!
Half an hour later.
When she saw Ding Ling and his group mount horses and bid her farewell, she even felt a strong impulse to leave with Ding Ling.
But she knew this wasn’t rational.
She forcibly suppressed this emotion and forced a smile, waving goodbye to Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding, don’t forget your promise. I’ll be waiting for you at Black Wood Cliff!"
"Don’t worry, it won’t be more than a year!"
Ding Ling rode off, his voice drifting farther and farther:
"Miss Ren, until we meet again!"
"I’ll be waiting for you to come!"
Ren Yingying took a few steps forward and shouted loudly, but received no response.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: The Vice Sect Leader of Mount Songh Sect’s Path of Self-Destruction
paragraphs: "He just left like that."
Ren Yingying felt a sense of loss.
Green Bamboo Elder sighed:
"Ding Ling is truly a peerless talent. Trying to win him over with mere external things would be difficult. Unless through kinship, love, or friendship."
"Love..."
Ren Yingying’s jade-like face flushed slightly red. She glanced at Green Bamboo Elder, not hiding anything, frankly saying:
"I genuinely admire such a great man like Ding Ling. After all, searching through Jiuzhou, it’s hard to find anyone who can match him.
If I could unite with such a heroic man, I believe my father would be pleased.
Unfortunately..."
She felt a bit melancholic:
"It seems Ding Ling doesn’t fancy me."
"Aunt, you’re belittling yourself."
Green Bamboo Elder sized up Ren Yingying, listing her qualities one by one, finally concluding:
"Aunt is as beautiful as a fairy, stunningly gorgeous. Any man would like you. How can you be sure that if you actively pursue, Ding Ling would definitely reject you?"
"Really?"
Ren Yingying, a resolute and decisive woman, found herself flustered and undecided when it came to love at this moment:
"How should I pursue him?"
"You know, I have no experience. But you might not be. Given your age, you’ve been through a lot and seen a lot. Maybe you have some insights into love."
"This..."
Green Bamboo Elder was speechless, finally saying:
"I can only say, I don’t understand love much either. But I’ve heard a saying: Love arises unknowingly and grows deep. When love reaches its peak, one may die for it or come back to life."

If true affection grows, despite being thousands of miles apart, you will meet! Even after reincarnation in hundreds of lives, one day perhaps you’ll fall in love with each other at first sight amid the vast sea of people!"
"Really?"
Ren Yingying looked at Green Bamboo Elder suspiciously:
"It feels like you’re pretending to understand."
Green Bamboo Elder shrugged, sighing:
"I told you, I don’t understand it much!"
Ding Ling’s group hurriedly hastened their journey.
In less than a day.
They arrived at the foot of Mount Songh.
At that moment.
The Great Sun was just rising.
Golden sunlight spread across the earth.
Ding Ling could clearly see the chaos at the foot of Mount Songh.
Ding Ling felt a jolt in his heart.
He sent Deng Bafeng to inquire.
Deng Bafeng quickly returned, respectfully reporting:

"Hero Ding, the news of Sect Leader Zuo and Li Yuanba’s deaths has already been spread. Now Mount Songh Sect is in turmoil, with people fighting over items everywhere. However, the Thirteen Grand Protectors are suppressing it, so the chaos is only small-scale and still controllable."
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
He was truly worried that the Mount Songh Sect’s Treasure Vault that he had set his sights on would be plundered by others.
Thus, after staying a day at Ren Yingying’s place.
He couldn’t stay any longer.
Anxiously heading towards Mount Songh Sect.
Fortunately, despite the delay.
Everything remained within controllable limits, which was manageable.
He signaled Deng Bafeng to lead the way ahead.
Deng Bafeng was obedient, clearly determined to align with Ding Ling, energetically leading a group of disciples ahead.
Encountering those who dared to obstruct, he would loudly reprimand them.
Cooperative disciples, he allowed them to join his team.
Those who dared to directly confront him were simply cut down by him.
Fortunately, such hard-boned individuals were few.
In addition, Deng Bafeng, as one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors, held significant status and prestige within Mount Songh Sect.

Some disciples saw Deng Bafeng leading a grand procession of over a hundred disciples, initially softening their stance, and after being scolded by Deng Bafeng, dared not resist, voluntarily joining the team.
Thus.
Deng Bafeng’s team gradually grew like a snowball.
By the time they reached Mount Songh Sect’s mountain gate.
The team had already grown to over two hundred people.
A sect, gathering scattered disciples outside the mountain gate, amounted to so many.
This doesn’t even account for those killed in Luoyang and disciples scattered within Mount Songh Sect.
Judging by this hint.
One can imagine, the immense influence of Mount Songh Sect, easily enough to crush other sects.

No wonder Sect Leader Zuo was ambitious to unite the Five Mountains Sword Sect, leveraging countless experts from both the orthodox and unorthodox factions, the sheer number of people within his sect is comparatively substantial compared to Huashan Sect and others.
"Deng Bafeng!"
A booming shout came from afar, roaring like thunder.
With the falling voice.
A figure swiftly approached from afar like a whirlwind.
At a closer look.
Only to see this person’s features were handsome, demeanor graceful, yet clearly talented.
Although somewhat aged, it couldn’t conceal his exceptional charm.
However, at this moment, he wore a face full of anger, clothes rustling in the fierce wind, hair billowing wildly, adding to his bold and overbearing aura.
"Tangg Ying’e!"
Deng Bafeng seemed to recognize this person, screamed in surprise, retreated several feet, only felt safe standing behind Ding Ling.
Seeing Qu Feiyan and others staring.
Deng Bafeng felt quite embarrassed, but thick-skinned, he didn’t care, peeking half his head from behind Ding Ling, earnestly watching Tangg Ying’e:
"Tangg Ying’e, you’re the Vice Sect Leader of Mount Songh Sect! It’s good you came."
He pointed to Ding Ling:
"This is the unmatched, towering, invincible, World’s Number One Ding Ling, Hero Ding! Why don’t you come and pay your respects to Hero Ding instead of dawdling there!"
Tangg Ying’e’s face froze with fury, then burst out in anger, drew his sword, rushing towards Deng Bafeng like the wind:
"Deng Bafeng, you shameless scoundrel. I, Tangg Ying’e, will clean up the sect today. Irrelevant people, scatter quickly!"
His voice was like Thunderbolt.
With one booming shout.
Startled numerous outer disciples of Mount Songh Sect to scatter, clearing a path of Heaven-Reaching Dao.
Allowing Tangg Ying’e to smoothly reach Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling standing barehanded before Deng Bafeng, not dodging, he laughed heartily:
"A bold fellow indeed. Just right, I’ll finish you off too!"
He had heard of Ding Ling’s deeds.
Knew Ding Ling was the one who murdered Zhang Jingchao and others!
Also knew Ding Ling killed Zuo Lengchan and Li Yuanba.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, his heart was filled with fear.
But recalling the recently taught Divine Skill and Inner Strength.
His strength soared, incomparable to the past.
Even if confronting Sect Leader Zuo himself, he was confident of defeating him easily!
Since then, his confidence surged immensely.
Despite this imparting of skills, which would cut others’ lifespan and power;
Similarly, it would diminish his meridians and lifespan, utterly severing his Martial Dao prospects, not to mention the impermanence of this skill.
But fundamentally, he aimed for timely enhancement to safeguard Mount Songh Sect.
He initially thought he would meet Ding Ling and Deng Bafeng after some time.
Unexpectedly, he saw them today.
Ecstatically overjoyed, he couldn’t help himself.
His power couldn’t last long, now was his strongest moment, yet Ding Ling and company coincidentally arrived.

"I told you, I don’t understand it much!"
Ding Ling’s group hurriedly hastened their journey.
In less than a day.
They arrived at the foot of Mount Songh.
At that moment.
The Great Sun was just rising.
Golden sunlight spread across the earth.
Ding Ling could clearly see the chaos at the foot of Mount Songh.
Ding Ling felt a jolt in his heart.
He sent Deng Bafeng to inquire.
Deng Bafeng quickly returned, respectfully reporting:
"Hero Ding, the news of Sect Leader Zuo and Li Yuanba’s deaths has already been spread.
Now Mount Songh Sect is in turmoil, with people fighting over items everywhere.
However, the Thirteen Grand Protectors are suppressing it, so the chaos is only small-scale and still controllable."
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
He was truly worried that the Mount Songh Sect’s Treasure Vault that he had set his sights on would be plundered by others.
Thus, after staying a day at Ren Yingying’s place.
He couldn’t stay any longer.
Anxiously heading towards Mount Songh Sect.
Fortunately, despite the delay.
Everything remained within controllable limits, which was manageable.
He signaled Deng Bafeng to lead the way ahead.
Deng Bafeng was obedient, clearly determined to align with Ding Ling, energetically leading a group of disciples ahead.
Encountering those who dared to obstruct, he would loudly reprimand them.
Cooperative disciples, he allowed them to join his team.
Those who dared to directly confront him were simply cut down by him.
Fortunately, such hard-boned individuals were few.
In addition, Deng Bafeng, as one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors, held significant status and prestige within Mount Songh Sect.

Some disciples saw Deng Bafeng leading a grand procession of over a hundred disciples, initially softening their stance, and after being scolded by Deng Bafeng, dared not resist, voluntarily joining the team.
Thus.
Deng Bafeng’s team gradually grew like a snowball.
By the time they reached Mount Songh Sect’s mountain gate.
The team had already grown to over two hundred people.
A sect, gathering scattered disciples outside the mountain gate, amounted to so many.
This doesn’t even account for those killed in Luoyang and disciples scattered within Mount Songh Sect.
Judging by this hint.
One can imagine, the immense influence of Mount Songh Sect, easily enough to crush other sects.

No wonder Sect Leader Zuo was ambitious to unite the Five Mountains Sword Sect, leveraging countless experts from both the orthodox and unorthodox factions, the sheer number of people within his sect is comparatively substantial compared to Huashan Sect and others.
"Deng Bafeng!"
A booming shout came from afar, roaring like thunder.
With the falling voice.
A figure swiftly approached from afar like a whirlwind.
At a closer look.
Only to see this person’s features were handsome, demeanor graceful, yet clearly talented.
Although somewhat aged, it couldn’t conceal his exceptional charm.
However, at this moment, he wore a face full of anger, clothes rustling in the fierce wind, hair billowing wildly, adding to his bold and overbearing aura.
"Tangg Ying’e!"
Deng Bafeng seemed to recognize this person, screamed in surprise, retreated several feet, only felt safe standing behind Ding Ling.
Seeing Qu Feiyan and others staring.
Deng Bafeng felt quite embarrassed, but thick-skinned, he didn’t care, peeking half his head from behind Ding Ling, earnestly watching Tangg Ying’e:
"Tangg Ying’e, you’re the Vice Sect Leader of Mount Songh Sect!
It’s good you came."
He pointed to Ding Ling:
"This is the unmatched, towering, invincible, World’s Number One Ding Ling, Hero Ding!
Why don’t you come and pay your respects to Hero Ding instead of dawdling there!"
Tangg Ying’e’s face froze with fury, then burst out in anger, drew his sword, rushing towards Deng Bafeng like the wind:
"Deng Bafeng, you shameless scoundrel.
I, Tangg Ying’e, will clean up the sect today.
Irrelevant people, scatter quickly!"
His voice was like Thunderbolt.
With one booming shout.
Startled numerous outer disciples of Mount Songh Sect to scatter, clearing a path of Heaven-Reaching Dao.
Allowing Tangg Ying’e to smoothly reach Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling standing barehanded before Deng Bafeng, not dodging, he laughed heartily:
"A bold fellow indeed.
Just right, I’ll finish you off too!"
He had heard of Ding Ling’s deeds.
Knew Ding Ling was the one who murdered Zhang Jingchao and others!
Also knew Ding Ling killed Zuo Lengchan and Li Yuanba.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, his heart was filled with fear.
But recalling the recently taught Divine Skill and Inner Strength.
His strength soared, incomparable to the past.
Even if confronting Sect Leader Zuo himself, he was confident of defeating him easily!
Since then, his confidence surged immensely.
Despite this imparting of skills, which would cut others’ lifespan and power;
Similarly, it would diminish his meridians and lifespan, utterly severing his Martial Dao prospects, not to mention the impermanence of this skill.
But fundamentally, he aimed for timely enhancement to safeguard Mount Songh Sect.
He initially thought he would meet Ding Ling and Deng Bafeng after some time.
Unexpectedly, he saw them today.
Ecstatically overjoyed, he couldn’t help himself.
His power couldn’t last long, now was his strongest moment, yet Ding Ling and company coincidentally arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: Palm Print Shatters the Heart
paragraphs: Especially upon seeing that Ding Ling was not holding a weapon, Tangg Ying’e was stunned, furious, then wildly ecstatic, unable to refrain from looking up to the sky and laughing loudly:
"When King Yama wants you dead by three, he won’t keep you alive till five. Ding Ling, your arrogance and conceit; today is the day you die!"
"Die for me!"
The Seventeen Paths of Mount Song Swordsmanship unfurled!
Every move was majestic! Like rivers rushing, like a waterfall pounding the earth!
At this moment, Tangg Ying’e’s inner strength was at its supreme! At its strongest! Mighty to the utmost!
Urged by inner strength.
This Seventeen Paths of Mount Song Swordsmanship became deadly with every move, every sword forcing one’s soul!
Deng Bafeng, just watching from behind, couldn’t help but have his hairs stand on end, feeling a sense of oppression and dread as if visited by the Death God!
While he found it hard to believe that Tangg Ying’e was so strong, Ding Ling calmly extended his palm!
Great Yin Yang Hand Seal!

As the palm was extended, vigorous qi and true qi fused, a thunderous sound erupted, and a rotating Yin Yang Grinding Disc manifested in Ding Ling’s palm, descending as Ding Ling struck out with his palm.
Rumble!
It seemed like an apocalyptic grinding disc descended on the world, with flashing thunder, and Xun Wind rising, accompanied by a loud explosion.
The Great Yin Yang Hand Seal collided with Tangg Ying’e’s Treasure Sword.
In just an instant.
Crack!
The Treasure Sword was unexpectedly snapped in an instant by an explosive force!

Amid Tangg Ying’e’s astonishment, terror, confusion, and incomprehension, the Great Yin Yang Hand Seal, unstoppable like a force amidst dry trees, broke the Treasure Sword and, carrying its fragments, bang! Landed, neither lightly nor heavily, on Tangg Ying’e’s chest!
Without causing any disturbance.
Yet it directly left a large handprint on Tangg Ying’e’s chest!
Made his chest sink an inch, causing his entire skeleton to uncontrollably fly backward!
He floated powerlessly in mid-air.
Blood uncontrollably seeped from the corner of his mouth.
His eyes were filled with bewilderment and terror:
’How is it possible?!’
"I clearly sacrificed my future and life span, temporarily breaking through the limits and reaching the legendary Innate Realm! How could I lose so quickly?!"
"Is this an illusion?!"
He clearly remembered that when he wielded the Seventeen Paths of Mount Song Swordsmanship, he was unbeatable, making Fei Bin, Lu Bai, and others unable to resist!
But why?
Couldn’t he defeat the unarmed Ding Ling?
He was easily killed by one of his palms?
Tangg Ying’e knew he was near death because his heart had been shattered by this palm.
The opponent was too strong.
Strong to a bizarre, unimaginable realm.
"Ding Ling..."
"Is he human, ghost, or god?"
Bam!
Tangg Ying’e’s body fell heavily to the ground, rolled a few times, and then stopped moving.
Clearly, he had completely perished.
Deng Bafeng looked incredulously at this scene.
Just now, Tangg Ying’e’s aura and momentum were so powerful, and yet he just died like that?!
When he looked at Ding Ling, his gaze grew more reverent.
And he felt increasingly fortunate.
Luckily, he had kneeled and surrendered early.
Otherwise.
Zuo Lengchan and Tangg Ying’e would be his fate.
He did not want to die.
[Achievement Medal: Intimidated Tangg Ying’e.]
[Annotation: As the Vice Sect Leader of Mount Songh Sect, Tangg Ying’e usually kept a low profile. Yet his power was extremely profound, and his feelings for Mount Songh Sect were deep.
He agreed to the Shaolin Temple monk’s proposal at any cost.

By sacrificing his future and lifespan, he gained temporary Innate Realm strength. However, even so, you easily killed him. He died with reluctance, bewilderment, and terror. He died without closing his eyes!]
Tangg Ying’e indeed died without closing his eyes.
When Ding Ling passed by his corpse, he saw those round eyes wide open.
His eyes still held complex emotions like confusion, perplexity, shock, and fear.
It was evident that at his death, he had felt a multitude of emotions!
Ding Ling merely glanced and then looked away.
If you want to kill him.
You must be prepared to be killed by him.
No matter who it is.

The Mount Songh Sect regarded him as a mortal enemy, and Zuo Lengchan even set up a ’deathtrap’ against him. If he hadn’t drunk the ’Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine’, with increased poison resistance at that time.
And with the Full Level Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, combined with the Full Level Medicine King Breathing Technique, having certain anti-poison and healing effects.
He might have died back then!
Thinking about it.

Ding Ling couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat, then felt grateful toward Blue Phoenix. Of course, he also knew that Blue Phoenix gave him the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine purely because of Ren Yingying.
So, the things he promised Ren Yingying, he would definitely do. Dongfang Bubai... the world’s number one master, even just for the task, he would have to challenge him for sure!
Clack, clack!
Ding Ling went ahead.
Deng Bafeng, fawning slightly behind by half a step, constantly pointing the way.
They were heading towards the Main Hall of the Mount Songh Sect.
A moment later.
Ding Ling and his group passed through the mountain gate, walked down a corridor, and reached the expansive practice ground in front of the Main Hall.
Here.
Ding Ling saw Fei Bin and Lu Bai.
Compared to before, Fei Bin had become much leaner, but his eyes were sharper, looking at Ding Ling with deep-seated hatred.
Lu Bai’s face was as gloomy as ever, looking at Ding Ling like an enemy that could not coexist under the same sky.
On the left and right sides of Fei Bin and Lu Bai, stood several men with extraordinary auras and different appearances.
Consort Yhu stared at a bald, thin-faced man on Lu Bai’s right and said:
"Sha Tianjiang!"

Qu Feiyan looked at him, remembered it in her heart, and thought: This Sha Tianjiang and Zhang Jingchao are really bad. Even a good woman like Sister Yu Ji, they want to bully. Who knows how many evil deeds they’ve done or how many young women they’ve bullied; they deserve to die.
"Fei Bin, Lu Bai, Sha Tianjiang, Sima De, Zhao Sihai..."
Before Fei Bin or Ding Ling could speak.
Deng Bafeng jumped out eagerly, pointed at Fei Bin and the others, and shouted loudly:
"The invincible Divine Skill, unparalleled and unprecedented Supreme Hero Ding Ling, Hero Ding is here; why aren’t you rushing over to pay your respects, standing there for what?!"
As soon as these words came out.
Huang Zhonggong and others felt ashamed, thinking Deng Bafeng was becoming more adept at flattering, and compared to him, they, the few old undead, seemed unable to speak.
Fei Bin and his crew were visibly stunned; then they got angry collectively, each furious, pointing at Deng Bafeng, shouting in reprimand:
"Deng Bafeng, you traitorous dog! Once we deal with Ding Ling, we’ll dismember you, flay you, and remove your bones to satisfy our hatred!"
Deng Bafeng appeared nervous at first but remembering Ding Ling was now his backer, he grew courageous, laughed heartily three times, his eyes appearing filled with contempt, scorn.
