chapters.title: Chapter 358: Drumming Golden Hammer Shatters the Sword Array
paragraphs: "Fei Bin, Lu Bai... your time to die is today, yet you dare to boast here, truly stupid beyond measure. Considering past camaraderie, I kindly warned you, but you took my good intentions for donkey liver and lungs; you deserve today’s calamity!"
Deng Bafeng’s voice rang clear, shaking the eight directions.
To Fei Bin’s group, it was infuriating, like one Buddha emerged and two Buddhas attained Nirvana!
Immediately, someone jumped out, sword pointed at Deng Bafeng:
"Deng, you dog! If you’ve got the guts, come and duel me. See if it’s your mouth that’s sharper or my sword."
"Haha."
Deng Bafeng mocked:
"Sha Tianjiang, you refuse to heed good advice; you’re about to die. Why should I tangle with a dying man? Save your strength to beg a few more words from King Yama!"
"Deng Bafeng!"
Sha Tianjiang was furious.
Ding Ling gestured behind him.
Dan Qingsheng and Ding Jian immediately moved the Drumming Golden Hammer to Ding Ling’s side.
Ding Ling reached out and grabbed the handle of the Drumming Golden Hammer.

Activating the Four Great Breathing Techniques, Pure Yang True Skill, he operated the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, and in an instant, the Drumming Golden Hammer was lightly lifted, like scattering leaves or rice.
Dan Qingsheng and Ding Jian watched, faces slightly reddened, feeling inferior.
They could lift such a heavy weapon, but could not hold it for long, requiring two people to carry it.
Ding Ling lifted it easily alone, naturally making them notice again the huge gap between them and Ding Ling.
Ding Ling walked towards Fei Bin and Lu Bai, holding the Drumming Golden Hammer.
Swish, swish!
Fei Bin and Lu Bai seemed extremely fearful of Ding Ling, instinctively stepping back two steps.
But soon.
They regained their composure, faces burning with shame, and then each shouted loudly, leaping into the Sword Array, activating it. Boom!
Vast waves of Sword Qi raged in all directions.
As if tens of thousands of Divine Swords were swirling above the martial field.
Fei Bin stationed at the center, eyes sharp as knives looked at Ding Ling, as if they wanted to carve out his heart:
"Ding, you thieving dog! If you dare to charge into this Sword Array, I guarantee you’ll die without a burial place!"
Swish, swish!
The Sword Array fully activated.
Disciples of Mount Songh Sect walked throughout the Sword Array, making it resemble a rotating giant sharp Sword Wheel!
This Sword Wheel, sharp Sword Qi everywhere, seemingly flawless.
Deng Bafeng was taken aback:
"How could there be such a Sword Array in the sect?!"
"Hahaha..."
Lu Bai laughed:
"Deng Bafeng, you dog, there are many things and objects you don’t know about! If you dare to come and take a stroll, I’ll proudly call you Master Deng! Pity you’re gutless!"
Clang, clang, clang!
The Sword Wheel spun faster, Sword Qi on the martial field capturing the heart and soul, the dazzling sword light mesmerizing and divine.
Dan Qingsheng and others watched, hearts pounding with fear.
They hadn’t expected such a situation here, and for a while, couldn’t help but worry.
Ding Ling just laughed heartily, holding the Drumming Golden Hammer, not hurrying nor slowing as he approached the Sword Array.
"Hahaha..."
Fei Bin also laughed:
"Ding Ling, you thieving dog. You’ve got guts! Just for that, I respect you, but alas, alas, today you’re destined to die."
"Hehe."
Ding Ling only sneered, not speaking, eyes fixed intently on the Sword Array.

The Full-Level Eight Array Map Explanation, Initial Tier Array Dao Explanation, Middle-tier Array Dao Explanation, and Full-level Star Gazing Skill from Three Kingdoms World showed unmatched effectiveness at this moment.
Ding Ling saw through the grade of the Sword Array with a glance.
Just at the Middle-Tier Sword Array level.
Such an array.
For Ding Ling, it was not tough to break.
He continued forward.
Eyes like an eagle’s, shining brightly, he saw both the path of life within the Sword Array and the path of death.
Take the path of life.
To avoid the heart-piercing Sword Qi.
"The moment I stepped into this martial field, I sensed something was amiss, so I didn’t act rashly."
"Now it’s clear, these guys were indeed prepared all along, waiting for me."

"Hehe, Tangg Ying’e confident and arrogant, eager to crush me with absolute strength. Fei Bin’s group is quite cautious, intending to use the full power of Mount Songh Sect’s Inner Sect combined with this Sword Array to kill me."
Alas.
All this will be futile.
"I finally spotted the opening of the Life Gate!"
"The time is now!"
Boom!
Ding Ling moved.
Vigorous Qi and True Qi fused.
His speed became ghostly, indistinguishable to the naked eye, in the blink of an eye seeming to teleport over sixty to seventy meters like a cannonball, lightning-fast, unbelievably!
Fei Bin and others hadn’t even reacted.
Ding Ling had already raised the Drumming Golden Hammer, striking at the Life Gate’s opening of the Sword Array.
This opening was extremely small.
The average person couldn’t see it, while a First-class expert might spend days to locate it and still might not crack it.
But Ding Ling chose to break it with force.
A hammer fell.
Boom!
Boom-boom-boom!

The Life Gate shook with booming thunderous cracking sounds, Fei Bin, Lu Bai, and others’ eyes twitched wildly, unable to resist looking over, and upon seeing this, they were immensely shocked and terrified.
Only to see Ding Ling.
With one hammer strike, breaking through the Life Gate’s opening, stepping into the Life Gate, unleashing havoc!
Boom-boom!
Boom-boom-boom!
Ding Ling charged left and right, rampant and unruly, his Drumming Golden Hammer swung emitting booming thunderous sounds, and in the void, all he surveyed was filled with the hammer’s image!
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Exhibited by Ding Ling exquisitely.
Even more domineering, fierce, and wild than Li Yuanba!
His True Qi far surpassing Li Yuanba’s Inner Strength, after the fusion of True Qi and Vigorous Qi, erupting power, terrifying like ancient beasts roaring, crashing onto the world!
Boom-boom!
The Drumming Golden Hammer wielded by Ding Ling like a whirlwind of hammer blows, unassailable and unmatched!
Wherever he passed.
The Sword Array collapsed!
Sword Qi scattered!
The elite disciples toppled and cried out in despair!
Bang-bang-bang!
Some disciples were hit directly by the Drumming Golden Hammer, immediately reduced to pulp!

Some disciples were swept by the hammer’s tail, screamed, helplessly thrown dozens of meters away, and with a resounding crash, landed heavily on the ground, left with only the breath coming in, none going out!
Ding Ling devastated all along the way!
Like a worldly emperor leading an invincible army sweeping over a nation!
In just three blinks of an eye.
Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer killed and injured countless elite disciples of Mount Songh Sect, finally thundering towards Fei Bin at the center of the Sword Array!

Clang, clang, clang!
The Sword Wheel spun faster, Sword Qi on the martial field capturing the heart and soul, the dazzling sword light mesmerizing and divine.
Dan Qingsheng and others watched, hearts pounding with fear.
They hadn’t expected such a situation here, and for a while, couldn’t help but worry.
Ding Ling just laughed heartily, holding the Drumming Golden Hammer, not hurrying nor slowing as he approached the Sword Array.
"Hahaha..."
Fei Bin also laughed:
"Ding Ling, you thieving dog.
You’ve got guts!
Just for that, I respect you, but alas, alas, today you’re destined to die."
"Hehe."
Ding Ling only sneered, not speaking, eyes fixed intently on the Sword Array.

The Full-Level Eight Array Map Explanation, Initial Tier Array Dao Explanation, Middle-tier Array Dao Explanation, and Full-level Star Gazing Skill from Three Kingdoms World showed unmatched effectiveness at this moment.
Ding Ling saw through the grade of the Sword Array with a glance.
Just at the Middle-Tier Sword Array level.
Such an array.
For Ding Ling, it was not tough to break.
He continued forward.
Eyes like an eagle’s, shining brightly, he saw both the path of life within the Sword Array and the path of death.
Take the path of life.
To avoid the heart-piercing Sword Qi.
"The moment I stepped into this martial field, I sensed something was amiss, so I didn’t act rashly."
"Now it’s clear, these guys were indeed prepared all along, waiting for me."
"Hehe, Tangg Ying’e confident and arrogant, eager to crush me with absolute strength.
Fei Bin’s group is quite cautious, intending to use the full power of Mount Songh Sect’s Inner Sect combined with this Sword Array to kill me."
Alas.
All this will be futile.
"I finally spotted the opening of the Life Gate!"
"The time is now!"
Boom!
Ding Ling moved.
Vigorous Qi and True Qi fused.
His speed became ghostly, indistinguishable to the naked eye, in the blink of an eye seeming to teleport over sixty to seventy meters like a cannonball, lightning-fast, unbelievably!
Fei Bin and others hadn’t even reacted.
Ding Ling had already raised the Drumming Golden Hammer, striking at the Life Gate’s opening of the Sword Array.
This opening was extremely small.
The average person couldn’t see it, while a First-class expert might spend days to locate it and still might not crack it.
But Ding Ling chose to break it with force.
A hammer fell.
Boom!
Boom-boom-boom!

The Life Gate shook with booming thunderous cracking sounds, Fei Bin, Lu Bai, and others’ eyes twitched wildly, unable to resist looking over, and upon seeing this, they were immensely shocked and terrified.
Only to see Ding Ling.
With one hammer strike, breaking through the Life Gate’s opening, stepping into the Life Gate, unleashing havoc!
Boom-boom!
Boom-boom-boom!
Ding Ling charged left and right, rampant and unruly, his Drumming Golden Hammer swung emitting booming thunderous sounds, and in the void, all he surveyed was filled with the hammer’s image!
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Exhibited by Ding Ling exquisitely.
Even more domineering, fierce, and wild than Li Yuanba!
His True Qi far surpassing Li Yuanba’s Inner Strength, after the fusion of True Qi and Vigorous Qi, erupting power, terrifying like ancient beasts roaring, crashing onto the world!
Boom-boom!
The Drumming Golden Hammer wielded by Ding Ling like a whirlwind of hammer blows, unassailable and unmatched!
Wherever he passed.
The Sword Array collapsed!
Sword Qi scattered!
The elite disciples toppled and cried out in despair!
Bang-bang-bang!
Some disciples were hit directly by the Drumming Golden Hammer, immediately reduced to pulp!

Some disciples were swept by the hammer’s tail, screamed, helplessly thrown dozens of meters away, and with a resounding crash, landed heavily on the ground, left with only the breath coming in, none going out!
Ding Ling devastated all along the way!
Like a worldly emperor leading an invincible army sweeping over a nation!
In just three blinks of an eye.
Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer killed and injured countless elite disciples of Mount Songh Sect, finally thundering towards Fei Bin at the center of the Sword Array!

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Hammer Shatters the Great Songyang Hand
paragraphs: "Ah!"
Fei Bin felt as though his heart and guts were shattered, his eyes seemed about to split open!
Horrified, it was as if his internal organs were tumbling over each other. Watching Ding Ling approach effortlessly like plucking leaves and scattering flowers, he sensed something was amiss.
Sure enough.
In less than three breaths, Ding Ling broke through the Life Gate, and a heavy hammer came crashing down on him, rumbling loudly!
It seemed as though the void would collapse, with rippling folds spreading out in all directions like water waves.
Fei Bin frantically cycled his Inner Power Heart Method, and his Lightweight Skill Technique was activated to its fullest extent, making him flutter like a leaf, narrowly dodging the heavy hammer.
Boom!

The heavy hammer landed exactly where Fei Bin had been stationed, shattering the ground. A spider-web-like pattern spread out from the point of impact, cracks spreading meters around. At the center, half a breath later, it couldn’t hold any longer, crack!
A huge pit caved in!
One hammer strike!
Such ferocity!
Not just one person, even ten would be smashed to pieces by this hammer!
Fei Bin’s scalp went numb, he gasped as a fine, cold sweat coated his back uncontrollably!
Boom!

Seeing that Fei Bin had actually dodged, Ding Ling wasn’t upset. Instead, he used his Breathing Technique and Pure Yang True Skill, activating his Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, wielding an eight hundred pound Drumming Golden Hammer like a windmill.
The ease with which he handled the weight was taken to an extreme.
Boom boom boom!
Ding Ling chased after Fei Bin to finish the kill.
How could Fei Bin outrun Ding Ling?

Only managing a dozen meters or so, he just reached another branch of the Sword Array when boom! Ding Ling’s giant hammer had already smashed the core of this part of the Sword Array, causing the elite disciples of the Mount Songh Sect guarding there to spit blood and fly backward.

With another hammer strike, boom! The two elite disciples blocking the path had their spines broken on the spot, their bodies sounding like bones cracking as they were flung like cannonballs, directly hitting Fei Bin.
Fei Bin’s body suddenly soared three zhang high, just evading the blow. Relieved, the next moment, his view was entirely blocked by endless shadows of hammers.
"Ah!"
He only had time to let out a scream before bang! A heavy sound met his ears as his whole body was smashed and flattened like a rag, flying over ten zhang, landing helplessly on the ground.
His body twitched twice and then suddenly went stiff!
Completely dead.
These few moments.
Could be described as the rise and fall of a hare, extremely swift!
From when Ding Ling started to when he killed Fei Bin.
Not even eight breaths.
And it was over.
Lu Bai, Sha Tianjiang, and other Mount Songh Sect leaders, upon witnessing this scene, turned ashen white, as if hit by a heavy object, their minds buzzing as if ready to explode!
"How could he be this strong?!"

"Isn’t this hammer technique something only Li Yuanba knows, the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique? How did Ding Ling know it? And he’s even more fierce and domineering than Li Yuanba, this, this is terrifying!"

"How did Ding Ling get this strong, to such an outrageous degree! We formed a sword array with hundreds of elite disciples. It’s said to suppress the mountain gate easily and annihilate any invading enemies. How could it be so easily broken?!"
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: Intimidate Fei Bin.]

[Annotate: The Great Songyang Hand, Fei Bin. High and proud, cold and ruthless, kills without mercy, heartless and unjust! He sees you as an enemy. Tried to recruit you early on, but when that failed, sought to destroy you.
Yet he was nearly beaten to death by you. Now, having learned his lesson, he prepared to extinguish you with the power of the Sword Array and fellow forces. Yet still, you easily broke through.
He was in shock, bewildered, clueless about which part went wrong!

Before dying, he was extremely attached to life. Only at this moment did he begin to develop an overwhelming fear of you. He regarded you as the greatest, strongest rival of his life! If given a chance to do it again, he absolutely wouldn’t have made you an enemy!]
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: Intimidate Sha Tianjiang.]

[Annotated: The Bald Eagle Sha Tianjiang, rampant north and south, has seen fierce and skilled men. But someone like you, he’s encountering for the first time! Thinking it might also be the last time, he could no longer remain calm, and had thoughts of fleeing.]
Two Achievement Medals earned.
Ding Ling didn’t dwell on them. Instead, he spun his Drumming Golden Hammer and smashed towards another Life Gate of the sword array!
This sword array was interconnected, one small formation linked to another, forming a large-scale sword array!
Ding Ling first broke the Life Gate of the major sword array.
Now breaking the Life Gate of the smaller sword array was as easy as a breeze, like eating and drinking, sweeping away like autumn leaves, boom boom boom!
The Drumming Golden Hammer swung.
The sky filled with innumerable phantom hammers!
Every phantom hammer was like a small mountain, crashing down, as if even the Celestial Palace would collapse! How could such a small sword array withstand it?
But with a snap, a crisp sound cut across the Celestial Extreme.
Boom!

The small sword array shattered apart, and more than a dozen Treasure Swords either shattered or were knocked flying. Mount Songh Sect’s elite disciples caught in the root were struck by the giant hammer, unable to even scream before being smashed into meat patties!
"Hiss!"

In the Mount Songh Sect’s sword array, numerous players were frightened, and taking advantage of Lu Bai and others’ distraction and divine fragment, they quickly jumped out of the array and swiftly fled.
Players who managed to rise among the ranks of elite disciples in the Mount Songh Sect in just a few months were undoubtedly highly talented people, with exceptional aptitude and comprehension!
They were shrewd, skilled at networking, and had incredible talent, making a name for themselves in the Mount Songh Sect, which they were quite proud of.
They felt they had become elites, able to look down upon, crush, and disdain players of lower ranks!
However, after Ding Ling’s arrival, everything collapsed instantly, like illusions shattering upon impact!
And at that moment.
These players suddenly realized their fragility, their prior confidence collapsing instantaneously. Their gazes toward Ding Ling were like seeing a ghost god, one by one they ran while thinking:

"Goodness, never saw Ding Ling go berserk before, some players swore it, but I never really believed it. Now I’ve seen it for myself. He’s way fiercer and more terrifying than that blockhead Li Yuanba!"
"From now on, definitely avoid him! Absolutely don’t make him an enemy. Otherwise, we might not even know how we’d die. After so much effort to train, dying would be too great a loss."
Nobody wants to die.
Even if they are players.
Especially after witnessing Ding Ling in full fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: Sword Array Shattered! Total Annihilation
paragraphs: The players’ hearts were burning hot.
They suddenly realized.
As long as you are strong enough, you can completely ignore all the rules and crush all authority!
In their eyes, the seemingly indestructible, impregnable Mount Songh Sect!
Under Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer, it was completely vulnerable, defeated at the first blow!
This is the absolute gap in strength!
And the strength they were so proud of, to Ding Ling, was as fragile as ants shaking a tree or eggs hitting iron!
Ding Ling completely ignored them!
He might not even know if they were natives or players!
Because in Ding Ling’s view, they were no different from natives, perhaps even inferior.
Thinking of this.
The players felt lost, dejected, gloomy, and envious, amazed, and jealous.
No need to say much about their loss.
Envious and jealous of everything Ding Ling had achieved in such a short time!
They also wished to roam the Jianghu like Ding Ling, the Smiling, Proud Wanderer!
Unfortunately, their strength didn’t allow it!
There weren’t many players.
After slipping away.
Ding Ling didn’t deliberately pursue them, only focused on fighting the likes of Lu Bai, Sha Tianjiang, and other high-ranking members!
Boom!
With a hammer strike, crack! Boom!
Another Sword Array was shattered, the fragments of dozens of Treasure Swords swished forward with the hammer’s wind from the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, puff puff!
The fragments pierced the bodies of several elite disciples of the Mount Songh Sect who turned to flee, and in their astonishment, unwillingness, and panic, they fell to the ground with a thud!
"Ding Ling!"
Seeing Ding Ling charging and smashing his way towards him like an ancient Divine Dragon, exuding an overwhelming fierce aura, Lu Bai felt suffocated from afar.
He wanted to run too.
But seeing Ding Ling seemingly locked onto him, he realized he couldn’t outrun Ding Ling!
There was no way he would escape today.
Thinking of this.
Lu Bai’s heart filled with grief and despair, he couldn’t help but let out a long howl:
"Ah! I want you dead! Sha Tianjiang, Sima De, Zhao Sihai, everyone, attack together!"
After discovering the Sword Array was ineffective against Ding Ling.
Lu Bai finally abandoned the idea of using the Sword Array to kill the enemy.
Moreover, the core of the Sword Array had been destroyed.
Unable to operate a large Sword Array.
A small Sword Array was not much different from paper facing Ding Ling’s Drumming Golden Hammer.
Lu Bai and his companions saw it with their own eyes.
A chill struck their hearts!
Each of them felt terrified, their hair standing on end, pupils dilated, and now faced with a life-and-death battle, Sha Tianjiang also yelled ’everyone attack together’!
When they saw Lu Bai, Sima De, and others charging forward without hesitation, Sha Tianjiang turned and ran without delay, running as fast as a rabbit, like a Pegasus.
He probably had never run this fast in his life! This was his only time surpassing himself!
"Sha Tianjiang!"
Lu Bai noticed, full of hate.
But now they had already charged in.
Ding Ling was also charging towards them, too late to turn and run now.
"Ah!"
Lu Bai roared, letting out a lion-like howl of rage:
"Charge!"
"Kill!"
Sima De and the others were terrified to the extreme, but now they could only boost their morale, urging the elite disciples of their sect to charge at Ding Ling en masse.
"Hahaha..."

Ding Ling advanced instead of retreating, letting out a long shout, laughing thrice loudly, his Vigorous Qi and True Qi merging, whoosh! His body like the Qingfeng, wielding the Drumming Golden Hammer, swinging it down, filling the void with the enormous hammer’s invisible shadows!
Boom boom!
With each swing, sweep, or throw of the Drumming Golden Hammer, it was like a Tyrannosaurus crashing into a flock of sheep!
In just an instant, dozens of people in front were smashed back, flying askew and straight like iron balls flying out with no force.
Boom!
Ding Ling, holding the Drumming Golden Hammer, leaped five or six zhang, landing with a boom before Lu Bai and his party, causing the ground to sink three inches!
"Ah!"
"Kill!"
Lu Bai and the others drew their treasure swords from their backs and thrust them toward Ding Ling’s vital points.

Ding Ling let out a long laugh, didn’t even dodge, and simply swung the Drumming Golden Hammer heavily. Boom! With one strike, he hit the longswords of Lu Bai and his men. It was as if they were struck by thunder, their tiger’s mouths cracked, and without exception, they all loosed their swords and staggered back more than ten steps!
With each step they retreated, a deep footprint was left behind, clearly under extreme strain, forcing them to use deflection techniques to channel the enormous force into the ground!
Yet before they could retreat further.
Ding Ling’s second hammer had already smashed down.
"Scatter and run!"
Lu Bai finally understood Fei Bin’s feeling of despair and suffocation.
He had originally thought that combining forces might offer a sliver of hope.
Now it seemed.
He was too foolish, too naive, not even a glimmer of hope was possible!
"Trying to escape?"
Ding Ling sneered coldly, the giant hammer in his hand already coming down. Boom! It struck Lu Bai right on the chest, sending him flying back over a hundred meters!
Boom!

The hammer flew forward, hitting Sima De, who had just sprinted several dozen meters away. With a loud crash, Sima De’s spine shattered, his whole body spewing blood as he flew sideways, collapsing on the ground like a pile of mud, his life hanging by a thread.
Whizz!
Ding Ling activated the fusion of Vigorous Qi and True Qi, moving as fast as the Xun Wind. In a whistling sound, he caught up with Zhao Sihai and delivered a palm strike.
Great Yin Yang Hand Seal!
A millstone flew out, landing squarely on Zhao Sihai’s back. Puff!
It sunk Zhao Sihai’s back by three inches, sending him tumbling off, lying motionless on the ground—clearly dead.
In less than the blink of an eye!
Almost all the key figures supporting the Sword Array were dead.
Only Sha Tianjiang remained.

Ding Ling beckoned from a distance, and Qu Feiyan immediately ran over with a large bow and an arrow pouch, handing them to Ding Ling. He strung the bow and nocked an arrow, aiming at Sha Tianjiang, who had already run several hundred meters away!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Tornado Arrow Technique!
Vigorous Qi and True Qi infused into the arrows, buzzing constantly as if they might explode at any moment. As Ding Ling released the string!
Whizz!
Three arrows, like three divine dragons, danced through the air, roaring forward with such speed that blinding flames sparkled through the void.
Xun Wind seemed to appear out of nowhere, small tornadoes swirling around the arrows, accelerating their fierce charge.
In an instant.
Thud, thud, thud!
The three arrows struck Sha Tianjiang’s head, back, and shoulder respectively.
Forming a triangular pattern, they shot Sha Tianjiang alive, pinning him to a massive stone.
"How, how is this possible?!"
Sha Tianjiang died with shock, confusion, horror, and disbelief.
He died with his eyes open.
He almost made it off the peak of Mount Songh.
Only to be shot down from a distance.
What kind of archery skill is this?!
[Achievement Medal: Intimidate Sima De.]

[Note: Sima De, as one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors, unrestrained and skilled in Sword Techniques, was nevertheless no match for you! He felt immense fear! If there is a next life, he will surely avoid you!]
[Achievement Medal: Intimidate Zhao Sihai.]

[Note: Zhao Sihai, also one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors. Shameless, without virtue or righteousness, he used dark methods to kill and persecute others without scruple! He thought joining forces to form a Sword Array would certainly put you to death. But your power exceeded his imagination.]
[Achievement Medal: Intimidate Lu Bai.]

[Note: Lu Bai’s martial arts were outstanding, his Lightweight Skill exceptional, his Sword Technique superior, yet multiple joint efforts with his brothers repeatedly saw them crushed by you. He doubted life, overwhelmed with despair! Initially determined to die, he was confident that even if he couldn’t kill you, he would at least make you pay a price!
But you remained unscathed, brutally hammering them to death.
He died with great discontent, frustrated and full of resentment!]
Ding Ling glanced at Lu Bai’s remains.
Indeed, his eyes were filled with resentment and reluctance.
But so what.
They were all dead.
Ding Ling would not contend with the dead.
He glanced at the task list.
[1: Defeat more than 20 strong figures from the Plane: 19/20.]
Previously, it was 13.
Subsequently, killing Tangg Ying’e, Fei Bin, Sha Tianjiang, Lu Bai, Sima De, and Zhao Sihai.

"Kill!"
Lu Bai and the others drew their treasure swords from their backs and thrust them toward Ding Ling’s vital points.
Ding Ling let out a long laugh, didn’t even dodge, and simply swung the Drumming Golden Hammer heavily.
Boom!
With one strike, he hit the longswords of Lu Bai and his men.
It was as if they were struck by thunder, their tiger’s mouths cracked, and without exception, they all loosed their swords and staggered back more than ten steps!
With each step they retreated, a deep footprint was left behind, clearly under extreme strain, forcing them to use deflection techniques to channel the enormous force into the ground!
Yet before they could retreat further.
Ding Ling’s second hammer had already smashed down.
"Scatter and run!"
Lu Bai finally understood Fei Bin’s feeling of despair and suffocation.
He had originally thought that combining forces might offer a sliver of hope.
Now it seemed.
He was too foolish, too naive, not even a glimmer of hope was possible!
"Trying to escape?"
Ding Ling sneered coldly, the giant hammer in his hand already coming down.
Boom!
It struck Lu Bai right on the chest, sending him flying back over a hundred meters!
Boom!
The hammer flew forward, hitting Sima De, who had just sprinted several dozen meters away.
With a loud crash, Sima De’s spine shattered, his whole body spewing blood as he flew sideways, collapsing on the ground like a pile of mud, his life hanging by a thread.
Whizz!
Ding Ling activated the fusion of Vigorous Qi and True Qi, moving as fast as the Xun Wind.
In a whistling sound, he caught up with Zhao Sihai and delivered a palm strike.
Great Yin Yang Hand Seal!
A millstone flew out, landing squarely on Zhao Sihai’s back.
Puff!
It sunk Zhao Sihai’s back by three inches, sending him tumbling off, lying motionless on the ground—clearly dead.
In less than the blink of an eye!
Almost all the key figures supporting the Sword Array were dead.
Only Sha Tianjiang remained.
Ding Ling beckoned from a distance, and Qu Feiyan immediately ran over with a large bow and an arrow pouch, handing them to Ding Ling.
He strung the bow and nocked an arrow, aiming at Sha Tianjiang, who had already run several hundred meters away!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Tornado Arrow Technique!
Vigorous Qi and True Qi infused into the arrows, buzzing constantly as if they might explode at any moment.
As Ding Ling released the string!
Whizz!
Three arrows, like three divine dragons, danced through the air, roaring forward with such speed that blinding flames sparkled through the void.
Xun Wind seemed to appear out of nowhere, small tornadoes swirling around the arrows, accelerating their fierce charge.
In an instant.
Thud, thud, thud!
The three arrows struck Sha Tianjiang’s head, back, and shoulder respectively.
Forming a triangular pattern, they shot Sha Tianjiang alive, pinning him to a massive stone.
"How, how is this possible?!"
Sha Tianjiang died with shock, confusion, horror, and disbelief.
He died with his eyes open.
He almost made it off the peak of Mount Songh.
Only to be shot down from a distance.
What kind of archery skill is this?!
[Achievement Medal: Intimidate Sima De.]
[Note: Sima De, as one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors, unrestrained and skilled in Sword Techniques, was nevertheless no match for you!
He felt immense fear!
If there is a next life, he will surely avoid you!]
[Achievement Medal: Intimidate Zhao Sihai.]
[Note: Zhao Sihai, also one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors.
Shameless, without virtue or righteousness, he used dark methods to kill and persecute others without scruple!
He thought joining forces to form a Sword Array would certainly put you to death.
But your power exceeded his imagination.]
[Achievement Medal: Intimidate Lu Bai.]
[Note: Lu Bai’s martial arts were outstanding, his Lightweight Skill exceptional, his Sword Technique superior, yet multiple joint efforts with his brothers repeatedly saw them crushed by you.
He doubted life, overwhelmed with despair!
Initially determined to die, he was confident that even if he couldn’t kill you, he would at least make you pay a price!
But you remained unscathed, brutally hammering them to death.
He died with great discontent, frustrated and full of resentment!]
Ding Ling glanced at Lu Bai’s remains.
Indeed, his eyes were filled with resentment and reluctance.
But so what.
They were all dead.
Ding Ling would not contend with the dead.
He glanced at the task list.
[1: Defeat more than 20 strong figures from the Plane: 19/20.]
Previously, it was 13.
Subsequently, killing Tangg Ying’e, Fei Bin, Sha Tianjiang, Lu Bai, Sima De, and Zhao Sihai.

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Ice Divine Palm Full Level
paragraphs: So the progress bar jumped forward a few steps.
Reached 19.
Task 1 is just one person away from completion.
Ding Ling then decided to spar with Deng Bafeng.
Get task 1 done before moving on.
Where did Deng Bafeng find the courage, he was so scared he almost knelt down and kowtowed, calling him Master Ding!
This scene just unfolded.
He saw everything clearly!
Ding Ling was as formidable as a peerless fiend, sweeping away everything in his path. Anyone who dared to resist was smashed, crushed, flattened!
The impact was extremely shocking.
Deng Bafeng was watching with twitching eyelids, feeling numb inside, petrified.
Seeing Ding Ling actually signaling him to come forward for a spar, Deng Bafeng’s legs went soft, almost kneeling.
When he heard Ding Ling say ’just a spar, no hammers, and won’t harm you’, Deng Bafeng hesitantly looked at Ding Ling, wanting to cry, he said trembling:
"Ding, Hero Ding, you’re not lying to me?"
"Come."
Ding Ling didn’t want to explain further, just slightly frowned.
Deng Bafeng immediately walked forward two steps, sparring with Ding Ling.
Very easily.
Ding Ling defeated Deng Bafeng.
The progress bar jumped forward by one more step.
Reached 20.
Task 1 was completed.
Next comes task 2, task 3.
"Take people to tidy up, and have someone take me to Mount Songh Sect’s Treasure Vault and Library."
Ding Ling glanced at Deng Bafeng.
Deng Bafeng still seemed a bit dazed now, touched himself, wasn’t dead!
Not crippled!
Not injured!
Great!!
He was overjoyed, almost wanting to shout to the sky.
Upon hearing Ding Ling’s words suddenly, he quickly nodded and bowed in response.
As long as he could stay alive.
Deng Bafeng would do anything, furthermore, what Ding Ling asked him to do was acceptable, so he gladly went on.
He passed by the remains of Lu Bai, Fei Bin, and others.
Deng Bafeng felt a mix of sadness and more so, relief.
Fortunately, he was smart enough not to be as foolish as Lu Bai, intent on opposing Ding Ling!
"Can’t they see how strong Ding Ling is!"
"Can Ding Ling be defeated just because there are many of them?!"
’If numbers were enough to win, could Ding Ling have survived till now? Truly ridiculously naive.’
Deng Bafeng mourned for Lu Bai and the others.
"Ding Ling is truly invincible."
Huang Zhonggong and others followed behind Ding Ling, looking at his back with endless admiration!
The more they interacted, the more they realized how unfathomable Ding Ling was!
Earlier they viewed Ding Ling as solid as Mount Tai, now they see him as grand as the Celestial Palace!
They had increasing reverence for Ding Ling!
"Objectively speaking, Ding Ling’s flair completely surpasses Xiang Yu."
Consort Yhu sighed inwardly.
Though reluctant to admit, based on the facts, if Ding Ling and Xiang Yu fought to the death, likely Xiang Yu would be the one to die.
Thinking of this.
Consort Yhu made a silent decision that if she ever met Xiang Yu, she would certainly advise him not to become Ding Ling’s enemy!
"Deserving of being my master (Brother Ding)."
Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan were full of joy and honor.
Especially seeing the looks and expressions of Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, Deng Bafeng when they looked at Ding Ling, felt greatly honored.
An hour later.
Ding Ling looked at the stack of Secret Manuals before him.
He started flipping through them.
The first book, finished quickly.
In an instant.
[Ice Divine Palm Full Level]
This was Zuo Lengchan’s supreme skill, placed in the deepest part of the library, the specific location known only to the Thirteen Grand Protectors.
It was Deng Bafeng who found it and placed it in front of Ding Ling.
At full level.
Ding Ling slightly operated the Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique, and delivered a palm, cold air burst out, Bang!
It imprinted on the nearby wall.
Sunken by an inch!
The cold was frightening!

"A very good palm technique. Considered a top-tier palm technique of the ice affinity. It’s unfortunate that I practice Pure Yang True Skill, trying to fully unleash this palm’s potential isn’t possible, only using the Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique to activate it. Only then does it show unmatched power. But ultimately, it should be paired with Cold Ice True Skill to be more perfect."
Ding Ling set the Ice Divine Palm aside.
Planning to gift it to Consort Yhu later.
Consort Yhu practiced Cold Ice True Skill, making this Ice Divine Palm perfect for her cultivation.
Rustle rustle.
Ding Ling continued flipping through the second Secret Manual.
Finished.
[Great Songyang Divine Palm Full Level]
This is the direct palm technique passed down by Mount Songh Sect, extremely solid, strong!
Renowned for its complex transformations.

Ding Ling activated the Pure Yang True Skill to deliver the palm technique, for a moment, the sky was filled with palm shadows, each palm seemed to carry scorching heat, leaving glimmers of flames in the air with each strike.
Moreover, these palm shadows were extremely fast.
Listening to the series of bangs resonating past the ear.
Looking once more.
The nearby wall was covered in palm prints each no less than an inch deep.
Ding Ling nodded silently.
Indeed, it was Mount Songh Sect’s Mountain Guardian Secret Technique.
This palm technique was also top-tier.
Alongside Ice Divine Palm, they embody yin and yang.
Ding Ling thought about yin and yang, then contemplated the unique nature of Great Yin Yang Hand Seal.
Pondered for a while.
Attempting to inject Vigorous Qi from the Ice Divine Palm and Great Songyang Divine Palm separately into the Vigorous Qi of Great Yin Yang Hand Seal, trying to merge the three palm techniques.
He tried multiple times, failing each without exception.
But because all of Ding Ling’s supreme skills were at full level, his comprehension of these palm techniques had reached the Transformation Realm, after several attempts, he had an epiphany:

"My idea is feasible, but it seems I currently do not possess the ability to melt the palm techniques. Perhaps I need to be stronger for these three palm techniques to truly melt into a new palm technique."
Ding Ling was spirited.
He believed. If this day truly came.
A ground-shaking ultimate palm technique would definitely be born.
"Continue."
Ding Ling flipped through the third Secret Manual.
Finished.
[Surprised Swan Swordsmanship Full Level]
Graceful like a startled swan, agile like a roaming dragon!
This sword technique is surprisingly also a Superior Sword Technique.
Just extremely difficult to practice.
Requires extremely high physical attributes to exhibit this miraculous sword technique.
As Zuo Lengchan and others practiced Inner Power, this sword technique was stored up high in the library, unknown for countless years.
"Surprised Swan Swordsmanship likely requires the physique of a Super-Elite Fierce General to practice. To achieve full level, physical attributes likely need to reach 40 points."
Ding Ling was astonished.

Exhibiting Surprised Swan Swordsmanship, the sword light flashed as Ding Ling moved like a dragon, gracefully like a bird, actually showcasing the sword technique akin to an Immortal dancing with a sword in the heavens, breathtaking, mesmerizing.
"Surely unlike ordinary sword techniques."
Ding Ling pondered:
"Could it be handed down by some supreme master?"
"Or perhaps in this Plane World’s Ancient Era, a master created such a Surprised Swan Swordsmanship? Compared to now, wouldn’t Ancient people’s physical attributes be higher?!"
What the truth is exactly.
Remains unknown.
Ding Ling didn’t think further.
He began flipping through the Secret Manual, one by one.
And because of the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat.
As expected.

chapters.title: Chapter 362: The Seven Trials Set by Feng Qingyang
paragraphs: All the secret manuals were flipped through completely, the Divine Skill also automatically reached Full Level.
One secret manual after another, one Divine Skill after another.
All reached Full Level.
All have been learned and mastered.
A total of over three hundred secret manuals.
First-class palm techniques, Sword Techniques, inner power, etc., are over thirty books.
Second-class Spear Techniques, Sword Techniques, inner power, etc., are over eighty books.
Third-class ones are over two hundred books.
All reached Full Level.
Not long ago.
After Ding Ling finished reading a few first-class Inner Power Secret Manuals.
[Inner Power Value +50]
[Inner Power Value +30]
[Inner Power Value +20]
Crack!
The sixth drop of True Water in Ding Ling’s Dantian cracked and emerged.
His True Qi attribute values suddenly became:
[True Power Value: 6 points]
After reaching 6 points.
Looking at those first-class Inner Power Secret Manuals, Ding Ling indeed saw no increase in Inner Power Value.
Although Ding Ling felt a bit regretful.
He still without exception finished reading all the Inner Power Secret Manuals.
Although Inner Power Value did not increase.
But Ding Ling’s foundation was greatly enhanced.
The level of mastery over True Qi continuously elevated!
After all Inner Power Secret Manuals reached Full Level.
His mastery over True Qi has elevated to a new realm, not to say he can do as he pleases, but he can also skillfully control and utilize these True Qi.
As if True Qi has become a weapon tightly held in his hand.
"If one day, True Qi seems to transform into my limbs, can be fully controlled at will, reaching the point where thought reaches, True Qi reaches! Then True Qi must have reached a flaw-free realm."
And this requires an extremely deep foundation.
Ding Ling thought of the Three Kingdoms World scene when cultivating Breathing Technique.

It was also because he cultivated many Martial Arts, techniques, etc., making his foundation as deep as a mountain, which allowed him to smoothly control the power of a Celestial Human Realm master, thereby defeating Zuo Ci.
If not for this, he may not have been able to win because Zuo Ci was indeed very strong!
"Thus, next, I need to read more Martial Arts, Heart Techniques, to enhance my foundation so that I can perfectly control the power of True Qi, then I surely can be invincible in the Innate Realm!"
Ding Ling knew well.
He rose tall.
Picked up several Secret Manuals on Superior Inner Power Heart Method, some Superior palm techniques, Sword Techniques, etc. from the library.
Then strode out from the library.
These first-class Inner Power Heart Techniques vary in strength.
But none are as good as Pure Yang True Skill, etc.
Therefore, the increase in Inner Power Value is strongest at around 50 points.
"And as I continue to grow stronger, slightly weaker first-class Inner Power Heart Methods may lose their effectiveness for me in the future."
Ding Ling’s heart was like a clear mirror.
But he wasn’t overly worried.
Because the world rules and Heavenly Dao Laws of each world are different.
Just like the last world breaking into the Celestial Human Realm can harness the Power of Celestial Might.
Thus.
Strong Celestial Human Realm masters like Zuo Ci and Ding Ling were extraordinarily powerful.
Can disregard imperial power, look down on the mortal realm!
But this world obviously can’t harness Celestial Might.
So, Ding Ling can’t say for sure if slightly weaker first-class Inner Power Heart Method Secret Manuals at Full Level in the next world can enhance Inner Power Value directly.
"We’ll know when the time comes."
After Ding Ling walked out of the library, he called Lin Pingzhi, instructed him to distribute these Secret Manuals to Consort Yhu, Qu Feiyan, Huang Zhonggong, and others.
Lin Pingzhi nodded with great respect and left with the Secret Manuals.
Ding Ling then let Deng Bafeng lead the way to the Treasure Vault again.
In the Treasure Vault, there were indeed many great medicines, secret medicines, medicinal wine, and so on.
Also countless worldly goods.
Unfortunately.
Ding Ling’s physical constitution and Inner Power Value had both reached the limit value of this world, yet he couldn’t utilize these things anymore.
Moreover, these things are likely impossible to take to the Upper Realm.
In the Game World, such loopholes can’t exist.
Ding Ling thought for a moment, then instructed Deng Bafeng to collect all the herbs.
He selected among them the top-grade great medicines, tonic wines, and other materials to store in his Storage Pouch.

Deng Bafeng secretly marveled at it, as such Immortal Treasure, Storage Pouch, he had seen for the first time, couldn’t help but be astonished, perceiving Ding Ling as extraordinary, becoming more respectful and reverent towards him!
With even Immortal Treasure in Ding Ling’s possession.
His potential and background are self-evident!
Thus another day passed.
The next day.
Ding Ling let everyone take away what needed to be taken.
Unable to take, Ding Ling let Deng Bafeng handle it.
"Brother Ding, are we leaving?"
Qu Feiyan after tying many things in large and small packages, found some free time, couldn’t help but glance and ask.
"Yes. To Huashan."
Ding Ling had long wanted to find Feng Qingyang.
Yesterday, he particularly went around game forums, etc. after logging off.
Confirmed one thing:

The whereabouts of Feng Qingyang were leaked by players months ago, later found out to have walked out of Huashan, but accidentally discovered a few times later, unwillingly perhaps due to attachment to homeland, maybe feeling old.
Or maybe he thinks the Dugu Nine Swords really needs an appropriate successor.
He returned to Huashan and set up seven barriers at the Reflection Cliff in Huashan.
Each barrier passed.
You can learn a type of Sword Technique.
After passing the seven barriers.
The legacy of the Dugu Nine Swords can be obtained.
Everyone has a chance, everyone has an opportunity.
Ding Ling’s heart burned, thinking:
"These seven barriers are incredibly difficult for others, but for me, it’s easy as turning over a hand!"
Seven barriers.
Each barrier.
Contains some incomplete sword moves.
If you can comprehend these incomplete sword moves within a specified time and cultivate to the level Feng Qingyang recognizes, you can pass.
As for the level Feng Qingyang recognizes?
Would Ding Ling worry given his Divine Skill Automatic Full Level?
"Used to worry about not getting the Dugu Nine Swords. Now, I have absolute assurance."
At this moment.
For the first time, Ding Ling felt players were rather ’cute’.
If they hadn’t inadvertently forced Feng Qingyang into a corner, it would certainly have been a huge effort for Ding Ling to want to learn the Dugu Nine Swords!
"Once learned the Dugu Nine Swords, then guiding Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, and others for a period of time, the duel with Bai Wushuang on Huashan Peak can proceed."
Bai Wushuang said six months later to decide the victor with Ding Ling on Huashan Peak.
As long as he wins.
She will give the Tai Chi Scripture to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling had been incredibly eager for Zhang Sanfeng’s handwritten Tai Chi Scripture.
Naturally, he wouldn’t miss this battle.
"If Bai Wushuang is Dongfang Bubai. If I defeat her, won’t my task be completed?"
Ding Ling silently pondered:
"If not. At least I can obtain the Tai Chi Scripture. Once learned the Tai Chi Scripture. Then clash head-on with Dongfang Bubai, I will surely win!"
Ding Ling couldn’t believe.
With both Body Refining and Inner Power reaching the world’s limit value!
He still couldn’t defeat Dongfang Bubai.
"After going to Huashan?"
Qu Feiyan’s heart was anxious, but her face was all smiles, she asked sweetly:
"Brother Ding, will you be leaving us?"
"No. I still want to fight Bai Wushuang on Huashan Peak."
In the midst of chatting.
Suddenly Deng Bafeng came to report.

But none are as good as Pure Yang True Skill, etc.
Therefore, the increase in Inner Power Value is strongest at around 50 points.
"And as I continue to grow stronger, slightly weaker first-class Inner Power Heart Methods may lose their effectiveness for me in the future."
Ding Ling’s heart was like a clear mirror.
But he wasn’t overly worried.
Because the world rules and Heavenly Dao Laws of each world are different.
Just like the last world breaking into the Celestial Human Realm can harness the Power of Celestial Might.
Thus.
Strong Celestial Human Realm masters like Zuo Ci and Ding Ling were extraordinarily powerful.
Can disregard imperial power, look down on the mortal realm!
But this world obviously can’t harness Celestial Might.
So, Ding Ling can’t say for sure if slightly weaker first-class Inner Power Heart Method Secret Manuals at Full Level in the next world can enhance Inner Power Value directly.
"We’ll know when the time comes."
After Ding Ling walked out of the library, he called Lin Pingzhi, instructed him to distribute these Secret Manuals to Consort Yhu, Qu Feiyan, Huang Zhonggong, and others.
Lin Pingzhi nodded with great respect and left with the Secret Manuals.
Ding Ling then let Deng Bafeng lead the way to the Treasure Vault again.
In the Treasure Vault, there were indeed many great medicines, secret medicines, medicinal wine, and so on.
Also countless worldly goods.
Unfortunately.
Ding Ling’s physical constitution and Inner Power Value had both reached the limit value of this world, yet he couldn’t utilize these things anymore.
Moreover, these things are likely impossible to take to the Upper Realm.
In the Game World, such loopholes can’t exist.
Ding Ling thought for a moment, then instructed Deng Bafeng to collect all the herbs.
He selected among them the top-grade great medicines, tonic wines, and other materials to store in his Storage Pouch.

Deng Bafeng secretly marveled at it, as such Immortal Treasure, Storage Pouch, he had seen for the first time, couldn’t help but be astonished, perceiving Ding Ling as extraordinary, becoming more respectful and reverent towards him!
With even Immortal Treasure in Ding Ling’s possession.
His potential and background are self-evident!
Thus another day passed.
The next day.
Ding Ling let everyone take away what needed to be taken.
Unable to take, Ding Ling let Deng Bafeng handle it.
"Brother Ding, are we leaving?"
Qu Feiyan after tying many things in large and small packages, found some free time, couldn’t help but glance and ask.
"Yes.
To Huashan."
Ding Ling had long wanted to find Feng Qingyang.
Yesterday, he particularly went around game forums, etc. after logging off.
Confirmed one thing:

The whereabouts of Feng Qingyang were leaked by players months ago, later found out to have walked out of Huashan, but accidentally discovered a few times later, unwillingly perhaps due to attachment to homeland, maybe feeling old.
Or maybe he thinks the Dugu Nine Swords really needs an appropriate successor.
He returned to Huashan and set up seven barriers at the Reflection Cliff in Huashan.
Each barrier passed.
You can learn a type of Sword Technique.
After passing the seven barriers.
The legacy of the Dugu Nine Swords can be obtained.
Everyone has a chance, everyone has an opportunity.
Ding Ling’s heart burned, thinking:
"These seven barriers are incredibly difficult for others, but for me, it’s easy as turning over a hand!"
Seven barriers.
Each barrier.
Contains some incomplete sword moves.
If you can comprehend these incomplete sword moves within a specified time and cultivate to the level Feng Qingyang recognizes, you can pass.
As for the level Feng Qingyang recognizes?
Would Ding Ling worry given his Divine Skill Automatic Full Level?
"Used to worry about not getting the Dugu Nine Swords.
Now, I have absolute assurance."
At this moment.
For the first time, Ding Ling felt players were rather ’cute’.
If they hadn’t inadvertently forced Feng Qingyang into a corner, it would certainly have been a huge effort for Ding Ling to want to learn the Dugu Nine Swords!
"Once learned the Dugu Nine Swords, then guiding Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, and others for a period of time, the duel with Bai Wushuang on Huashan Peak can proceed."
Bai Wushuang said six months later to decide the victor with Ding Ling on Huashan Peak.
As long as he wins.
She will give the Tai Chi Scripture to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling had been incredibly eager for Zhang Sanfeng’s handwritten Tai Chi Scripture.
Naturally, he wouldn’t miss this battle.
"If Bai Wushuang is Dongfang Bubai.
If I defeat her, won’t my task be completed?"
Ding Ling silently pondered:
"If not.
At least I can obtain the Tai Chi Scripture.
Once learned the Tai Chi Scripture.
Then clash head-on with Dongfang Bubai, I will surely win!"
Ding Ling couldn’t believe.
With both Body Refining and Inner Power reaching the world’s limit value!
He still couldn’t defeat Dongfang Bubai.
"After going to Huashan?"
Qu Feiyan’s heart was anxious, but her face was all smiles, she asked sweetly:
"Brother Ding, will you be leaving us?"
"No.
I still want to fight Bai Wushuang on Huashan Peak."
In the midst of chatting.
Suddenly Deng Bafeng came to report.

chapters.title: Chapter 363: Master Fang Zheng
paragraphs: "Hero Ding, those bald donkeys from the Shaolin Temple have arrived!"
"Shaolin Temple?"
Ding Ling frowned.
"Indeed."
Deng Bafeng said respectfully:

"On Mount Songh, there are two major sects: the Shaolin Temple and the Mount Songh Sect. The Shaolin Temple is not far from our Mount Songh Sect. Such a significant event has happened here, and it’s already spread far and wide. The Shaolin Temple learning of it and taking action seems quite normal."
"Where are they?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
"They’re waiting outside the main gate of the Mount Songh Sect."
Deng Bafeng was a bit apprehensive:
"They are many and appear to be here to hold us accountable. I’m worried, worried..."
"Is worrying useful?"
Ding Ling picked up the Drumming Golden Hammer beside him and lifted his leg to walk forward:
"Let’s go and see."
Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, and others tied up their belongings and followed closely behind with their things.
Their mounts were being taken care of by the disciples of the Mount Songh Sect at the foot of the mountain.
Although Deng Bafeng was cowardly, he handled these trivial matters methodically and orderly.
At this moment.
Qu Feiyan and her group, carrying their belongings, also had several elite disciples helping to carry their things.
These disciples had been gathered by Deng Bafeng and respected him as the Sect Leader of the Mount Songh Sect, whether they were players or natives.
The players, knowing Deng Bafeng had Ding Ling’s backing, joined in with joy and were quick to acknowledge Deng Bafeng as the Sect Leader.
The natives, having been intimidated by Ding Ling before, easily followed the trend.
Thus, when tasked with handling matters, they were efficient and effective.
Tap-tap!
Ding Ling was at the front, walking slowly, yet in a flash, he had moved ahead of everyone, leaving their shadows far behind.
Qu Feiyan’s group quickly accelerated their pace, using their Lightweight Skill to catch up.
Soon.
Ding Ling arrived at the main gate of the Mount Songh Sect.
He saw a group of monks.
The one at the front had kind eyes and a benevolent face, his palms together, resembling a high monk who had attained enlightenment!
He too seemed to have noticed Ding Ling, and his once cloudy eyes instantly became clear like a shimmering lake, seemingly able to reflect a person’s good and evil:
"Amitabha Buddha, is the one who comes Ding Ling, Hero Ding?"
The voice was loud, echoing in all directions.
"Hero Ding is a title I’m unworthy of. I am Ding Ling."
Ding Ling’s voice was clear and bright.
Perfectly overshadowing the monk’s voice.
The monk’s face slightly changed, just about to speak again, when he saw that before his voice could fall, Ding Ling’s footsteps sounded like thunder, and swoosh!
The next moment.
Ding Ling seemed to have instantly teleported in front of them like a bolt of lightning.
The speed was so fast that it was indistinguishable to the naked eye, truly astonishing.

The monk’s brow twitched at this sight, his face changing again, this time tightening from a natural state to tension. He looked at Ding Ling with a serious expression, placing his palms together and saying:

"Hero Ding, under a great reputation, there are no empty individuals. Rumors in the Jianghu claim your skills are the best in the world, even Dongfang Bubai is not your match, and now seeing you, it seems there is some truth in that.
Indeed, there is some merit to it.
I am the Abbot of the Shaolin Temple, with the religious name of Fang Zheng. I have met Hero Ding!"
"So it’s Master Fang Zheng."
Ding Ling solemnly greeted, saying:
"I wonder, Master..."
He looked at the dense group of monks behind Fang Zheng: "Coming in such a grand manner, what business do you have with me?"
"The reason for coming here is to invite Hero Ding to visit the Shaolin Temple."
Master Fang Zheng’s face became increasingly tense, his entire body seemingly on high alert, as if facing a great enemy.
"There’s no need to go to the Shaolin Temple."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"We can just talk here. Once done, we go our separate ways, from then on, it would be best never to have contact again."
Ding Ling did not want to deal with this group from the Shaolin Temple.
Because, from his personal analysis.
This Jianghu world is full of disputes and killings, hard to say if this group from the Shaolin Temple is secretly stirring the pot.
If they are.
Then they are truly detestable.
If not, then why does the Shaolin Temple always benefit from the chaos in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World?
The reasoning behind this is difficult to determine.
Ding Ling might have considered exploring it further before.
But now, he estimated he was about to break through to another realm.
And no longer had the interest.
"Hero Ding, your words are mistaken."
Master Fang Zheng said solemnly:

"I see from Hero Ding’s visage that you have a connection to our Buddha. If you don’t mind, would you accompany me to stay at the Shaolin Temple, devote yourself wholeheartedly to Buddha, and from now on say goodbye to this Jianghu, no longer partake in the bloody, filthy matters? Wouldn’t that be good?"
"What kind of nonsense is this bald donkey saying?"
Before Ding Ling could speak.
Qu Feiyan was angered.
She had just arrived here not long ago and heard Fang Zheng’s words, which made her anxious and angry, so she immediately retorted:

"Why don’t you say the barbarian raiders and coastal Wokou invading your lands are also connected to your Buddha? My Brother Ding is the world’s number one, a heroic figure, and at his prime, why should he say goodbye to Jianghu?!
I see you bald donkeys are up to no good.
Envious of my Brother Ding’s prowess, wanting to imprison him, just with a fancier phrasing to make yourselves look noble."
She looked disdainful:

"You are really hypocritical, despicable. Worshipping Buddha every day, calling yourselves Buddha’s sons and grandsons, if Buddha knew Buddha had you as sons and grandsons, surely he’d be so angry he’d fly over from the West and kill you all!"
Master Fang Zheng was stunned, but quickly, his gentle and benevolent face, out of shame, or anger, or perhaps both, turned beet red, he pointed at Qu Feiyan:

"Good, good, sharp-tongued demoness of the Demon Sect. I recognize you, granddaughter of the Demon Sect Elder Qu Yang. Hero Ding, staying with this little demoness every day, how could you remain unchanged?"
He looked at Ding Ling seriously, saying:
"Hero Ding, black is black, and white is white. The Sun and Moon Divine Sect stands against our righteous sects, yet you mix with them, destroying the Mount Songh Sect.
Committing such heinous, heartless, bloodthirsty acts.
How could the Jianghu Martial Arts community accept you?
If today, you heed my advice, accompany me to reside in the Shaolin Temple, you may avoid this disaster, but if not, there will be no place for you in this Jianghu."
"Showing true colors now, huh?"
Qu Feiyan’s pretty face darkened at the mention of ’Qu Yang’ from Master Fang Zheng, but soon, thinking about Ding Ling, she suppressed her bitterness, made a face at Master Fang Zheng, then said:
"Should have said this earlier, why go through so much formality to make yourselves seem so righteous, so grand. After all, you are still a bunch of hypocritical, despicable people."
Without waiting for the beet-red-faced Master Fang Zheng to argue, Qu Feiyan said crisply:

"You claim the Mount Songh Sect is righteous, but this matter enrages me! You from the Shaolin Temple, ’neighbors’ to the Mount Songh Sect! Don’t you know the vile deeds committed by the Mount Songh Sect?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 364: Eighteen Arhats Array
paragraphs: Qu Feiyan began counting on her fingers, listing the numerous despicable, shameless, vile, bloody, and dirty deeds perpetrated by the Mount Songh Sect.

Among them, she emphasized the extermination of the entire Liu Zhengfeng family of the Mount Heng Sect, Consort Yhu being hunted by the Thirteen Grand Protectors, and Zuo Lengchan’s numerous atrocities committed through alliances with both righteous and demonic sides...
Each crime was shocking and horrifying!
Qu Feiyan’s voice was crisp, yet her speech was incredibly fast.
Her mind was clear and methodical, speaking so clearly that no one could refute her.
Master Fang Zheng was left speechless and deeply shameful by her words.
But obviously, he was a person of firm will, not one to change his judgment because of a few words from Qu Feiyan:
"Little demoness, no matter what you say, it can’t change the fact that you are a demon sect witch. Likewise."
He looked at Ding Ling, pointing towards the direction of the Mount Songh Sect:
"It can’t change the fact that Ding Ling, you have slaughtered countless elite disciples of the Mount Songh Sect, almost wiping out the sect completely!"
He began addressing Ding Ling as Ding Ling instead of Hero Ding.
Clearly, Master Fang Zheng was emotionally stirred after Qu Feiyan’s angry rebuke, not serene as before.
He fixed his bright eyes on Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, what are your thoughts? Are you prepared to make enemies with the entire Jianghu? Or will you stay with us at the Shaolin Temple, living a carefree life without worries?"
"You bald donkey!"
Qu Feiyan was anxious, afraid that Ding Ling might agree, so she looked at Ding Ling and called out ’Brother Ding.’
Ding Ling gave her a reassuring glance, lifted the Drumming Golden Hammer, took two steps forward, and scanned all the monks, finally setting his gaze on Master Fang Zheng:

"I have no intention of making enemies with the entire Jianghu. I also believe that in this world, sensible and neutral people are in the majority. If anyone truly wants to trouble me, I’m not afraid."
Ding Ling paused, smiled slightly, and suddenly out of nowhere, gusts of wind were conjured, making his clothes flutter noisily, as he stood there like a mountain, calm and confident.
His voice was calm but full of steely resolve:
"If the entire Jianghu really wants to oppose me, I want to see who dares to lead them."
He looked at Master Fang Zheng, his eyes deep like two bottomless pools:
"Is it you?"
Master Fang Zheng was drenched in sweat, as if he were being watched by a primordial beast, the intense pressure making him feel suffocated.
He was inwardly shaken, but his resolve grew firmer, pressing his palms together solemnly:

"Amitabha Buddha, blessed be! The Buddha has spoken, ’If I do not enter hell, who will?’ If Donor Ding stubbornly persists in his wrong path, our Shaolin Temple may have to be the one to stand up against him."
His expression was solemn and dignified:
"Even if the abbot of Shaolin Temple were to perish here today, the world must recognize our determination to protect orthodoxy and righteousness, and it shall not be violated!"
"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling laughed three times, his eyes sharp as lightning, surveying the scene:
"What an eloquent Master Fang Zheng. The dead can be brought to life in your words. I won’t waste more words with you. You want to fight, right? Fine!"
Ding Ling raised the Drumming Golden Hammer and stepped forward:
"I’ll accompany you!"
"Form the array!"
Master Fang Zheng, his scalp tingling, couldn’t help but shout in anger.
Boom!
Clang clang clang!
From behind Master Fang Zheng rushed out eighteen Golden Body Arhats, as if painted with gold!
Each holding iron staffs, they shouted loudly, forming a seamless, continuous Flawless Grand Array.
"Does Donor Ding dare to test the power of our Shaolin Temple’s Eighteen Arhats Array?"
Master Fang Zheng retreated to the rear, loudly speaking.
"I was just about to try."
Ding Ling let out a long howl, splitting the skies, shaking the eardrums of Master Fang Zheng’s group, and causing them all to change their expressions drastically.
Qu Feiyan’s group, however, was full of joy, especially Qu Feiyan, who couldn’t help but look delighted, thinking:
"Brother Ding’s voice is getting louder and stronger. Has his skill improved? Good, let’s see how these bald donkeys handle this!"
Boom!

Beneath Ding Ling’s feet, wind arose, and thunder rumbled across the sky. In an instant, Ding Ling had swept to the front of the Eighteen Arhats Array, amidst their full readiness, raising the Drumming Golden Hammer high, activating the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique. The fusion of Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique and True Qi from Pure Yang True Skill was rapidly infused into the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, making it increasingly overpowering and formidable.
Rumble rumble!
Even before the hammer fell, the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique had already caused the Drumming Golden Hammer to produce explosive thunder claps.
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically.
The Eighteen Arhats, especially, were all in high alert!
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed loudly, showing his unbridled and wild nature, leaping into the air. Midair, he fiercely smashed down with the Drumming Golden Hammer, boom boom boom!

As if countless invisible phantom hammers materialized in the void, dense and uncountable, not only that, their speed was extraordinarily fast, being in the sky one moment and crashing at the entrance of the Eighteen Arhats Array the next.
"Block it!"
The Eighteen Arhats roared.
Each one unleashed their supreme skill.
"Monkey Staff Technique!"
One Arhat moved agilely like a monkey, his long staff extending and retracting unpredictably, striking heavily at the Drumming Golden Hammer of the Celestial Palace amidst metallic clangs.
"Mountain Splitting Staff Technique!"
One Arhat took a deep breath and let out a loud shout, wielding his long staff with great power as if he were using the Mountain Splitting Axe Technique, aiming to smash mountains apart.
"Little Plum Blossom Staff Technique!"
One Arhat’s long staff pointed out countless staff shadows.
"Coiling Dragon Staff Technique!"
One Arhat’s long staff spun like a dragon ascending to the heavens, overwhelmingly powerful and unstoppable.
"Wolf Fang Staff Technique!"
"Six Harmonies Staff Technique!"
Eighteen Arhats, eighteen different staff techniques, each mastered to the fullness of their natural ability, combining with the Eighteen Arhats Array!
Consolidating the power of the Eighteen Arhats into one.
The collective power of their staff techniques seemed to form a giant staff reaching the sky, as if it might pierce a hole in the heavens!
Such a formation.
Rarely seen in the world.
Capable of easily crushing a formidable enemy.
Qu Feiyan’s group watched, their faces slightly changing with some worry.
Master Fang Zheng, however, breathed a long sigh of relief, his anticipation quietly building when suddenly.
Boom!
Ding Ling’s invisible phantom giant hammers collided with the power of the staff techniques, rumbling, as soon as the clash began, both sides entered a fierce, heated battle state!
Watching from the outside.
Only the shadows of staffs and hammers could be seen flying non-stop, dust swirling, grass flying in all directions, making it impossible to see clearly what was happening with those inside.

"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling laughed three times, his eyes sharp as lightning, surveying the scene:
"What an eloquent Master Fang Zheng.
The dead can be brought to life in your words.
I won’t waste more words with you.
You want to fight, right?
Fine!"
Ding Ling raised the Drumming Golden Hammer and stepped forward:
"I’ll accompany you!"
"Form the array!"
Master Fang Zheng, his scalp tingling, couldn’t help but shout in anger.
Boom!
Clang clang clang!
From behind Master Fang Zheng rushed out eighteen Golden Body Arhats, as if painted with gold!
Each holding iron staffs, they shouted loudly, forming a seamless, continuous Flawless Grand Array.
"Does Donor Ding dare to test the power of our Shaolin Temple’s Eighteen Arhats Array?"
Master Fang Zheng retreated to the rear, loudly speaking.
"I was just about to try."
Ding Ling let out a long howl, splitting the skies, shaking the eardrums of Master Fang Zheng’s group, and causing them all to change their expressions drastically.
Qu Feiyan’s group, however, was full of joy, especially Qu Feiyan, who couldn’t help but look delighted, thinking:
"Brother Ding’s voice is getting louder and stronger.
Has his skill improved?
Good, let’s see how these bald donkeys handle this!"
Boom!
Beneath Ding Ling’s feet, wind arose, and thunder rumbled across the sky.

In an instant, Ding Ling had swept to the front of the Eighteen Arhats Array, amidst their full readiness, raising the Drumming Golden Hammer high, activating the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.

The fusion of Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique and True Qi from Pure Yang True Skill was rapidly infused into the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, making it increasingly overpowering and formidable.
Rumble rumble!
Even before the hammer fell, the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique had already caused the Drumming Golden Hammer to produce explosive thunder claps.
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically.
The Eighteen Arhats, especially, were all in high alert!
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed loudly, showing his unbridled and wild nature, leaping into the air.
Midair, he fiercely smashed down with the Drumming Golden Hammer, boom boom boom!

As if countless invisible phantom hammers materialized in the void, dense and uncountable, not only that, their speed was extraordinarily fast, being in the sky one moment and crashing at the entrance of the Eighteen Arhats Array the next.
"Block it!"
The Eighteen Arhats roared.
Each one unleashed their supreme skill.
"Monkey Staff Technique!"
One Arhat moved agilely like a monkey, his long staff extending and retracting unpredictably, striking heavily at the Drumming Golden Hammer of the Celestial Palace amidst metallic clangs.
"Mountain Splitting Staff Technique!"
One Arhat took a deep breath and let out a loud shout, wielding his long staff with great power as if he were using the Mountain Splitting Axe Technique, aiming to smash mountains apart.
"Little Plum Blossom Staff Technique!"
One Arhat’s long staff pointed out countless staff shadows.
"Coiling Dragon Staff Technique!"
One Arhat’s long staff spun like a dragon ascending to the heavens, overwhelmingly powerful and unstoppable.
"Wolf Fang Staff Technique!"
"Six Harmonies Staff Technique!"
Eighteen Arhats, eighteen different staff techniques, each mastered to the fullness of their natural ability, combining with the Eighteen Arhats Array!
Consolidating the power of the Eighteen Arhats into one.
The collective power of their staff techniques seemed to form a giant staff reaching the sky, as if it might pierce a hole in the heavens!
Such a formation.
Rarely seen in the world.
Capable of easily crushing a formidable enemy.
Qu Feiyan’s group watched, their faces slightly changing with some worry.
Master Fang Zheng, however, breathed a long sigh of relief, his anticipation quietly building when suddenly.
Boom!
Ding Ling’s invisible phantom giant hammers collided with the power of the staff techniques, rumbling, as soon as the clash began, both sides entered a fierce, heated battle state!
Watching from the outside.
Only the shadows of staffs and hammers could be seen flying non-stop, dust swirling, grass flying in all directions, making it impossible to see clearly what was happening with those inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 365: Ding Ling vs. Master Fang Zheng
paragraphs: But in this state.
It lasted for only about three to five breaths.
Then there was a crisp cracking sound, as if something had broken.
Everyone fixed their eyes on it.

There was a loud crash, and then they saw an Arhat hit by a huge hammer, screaming miserably as he was thrown more than dozens of meters away, falling to the ground like a rag, rolling a few times before stopping. Upon closer inspection, it was discovered that he only had incoming breaths, but no outgoing breaths.
Master Fang Zheng’s face turned pale, anger boiling.
Just as he was about to reprimand.
Boom, boom, boom!
One by one, the Golden Body Arhats were swept away by the hammer shadows!

They flew dozens of meters away like rags, falling to the ground with a series of thuds, without exception, all severely injured, some even dying on the spot, their faces unrecognizable, evidently dying miserably.
Qu Feiyan and her companions breathed a sigh of relief.
"Ah!"
Master Fang Zheng’s eyes nearly burst with rage, unable to hold back a furious howl, pointing at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, you great demon, do you really wish to make an enemy of the world and slaughter all beings?"
Ding Ling, carrying the Drumming Golden Hammer, walked towards Master Fang Zheng unhurriedly, his eyes deep and expression indifferent, his voice cold:
"I have said before. I do not wish to make enemies with the people of the world, nor do I wish to oppose this Jianghu. You chose to be the leader in challenging me.
Since you want to be my enemy.
Then you must be prepared to be killed by me at any time.
Master Fang Zheng!
What do you say?"
"Ah!"
Master Fang Zheng roared in anger:
"Ding Ling, you wield a Divine Weapon, while we of the Shaolin Temple use ordinary iron staves. This battle was unfair from the start. If you were a hero, you wouldn’t do such unfair things."
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed, as if he had heard the funniest joke in the world. Suddenly, he stopped smiling, his face turning cold as ice:
"Qu Feiyan was right. You bald donkeys are all hypocrites! You besiege me, and it’s fair. I use a Divine Weapon, and it’s unfair. Fine!"
Ding Ling put down the Drumming Golden Hammer:
"Today, I will face Master Fang Zheng and your Shaolin Temple’s supreme skills barehanded!"
"Good!"

Master Fang Zheng, initially heated by Ding Ling’s words, didn’t know how to respond. Seeing Ding Ling put down the Divine Weapon to face him, he breathed a sigh of relief while tension built up inside.
He swept his gaze over those behind him, uttered ’Amitabha Buddha’, and then said:
"If I die. The people of Shaolin Temple must not seek revenge for me, remember this!"
Master Fang Zheng sighed.
He had overestimated the power of Shaolin Temple’s Eighteen Arhats Array.
And underestimated the overbearing aura and unrivaled nature of Ding Ling!
He originally thought that with the combined efforts of eighteen First-class Peak Level experts in the Eighteen Arhats Array, it would be enough to kill a strong fighter like Ding Ling.
And even if they couldn’t kill him.
They should have been able to retreat.
Now it seemed he had overrated his side.
Underestimated Ding Ling.
The eighteen First-class Peak experts on their side were nurtured through the entirety of Shaolin Temple’s resources and decades of painstaking effort!
They were meant to be the heritage of Shaolin Temple, passed down!
Yet now they were destroyed in a single morning.
Master Fang Zheng felt a chill in his heart, regretful, blaming himself, annoyed, pained, and angry.
Regretful and blaming himself for taking things for granted, thinking that as a Beidou of Jianghu Martial Arts, Ding Ling would never strike them!
Annoyed at not mobilizing Shaolin Temple’s force along with the Wudang Sect and others to hold Ding Ling accountable.
Heartbroken and furious over the death of Eighteen Arhats, the decades of effort by Shaolin Temple wasted in an instant!
"Abbot."
All Shaolin Temple monks turned pale.
"Remember my words."
Master Fang Zheng solemnly said:
"Otherwise, even if I meet the Buddha in the west, my heart will not be at peace!"
"Yes. Abbot."
All monks could only obey orders.
Yet each harbored ominous thoughts in their hearts.
"Amitabha Buddha."
Having made up his mind and given instructions to the monks, Master Fang Zheng strode out to face Ding Ling:

"Donor Ding’s Hammer Technique shakes the heavens, and your power is such that people can only look on in admiration. I am likely not your opponent! However, I must say, Donor Ding, you have fallen deeply into demonic ways. Only by stopping in time and finding the way back can you truly reach the Buddha’s other shore, enjoying great freedom, great euphoria.
If you continue stubbornly, failing to repent, I fear the Buddha may find it hard to save you once you are deeply lost.
"Master Fang Zheng is quite glib."
Ding Ling said indifferently:
"But no matter how much you babble, I will not listen to your nonsense!"
"Brother Ding, well said!"
Qu Feiyan cheered, her charming face full of delight.
"If Donor Ding is willing to convert to Buddhism, our Shaolin Temple is willing to exhaust all efforts to assist you."
Master Fang Zheng said sincerely:
"This is a rare opportunity. Not everyone receives such treatment."
"Thank you, Master Fang Zheng, for your kindness."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"I admire your broad-mindedness and courage. Not long ago you wanted to kill me, and now you’re trying your utmost to win me over. Such breadth of heart is rare. I confess I can’t do it. So I won’t sit with you. Come."
He raised his hand:
"Let me experience the supreme skills of Shaolin Temple’s Master Fang Zheng."
"Since reason fails, I will forsake this body and have a proper contest with Donor Ding."

Master Fang Zheng took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the boiling thoughts within, activating the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic. In an instant, Qi Force filled his whole body, Qi generating within, circulating continuously, rising and falling like the tide, surging like thunder!
Boom!

Master Fang Zheng’s figure moved like lightning, reaching Ding Ling, lightly striking out a palm. This palm initially seemed ordinary, but in an instant, it transformed into two palms, then four, and in no time, the sky was filled with palm shadows, every palm unpredictable and vast beyond measure!
The claps of thunder seemed to rise in the void, echoed by rumbling sound streaking across the Celestial Extreme.
Ding Ling did not advance but retreated, also striking out a palm.
Great Songyang Divine Palm!

The Great Songyang Divine Palm, driven and unleashed together with Pure Yang True Skill and Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, upon execution, also transformed into countless palm shadows, each carrying intense and violent Qi, like thunderbolts about to explode.
As their palm shadows collided.
Bam bam bam!
Boom boom boom!
A series of explosions sounded endlessly!
As soon as the two fought, they immediately engaged at the highest peak!

Palm shadows flew through the void, Xun Wind stirring constantly, hidden thunder born, everywhere they went, great stones shattered, trees fell and grass bent, akin to two deities clashing, leaving onlookers secretly amazed.
The people of Shaolin Temple all had their hearts in their throats, seeing their abbot’s heroic spirit, cheering secretly, glowing with enthusiasm, when suddenly, boom!
A loud sound passed by their ears.
Upon looking again, they saw their abbot already sent flying dozens of meters!
