chapters.title: Chapter 366: Quest Progress
paragraphs: Master Fang Zheng spun and rolled several times in mid-air before landing.
Thud thud thud!
But he was still unstable, retreating over ten steps before he seemed to dissipate all his Vigorous Qi.
Even so.
He still staggered, almost falling to the ground.
"Abbot!"
The monks of Shaolin Temple were shocked, and someone immediately stepped forward to support Master Fang Zheng.
Master Fang Zheng’s face was fluctuating between blue and white, his chest heaving violently for a long while. Unable to hold it back anymore, pfft!
He suddenly opened his mouth and spat out a blood jet.
The monks of Shaolin Temple were even more astonished, worried, and furious at this sight.
Someone immediately accused Ding Ling:
"Donor Ding, your Demon Nature is beyond cure. You even dared to injure my Shaolin Temple’s venerable Master Fang Zheng. You are truly sinful, heading straight for the Eighteen Layers of Hell."
"Nonsense!"
Qu Feiyan couldn’t hold back any longer and stood up angrily:

"It was your people who first surrounded Brother Ding, not to mention they ganged up on him. Later, they claimed that Brother Ding used the Divine Weapon to win unfairly. My Brother Ding didn’t use any weapons and injured your Master Fang Zheng, and now you talk about how the venerable shouldn’t be injured.
So my Brother Ding, the mighty hero, should suffer such repeated humiliation from you?
It’s really hateful, loathsome, infuriating!
You bald donkeys are shameless. Brother Ding didn’t unleash a slaughter on you, already showing mercy.
Yet you’re so unaware of your own wrongs and even turn against my Brother Ding!
Who exactly should be heading to the Eighteen Layers of Hell?!
Moreover..."
Qu Feiyan’s voice was crisp, pleasant, and resonated in the mountains, echoing restlessly as she spoke rapidly, leaving the monks no chance to argue:
"You are absolutely in cahoots with the Mount Songh Sect. Otherwise, how could you turn a blind eye to your neighbor doing so many things that undermine the righteous demeanor?
My Brother Ding eradicated such a gang of evil-doers acting domineeringly, unchecked, and arrogantly!
It would be fine if you did not praise him.
Yet you even come out to unjustly criticize, talking about safeguarding the righteous, protecting the righteous path!
It’s really too ridiculous.
You are the only ones who believe your nonsense.
Anyone with a bit of a brain wouldn’t believe your bullshit!"
"You, you, you..."
The monk was furious beyond belief.
"What do you mean you."
Qu Feiyan glared:
"Having no grounds and still wanting to gain a huge advantage! Dream on! We won’t tolerate you bunch of bald donkeys!"
"Ha ha..."
Huang Zhonggong couldn’t help but clap his hands and said:
"Well said!"
"A bunch of Demon Sect fiends."
The monk shouted angrily:
"Ding Ling, mingling with you Demon Sect people, has long been defiled! What isn’t he a demon?!
Snap! Snap!

Ding Ling’s expression was indifferent, his body like the wind, his palms striking like lightning, with two crisp snaps, the monk who had just yelled angrily was beaten flying out, falling to the ground, life or death unknown.
"Kongjian!"
The other monks shouted in surprise.
"I don’t want to waste my breath with you any longer."

Ding Ling stood with his hands behind his back, with a gesture, a stream of Vigorous Qi flew out, boom! The Drumming Golden Hammer was locked and knocked into the air, spinning backward until it landed perfectly in Ding Ling’s hand. Holding it, he scanned the monks and said coldly:
"Keep babbling, and my hammer won’t be reasoning with you."
"Hmm hmm."
The monks were furious, yet helpless, and had no choice but to reluctantly lead Master Fang Zheng down the mountain.
Master Fang Zheng was heavily injured by Ding Ling.
How long he could live.
Was still an unknown.
Ding Ling watched, without a trace of pity for them.
Pitiful people must have an aspect worthy of hatred.
Just as Qu Feiyan said.
Mount Songh Sect is so close to Shaolin Temple.
There’s no reason the world’s top righteous sect wouldn’t know about the great deeds happening within the Mount Songh Sect.
Since they knew, why didn’t they stop it?
How much trickery is there among all this, who can say clearly?
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling also prepared to head to Huashan.
Being delayed by this group led by Master Fang Zheng for a while.
But because Ding Ling’s actions were decisive enough, the delay was minimal.
Da da!
A group of people moved quickly.
Qu Feiyan trailed far behind Ding Ling.
On the way, her eyes darting around, she suddenly threw the package in her hand to Lin Pingzhi, then dashed into the forest with a small package of her own and disappeared.
"Hey!"
Lin Pingzhi only wanted to shout twice, but Qu Feiyan’s voice came distantly:
"I’m going to relieve myself, please inform Brother Ding."
"Alright."
Lin Pingzhi could only agree.
After all, Qu Feiyan was nowhere to be seen.
It was already too late to say anything else at this point.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating the Eighteen Arhats!]
[Annotation: As the trump card of Shaolin Temple. Each of the Eighteen Arhats possesses profound Inner Strength, with Martial Arts Skills that have Entered the Transformation Realm!
Originally, Master Fang Zheng thought that dispatching such a trump card team would be enough to suppress you. Even if not, they could still withdraw safely.
The Eighteen Arhats themselves also believed so. Each one was brimming with confidence.
But the result was completely unexpected.
They were shocked, unwilling, confused! They couldn’t believe that someone like you existed in this world!]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating Master Fang Zheng.]

[Annotation: As the Abbot of Shaolin Temple, Master Fang Zheng mastered Supreme Skills like the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Thousand Hands Buddha Palm, and Lion’s Roar. Unfortunately, even before he could employ Lion’s Roar, he was almost killed by you. At this moment, his heart veins have ruptured, and he doesn’t have long to live. His heart is full of regret and remorse.
If he could do it all over again, he would never recklessly come to reason with you!]
Ding Ling listened to the prompts.
Thinking:
"These monks are arrogant and self-confident, considering themselves to be above all. Even the seeming kind and dignified Master Fang Zheng is no exception.
Their initial intent was to imprison me, even to severely injure me.
In such a case, why would I show mercy?"
Ding Ling’s principle has always been like this.
If people don’t offend me, I won’t offend them!
If people offend me, I will harm or kill them!
As he traversed through the Three Kingdoms World, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, these were his behavioral guidelines.
He has boundaries, perspective, and determination.
But equally, he’s not capable of being considerate and tolerant toward those with murder in their hearts against him.
He is not that magnanimous.
Ding Ling has grown all this way. His state of mind has been elevated several times.
The whole person has become increasingly bold, free-spirited, and overbearing!
This is an inevitable part of the growth journey.
Every stage of a person’s life is different, the mindset will undergo subtle changes, Ding Ling is human, and he is no exception.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane powerhouses: 39/20.]
Ding Ling noticed the change on the Character Panel.
Previously it was 20.
Now having defeated the 18 Arhats and Master Fang Zheng. It instantly turned into 39.
[3: You must let your name as the World’s Number One echo throughout the Plane World. 35%/100%.]
Previously it was 13%.
It shows that during this time, Ding Ling destroying Li Yuanba, killing Zuo Lengchan, and shattering the Mount Songh Sect’s deeds have already started to spread widely.
Many people have begun to consider him, Ding Ling, as the World’s Number One.
But likewise.
There certainly aren’t a few who support Dongfang Bubai or even Feng Qingyang as the number one.
However, now that Ding Ling has defeated Master Fang Zheng and killed the 18 Arhats, once this news spreads, his fame will undoubtedly rise once again.
"Defeating Dongfang Bubai, Feng Qingyang, and others, learning the Dugu Nine Swords, should allow me to shatter the void and depart."
The principle of shattering the void is simple.
Just finish walking the Path of Glory.

"I don’t want to waste my breath with you any longer."
Ding Ling stood with his hands behind his back, with a gesture, a stream of Vigorous Qi flew out, boom!
The Drumming Golden Hammer was locked and knocked into the air, spinning backward until it landed perfectly in Ding Ling’s hand.
Holding it, he scanned the monks and said coldly:
"Keep babbling, and my hammer won’t be reasoning with you."
"Hmm hmm."
The monks were furious, yet helpless, and had no choice but to reluctantly lead Master Fang Zheng down the mountain.
Master Fang Zheng was heavily injured by Ding Ling.
How long he could live.
Was still an unknown.
Ding Ling watched, without a trace of pity for them.
Pitiful people must have an aspect worthy of hatred.
Just as Qu Feiyan said.
Mount Songh Sect is so close to Shaolin Temple.
There’s no reason the world’s top righteous sect wouldn’t know about the great deeds happening within the Mount Songh Sect.
Since they knew, why didn’t they stop it?
How much trickery is there among all this, who can say clearly?
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling also prepared to head to Huashan.
Being delayed by this group led by Master Fang Zheng for a while.
But because Ding Ling’s actions were decisive enough, the delay was minimal.
Da da!
A group of people moved quickly.
Qu Feiyan trailed far behind Ding Ling.
On the way, her eyes darting around, she suddenly threw the package in her hand to Lin Pingzhi, then dashed into the forest with a small package of her own and disappeared.
"Hey!"
Lin Pingzhi only wanted to shout twice, but Qu Feiyan’s voice came distantly:
"I’m going to relieve myself, please inform Brother Ding."
"Alright."
Lin Pingzhi could only agree.
After all, Qu Feiyan was nowhere to be seen.
It was already too late to say anything else at this point.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating the Eighteen Arhats!]
[Annotation: As the trump card of Shaolin Temple.
Each of the Eighteen Arhats possesses profound Inner Strength, with Martial Arts Skills that have Entered the Transformation Realm!
Originally, Master Fang Zheng thought that dispatching such a trump card team would be enough to suppress you.
Even if not, they could still withdraw safely.
The Eighteen Arhats themselves also believed so.
Each one was brimming with confidence.
But the result was completely unexpected.
They were shocked, unwilling, confused!
They couldn’t believe that someone like you existed in this world!]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Intimidating Master Fang Zheng.]
[Annotation: As the Abbot of Shaolin Temple, Master Fang Zheng mastered Supreme Skills like the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Thousand Hands Buddha Palm, and Lion’s Roar.
Unfortunately, even before he could employ Lion’s Roar, he was almost killed by you.
At this moment, his heart veins have ruptured, and he doesn’t have long to live.
His heart is full of regret and remorse.
If he could do it all over again, he would never recklessly come to reason with you!]
Ding Ling listened to the prompts.
Thinking:
"These monks are arrogant and self-confident, considering themselves to be above all.
Even the seeming kind and dignified Master Fang Zheng is no exception.
Their initial intent was to imprison me, even to severely injure me.
In such a case, why would I show mercy?"
Ding Ling’s principle has always been like this.
If people don’t offend me, I won’t offend them!
If people offend me, I will harm or kill them!
As he traversed through the Three Kingdoms World, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, these were his behavioral guidelines.
He has boundaries, perspective, and determination.
But equally, he’s not capable of being considerate and tolerant toward those with murder in their hearts against him.
He is not that magnanimous.
Ding Ling has grown all this way.
His state of mind has been elevated several times.
The whole person has become increasingly bold, free-spirited, and overbearing!
This is an inevitable part of the growth journey.
Every stage of a person’s life is different, the mindset will undergo subtle changes, Ding Ling is human, and he is no exception.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane powerhouses: 39/20.]
Ding Ling noticed the change on the Character Panel.
Previously it was 20.
Now having defeated the 18 Arhats and Master Fang Zheng.
It instantly turned into 39.
[3: You must let your name as the World’s Number One echo throughout the Plane World.
Previously it was 13%.
It shows that during this time, Ding Ling destroying Li Yuanba, killing Zuo Lengchan, and shattering the Mount Songh Sect’s deeds have already started to spread widely.
Many people have begun to consider him, Ding Ling, as the World’s Number One.
But likewise.
There certainly aren’t a few who support Dongfang Bubai or even Feng Qingyang as the number one.
However, now that Ding Ling has defeated Master Fang Zheng and killed the 18 Arhats, once this news spreads, his fame will undoubtedly rise once again.
"Defeating Dongfang Bubai, Feng Qingyang, and others, learning the Dugu Nine Swords, should allow me to shatter the void and depart."
The principle of shattering the void is simple.
Just finish walking the Path of Glory.

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Qu Feiyan Hears the Complete Scripture
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s path of glory was also coming to an end.
He estimated that his time in this world could not last long.
He thought of using this time to mentor Qu Feiyan and others, especially Qu Feiyan, as he had promised Qu Yang to take good care of her.
If he were to shatter the void and leave, leaving Qu Feiyan alone in this world.
Ding Ling felt uneasy about it.
He resolved that no matter what, he must do his utmost to train Qu Feiyan into a first-class expert! Let her have the power to protect herself.
With this in mind.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but turn his eyes and scan behind him, ’huh’!
He didn’t see Qu Feiyan and couldn’t help but ask:
"Where’s Qu Feiyan?"
"She said she went to relieve herself."
Lin Pingzhi replied.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Qu Feiyan didn’t go before, why go now, what’s the reason?
But if a young lady did indeed go to relieve herself.
He couldn’t simply go and check.
He could only stand at the foot of the mountain and wait.
So he waited for about more than an hour.
Just when Ding Ling couldn’t help but want Consort Yhu to go check, a clear voice suddenly came from the front side:
"Brother Ding, Brother Ding!"
Ding Ling looked towards the voice.
He saw a small figure, dressed in monk’s attire and wearing a novice monk hat, running over, looking very much like a little novice monk.
Her features were delicate, difficult to discern between male and female.
But Ding Ling vaguely recognized her through her eyebrows; she was Qu Feiyan, and he was taken aback:
"Qu Feiyan?!"
"Brother Ding, Brother Ding."
The little novice monk was indeed Qu Feiyan. She ran to Ding Ling, saw everyone staring at her, blushed, slightly turned her body, and wiped her face with a handkerchief.
Removed the hat and monk’s attire.
In no time.
A charming young maiden appeared before everyone.
In stark contrast to her previous appearance.
Lin Pingzhi was astonished:
"You, you..."
"Hehe."
Qu Feiyan covered her mouth and chuckled:

"I learned this from Brother Ding. Brother Ding’s makeup skill is extraordinary. I found it interesting and learned it, and to my surprise, I seem to have a talent in this area, managing to learn seventy to eighty percent of Brother Ding’s skills, which works well to fool those bald monks."
"You’re more than seventy or eighty percent."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"You’ve surpassed me. You’re more skilled than I am."
Ding Ling’s words were sincere.
Though his makeup skill was at a full level.
It was only at the full level of real-world makeup skills.
Qu Feiyan, on the other hand, took a unique approach, using martial arts, inner strength, and other techniques to create a disguise more suited to her.
If Ding Ling weren’t familiar enough with her, he might not have recognized her just now.
"Brother Ding is humble."
Qu Feiyan smiled as she raised the snakeskin bag in her hand like showing off a treasure, saying:
"Brother Ding, I found what you needed, take a look."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was puzzled, but seeing Qu Feiyan urging, he did not delay, took the snakeskin bag, and opened it.
After taking a close look at it.
He couldn’t help but twitch his eyelids, surprised:
"This, this..."
"Hehe."
Qu Feiyan raised an eyebrow, seemingly a bit proud:
"The abbot at Shaolin Temple is near death. I disguised myself, dressed as a little novice monk, mingled with some little novices..."
Qu Feiyan’s speech was as quick as always.
Clear and coherent.
Easy to understand upon hearing.
It turned out that she secretly arrived at Shaolin Temple ahead of Master Fang Zheng and others.
She then knocked out a little novice monk, disguised herself as him, and communicated with some other little novices.

Some little novices sensed something unusual, feeling her speech and physique were not quite right. Qu Feiyan intentionally mentioned Master Fang Zheng’s impending death and the death of the Eighteen Arhats.
It successfully diverted the topic, causing the little novices to exclaim repeatedly, deeply shocked.
Qu Feiyan, lively and sharp, with a series of unconventional moves, managed to stop them from further questioning her odd speech and physique.
When she saw the bodies of the Eighteen Arhats being carried into the Shaolin Temple gates.
The little novices were even more moved and naturally believed Qu Feiyan’s words without a doubt.
Qu Feiyan took the opportunity to gather a few gullible-looking little novices and went to Master Fang Zheng’s location. To avoid being discovered, they hid secretly.
Just in time to overhear Master Fang Zheng reciting the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic.
"Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic.
Hearing this, Ding Ling was quite moved, his eyes bright as he looked at Qu Feiyan:
"You memorized it?"
"Yes, yes!"

Qu Feiyan, seeing Ding Ling indeed cared about this matter, couldn’t help but burst into a joyful smile. She had always felt somewhat useless, unable to help Ding Ling, feeling sad for it. Now, being able to help him once, she naturally was ecstatic, her voice excitedly rising a few pitches:
"Fang Zheng said the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic is orally passed down; to prevent it from being lost, it must be transmitted while he is still breathing.
Otherwise, he couldn’t face the abbots of past generations.
So.
He called for his junior brother to impart this technique to him.
However, his junior brother wasn’t very good at memory.

Fang Zheng had to recite it five times before his junior brother barely memorized it. I memorized it during the second recitation, but couldn’t leave due to the presence of others. After his junior brother memorized it and Fang Zheng passed away, I then secretly left with a few little novices, heading for the Scripture Pavilion..."
Qu Feiyan, full of wisdom, having no anxiety over Ding Ling’s matters anymore, seemed enlightened while handling things, despite facing some difficulties, resolved them smoothly.
She went to the Scripture Pavilion, met a few high monks guarding it, and told them the abbot was about to pass away and wanted to see them one last time.
The high monks initially did not believe.
But seeing the few little novices also sadly talking about the abbot’s impending death.
The high monks believed a bit more.
They went off to find Fang Zheng.
Qu Feiyan seized the chance to knock out the little novices, quickly scouring through the Scripture Pavilion for martial arts secret manuals, then ran off like the wind.
She was discovered midway.
But couldn’t be caught immediately.
Upon reaching the foot of the mountain and seeing Ding Ling, Qu Feiyan truly breathed a sigh of relief, couldn’t help but call out ’Brother Ding,’ leading to this current situation.
After Ding Ling listened, he tapped Qu Feiyan’s forehead:
"Do not do such things in the future, it’s too dangerous."
"I will be careful."
Qu Feiyan blinked her large watery eyes at Ding Ling:
"Brother Ding, won’t you look at these secret manuals?"
"Alright."
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate:
"I’ll take a look now."
He took out the first secret manual.
It was indeed the Thousand Hands Buddha Palm!
It was this supreme skill that Master Fang Zheng had previously clashed with his Great Songyang Divine Palm.
Ding Ling quickly finished reading it.
In an instant.
[Thousand Hands Buddha Palm Full Level]
Ding Ling gently turned his palm, and saw the air was filled with palm shadows, resembling a holy Buddha making a palm strike, bringing forth a kind of merciful intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic Full Level
paragraphs: Consort Yhu and her group were secretly astonished.
Despite being long accustomed to Ding Ling’s superhuman speed in mastering martial arts.
Witnessing once more that he could cultivate an entire supreme skill to an instinctive, flawless realm after just a glance, still left them shaken and amazed.
One must understand, this was a supreme skill of the Shaolin Temple!
Ding Ling flipped to the second secret manual.
Swish.
Soon, he finished reading it.
In an instant.
[Great Compassion Thousand Leaves Hand: Full Level]
Boom!

Ding Ling’s palm spun slightly, and in the void, countless Infinite Buddha Palms emerged, akin to the Thousand-Handed Guanyin Bodhisattva plucking a flower and smiling, astoundingly beautiful, yet the force of the palm was extremely intimidating.
Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and the others could not help but take a breath of cold air, feeling increasingly respectful.
Qu Feiyan watched with hidden joy, feeling proud and thinking:
"Indeed, it’s useful to Brother Ding. It seems this trip wasn’t in vain."
The third book.
[Dorayaki: Full Level]
Ding Ling extended a finger, pointed it towards a massive rock nearby, and puff! The finger force penetrated the rock, going in as deep as three inches!
Ding Ling secretly praised, as his fingers flew through the air, resembling blooming patola flowers, with every pass of his ten fingers, puff puff!
Ten deep pits, over three inches deep, instantly appeared on the massive rock!
Consort Yhu and her group were extremely astounded:
"This Finger Technique is so powerful!"
"Indeed, it’s a top-tier Finger Technique."

"Remarkable. Such a Finger Technique can be perfected in an instant. Ding Ling truly is a born Martial God. If anyone said Ding Ling was the Wuqu Star Monarch descending from the heavens, I’d truly believe it!"
The fourth book.
[Shaolin Tiger Claw Hand: Full Level]
His fingers curled like claws, one claw tearing down, seemingly able to shred everything.
The fifth book.
[Dharma Swordsmanship: Full Level]
Using his fingers as a sword, an extremely superior sword technique was displayed, with sword lights shimmering in the void, extremely dazzling and blinding.
The sixth book.
[Merciful Saber Technique: Full Level]
A superior saber technique that subdues the enemy without killing them.
Although this saber technique is extremely strong, it doesn’t kill, because its saber force is primarily used for trapping and restraining people.
It’s similar to chopping someone with the back of a saber, as long as control is precise, it’s difficult to kill someone.
The seventh book.
[Little Yaksha Staff Technique]
With a single staff swing, the essence of countless staff techniques is vividly displayed.
A highly ferocious killer staff technique.
The eighth book.
[Shaolin Iron Broom Skill: Full Level]
A superior technique using a broom as a weapon, where intent and force align so that the broom can become a supreme divine weapon for defeating enemies.
There were over thirty secret manuals in total.
Only eleven or so could be counted as part of the Seventy-Two Shaolin Skills.
The others could only be considered some basic cultivation techniques of the Shaolin Temple.
Such as Pile Skill and some Inner Power Heart Methods, etc.
Ding Ling looked through them one by one.
All reached full level.
After reading them, he packed the secret manuals back into the canvas sack.
Consort Yhu and her group were numb.
They had just watched clearly, it took only a moment.
Over thirty completely different skills, Ding Ling had perfected them all.
What kind of divine being is this!
No matter how many times they watched something like this, it was inevitably shocking.
Although they were now already numb, inside their hearts, waves still rolled in their Heart Lake, unable to calm down.
For ordinary people, cultivating a martial art might take decades, and even then, they might not achieve Great Perfection, but Ding Ling did it in less time than it took to blink.
This kind of disparity.
The difference.
It’s enough to be fatal!
Fortunately, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and the others had already given up comparing themselves to Ding Ling’s martial arts progress, otherwise they would have been utterly demoralized.
"Shaolin Temple has seventy-two ultimate skills, now only a dozen are left. It seems that during these historical tumultuous years, Shaolin Temple couldn’t avoid encountering some disasters either."
"There are no whole eggs under a toppled nest."
Every change of dynasty.
The Shaolin Temple seeking to break away perfectly, how could it be so easy?
Ding Ling let it go.
He just glanced at Qu Feiyan.
Qu Feiyan immediately beamed with joy and promptly recited the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic.
She didn’t specifically pull Ding Ling aside to recite it.
She just said it straightforwardly in front of everyone.
Ding Ling didn’t stop her.
They were all on his side.
If they could remember the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and learn it, that would be great; if not, it wasn’t a big deal.
Greedily attempting to learn too much would be counterproductive.
How many years has the Shaolin Temple passed down the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, yet how many of their own people have mastered it?
But Ding Ling was an exception.
After Qu Feiyan explained.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
As a book condensed on the shelf.
In an instant after.
[Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic: Full Level]
A special batch of Vigorous Qi emerged from his limbs and bones.
This Qi was extremely pure, incredibly gentle; wherever it passed, Ding Ling felt as if some damaged areas in his meridians were being healed.
This was clearly an especially exquisite and profound superior, top-tier inner power heart technique for nourishing the body and mind.
In quality, it even surpassed Pure Yang True Skill to some extent.
But perhaps because of insufficient quantity of Qi.
It did not consume the True Water of the Pure Yang True Skill.
Instead, it transformed into a thread, weaving through the meridians, stabilizing Ding Ling’s foundation and broadening his channels.
This wisp of Qi.
The True Qi of Pure Yang True Skill could not refine, absorb, or incorporate it for its use. The two were clearly defined, not interfering with each other, and seemed extremely harmonious.
"Is this the incredibly mighty Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic?"
Ding Ling mused.
"How is it?"
Qu Feiyan asked eagerly.
Ding Ling smiled and patted her head:
"Very good. Thank you."
"To be able to help Brother Ding, it’s my blessing. I’m very happy!"
Qu Feiyan was delighted, she had spoken her heartfelt words.
"It’s incredible."
Consort Yhu and her group admitted their inadequacy.

They were also listening to the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic just now, but after listening, they couldn’t say how much they remembered. Just understanding the content was extremely difficult, let alone practicing it.
Yet Ding Ling seemingly mastered it.
This shocking speed of cultivation was truly unprecedented throughout history!
Being with such a Divine Being like this, Consort Yhu and her group felt both fortunate and pressured, with an urgency to put in more effort and practice harder.
"Let’s go. Leave this place."
Ding Ling and his group prepared to leave on horseback.

Meanwhile, people from Shaolin Temple also reached the foot of the mountain at that moment. Someone blocked the path and questioned Ding Ling if he had taken the Shaolin Temple’s supreme skills. Ding Ling merely frowned and shouted sharply:
"Scram!"
Roar!
It sounded like a dragon’s roar, more like a Lion’s Roar!
As he shouted.
The questioner’s eardrums shattered on the spot, screaming as he rolled to the ground, yet when looking at Ding Ling, his gaze changed.
"Buddhist Lion’s Roar! You’re the one who took our Shaolin Temple’s supreme skills!"
Regardless of their injuries, they got up and roared furiously.
"Heh."
Ding Ling sneered:
"So what if it was me? What can you do about it?"
Ding Ling directly drew his sword, unleashing the Dharma Swordsmanship, and saw countless sword shadows filling the sky. Amidst the clashing sounds, the monks blocking his way were all decapitated.
At that moment, Ding Ling became even more certain that the Lion’s Roar skill he obtained from Gao Kexin of the Thirteen Grand Protectors of Mount Songh had originated from the Shaolin Temple.

[Merciful Saber Technique: Full Level]
A superior saber technique that subdues the enemy without killing them.
Although this saber technique is extremely strong, it doesn’t kill, because its saber force is primarily used for trapping and restraining people.
It’s similar to chopping someone with the back of a saber, as long as control is precise, it’s difficult to kill someone.
The seventh book.
[Little Yaksha Staff Technique]
With a single staff swing, the essence of countless staff techniques is vividly displayed.
A highly ferocious killer staff technique.
The eighth book.
[Shaolin Iron Broom Skill: Full Level]
A superior technique using a broom as a weapon, where intent and force align so that the broom can become a supreme divine weapon for defeating enemies.
There were over thirty secret manuals in total.
Only eleven or so could be counted as part of the Seventy-Two Shaolin Skills.
The others could only be considered some basic cultivation techniques of the Shaolin Temple.
Such as Pile Skill and some Inner Power Heart Methods, etc.
Ding Ling looked through them one by one.
All reached full level.
After reading them, he packed the secret manuals back into the canvas sack.
Consort Yhu and her group were numb.
They had just watched clearly, it took only a moment.
Over thirty completely different skills, Ding Ling had perfected them all.
What kind of divine being is this!
No matter how many times they watched something like this, it was inevitably shocking.
Although they were now already numb, inside their hearts, waves still rolled in their Heart Lake, unable to calm down.
For ordinary people, cultivating a martial art might take decades, and even then, they might not achieve Great Perfection, but Ding Ling did it in less time than it took to blink.
This kind of disparity.
The difference.
It’s enough to be fatal!
Fortunately, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and the others had already given up comparing themselves to Ding Ling’s martial arts progress, otherwise they would have been utterly demoralized.
"Shaolin Temple has seventy-two ultimate skills, now only a dozen are left.
It seems that during these historical tumultuous years, Shaolin Temple couldn’t avoid encountering some disasters either."
"There are no whole eggs under a toppled nest."
Every change of dynasty.
The Shaolin Temple seeking to break away perfectly, how could it be so easy?
Ding Ling let it go.
He just glanced at Qu Feiyan.
Qu Feiyan immediately beamed with joy and promptly recited the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic.
She didn’t specifically pull Ding Ling aside to recite it.
She just said it straightforwardly in front of everyone.
Ding Ling didn’t stop her.
They were all on his side.
If they could remember the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and learn it, that would be great; if not, it wasn’t a big deal.
Greedily attempting to learn too much would be counterproductive.
How many years has the Shaolin Temple passed down the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, yet how many of their own people have mastered it?
But Ding Ling was an exception.
After Qu Feiyan explained.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
As a book condensed on the shelf.
In an instant after.
[Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic: Full Level]
A special batch of Vigorous Qi emerged from his limbs and bones.
This Qi was extremely pure, incredibly gentle; wherever it passed, Ding Ling felt as if some damaged areas in his meridians were being healed.
This was clearly an especially exquisite and profound superior, top-tier inner power heart technique for nourishing the body and mind.
In quality, it even surpassed Pure Yang True Skill to some extent.
But perhaps because of insufficient quantity of Qi.
It did not consume the True Water of the Pure Yang True Skill.
Instead, it transformed into a thread, weaving through the meridians, stabilizing Ding Ling’s foundation and broadening his channels.
This wisp of Qi.
The True Qi of Pure Yang True Skill could not refine, absorb, or incorporate it for its use.
The two were clearly defined, not interfering with each other, and seemed extremely harmonious.
"Is this the incredibly mighty Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic?"
Ding Ling mused.
"How is it?"
Qu Feiyan asked eagerly.
Ding Ling smiled and patted her head:
"Very good.
Thank you."
"To be able to help Brother Ding, it’s my blessing.
I’m very happy!"
Qu Feiyan was delighted, she had spoken her heartfelt words.
"It’s incredible."
Consort Yhu and her group admitted their inadequacy.
They were also listening to the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic just now, but after listening, they couldn’t say how much they remembered.
Just understanding the content was extremely difficult, let alone practicing it.
Yet Ding Ling seemingly mastered it.
This shocking speed of cultivation was truly unprecedented throughout history!
Being with such a Divine Being like this, Consort Yhu and her group felt both fortunate and pressured, with an urgency to put in more effort and practice harder.
"Let’s go.
Leave this place."
Ding Ling and his group prepared to leave on horseback.
Meanwhile, people from Shaolin Temple also reached the foot of the mountain at that moment.
Someone blocked the path and questioned Ding Ling if he had taken the Shaolin Temple’s supreme skills.
Ding Ling merely frowned and shouted sharply:
"Scram!"
Roar!
It sounded like a dragon’s roar, more like a Lion’s Roar!
As he shouted.
The questioner’s eardrums shattered on the spot, screaming as he rolled to the ground, yet when looking at Ding Ling, his gaze changed.
"Buddhist Lion’s Roar!
You’re the one who took our Shaolin Temple’s supreme skills!"
Regardless of their injuries, they got up and roared furiously.
"Heh."
Ding Ling sneered:
"So what if it was me?
What can you do about it?"
Ding Ling directly drew his sword, unleashing the Dharma Swordsmanship, and saw countless sword shadows filling the sky.
Amidst the clashing sounds, the monks blocking his way were all decapitated.
At that moment, Ding Ling became even more certain that the Lion’s Roar skill he obtained from Gao Kexin of the Thirteen Grand Protectors of Mount Songh had originated from the Shaolin Temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: A Roar Drives Away the Monks
paragraphs: And the Lion’s Roar in the hands of the Thirteen Grand Protectors belongs to the Shaolin Temple.
Did the Shaolin Temple willingly give it to Golden Lion Gao Kexin?
Or did Gao Kexin steal it?
The probability of theft is low. After all, the Mount Songh Sect is neighboring the Shaolin Temple. Once Gao Kexin uses the Lion’s Roar and is discovered, how could the Shaolin Temple let it go?
So, it’s highly likely that the Shaolin Temple sent it.
With this in view...
The Thirteen Grand Protectors, and possibly even Zuo Lengchan, might be conspiring with the Shaolin Temple to rule the world.
Unfortunately...
They encountered Ding Ling.
Their schemes subsequently collapsed, and people went one by one to meet King Yama.
"Swoosh swoosh!"

High monks from the Shaolin Temple quickly descended the mountain. Upon witnessing this scene, they loudly chanted ’Amitabha Buddha.’ Before the sound landed, they had already reached the front side of Ding Ling and his group.
He saluted Ding Ling and spoke solemnly:
"Donor Ding unleashing killing intent, are you not afraid of sinking into hell after death?"
"I don’t want to waste words with you."
Ding Ling’s eyes were deep as an abyss. Indifferently sweeping over all the monks, he said:
"If you block my way again, be careful I might slay you!"
"You!"
A monk was furious.
A high monk pulled him back and whispered, "Calm down," then faced Ding Ling and said:
"I saw a little novice monk run to your side and give a bag to you, Donor Ding, on the mountain. Could you return it to the Shaolin Temple?"
Someone noticed Qu Feiyan’s escape.
This couldn’t be concealed.
Qu Feiyan’s face slightly changed, looking unnaturally at Ding Ling, full of guilt, and was about to speak.
But Ding Ling said:
"If you want this bag, you can have it. Bring me the Sutra of Marrow Cleansing from the Shaolin Temple in exchange."
The strongest of the Shaolin Temple are the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and the Sutra of Marrow Cleansing.

The Inner Qi quality of the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic surpasses that of the Pure Yang True Skill, but it is extremely gentle, showing no signs of invading, devouring, or refining other True Qi or Inner Qi.

Instead, it can continually support the Pure Yang True Skill, refining True Qi, making it increasingly pure, not to mention that this classic can also nurture the body and mind, eliminating malice, Evil Qi, and other negative influences.
It can even widen the meridians and nourish the bones and muscles.
As long as time is sufficient, and the inner Qi of the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic is abundant, undoubtedly Ding Ling’s bones, physique, and True Qi will become ever stronger in the future.
The Sutra of Marrow Cleansing, given its name, is in no way inferior to the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, and its efficacy is imaginable.
"Donor Ding, aren’t your words too excessive!"
The high monk’s face changed drastically, eyes seemingly on fire:

"Not to mention whether our Shaolin Temple has the Sutra of Marrow Cleansing, even if we had it, it’s absolutely impossible to hand it over to an outsider like you. Even if you use force and kill us all, it’s still useless!"
"Stubborn indeed."
Ding Ling slightly glanced sideways and said:
"Your Shaolin Temple monks blocked me first and threatened me afterward. It’s only right that I collect some interest. If you continue to oppose me, beware I’ll destroy your Shaolin Temple."
Ding Ling’s tiger eyes emitted terrifying brilliance, and he roared:
"Scram!"
Roar!

A sound split the sky like a dragon’s chant and a lion’s roar. A sweeping sound wave surged like the Yangtze River towards the high monk and his group, enveloping and impacting them directly. The foremost ones had their eardrums burst instantly, screamed in agony, and fell to the ground clutching their ears.
"What powerful skill!"
"What powerful Buddhist Lion’s Roar!"

The high monk was startled and horrified, retreating over ten steps while channeling all his power to barely counteract the wave’s assault. Despite this, he felt intense eardrum pain, with a resonating pounding in his head as if drums were rumbling!
"Such Lion’s Roar skill—how is it possible to cultivate it without thirty years of relentless practice day and night? How old is Ding Ling?! His talent truly is extraordinary!
No wonder he single-handedly defeated the Eighteen Arhats and killed Master Fang Zheng, the world’s number one demon!"
The high monk’s heart surged with tumultuous waves.
He was one of Shaolin Temple’s secret weapons.
Also a half-step Innate expert. Initially, he thought he could at least exchange a few moves with Ding Ling and negotiate a bit, but now he realized he completely overestimated his combat power.
He couldn’t even withstand a single roar from Ding Ling, so how could he compete with Ding Ling in palm power?
Thinking of this...

The high monk felt a surge of fear in his heart, and, clasping his hands, he said, "Well said, well said, Donor Ding. We were wrong first. From now on, when we see Donor Ding, we will certainly avoid him by three feet. We hope you no longer hold grudges against us. Many little novice monks and monks in the Shaolin Temple are innocent!
Taking the little novice monks and monks as an excuse.
Ding Ling merely snorted without bothering to acknowledge the high monk, and rode forward on his horse.

The high monk dared not stop him, leading the rest of the monks to retreat to the side and watched Ding Ling and his group walk far away. Only then did the high monk suddenly realize there was a cold sweat on his back.

"Ding Ling is overwhelmingly powerful. It was extremely unwise for the Shaolin Temple to provoke him. It seems I must suggest sealing the mountain door when I return, to refrain from meddling in worldly affairs for the time being."
He led the monks, who were either indignant, anxious, or uneasy, back to the Shaolin Temple.
On the way...
The high monk pondered:

"Ding Ling’s Lion’s Roar skills are profoundly advanced. It’s absolutely impossible for them to have been recently mastered. This suggests that the Lion’s Roar manual that Gao Kexin had from the Mount Songh Sect might have fallen into Ding Ling’s hands?
But even so.
Counting the time, Ding Ling would have only been practicing for a few months.
In just a few months, he managed to cultivate the Lion’s Roar to such an unbelievable Great Perfection, Flawless Realm?!"
The high monk’s heart was filled with suspicion, unable to conceive how it could be.

But thinking back to when he vaguely saw Ding Ling flipping through the Secret Manual inside a snakeskin bag on the mountain, seemingly perfectly practicing the Technique after reading it, the high monk’s heart skipped a beat.
A swirling, sky-high wave surged in his heart!
"Impossible, how could this be?!"
"It must be my eyes deceiving me!"

"How could there be someone in the world who could blindly cultivate a Supreme Skill to a flawless realm just by reading through a Secret Manual? If such a person existed, then what does it mean for us to toil for decades without completing a Supreme Skill cultivation to perfection?
Can the disparity between people be so great?
Even the legendary Master Bodhidharma did not possess such talent!
Could Ding Ling be stronger than Master Bodhidharma?!"
The high monk was no longer calm.
Although difficult to believe, he knew that with his skill and eyesight, it was unlikely he would be so mistaken by what he saw.
Hadn’t pondered it deeply before.
Now considering Ding Ling’s Lion’s Roar skill, recalling it in detail, cold sweat broke out on his forehead, filled with fear.

"Master Fang Zheng truly was befuddled. Provoking such a Demon King-level figure. It’s terrifying. I must return at once to discuss this, urging the enraged high monks to revoke the order for Ding Ling’s pursuit and encirclement in the Jianghu!"
If Ding Ling discovered that the Shaolin Temple was behind instigating his encirclement and pursuit,

chapters.title: Chapter 370: Ding Ling’s Biography Passed Down Through the Ages
paragraphs: Ding Ling, in a fit of anger,
stormed into Shaolin Temple.
Is there anyone at Shaolin Temple who can withstand his Lion’s Roar?
Who can withstand his Drumming Golden Hammer?
The senior monks shivered.
Dared not be negligent.
After returning to Shaolin Temple,
they immediately gathered the senior monks and explained the matter thoroughly and meticulously.
The senior monks couldn’t believe it.
But some monks who personally witnessed Ding Ling’s immense power at the Mount Songh Sect couldn’t help but say:

"When Ding Ling swings that Drumming Golden Hammer, it is akin to a mountain collapse, a meteor falling from the sky, with unfathomable might! The Eighteen Arhats, each extraordinarily strong, were all easily hammered to death using the Eighteen Arhats Array. If everyone in our Shaolin Temple charges together, we would likely be easily hammered to death as well.
According to reliable information,
before encountering Li Yuanba, Ding Ling apparently did not know the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.
It was after killing Li Yuanba, obtaining the secret manual from Li Yuanba’s possession, that he learned the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.
Think about it.
How long did it take for him to master and perfect the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique?!"
Everyone thought carefully.
Each was horrified, sitting as if on pins and needles.
"Now you should believe what Fang Ku said. Ding Ling’s talent cannot be evaluated by ordinary standards. We were indeed too impulsive before.
It’s possible to plot against Dongfang Bubai.
But plotting against Ding Ling is absolutely unfeasible.
Because his Martial Arts and talent have reached the level of immortal gods, which is beyond our imagination as mere mortals!"
The senior monks looked at each other, speechless for a moment.
Subsequently, regarding Ding Ling,
they deliberated for a full two hours.
Finally, they unanimously decided to revoke the order for his capture.
And to seal the mountain gates.
Before Ding Ling shatters the void, they decided not to engage with the worldly realm, to avoid being targeted and struck down by Ding Ling.
No smoke without fire.
Where there are players, there are no secrets.
As the martial arts holy land in the eyes of players, Shaolin Temple naturally attracted a gathering of players!
Thus,
the events at Shaolin Temple quickly spread throughout the land.
The title of Ding Ling as the ’World’s Number One Martial God’ was known to countless people in no time.
In the martial world.
Those who didn’t know of Ding Ling’s name were regarded as outdated!
When some asked a martial arts comrade on the long street, ’Who is Ding Ling anyway?’
They were often questioned in astonishment, ’How could you not know Ding Ling? Have you just come out of the mountains?!’
Thus it can be seen.
Ding Ling’s current popularity.
It wouldn’t be an overstatement to say it’s soaring high as the sun.
The natives were astonished by Ding Ling’s great deeds.

Players were even more shocked that the ancient Shaolin Temple, renowned for thousands of years, was overturned by Ding Ling, to the extent that they dared not face him, and urgently closed the mountain gates overnight, refusing to receive guests.
How afraid they were of Ding Ling?
"Ding Ling is too defying of the heavens. Truly a model for us!"
"I heard that at the foot of Mount Songh, with a single roar, he silenced a highly attained monk from Shaolin Temple, making him yield obediently and allow Ding Ling passage."
"This isn’t the scariest part. I heard Ding Ling single-handedly, with just a hammer, not only overthrew the entire Mount Songh Sect but also killed the famous Eighteen Golden Body Arhats!"
This day.
Ding Ling and his group arrived at an inn not far from the foot of Huashan.
While resting here,
Ding Ling heard some natives passionately discussing, surprisingly all about his own affairs.
Especially a storyteller among them, who, after taking a sip of tea, began seriously narrating Ding Ling’s story:
"It is said that Ding Ling’s first stop after shattering the void was just outside Fuzhou City..."
Somehow, this storyteller had received news about Ding Ling.
He recounted Ding Ling’s events of killing Yu Renyan, severely wounding Yu Canghai, slapping Tian Boguang, intimidating the Thirteen Grand Protectors, and so forth, in a thrilling, passionate rhythm!
There were quite a few listeners.
When reaching exciting points, they couldn’t help but cheer loudly, throwing out considerable amounts of gold and silver.
Every time at this moment, the storyteller would beam, thank them, give a dry cough, and continue his narration.
Qu Feiyan, watching and listening, couldn’t help but beam with joy as well, tossing out some gold and silver; barely had the storyteller thanked her when a player interjected:
"Hahaha, Uncle Zhang. Hero Ding is right across from you, and yet you have eyes but fail to recognize Mount Tai, speaking so boldly in front of the true Buddha!"
The storyteller was startled:
"Where is Hero Ding?"
The player pointed towards Ding Ling’s direction.
The storyteller scrutinized for a moment, his face changing drastically, then immediately came down, respectfully paying great courtesy to Ding Ling, and said:
"We storytellers, making a living with our tales, inevitably add some artistic elements, hoping Hero Ding would not take offense."
"No problem."
Ding Ling smiled gently:
"I think you narrated it quite well."
Being pointed out,
Ding Ling saw the storyteller becoming overly cautious,
so he decided not to stay any longer.
After paying the tab,
he took Qu Feiyan and others up to Huashan.
The storyteller saw them off to the door,
and after Ding Ling was truly gone, he couldn’t help feeling somewhat dazed:
"Just now, did I really meet Hero Ding and even converse with him?!"
"Isn’t that right, Uncle Zhang?"
The player laughed heartily:
"How is it? Doesn’t it feel quite an honor?"
"Indeed, indeed."
The storyteller Uncle Zhang chuckled:

"Hero Ding is truly a legendary hero. I make money by telling stories about him, yet he didn’t mind. Such a broad mind and spirit is incomparable to ordinary people. Remarkable, remarkable. From now on, this old man must say more good things about Hero Ding."
Uncle Zhang indeed did as he said.
He praised Ding Ling as an unparalleled genius, a peerless hero, and wrote numerous novels about Ding Ling’s stories.
A hundred years later,
A Wuxia book "Ding Ling’s Biography" was published, becoming a hit across Jiuzhou, loved by countless nobles and royals, and thus survived for hundreds, even thousands of years.
In the era of modern civilization, this "Ding Ling’s Biography," became a great classic!
Several movie and TV directors made films of his stories.
Moreover, the "Ding Ling’s Biography" was so passionate and legendary that its film adaptations became major hits, to the point that even a three-year-old child knew Ding Ling’s story!
Its popularity was evident.
Of course,
Ding Ling certainly couldn’t know these things now.
He couldn’t imagine what might happen in this world hundreds or thousands of years later.
He is currently ascending the mountain.
And it was none other than the second disciple of the Huashan Sect Leader, Laudeno, who received him.
Ding Ling immediately recognized this figure, different from when they first met as a middle-aged man.
The first time they met,
he was a mediocre, hunchbacked old man.
Upon seeing him again,
his age was still on the older side, yet he possessed a graceful demeanor, with an impressive and spirited presence.

It’s possible to plot against Dongfang Bubai.
But plotting against Ding Ling is absolutely unfeasible.
Because his Martial Arts and talent have reached the level of immortal gods, which is beyond our imagination as mere mortals!"
The senior monks looked at each other, speechless for a moment.
Subsequently, regarding Ding Ling,
they deliberated for a full two hours.
Finally, they unanimously decided to revoke the order for his capture.
And to seal the mountain gates.
Before Ding Ling shatters the void, they decided not to engage with the worldly realm, to avoid being targeted and struck down by Ding Ling.
No smoke without fire.
Where there are players, there are no secrets.
As the martial arts holy land in the eyes of players, Shaolin Temple naturally attracted a gathering of players!
Thus,
the events at Shaolin Temple quickly spread throughout the land.
The title of Ding Ling as the ’World’s Number One Martial God’ was known to countless people in no time.
In the martial world.
Those who didn’t know of Ding Ling’s name were regarded as outdated!
When some asked a martial arts comrade on the long street, ’Who is Ding Ling anyway?’
They were often questioned in astonishment, ’How could you not know Ding Ling?
Have you just come out of the mountains?!’
Thus it can be seen.
Ding Ling’s current popularity.
It wouldn’t be an overstatement to say it’s soaring high as the sun.
The natives were astonished by Ding Ling’s great deeds.

Players were even more shocked that the ancient Shaolin Temple, renowned for thousands of years, was overturned by Ding Ling, to the extent that they dared not face him, and urgently closed the mountain gates overnight, refusing to receive guests.
How afraid they were of Ding Ling?
"Ding Ling is too defying of the heavens.
Truly a model for us!"
"I heard that at the foot of Mount Songh, with a single roar, he silenced a highly attained monk from Shaolin Temple, making him yield obediently and allow Ding Ling passage."
"This isn’t the scariest part.
I heard Ding Ling single-handedly, with just a hammer, not only overthrew the entire Mount Songh Sect but also killed the famous Eighteen Golden Body Arhats!"
This day.
Ding Ling and his group arrived at an inn not far from the foot of Huashan.
While resting here,
Ding Ling heard some natives passionately discussing, surprisingly all about his own affairs.
Especially a storyteller among them, who, after taking a sip of tea, began seriously narrating Ding Ling’s story:
"It is said that Ding Ling’s first stop after shattering the void was just outside Fuzhou City..."
Somehow, this storyteller had received news about Ding Ling.
He recounted Ding Ling’s events of killing Yu Renyan, severely wounding Yu Canghai, slapping Tian Boguang, intimidating the Thirteen Grand Protectors, and so forth, in a thrilling, passionate rhythm!
There were quite a few listeners.
When reaching exciting points, they couldn’t help but cheer loudly, throwing out considerable amounts of gold and silver.
Every time at this moment, the storyteller would beam, thank them, give a dry cough, and continue his narration.
Qu Feiyan, watching and listening, couldn’t help but beam with joy as well, tossing out some gold and silver; barely had the storyteller thanked her when a player interjected:
"Hahaha, Uncle Zhang.
Hero Ding is right across from you, and yet you have eyes but fail to recognize Mount Tai, speaking so boldly in front of the true Buddha!"
The storyteller was startled:
"Where is Hero Ding?"
The player pointed towards Ding Ling’s direction.
The storyteller scrutinized for a moment, his face changing drastically, then immediately came down, respectfully paying great courtesy to Ding Ling, and said:
"We storytellers, making a living with our tales, inevitably add some artistic elements, hoping Hero Ding would not take offense."
"No problem."
Ding Ling smiled gently:
"I think you narrated it quite well."
Being pointed out,
Ding Ling saw the storyteller becoming overly cautious,
so he decided not to stay any longer.
After paying the tab,
he took Qu Feiyan and others up to Huashan.
The storyteller saw them off to the door,
and after Ding Ling was truly gone, he couldn’t help feeling somewhat dazed:
"Just now, did I really meet Hero Ding and even converse with him?!"
"Isn’t that right, Uncle Zhang?"
The player laughed heartily:
"How is it?
Doesn’t it feel quite an honor?"
"Indeed, indeed."
The storyteller Uncle Zhang chuckled:
"Hero Ding is truly a legendary hero.
I make money by telling stories about him, yet he didn’t mind.
Such a broad mind and spirit is incomparable to ordinary people.
Remarkable, remarkable.
From now on, this old man must say more good things about Hero Ding."
Uncle Zhang indeed did as he said.
He praised Ding Ling as an unparalleled genius, a peerless hero, and wrote numerous novels about Ding Ling’s stories.
A hundred years later,
A Wuxia book "Ding Ling’s Biography" was published, becoming a hit across Jiuzhou, loved by countless nobles and royals, and thus survived for hundreds, even thousands of years.
In the era of modern civilization, this "Ding Ling’s Biography," became a great classic!
Several movie and TV directors made films of his stories.
Moreover, the "Ding Ling’s Biography" was so passionate and legendary that its film adaptations became major hits, to the point that even a three-year-old child knew Ding Ling’s story!
Its popularity was evident.
Of course,
Ding Ling certainly couldn’t know these things now.
He couldn’t imagine what might happen in this world hundreds or thousands of years later.
He is currently ascending the mountain.
And it was none other than the second disciple of the Huashan Sect Leader, Laudeno, who received him.
Ding Ling immediately recognized this figure, different from when they first met as a middle-aged man.
The first time they met,
he was a mediocre, hunchbacked old man.
Upon seeing him again,
his age was still on the older side, yet he possessed a graceful demeanor, with an impressive and spirited presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 371: Yue Buqun and His Wife
paragraphs: "Greetings, Hero Ding!"
Laudeno was tasked with welcoming Ding Ling, and he felt extremely tense.
His gaze towards Ding Ling was filled with awe and fear.
But he was careful to hide those feelings.

He hadn’t anticipated that he, planted as a pawn within the Huashan Sect, would see the Mountain Guardian Level figures from the Mount Song Sect, including Zuo Lengchan, being killed by Ding Ling before he even had the chance to shine.
Thinking of the might of Zuo Lengchan and the others.
And looking at Ding Ling.
Laudeno’s back started to sweat profusely.

He had actually recognized Ding Ling early on, but at first, he couldn’t quite believe it. When it was confirmed to be Ding Ling, he was scared nearly to death, grateful that he hadn’t exposed his secret. If Ding Ling found out he was from the Mount Song Sect, he might be killed with a single slap.
Thinking about it.
Laudeno shuddered, becoming even more respectful and cautious towards Ding Ling.
Behind him, Yue Lingshan noticed and was also amazed, pondering:
"Even though I’ve recognized Ding Ling as that mysterious powerhouse we encountered outside Fuzhou City earlier, Second Senior Brother doesn’t have to be so respectful to him.
It seems like Second Senior Brother isn’t even that respectful to my parents."
Although Yue Lingshan was puzzled in her heart.
She was nonetheless curious, fearful, and cautious of Ding Ling.
Not long ago.
When Linghu Chong secretly met with her upon returning to the Huashan Sect, he told her everything about Ding Ling, instructing her to be wary of him.
She especially listened to Senior Brother, treating Ding Ling as a nemesis, keeping a constant distance from him.

Qu Feiyan noticed it and was surprised but didn’t take it to heart, only thinking: ’This girl is fair-skinned, charming, and lovely. It’s best she doesn’t trouble my Brother Ding. That’s for the better.’
She instead felt relieved.
Previously, Ren Yingying was overly passionate towards Ding Ling.

Along the way, various attractive women would occasionally approach Ding Ling, asking for his contact number, even though she didn’t really understand, it was clear they were trying to flirt with her Brother Ding.
Qu Feiyan, naturally, felt both proud and satisfied with this. Why wouldn’t she be happy seeing her Brother Ding being so charming?
Yet there were so many demons eyeing her Brother Ding.
She still felt immense pressure.
Having arrived at Huashan.
Seeing a young girl actively staying away from her Brother Ding, Qu Feiyan was both surprised and relieved.
Taptap!
Laudeno and Yue Lingshan led the way.
Ding Ling and his party ascended the mountain.
They settled comfortably in the Main Hall.
Yue Lingshan, as the Sect Leader’s daughter, had to speak up:
"Please wait a moment; my parents will be here shortly."
"Alright."
Ding Ling nodded without saying much.
Yue Lingshan paused but obediently began serving them tea:
"This is top-grade tea from our Huashan Sect, please enjoy."
Ding Ling glanced at Yue Lingshan.
Yue Lingshan’s body stiffened, smiling awkwardly, placed down the teacup, and rushed out of the hall like a startled rabbit.
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Little did he know that due to Linghu Chong’s indiscreetness, Yue Lingshan already had considerable wariness towards him.
Even if he knew.
Ding Ling wouldn’t mind.
He didn’t take Linghu Chong seriously.
He merely picked up the teacup and sipped quietly, initially bitter but then sweet, with a lingering taste.
It was indeed top-grade, exquisite tea.
Yue Buqun was, at least, generous in this aspect.
Taptap!
After a short while.
Accompanied by a burst of hurried, disorderly footsteps, two figures appeared outside the Main Hall.
Leading was an elegant middle-aged man.

His chin was adorned with three floating strands of long beard, features were correct, eyes sharp and clear, dressed in a blue robe, holding a folding fan in his right hand, appearing graceful and possessing the demeanor of a gentleman.
Behind him was a bright-eyed, dignified, and beautiful middle-aged woman.
The two seemed to have rushed over, slightly sweating on their foreheads.
Scanning the guests in the hall, following Laudeno’s indication, they all turned their gaze to Ding Ling and greeted:
"Yue Buqun (Ning Zhongze) greets Hero Ding!"
"Sect Leader Yue, Lady Yue, you are too courteous."
Ding Ling stood up and returned the greeting, smiling slightly:
"I came unannounced, and haven’t yet apologized for disturbing you both."
"Haha..."

Seeing Ding Ling being polite and composed, neither arrogant nor humble, Yue Buqun’s eyes lit up slightly, thinking that Ding Ling wasn’t as prideful as the rumors suggested, which made things easier.
Thinking this, he laughed heartily and said:

"The humble premises of the Huashan Sect are graced by the presence of a world-renowned hero like Hero Ding, which is an honor that shines upon us; it’s three lives of fortune! Not to mention this visit, even if you choose to reside at the Huashan Sect for a lifetime, I’d welcome it with both hands!
"Sect Leader Yue truly knows how to speak."
Ding Ling chuckled, exchanged a few cordial words with the Yue couple, and then got straight to the point:
"To be honest, I am here to confront the seven trials arranged by Senior Feng Qingyang at the Reflection Cliff."
The faces of the Yue couple changed slightly, showing a hint of unnaturalness.
It was understandable.
Usually, people visiting Huashan to face the seven trials set by Feng Qingyang was understandable.
But for a person like Ding Ling to come to Huashan for Feng Qingyang!
Yue Buqun felt a bit melancholic.
Ever since Feng Qingyang emerged.
The Huashan Sect’s reputation soared, with no petty villains daring to challenge, and his position as Sect Leader became more stable.
But he felt as if he was cast aside, becoming a titular Sect Leader of Huashan.
He had let down his master’s expectations.
Especially when thinking of the Sword Sect vs. Qi Sect dispute.
Yue Buqun felt a pressing sense of urgency.
He didn’t want outsiders to only recognize Huashan Sect for the Sword Sect’s Feng Qingyang and not for the Qi Sect’s Yue Buqun!
The Sword Qi dispute might have already subsided.

But Feng Qingyang’s emergence, the return of Sword Sect descendants Cheng Buyou, Cong Buqi, Feng Buping, increased his pressure constantly. By this point, Ding Ling, such a notable figure, claims to be visiting Feng Qingyang.
Yue Buqun felt bitter inside, but outwardly pretended to be magnanimous, saying:
"Since it’s because of Master Feng that you’ve come. I, Yue Buqun, have no reason to obstruct you. Just wondering when Hero Ding plans to go?"
"To avoid prolonged delays, I’m planning to go now."
Ding Ling said seriously.
"Then I’ll personally escort Hero Ding there."
The Yue couple exchanged a glance, and Yue Buqun decisively said:
"After Hero Ding has faced the seven trials, perhaps you may wish to return and ponder over the solutions. During this pondering time, we will certainly treat Hero Ding well."
"Thank you, Sect Leader Yue, Lady Yue."
Ding Ling sincerely expressed his gratitude.
Whether or not Yue Buqun was a pretender.
If he treated Ding Ling with such caution and politeness.
Ding Ling certainly wouldn’t cause trouble.
It’s not like he’s got nothing better to do, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 372: Sword Sect’s Cong Buqi! Consecutive Breakthroughs Through Seven Trials
paragraphs: Ding Ling is not an unreasonable or overbearing person.
Yue Buqun and his wife’s courtesy and kind treatment of him.
Naturally, Ding Ling would choose to repay the favor with courtesy in return.
That’s how one should conduct themselves.
Whoever treats him well and courteously, he would clearly acknowledge it and wouldn’t arbitrarily take a dislike to them or resort to violence.
Ding Ling’s impression of Yue Buqun and his wife mostly remained within TV dramas and novels.
After interacting with them.
Only then did he realize.
Yue Buqun made people feel as if they were bathed in a warm spring breeze, truly embodying the demeanor of a gentleman.
Ning Zhongze, on the other hand, was righteous and dignified, courageous and knowledgeable, the very picture of a genuine heroic maiden.

Though Yue Buqun portrayed it exquisitely, Ding Ling would say that if a person could maintain the facade of a gentleman for decades, that’s quite remarkable. If he could keep it up till old age or death, he would become a true gentleman even as a hypocrite!
Moreover, Ding Ling had no grievances or animosity with Yue Buqun and his wife.
With their deliberate congeniality.
The two parties enjoyed a pleasant conversation.
Yue Lingshan watched from the back, very distressed, and just thought to herself:
"My senior brother said Ding Ling cannot distinguish good from bad, has a heavy killing tendency, repeatedly humiliating him. How come now it seems not quite right?"
Thinking this way, she quickly shook her head, denying herself:
"My senior brother must be correct. I’ll just listen to him. But why are my parents still so enthusiastic towards Ding Ling after listening to my advice?"
She was puzzled:

"Could it be just because Ding Ling is very powerful? But our Huashan Sect is also a top-notch faction in the world, with the Sword Sect’s Senior Feng Qingyang guarding Reflection Cliff, there’s no need to fear him."
Although deeply confused, Yue Lingshan still followed closely behind Yue Buqun and his wife.
Laudeno and several other direct disciples of the Huashan Sect also joined the group one after another out of curiosity.
A moment later.
The group arrived at Reflection Cliff.
Yue Buqun pointed to a steep mountain path ahead and said aloud:

"Beyond this mountain path is Reflection Cliff. To see Master Feng, you must start overcoming the barriers from the entrance of this mountain path. The first barrier is to learn some remnant moves of our Huashan Swordsmanship, learn and comprehend them to a level that satisfies Master Feng, and you can enter the second barrier to learn some remnant moves of the Taiyue Three Cyan Peaks...
All the way to the seventh barrier.
Then you can meet Master Feng and learn his unparalleled supreme skill, the Dugu Nine Swords."
Yue Buqun was somewhat emotional, his feelings extremely complicated:
"I don’t know why so many people want to learn the Dugu Nine Swords, but I suppose this sword technique must be extraordinary."
He is a disciple of the Qi Sect.
However, he cannot openly and legitimately conquer barriers to learn the Sword Sect’s techniques like other outsiders.
Not to mention whether Feng Qingyang would agree.
Even if Feng Qingyang agreed, he couldn’t get over that hurdle in his heart.
Thinking like this.
Yue Buqun added:
"In recent months, the number of people who came to conquer the barriers is countless, I’ve lost track of how many there were, but except for one person, all others have failed."
"Who?"
Ding Ling was curious.
"My senior brother."
Yue Lingshan, listening from the back, couldn’t resist a look of pride:
"He managed to conquer to the last barrier in less than a month and met Master Ancestor. He learned the ever-changing Dugu Nine Swords."
"Hmph."
Yue Buqun snorted coldly, seeming to feel some shame:
"The senior brother of the dignified Qi Sect, yet learned the techniques of the Sword Sect."
In front of Ding Ling.
He couldn’t say much more.
But just this one sentence scared Yue Lingshan, her face turned slightly pale, she became timid and lowered her head, not daring to speak further.
"Alright, let me take a look."
Ding Ling didn’t say much, just walked over directly, looked at the carving of some remnant moves on the wooden plaque of the first barrier.
At this time, quite a few people came to conquer the barriers too.
But knowing that Ding Ling also came to conquer the barriers, everyone made way to the side, becoming onlookers.
One after another, they began discussing enthusiastically, the player community especially lively:
"How long do you think it will take for Ding Ling to meet Feng Qingyang? I think it shouldn’t take more than half a month."
"I think a day should be enough. Who doesn’t know now that Hero Ding can cheat!"
The players’ words drew the attention and anger of three distinctly different, middle-aged men with diverse temperaments not far off.
Among them, a man with a coarse appearance and a frivolous gaze couldn’t help but retort:

"Nonsense! Master Feng’s barriers are extremely difficult. That Linghu Chong kid could conquer them in a month, that’s because he had learned Huashan Swordsmanship and related sword moves long before, so he could successfully break through these barriers one by one.
Ding Ling doesn’t understand our Huashan Sect’s sword techniques or moves.
He’s starting from a completely different point than Linghu Chong.
How can he break through the barriers and meet Master Feng in half a month? Saying such wild things, aren’t you afraid of being struck by lightning with such wind!"
The players, seeing that the speaker was Cong Buqi of the Sword Sect, promptly closed their mouths.
This person is extremely vile and despicable.
Once they offended him.
Want to conquer the barriers and meet Feng Qingyang? That probability is basically zero.

The players who were infinitely longing for the Dugu Nine Swords also thought to first apprentice under Cong Buqi and others to learn some exquisite sword techniques before conquering the barriers to meet Feng Qingyang. How could they dare to argue with him?

They just complained inwardly, thinking: ’It’s not that we’re talking big, but this Ding Ling guy, from the Three Kingdoms to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, everything he did along the way shows that he learns martial arts incredibly fast!’
But perhaps because of the players’ words.
Cong Buqi, Feng Buping, and Cheng Buyou of the Sword Sect all couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling.
They did this.

Yue Buqun and his wife exchanged glances and also felt that Ding Ling probably couldn’t achieve anything on the first try, because as people of the Huashan Sect, facing these seven barriers, except for the first few due to having learned related sword techniques, they could naturally break through easily.
But later sword exercises they had never heard of or seen, they found it very hard to break through in a short time.
Ding Ling, being an outsider.
How could he break through in such a short time?
Ding Ling was unaware of what people thought.
After reaching the first barrier.
He just scanned through the remnant moves.
[Huashan Swordsmanship (remnant) Full Level]
He moved to the second barrier.
[Taiyue Three Cyan Peaks (remnant) Full Level]
Third barrier.
[Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords (remnant) Full Level]
Fourth barrier.
[One Hundred and Eight Forms of Furious Wind Swift Sword (remnant) Full Level]
Fifth barrier.
[Dugu Nine Swordsmen’s Blade-Breaking Technique (remnant) Full Level]
Sixth barrier.
[Dugu Nine Swordsmen’s Arrow-Breaking Technique (remnant) Full Level]
Seventh barrier.
[Dugu Nine Swordsmen’s Sword-Breaking Technique (remnant) Full Level]
All seven barriers.
Ding Ling stood at each barrier for no more than three breaths.
After walking through all seven.
It was a matter of moments.
To Yue Buqun and others, such a short time raises doubts if it’s possible to even carefully look at them. Yet Ding Ling walked through like a brief survey.
They became increasingly certain of one thing, Ding Ling’s first visit might really just be to assess the difficulty of these seven barriers.
