Laudeno and several other direct disciples of the Huashan Sect also joined the group one after another out of curiosity.
A moment later.
The group arrived at Reflection Cliff.
Yue Buqun pointed to a steep mountain path ahead and said aloud:
"Beyond this mountain path is Reflection Cliff.
To see Master Feng, you must start overcoming the barriers from the entrance of this mountain path.

The first barrier is to learn some remnant moves of our Huashan Swordsmanship, learn and comprehend them to a level that satisfies Master Feng, and you can enter the second barrier to learn some remnant moves of the Taiyue Three Cyan Peaks...
All the way to the seventh barrier.
Then you can meet Master Feng and learn his unparalleled supreme skill, the Dugu Nine Swords."
Yue Buqun was somewhat emotional, his feelings extremely complicated:
"I don’t know why so many people want to learn the Dugu Nine Swords, but I suppose this sword technique must be extraordinary."
He is a disciple of the Qi Sect.
However, he cannot openly and legitimately conquer barriers to learn the Sword Sect’s techniques like other outsiders.
Not to mention whether Feng Qingyang would agree.
Even if Feng Qingyang agreed, he couldn’t get over that hurdle in his heart.
Thinking like this.
Yue Buqun added:
"In recent months, the number of people who came to conquer the barriers is countless, I’ve lost track of how many there were, but except for one person, all others have failed."
"Who?"
Ding Ling was curious.
"My senior brother."
Yue Lingshan, listening from the back, couldn’t resist a look of pride:
"He managed to conquer to the last barrier in less than a month and met Master Ancestor.
He learned the ever-changing Dugu Nine Swords."
"Hmph."
Yue Buqun snorted coldly, seeming to feel some shame:
"The senior brother of the dignified Qi Sect, yet learned the techniques of the Sword Sect."
In front of Ding Ling.
He couldn’t say much more.
But just this one sentence scared Yue Lingshan, her face turned slightly pale, she became timid and lowered her head, not daring to speak further.
"Alright, let me take a look."
Ding Ling didn’t say much, just walked over directly, looked at the carving of some remnant moves on the wooden plaque of the first barrier.
At this time, quite a few people came to conquer the barriers too.
But knowing that Ding Ling also came to conquer the barriers, everyone made way to the side, becoming onlookers.
One after another, they began discussing enthusiastically, the player community especially lively:
"How long do you think it will take for Ding Ling to meet Feng Qingyang?
I think it shouldn’t take more than half a month."
"I think a day should be enough.
Who doesn’t know now that Hero Ding can cheat!"
The players’ words drew the attention and anger of three distinctly different, middle-aged men with diverse temperaments not far off.
Among them, a man with a coarse appearance and a frivolous gaze couldn’t help but retort:
"Nonsense!
Master Feng’s barriers are extremely difficult.

That Linghu Chong kid could conquer them in a month, that’s because he had learned Huashan Swordsmanship and related sword moves long before, so he could successfully break through these barriers one by one.
Ding Ling doesn’t understand our Huashan Sect’s sword techniques or moves.
He’s starting from a completely different point than Linghu Chong.
How can he break through the barriers and meet Master Feng in half a month?
Saying such wild things, aren’t you afraid of being struck by lightning with such wind!"
The players, seeing that the speaker was Cong Buqi of the Sword Sect, promptly closed their mouths.
This person is extremely vile and despicable.
Once they offended him.
Want to conquer the barriers and meet Feng Qingyang?
That probability is basically zero.

The players who were infinitely longing for the Dugu Nine Swords also thought to first apprentice under Cong Buqi and others to learn some exquisite sword techniques before conquering the barriers to meet Feng Qingyang.
How could they dare to argue with him?

They just complained inwardly, thinking: ’It’s not that we’re talking big, but this Ding Ling guy, from the Three Kingdoms to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, everything he did along the way shows that he learns martial arts incredibly fast!’
But perhaps because of the players’ words.
Cong Buqi, Feng Buping, and Cheng Buyou of the Sword Sect all couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling.
They did this.

Yue Buqun and his wife exchanged glances and also felt that Ding Ling probably couldn’t achieve anything on the first try, because as people of the Huashan Sect, facing these seven barriers, except for the first few due to having learned related sword techniques, they could naturally break through easily.
But later sword exercises they had never heard of or seen, they found it very hard to break through in a short time.
Ding Ling, being an outsider.
How could he break through in such a short time?
Ding Ling was unaware of what people thought.
After reaching the first barrier.
He just scanned through the remnant moves.
[Huashan Swordsmanship (remnant) Full Level]
He moved to the second barrier.
[Taiyue Three Cyan Peaks (remnant) Full Level]
Third barrier.
[Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords (remnant) Full Level]
Fourth barrier.
[One Hundred and Eight Forms of Furious Wind Swift Sword (remnant) Full Level]
Fifth barrier.
[Dugu Nine Swordsmen’s Blade-Breaking Technique (remnant) Full Level]
Sixth barrier.
[Dugu Nine Swordsmen’s Arrow-Breaking Technique (remnant) Full Level]
Seventh barrier.
[Dugu Nine Swordsmen’s Sword-Breaking Technique (remnant) Full Level]
All seven barriers.
Ding Ling stood at each barrier for no more than three breaths.
After walking through all seven.
It was a matter of moments.
To Yue Buqun and others, such a short time raises doubts if it’s possible to even carefully look at them.
Yet Ding Ling walked through like a brief survey.
They became increasingly certain of one thing, Ding Ling’s first visit might really just be to assess the difficulty of these seven barriers.

chapters.title: Chapter 373: Feng Qingyang
paragraphs: Finished reading.
Going back to study for some days.
Come back to research again when I’ve learned something.
This is the usual pattern for most people.
Even if Ding Ling is a genius, it’s normal for him to not grasp it the first time and to come back multiple times.
However, as Yue Buqun, Ning Zhongze, Fengg Buping, Cong Buqi, and Yue Lingshan were thinking this.
Ding Ling suddenly cupped his hands towards the direction of Reflection Cliff and said loudly:
"I am Ding Ling and have passed the seven checkpoints. I request Senior Feng Qingyang to show himself."
Yue Buqun’s hand froze as it stroked his beard, almost pulling it off. He looked at Ding Ling with confusion:
"Ding, Ding, Hero Ding, are you serious?!"
"It seems so."
Ning Zhongze was also uncertain and suspicious:
"Since he has said it, if he can’t do it, Uncle Master Feng would definitely be furious and drive him down from Reflection Cliff, never to see him again. It has happened before."
"Ah."
Yue Buqun sighed, feeling a bit troubled.
If Ding Ling were driven down the mountain by Feng Qingyang, he would be stuck in the middle, unable to please anyone.
"Hehe."
Cong Buqi, Fengg Buping, and Cheng Buyou, descendants of the Sword Sect, sneered, thinking Ding Ling was exaggerating and was really just a joker!
Yue Lingshan, Laudeno, and others were also shocked and found it hard to believe.
In contrast, Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan, and Consort Yhu were much calmer and more composed, even considering this to be a very normal occurrence.
If Ding Ling can’t quickly solve a few incomplete moves, then he wouldn’t be the peerless Martial God in their hearts!
Whoosh!
Gentle breezes blew across the cliff edge at Reflection Cliff.
Before long.
A figure suddenly appeared on a large boulder.
No one knew when or how he appeared.
Except for Ding Ling.
He saw with his own eyes a ghostly figure flash like lightning from below the cliff, stepping on air and landing on the boulder.
Such speed.
Almost beyond the naked eye’s recognition.
Clearly, this person was a master of unparalleled Lightweight Skill.
Swoosh!
Once the person settled on the boulder, he sharply looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling also looked at him.
With this look, both sides saw each other’s figure and appearance clearly.

In Ding Ling’s eyes, this person stood upright, with a lean face and bright eyes. Although old, he exuded an immortal’s aura, resembling a celestial Sword Immortal descending on the wind, and his eyes naturally carried a captivating Sword Qi.
"Greetings, Senior!"
Ding Ling saluted.
"Hmm."
The person was evidently Feng Qingyang, with three strands of long beard fluttering gracefully, looking extremely ethereal:
"Did you just say you have passed the seven checkpoints?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling nodded.
"Oh?"
Feng Qingyang looked at Fengg Buping in the crowd.
Fengg Buping hurried over and reported the detailed situation of Ding Ling’s breakthroughs to Feng Qingyang.
After listening, Feng Qingyang looked at Ding Ling in astonishment:
"Is it true?"
"It is true."

Fengg Buping, compared to Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou, had relatively better character, and Feng Qingyang chose him to guard these seven checkpoints for a reason, showing his sharp and insightful judgment.
The words Fengg Buping reported to Feng Qingyang were precise, without any unnecessary embellishments.
"If it is true, that you passed my seven checkpoints in a matter of moments. Are you playing tricks on me?"
As Feng Qingyang spoke, his face was slightly red, clearly feeling a hidden fire in his heart.
Ding Ling was not annoyed, only smiling slightly:
"Whether it is true or false, Senior will know if you try!"
"Very well."

Seeing Ding Ling’s extraordinary temperament, confident and composed, with deep and calm eyes, Feng Qingyang couldn’t help but feel uncertain. At this moment, hearing Ding Ling speak, he said, "Show me what you can do then!"
"Senior, please watch."
Ding Ling made a sword gesture with his fingers:
"This is the incomplete move of the first checkpoint!"
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The sword fingers darted out, nimble and clever, flipping up and down, high and low, left and right, turning smoothly, yet it was an extremely exquisite Sword Technique!
The incomplete moves consisted of only a dozen or so strokes.
Yet Ding Ling was not restricted by forms, practicing them freely, clearly reaching a perfect state where greatness appears simple, and simplicity appears great.
He quickly finished demonstrating and stood with his skills withdrawn, looking at Feng Qingyang:
"Senior, please instruct me."
"You, you are excellent."
Feng Qingyang gently stroked his beard, somewhat unable to believe his eyes as he looked at Ding Ling:
"This is your first exposure to Huashan Swordsmanship.
"Correct."
"If you are truly not deceiving me, then you are indeed a peerless genius!"
Feng Qingyang’s previously indifferent demeanor instantly became focused, looking seriously at Ding Ling:
"Continue."
"Yes, Senior."
Ding Ling demonstrated the sword moves of the second checkpoint.
This time.
He drew his sword for practice.

The sword tip trembled, creating three sword shadows, seemingly real and illusory, like a dream, like a fantasy, the sword shadow swayed through the void, zzzap! As if capable of piercing through all barriers, it made a harsh sound.
Feng Qingyang was deeply moved by what he saw.
Beside him, Fengg Buping was completely dumbfounded, as if witnessing a fantastic tale.
"Pass."
As soon as Ding Ling stopped, Feng Qingyang decisively waved his hand:
"Continue!"

The sword moves of the third checkpoint were continuous, with an imposing momentum, like three immortals striking with life-taking sword strikes, each sword move mystically invincible, almost unstoppable.
"Pass."
Feng Qingyang’s pupils tightened, looking at Ding Ling with solemnity:
"Continue!"

As soon as the sword moves of the fourth checkpoint were executed, sword shadows of Gale Swift Sword filled the sky. Where the sharp swords passed, the sound of Xun Wind could faintly be heard, and one could even vaguely see approaching threatening Vigorous Qi, seemingly condensed from Sword Qi.
"Excellent, excellent, excellent!"
Feng Qingyang was overwhelmingly amazed:
"With only a few incomplete moves, you have reached such a standard in the One Hundred and Eight Forms of Furious Wind Swift Sword. Truly, you are a peerless genius seldom found worldwide."
Feng Qingyang’s eyes on Ding Ling changed, now filled with admiration, praise, and approval:
"Very good. If you really reached this stage in such a short time with just incomplete moves, you are superlatively talented in Sword Dao without precedent or future!
With this alone, I have no reason not to accept you.
However, the next set of sword moves is the most special, show it to me.
Feng Qingyang was extremely satisfied.
Fengg Buping was dumbstruck.
Cong Buqi, Cheng Buyou, and several other descendants of the Sword Sect looked at each other, clearly seeing the shock in each other’s eyes.
Yue Buqun watching from not far away was left gasping in cold air, pulling out one of his own beard hairs in the process.
Is there truly such a heaven-defying genius in swordsmanship in this world?!
He muttered to himself, unable to believe it.
Comparing with Ding Ling.
He instantly felt like a third-rate trash and cripple.
Ning Zhongze was also in a daze:

"How is this possible?! The first three checkpoints consist of sword moves from Huashan Swordsmanship, Taiyue Three Cyan Peaks, and Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords. How did Ding Ling learn them?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Huashan in Uproar! Passing Down the Sword
paragraphs: "Could it really be just a few glances, and then he mastered it?!"
Ning Zhongze’s heart was overturned like a river and sea, unable to control herself.
Yue Lingshan, however, couldn’t believe there was such a genius in the world, interjecting:

"Senior brother is exceptionally intelligent, with extraordinary comprehension, and he has the foundation of Huashan Swordsmanship, yet it took about a month to pass. How could Ding Ling be this fast?!"
Qu Feiyan covered her mouth, lightly laughing:

"That’s because you haven’t witnessed it. My Brother Ding is born with a unique talent, far surpassing the so-called geniuses of this world. You’ve only seen this small hill in front of you but don’t know there is an infinite giant mountain piercing the clouds further ahead!"
"You!"
Yue Lingshan was a little angry:
"How can you compare my senior brother to a small hill?"
"It’s the truth."
Qu Feiyan said crisply:
"Comparing anyone to my Brother Ding, they are just a small hill. I was already giving you face by not saying your senior brother was mere dirt or dust."
"You!"
Yue Lingshan was furious.
Ning Zhongze pulled Yue Lingshan aside:
"Enough, keep watching."
Over there.
Ding Ling has already started practicing the broken techniques of the Dugu Nine Swords: the Breaking Blade Form, Breaking Arrow Form, and Breaking Sword Form.
Three broken moves.
Each move complex and different, yet crisp and efficient, with a touch of divine craftsmanship in them.
After finishing his practice, Ding Ling cupped his hands and said:
"Senior, please guide me."
"Remarkable, remarkable!"
Feng Qingyang was already so shocked that his heart was trembling slightly, thinking back to how many years he had spent learning these sword moves back then.
And Ding Ling?
Just a few glances, without a Heart Technique, yet he managed to cultivate some broken techniques to the realm of Infinite Perfection. Remarkable.
Feng Qingyang’s gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly.
Rising once again from admiration to astonishment!
Feng Qingyang, obviously a straightforward and generous person as well, seeing Ding Ling actually passed the test flawlessly, jumped down from the boulder and headed straight into a cave on the side:
"Ding Ling, follow me, I will teach you the Dugu Nine Swords!"
The voice was clear and loud.
Unconcealed.
Many people heard it.
Ding Ling responded, sheathed his sword, and strode into the cave.
Fengg Buping didn’t follow, just stared at Ding Ling’s back with a dazed look, his heart already overwhelmed with shock:
"How could there really be such a genius in this world?!"
"This is outrageous!"
Thinking he spent months studying and couldn’t break through those seven obstacles.
Ding Ling broke through just by looking a few times.
The gap in Fengg Buping’s heart, the sense of loss, was like sharp arrows stabbing into his heart, causing him chest pain, almost to the point of suffocation:
"How could the difference be so vast?! Am I really a waste?!"
Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou were also trembling, speechless.
The players, on the other hand, were all in heated discussion:

"Wow! Hero Ding turned out to be even more incredible than I imagined! He actually learned these sword moves just by looking a few times, perfectly breaking through these obstacles and earning the right to learn the Dugu Nine Swords. Ah, if I had such a strong talent, I’d have ventured into the Jianghu long ago, instead of wallowing in self-pity and self-reflection here."
"So powerful, worthy as the man who journeyed as if blessed by luck!"
The players’ words reached the ears.
Making Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou flush with embarrassment and feel extreme discomfort.
Previously, they questioned the player’s words, thought they were talking nonsense, even couldn’t help but scold!
But now looking at the result.
They instantly felt like jokers.
’Originally thought Ding Ling wouldn’t be able to break these seven obstacles in half a month. But now Ding Ling just looked a few times and broke them!’
Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou’s faces scrunched up, each one’s heart was completely exploded by emotions like shock and awe.
They felt this way.
Yue Buqun and Ning Zhongze were no better.
The couple looked at each other, speechless for a long moment.
Finally, Yue Buqun couldn’t help but whisper:
"Can there really be such a genius in sword skill in this world?"
"Isn’t Ding Ling just that?"
Ning Zhongze replied softly.
"Unbelievable."
Yue Buqun sighed:
"Feels like my worldview and outlook on life are shattered into pieces."
Laudeno, Yue Lingshan, and others behind listened and nodded in deep agreement.
This scene was indeed too impactful.
They weren’t mentally prepared at all.
By Ding Ling’s actions, each of them was knocked over and couldn’t get up.
"No wonder he’s my Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan watched from behind, full of joy, and felt a sense of pride.
As if she was the one breaking through the seven obstacles and about to learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and others all felt honored to follow such a unique person as Ding Ling.
Inside the cave.
Feng Qingyang stood with hands behind, his eyes bright as he looked at Ding Ling, saying:
"In the art of sword skill, it emphasizes flowing like clouds and water, reaching wherever freely. Instead of being rigid and inflexible, unable to adapt."
He cast an appreciative glance at Ding Ling:
"In this aspect, you far surpass that boy Linghu Chong. That boy was very stubborn at first, like a fool, unlike you who already have a touch of extraordinary aura and demeanor."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, neither agreeing nor disagreeing.
Feng Qingyang continued:
"The broken moves I engraved on the seven obstacles have no connection or relation, yet you could perfectly use them, obviously understanding the mysteries within.
You’ve reached the state where heart, intention, and sword are united.
Reaching this step, learning the Dugu Nine Swords is absolutely no problem."
He stroked his beard, saying meaningfully:
"Ordinary people could never learn the Dugu Nine Swords. Without absolute comprehension and sword skill talent, even with the sword manual of the Dugu Nine Swords placed in front of someone,
They would only be helplessly anxious.
Alright, I won’t say much nonsense. I’ll first pass you the mantra of the Dugu Nine Swords, listen closely.
Following the unknown, the unknown follows humanity, humanity follows greatness, Jia turns to Bing..."
After Feng Qingyang finished reciting.
He asked Ding Ling if he could recite it.
But Ding Ling said:
"Senior, why don’t you pass the entire Dugu Nine Swords to me at once, including all the forms and Heart Techniques."
"You!"
Feng Qingyang felt a slight anger in his heart, about to scold Ding Ling for overreaching himself and being senseless.
But thinking that Ding Ling broke through all those obstacles just by looking a few times.
After pondering for a while, he nodded:
"Seeing as you are indeed a genius. Let’s treat it as an exception. Listen well, and watch carefully!"
Feng Qingyang began explaining while demonstrating the moves.

"Dugu Nine Swords, only attacking and not defending, only advancing and not retreating, each move is an offense, each move varies intricately and is extremely profound! It consists of nine forms in total."

Feng Qingyang, obviously a straightforward and generous person as well, seeing Ding Ling actually passed the test flawlessly, jumped down from the boulder and headed straight into a cave on the side:
"Ding Ling, follow me, I will teach you the Dugu Nine Swords!"
The voice was clear and loud.
Unconcealed.
Many people heard it.
Ding Ling responded, sheathed his sword, and strode into the cave.
Fengg Buping didn’t follow, just stared at Ding Ling’s back with a dazed look, his heart already overwhelmed with shock:
"How could there really be such a genius in this world?!"
"This is outrageous!"
Thinking he spent months studying and couldn’t break through those seven obstacles.
Ding Ling broke through just by looking a few times.
The gap in Fengg Buping’s heart, the sense of loss, was like sharp arrows stabbing into his heart, causing him chest pain, almost to the point of suffocation:
"How could the difference be so vast?!
Am I really a waste?!"
Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou were also trembling, speechless.
The players, on the other hand, were all in heated discussion:
"Wow!
Hero Ding turned out to be even more incredible than I imagined!
He actually learned these sword moves just by looking a few times, perfectly breaking through these obstacles and earning the right to learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
Ah, if I had such a strong talent, I’d have ventured into the Jianghu long ago, instead of wallowing in self-pity and self-reflection here."
"So powerful, worthy as the man who journeyed as if blessed by luck!"
The players’ words reached the ears.
Making Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou flush with embarrassment and feel extreme discomfort.
Previously, they questioned the player’s words, thought they were talking nonsense, even couldn’t help but scold!
But now looking at the result.
They instantly felt like jokers.
’Originally thought Ding Ling wouldn’t be able to break these seven obstacles in half a month.
But now Ding Ling just looked a few times and broke them!’
Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou’s faces scrunched up, each one’s heart was completely exploded by emotions like shock and awe.
They felt this way.
Yue Buqun and Ning Zhongze were no better.
The couple looked at each other, speechless for a long moment.
Finally, Yue Buqun couldn’t help but whisper:
"Can there really be such a genius in sword skill in this world?"
"Isn’t Ding Ling just that?"
Ning Zhongze replied softly.
"Unbelievable."
Yue Buqun sighed:
"Feels like my worldview and outlook on life are shattered into pieces."
Laudeno, Yue Lingshan, and others behind listened and nodded in deep agreement.
This scene was indeed too impactful.
They weren’t mentally prepared at all.
By Ding Ling’s actions, each of them was knocked over and couldn’t get up.
"No wonder he’s my Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan watched from behind, full of joy, and felt a sense of pride.
As if she was the one breaking through the seven obstacles and about to learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and others all felt honored to follow such a unique person as Ding Ling.
Inside the cave.
Feng Qingyang stood with hands behind, his eyes bright as he looked at Ding Ling, saying:
"In the art of sword skill, it emphasizes flowing like clouds and water, reaching wherever freely.
Instead of being rigid and inflexible, unable to adapt."
He cast an appreciative glance at Ding Ling:
"In this aspect, you far surpass that boy Linghu Chong.
That boy was very stubborn at first, like a fool, unlike you who already have a touch of extraordinary aura and demeanor."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, neither agreeing nor disagreeing.
Feng Qingyang continued:
"The broken moves I engraved on the seven obstacles have no connection or relation, yet you could perfectly use them, obviously understanding the mysteries within.
You’ve reached the state where heart, intention, and sword are united.
Reaching this step, learning the Dugu Nine Swords is absolutely no problem."
He stroked his beard, saying meaningfully:
"Ordinary people could never learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
Without absolute comprehension and sword skill talent, even with the sword manual of the Dugu Nine Swords placed in front of someone,
They would only be helplessly anxious.
Alright, I won’t say much nonsense.
I’ll first pass you the mantra of the Dugu Nine Swords, listen closely.
Following the unknown, the unknown follows humanity, humanity follows greatness, Jia turns to Bing..."
After Feng Qingyang finished reciting.
He asked Ding Ling if he could recite it.
But Ding Ling said:
"Senior, why don’t you pass the entire Dugu Nine Swords to me at once, including all the forms and Heart Techniques."
"You!"
Feng Qingyang felt a slight anger in his heart, about to scold Ding Ling for overreaching himself and being senseless.
But thinking that Ding Ling broke through all those obstacles just by looking a few times.
After pondering for a while, he nodded:
"Seeing as you are indeed a genius.
Let’s treat it as an exception.
Listen well, and watch carefully!"
Feng Qingyang began explaining while demonstrating the moves.
"Dugu Nine Swords, only attacking and not defending, only advancing and not retreating, each move is an offense, each move varies intricately and is extremely profound!
It consists of nine forms in total."

chapters.title: Chapter 375: The Contest of Dugu Nine Swords
paragraphs: "They are the General Technique, Breaking Sword Form, Breaking Blade Form, Breaking Spear Form, Breaking Whip Form, Breaking Rope Form, Breaking Palm Form, Breaking Arrow Form, and Breaking Qi Form."
"If the Nine Techniques are perfected, then nothing is unattainable, nothing is impenetrable, nothing is unbreakable."
"All swords, blades, palms, qi, and hidden weapons in the world can be neutralized by the Dugu Nine Swords. Once mastered, one becomes invincible and unbeatable!"
The techniques demonstrated by Feng Qingyang were intricate and extraordinarily varied.
The General Technique alone had a full three hundred and sixty variations.
The speed at which Feng Qingyang performed was neither too fast nor too slow.
But this was relative to first-class experts.
In the eyes of second and third-rate experts,
the speed at which he wielded his sword and executed the techniques was incredibly fast. Even if it were slower, the ordinary eye would struggle to see and discern clearly.
Ding Ling naturally had no such concerns.
He was already in the Innate Realm.
Therefore, he could clearly see all the various sword moves.
He neither spoke nor interrupted.
Just silently watched and listened.
After watching the beginning,
Ding Ling had to admit that mastering such Dugu Nine Swords, without exceptionally strong insight, was indeed impossible.
At the very least,
his foundation was as deep as a mountain, yet he still only half understood what he heard.
If it were someone else, they would definitely be completely confused!
Listening halfway through,
Ding Ling had already determined that the Dugu Nine Swords were undeniably a supreme and unparalleled swordsmanship, surpassing any martial arts techniques he had learned!
Getting started was extremely difficult.
To cultivate the Dugu Nine Swords to a flawless state, it would take decades or even centuries of relentless effort and practice.
This was said for ordinary geniuses.
For those prodigies beyond ordinary standards, entry might be achieved easily, but to go deeper, to cultivate to Great Success, and then to a state of mastery, still requires a lot of time.
But for Ding Ling,
this was not an issue.
Even though he felt confused after one look,
this did not affect the archive in the library within his Sea of Consciousness.
Almost as Feng Qingyang finished explaining the Nine Techniques of the Dugu Nine Swords,
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
Then he saw a book condense on the bookshelf in the library.
In an instant,
[Dugu Nine Swords Full Level]
Bang!
An invisible gust of wind spread out in all directions from the position where Ding Ling stood.
A surging sword intent suddenly emerged from Ding Ling!
This sword intent penetrated Ding Ling’s bones and organs, transforming into an instinct.
It seemed ready to erupt at any moment.
"Hmm?!"
As Feng Qingyang was full of surprise and doubt,
Ding Ling suddenly opened his eyes.
Kong!
Two beams of light condensed into two dazzling streams of Sword Qi, piercing the void with a humming sound.
"What?!"
Feng Qingyang saw all this and had an incredibly unbelievable suspicion in his heart. His eyelids twitched violently as he asked somewhat unnaturally:
"You understood it?"
"Yes indeed."
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said,
"Thank you, senior, for imparting such profound swordsmanship to me. I am deeply grateful."
"Just understood?"
Recalling the commotion just now, Feng Qingyang couldn’t help but say,
"Or have you already grasped the Dugu Nine Swords to an extremely profound level? Otherwise, how could you suddenly give rise to that unique Dugu Sword Intent inherent to the Dugu Nine Swords."
The so-called Dugu Sword Intent,
is an intent that looks down upon and dominates the world!
It is like a Sword Saint sitting high on the Cloud Peak, even more like a Sword God traversing the Nine Heavens, unruly and domineering, capable of piercing and shattering everything!
That is why it is called Dugu!
"Exactly."
Ding Ling made a sword gesture with his fingers, opening his palm, and said,
"If senior doesn’t mind, please feel free to offer some pointers."
"Hmm?"
Feng Qingyang was initially taken aback, then laughed heartily:
"Good, good, good, you are a young man of courage and wisdom, worthy of praise. Come."
He also made a sword gesture with his fingers:
"Let me see to what extent your Dugu Nine Swords has reached?"
Just by watching him practice and listening to an explanation once, could he master the Dugu Nine Swords?
It all seemed unimaginable and inexplicable!
Bang!
The two quickly engaged in a duel.
Moreover, as soon as they exchanged blows,
they directly entered into a white-hot intensity.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Although they were empty-handed, sounds of Divine Weapons clashing occasionally echoed in the void!
The two attacked quickly, both focusing on offense with no defense whatsoever.
And most surprisingly, neither of them used high-level inner strength cultivation, solely relying on sword skills to attack!
Even so,
one could still only see the sky filled with sword shadows!
The exchange was fierce and evenly matched, with neither side gaining the upper hand.
But the bout lasted only a moment.
Feng Qingyang suddenly jumped back a step, waved his hand, and said,
"You’ve won!"
He sighed deeply:
"I’m getting old, running out of energy. If this continues, I’ll end up being overrun by you, a youngster. Besides..."
His expression was complex, his voice slightly trembling, whether from shock or incredulity:
"Your Dugu Nine Swords has actually reached the flawless state of mastery! This is the realm I have long yearned for, never expected you to achieve it before me."
He reddened with humiliation:

"So ashamed, so ashamed. Though I am a senior, the inheritor of the Dugu Nine Swords, I find myself less than you in reaching mastery of the Dugu Nine Swords. Alas, the Yangtze River’s waves behind drive on those ahead. Truly, each new generation surpasses the previous! Each era produces its heroes! With a genius like Ding Ling in this era, I have no place to make a fool of myself."
"Senior, you’re too humble."
Ding Ling said solemnly:
"Without senior’s teachings, how could I possibly learn this Dugu Nine Swords? Therefore, senior will always be a respected figure to me!"
"It’s good that you have such a heart."
Feng Qingyang was very gratified:

"Such a counterintuitive prodigy, yet remains humble and courteous, is truly rare. Like Linghu Chong, who with little gain, becomes uninhibited and unbridled, doomed to be a troublemaker by nature. You are different; you lean towards steadiness and reliability.
Your temperament, yet able to cultivate the Dugu Nine Swords to an impeccable state,
To be honest, I had no expectations or faith in you at first. It was just unexpected.
You have achieved so much."
He was not stingy with his words of praise for Ding Ling, lavishly commended him, and then said,
"There are sword techniques of the Five Mountains Sword Sect stored on the side of this cave. If you wish to learn, you may go and learn them."
Ding Ling naturally wanted to learn,
so he went in to take a look.
Soon after.
[Heng Mountain Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Mount Tai Swordsmanship Full Level]
The Five Mountains Sword Sect’s sword techniques were all maxed out.
Each sword technique was extremely exquisite.
Ding Ling demonstrated them one by one.

One moment, the sword techniques were intricate and complex; the next, the sword light shone brightly; another moment, the Sword Qi flowed as if it would reach straight into the East Sea; and sometimes, the sword moves seemed to predict the future, striking at places unimaginable to ordinary people.
Feng Qingyang watched from the side, astounded and tongue-tied.
When Ding Ling sheathed his sword and walked over,

chapters.title: Chapter 376 376: Ning Zhongze's Highest Recognition
paragraphs: Feng Qingyang also taught Ding Ling the Gale Swift Sword, Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords, and Taiyue Three Cyan Peaks Swordsmanship.
He truly admired and appreciated Ding Ling to the core.
He admired Ding Ling's talent.
He appreciated Ding Ling's comprehension and character.
For Ding Ling, he held nothing back and passed on his entire sword skill.
In Feng Qingyang's view, since he taught the Dugu Nine Swords, there was no need to hold back on other sword techniques.
Ding Ling's talent in the Sword Dao is so exceptional.
He couldn't help but teach him all the sword techniques he had learned.
Seeing Ding Ling master the mysterious Sword Sect supreme skills to perfection in a very short time.
Feng Qingyang was not only shocked.
But also thrilled and delighted.
He couldn't help but sigh deeply:
"If decades ago, my Sword Sect had a genius like you, Ding Ling, how could such absurd things have occurred."
Ding Ling knew what he was referring to, because the matter of Huashan Sword Qi dispute was known by almost all martial artists in Jianghu, especially with the influx of players.
Such matters are naturally prone to spread in Jianghu, just as the saying goes, good deeds don't get out the door, but bad news travels a thousand miles.
This kind of scandal, many people like to hear, naturally spreads even faster.
Walking in Jianghu, even if Ding Ling doesn't focus much on these things, he can roughly hear some.
Other than listening to Feng Qingyang, it seems he can't do much about it, after all, time can't be turned back, so he can only occasionally offer some comfort.
After a period of time.
[Achievement Medal earned: You have earned Feng Qingyang's utmost recognition.]

[Note: Your talent is so great that it gives Feng Qingyang an extreme sense of suffocation! He can't imagine how this era, this world, could have a genius of your extraordinary caliber! Plus, you're neither arrogant nor impetuous, are calm and measured, yet your sword techniques are clever and adaptable, practicing freely, all to perfect completion, which greatly surprises him!]
Putting aside the achievement medal in hand.
Ding Ling's task progress edged forward a bit.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane World experts: 41/20.]
Previously it was 39.
Roared back a monk, defeated Feng Qingyang. It became 41.
[3: You must make your name as the World's Number One resonate across the entire Plane World. 63%/100%.]
Previously it was 35%.
After sweeping the Mount Songh Sect.
Killed Master Fang Zheng, Eighteen Arhats, and others.
Ding Ling's reputation as the World's Number One grew even more!
He even completely overshadowed Feng Qingyang, Dongfang Bubai, Daoist Chongxu, and others!
"The task is almost complete. It seems I won't be in this world much longer."
Comparing the few years in the Three Kingdoms World.
The few months in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
It really seems like a fleeting moment, passing in the blink of an eye.
Ding Ling and Feng Qingyang walked out of the cave together.
Feng Qingyang came out laughing, his voice echoing, overwhelming the area:

"Ding Ling is a Sword Dao genius. His prowess in the Dugu Nine Swords has surpassed mine completely. I have found the true inheritor of the Dugu Nine Swords, and I am at peace to die! These seven checkpoints will remain. The rewards are unchanged. But if you don't think you have the talent like Ding Ling.
Then don't bother me.
The Dugu Nine Swords will only be taught to unrivaled Sword Dao geniuses!"
As soon as these words were spoken.
The surrounding audience turned pale.
Yue Buqun thought:

"Rumor has it that Dugu Nine Swords is extremely difficult to learn. Achieving depth is like ascending the heavens. Ding Ling managed to train the Dugu Nine Swords to a level surpassing Feng Qingyang in such a short time. This is indeed too much to believe.
But Feng Qingyang, as a senior in the Sword Sect, wouldn't belittle himself for an outsider.
So this must be true?!"
Yue Buqun was moved, once again raising his level of admiration for Ding Ling.
Ning Zhongze felt the same.
[Achievement Medal earned: You have earned Yue Buqun's utmost recognition.]

[Note: Your repeated rapid breakthroughs have shattered Yue Buqun's worldview multiple times, and you've even made Feng Qingyang feel inferior. This generated great respect for you in Yue Buqun! He doesn't want to be your enemy, only wants to be your friend!]
[Achievement Medal earned: You have earned Ning Zhongze's utmost recognition.]
[Note: Ning Zhongze rarely feels overwhelmed by someone like looking at the Celestial Palace. You are the only exception!]
Ding Ling suddenly heard the notification sound, and couldn't help but glance at the Yue Buqun couple.
He then shifted his gaze to Fengg Buping and others.
The expressions of these people varied.
But it seems that there was no response from the achievement medals.
It seems either they were taken by other players, or they are still unconvinced of me.
And indeed, this is the case.
Fengg Buping was ambitious, determined to strengthen the Huashan Sect, and even become the leader of the Five Mountains Sword Sect.

Therefore, knowing that Feng Qingyang, a senior of the Sword Sect, was in Huashan, he decisively brought Cong Buqi and others to Huashan to seek guidance from Feng Qingyang, appealing with emotion and reason, and due to his persistent nature, he did not give up.
Thus, Feng Qingyang accepted them.

However, what made Fengg Buping quite dissatisfied and angry was that Linghu Chong from the Qi Sect learned the Dugu Nine Swords, which was fine, but Ding Ling, an outsider, also learned the Dugu Nine Swords.
Yet he, a bona fide descendant of the Sword Sect, didn't get to learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
How could he accept this?
Seeing Feng Qingyang and Ding Ling talking and laughing as they emerged, and were about to leave, Fengg Buping hurriedly jumped out, loudly said:
"Master Feng, I have something I don't know if I should say?"
"Go ahead."
Feng Qingyang replied solemnly.
"I'm a descendant of the Sword Sect, yet I haven't received your guidance, let alone trained in the Dugu Nine Swords. Why can Ding Ling, an outsider, receive your careful instruction.
This is unfair."
With Fengg Buping saying this.
Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou also jumped out, saying:

"That's right, although Ding Ling's talent in swordsmanship is good, it doesn't necessarily qualify him to be taught the Dugu Nine Swords. Additionally, he learned it so quickly. Is the Dugu Nine Swords failing to live up to its name?"
Feng Qingyang raised his hand to stop their words, and said:
"I understand what you mean. How about this."
He glanced at Ding Ling:
"As long as you can surpass Ding Ling by a move or half a move in swordsmanship, I'll teach you the Dugu Nine Swords."
"No use of inner strength? Arm strength? Only moves?"
Cheng Buyou asked anxiously.
"Correct."
"Good."
Cheng Buyou was the first to jump out, drew his sword, and pointed it at Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding, I shamelessly ask for your guidance."

Ding Ling was unreserved as well; it was a good opportunity to advance his task progress and achievement medals. Their initiative to challenge was just what he wished for, Ding Ling thought this, and also drew the Heaven-Swaying Sword from his back, flicked the tip, and smiled:
"Let's learn from each other. You are the senior, please start."
"Haha..."
Cheng Buyou laughed three times:
"Alright then, I'll let you try our Huashan Sect's Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords!"
Clang, clang, clang!
As the sound fell, Cheng Buyou's feet swiftly shifted, and his sword wielded in a seamless, uninterrupted fashion, dense and flawless, impenetrable by needles, impervious to water.

"The task is almost complete.
It seems I won't be in this world much longer."
Comparing the few years in the Three Kingdoms World.
The few months in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
It really seems like a fleeting moment, passing in the blink of an eye.
Ding Ling and Feng Qingyang walked out of the cave together.
Feng Qingyang came out laughing, his voice echoing, overwhelming the area:
"Ding Ling is a Sword Dao genius.
His prowess in the Dugu Nine Swords has surpassed mine completely.
I have found the true inheritor of the Dugu Nine Swords, and I am at peace to die!
These seven checkpoints will remain.
The rewards are unchanged.
But if you don't think you have the talent like Ding Ling.
Then don't bother me.
The Dugu Nine Swords will only be taught to unrivaled Sword Dao geniuses!"
As soon as these words were spoken.
The surrounding audience turned pale.
Yue Buqun thought:
"Rumor has it that Dugu Nine Swords is extremely difficult to learn.
Achieving depth is like ascending the heavens.
Ding Ling managed to train the Dugu Nine Swords to a level surpassing Feng Qingyang in such a short time.
This is indeed too much to believe.
But Feng Qingyang, as a senior in the Sword Sect, wouldn't belittle himself for an outsider.
So this must be true?!"
Yue Buqun was moved, once again raising his level of admiration for Ding Ling.
Ning Zhongze felt the same.
[Achievement Medal earned: You have earned Yue Buqun's utmost recognition.]
[Note: Your repeated rapid breakthroughs have shattered Yue Buqun's worldview multiple times, and you've even made Feng Qingyang feel inferior.
This generated great respect for you in Yue Buqun!
He doesn't want to be your enemy, only wants to be your friend!]
[Achievement Medal earned: You have earned Ning Zhongze's utmost recognition.]
[Note: Ning Zhongze rarely feels overwhelmed by someone like looking at the Celestial Palace.
You are the only exception!]
Ding Ling suddenly heard the notification sound, and couldn't help but glance at the Yue Buqun couple.
He then shifted his gaze to Fengg Buping and others.
The expressions of these people varied.
But it seems that there was no response from the achievement medals.
It seems either they were taken by other players, or they are still unconvinced of me.
And indeed, this is the case.
Fengg Buping was ambitious, determined to strengthen the Huashan Sect, and even become the leader of the Five Mountains Sword Sect.

Therefore, knowing that Feng Qingyang, a senior of the Sword Sect, was in Huashan, he decisively brought Cong Buqi and others to Huashan to seek guidance from Feng Qingyang, appealing with emotion and reason, and due to his persistent nature, he did not give up.
Thus, Feng Qingyang accepted them.

However, what made Fengg Buping quite dissatisfied and angry was that Linghu Chong from the Qi Sect learned the Dugu Nine Swords, which was fine, but Ding Ling, an outsider, also learned the Dugu Nine Swords.
Yet he, a bona fide descendant of the Sword Sect, didn't get to learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
How could he accept this?
Seeing Feng Qingyang and Ding Ling talking and laughing as they emerged, and were about to leave, Fengg Buping hurriedly jumped out, loudly said:
"Master Feng, I have something I don't know if I should say?"
"Go ahead."
Feng Qingyang replied solemnly.
"I'm a descendant of the Sword Sect, yet I haven't received your guidance, let alone trained in the Dugu Nine Swords.
Why can Ding Ling, an outsider, receive your careful instruction.
This is unfair."
With Fengg Buping saying this.
Cong Buqi and Cheng Buyou also jumped out, saying:
"That's right, although Ding Ling's talent in swordsmanship is good, it doesn't necessarily qualify him to be taught the Dugu Nine Swords.
Additionally, he learned it so quickly.
Is the Dugu Nine Swords failing to live up to its name?"
Feng Qingyang raised his hand to stop their words, and said:
"I understand what you mean.
How about this."
He glanced at Ding Ling:
"As long as you can surpass Ding Ling by a move or half a move in swordsmanship, I'll teach you the Dugu Nine Swords."
"No use of inner strength?
Arm strength?
Only moves?"
Cheng Buyou asked anxiously.
"Correct."
"Good."
Cheng Buyou was the first to jump out, drew his sword, and pointed it at Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding, I shamelessly ask for your guidance."
Ding Ling was unreserved as well; it was a good opportunity to advance his task progress and achievement medals.
Their initiative to challenge was just what he wished for, Ding Ling thought this, and also drew the Heaven-Swaying Sword from his back, flicked the tip, and smiled:
"Let's learn from each other.
You are the senior, please start."
"Haha..."
Cheng Buyou laughed three times:
"Alright then, I'll let you try our Huashan Sect's Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords!"
Clang, clang, clang!
As the sound fell, Cheng Buyou's feet swiftly shifted, and his sword wielded in a seamless, uninterrupted fashion, dense and flawless, impenetrable by needles, impervious to water.

chapters.title: Chapter 377 377: The Three Sword Sect Disciples Defeated
paragraphs: After Cheng Buyou thrust his sword, it seemed as if three immortals simultaneously spun out three swords, each directly targeting Ding Ling's vital points.
It was clearly a single sword.
Yet, in that instant.
It seemed to produce countless sword shadows.
Within these shadows lay three tangible sword bodies, each hiding a sharp sword edge aimed to stab, slice, or chop Ding Ling's neck, waist, and back.
Such Sword Skill was truly a rare Superior Swordsmanship.
Cheng Buyou had clearly trained to the Flawless Innate Ability level.
His execution was exquisite, with a hidden murderous intent.
After thrusting his sword, he saw that Ding Ling didn't react and couldn't help but laugh heartily, thinking that Ding Ling, this Sword Dao genius, was merely so-so.
However.
In the next instant.
As Ding Ling shook his sword tip, he softly uttered three words, "Breaking Sword Form"!
Clang, clang, clang!

A series of fine clashes of weapons resounded in his ear, and upon looking again, Cheng Buyou suddenly found that Ding Ling's sword was already pressed against his neck; if he moved even an inch forward, he would certainly be pierced through the neck, meeting his death.
His face turned pale instantly, and cold sweat uncontrollably broke out on his back, causing all the hairs on his body to stand on end.
"I concede,"
Ding Ling sheathed his sword.
Only then did Cheng Buyou realize that they had been sparring with swords, and he was somewhat in a daze, finding it hard to believe he had lost so quickly, without even feeling it.
But the fact was unchangeable; if not for Ding Ling yielding, he might already be dead.
Thinking of this,
He felt disgruntled in his heart, sighed, hunched slightly, and walked to the back without saying a word.
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidated Cheng Buyou.]

[Note: Cheng Buyou, with a hot temper and rude manner, originally intended to seize this opportunity to beat you by a move or two, but was easily defeated by you. He couldn't even figure out where he lost. His feelings of envy and jealousy turned into fear, vigilance, and wariness towards you.]
Aside from the Achievement Medal.
[1: Defeat more than 20 realm powerhouses: 42/20.]
Previously, it was 41.
"Sure enough, it works."
Ding Ling's expression slightly lifted.
Looking at people like Fengg Buping, it was as if he was seeing experience points!
"Who's next?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly, lowering the Heaven-Swaying Sword in his hand.
"I am."
Cong Buqi, without saying more, thrust a Treasure Sword directly at Ding Ling.
But in the next instant,
Clang!
In just one round,
Ding Ling's Heaven-Swaying Sword already pointed at his forehead, and with just a bit more force, Cong Buqi's forehead would be pierced.
"You, you, you..."
Cong Buqi stammered you, you, you for a long time, but couldn't say anything, retreating with an unwilling and fearful look.
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidated Cong Buqi.]

[Note: Cong Buqi, arrogant and despicable, unscrupulously intended to take this opportunity to attack you, to seize an advantage and win a half move. Yet, he was still easily defeated by you. He's somewhat questioning life.
He merely hoped to win half a move, even when having the upper hand, and yet failed! He felt desolate, depressed, unwilling, and uncomfortable!]
[1: Defeat more than 20 realm powerhouses: 43/20.]
Sure enough, it works.
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
Originally, I thought the Achievement Medals of these Sword Sect descendants were taken by other players.
But it seems no other player has gained their recognition yet.
Thinking about it, indeed.
These three without exception were those with 'great vendettas and deep resolves', with resilient hearts, paying countless time, blood, sweat, and tears to return to Huashan.
How could they be easily subdued, intimidated, or moved by people?
Next, Fengg Buping's Gale Swift Sword was also easily broken by Ding Ling's Breaking Sword Form.
Ding Ling gained another Achievement Medal.
The mission progress jumped to 44.
"Now do you understand the gap between you and Ding Ling?"
Feng Qingyang glanced at Fengg Buping and the others:
"When your Sword Technique can reach a state unconfined by form, reaching anywhere you will, then I will consider teaching you the Dugu Nine Swords."
Fengg Buping and the others were now in a daze, being defeated by Ding Ling in one move before everyone, the blow could be imagined, each feeling ashamed and crestfallen.
Upon hearing Feng Qingyang's words, they could only respond hollowly, not daring to question unfairness any longer.
Compared to Ding Ling,
They were like fools, like trash.
Feng Qingyang's lack of regard seemed understandable.
Thinking of this made them even more dejected.
Their gazes at Ding Ling inevitably carried a hint of fear.
For them,
The onlooking Yue Buqun couple, Yue Lingshan, Laudeno, and others were either shocked, in a daze, or frightened.
Ning Zhongze muttered to herself:
"Ding Ling's Sword Skill has reached an incredible level. I can't even comprehend why his last strike was made, yet it easily broke the Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords!"

"Indeed. The Life-taking Linked Three Immortal Swords, such a Superior Swordsmanship, was broken so simply. Facing Ding Ling, I now have no confidence. I doubt if we become enemies, I'd likely be easily killed by him with one strike."
Yue Buqun sighed.
More determined to befriend Ding Ling.
Imagine being enemies with Ding Ling?
Yue Buqun shuddered at the thought, raising all the hairs on his body!
"Dad, Mom, can you really not block Ding Ling's sword?!"
Yue Lingshan couldn't believe it.
In her eyes,
Her parents were omnipotent, the strongest in the Jianghu.
They were her sky, her earth!
But now it seems her world is about to collapse.
"No. We can't block it."
Ning Zhongze was honest: "Facing him head-on, I might not even last a breath before being killed. He's too strong; I don't have the courage to face his sword!"

"Exactly. Previously, his swords had traces to follow. But now, learning the Dugu Nine Swords, they are traceless, a single move, Heavenly Horse Soaring in the Sky, antelope's horns, I can't comprehend it, how could I possibly parry?"
Yue Buqun agreed, nodding without shame.
All three Sword Sect members were easily defeated.
Even someone as grand as Feng Qingyang claimed to have less achievement in the Dugu Nine Swords than Ding Ling.
Think of Ding Ling's past achievements!
Yue Buqun at this moment admitting being inferior to Ding Ling was entirely reasonable.
He even found it normal to be inferior to Ding Ling!
Before, he thought he could spar ten moves with Ding Ling; now, he had no confidence in lasting one!
"This, this, this..."
Yue Lingshan was as if struck by lightning, her face turned pale.
Her worldview and outlook on life began to crumble at this moment.
Qu Feiyan glimpsed at Yue Lingshan but didn't add fuel to the fire by saying anything like 'Now do you see how powerful my Brother Ding is?'
Instead, her bright eyes shone even more brilliantly when looking at Ding Ling.
The sense of glory in her eyes seemed almost tangible.
Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, and others felt similar, feeling proud as one.

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Ren Yingying and Two Others Ascend Reflection Cliff
paragraphs: At the Reflection Cliff on Huashan.
Ding Ling easily defeated three masters from the Sword Sect.
Feng Qingyang admitted that he was not as good as Ding Ling.
Like the wind.
The news quickly spread across the Jiuzhou land.
Ding Ling’s fame rose once again.
His title as the world’s number one became even more resounding.
Ding Ling settled down at the Reflection Cliff.
Preparing for a great battle in a month and a half.
Regarding Ding Ling’s decision.
Yue Buqun was extremely surprised and delighted.
After learning Ding Ling’s purpose, he was even more attentive and courteous to Ding Ling every day.
Yue Lingshan, observing from the side, felt quite nauseous.
She couldn’t help but feel a mix of envy and admiration for Ding Ling.
After all, everyone around her was discussing and revering Ding Ling.
Yue Lingshan, hearing it every day, and seeing her parents equally admire Ding Ling, naturally had her mindset unconsciously changed.
And after this shift in mindset.
Upon looking at Ding Ling again.
She felt that Ding Ling was radiant, grandly magnificent, and infinitely charming, truly a hero as matchless as Qu Feiyan had described.

As she accompanied her parents to deliver food to Ding Ling at the Reflection Cliff every day, or watched him sparring with her parents, she found herself becoming even more mesmerized, gaining more recognition for Ding Ling.
Unconsciously, she had tossed Linghu Chong’s reminders aside.
A month passed like this.
Yue Lingshan was already eagerly calling Ding Ling ’Hero Ding’ alongside Qu Feiyan.
Qu Feiyan glanced sideways, thinking:

"Could Yue Lingshan have forgotten her previous caution towards my Brother Ding a month ago? How could she become so close within just a month? She really has a big heart. Or maybe my Brother Ding’s charm is just too overwhelming for her to resist?"
Thinking this way.
While feeling proud, she couldn’t help but get even closer to her Brother Ding, fearing Yue Lingshan might occupy his time.
She knew her Brother Ding might soon shatter the void and leave.
So she wanted to spend as much time with her Brother Ding as she could in the remaining time.
Time flew by.
Ding Ling stayed on Huashan.
Without feeling bored.
Aside from instructing Qu Feiyan and others,
he often sparred with Yue Buqun and others, using the sparring as an excuse, Ding Ling also managed to defeat the Yue couple, advancing his task progress bar significantly.
Aside from that,
Ding Ling focused mainly on Qu Feiyan, using all sorts of great medicine he obtained from the Mount Songh Sect on her.
Relentlessly guiding her to cultivate upper-class inner power, lightweight skill, sword skill, and more.
Qu Feiyan, extremely gifted and intelligent, was also very diligent and ambitious.
Her progress was naturally swift.
This day.
Several familiar faces arrived on Huashan.
Ding Ling looked closely and saw that it was Ren Yingying, Ren Woxing, Xiaang Wentian, and others.
"It’s you!"
Huang Zhonggong and others turned pale.
"Haha..."
Ren Woxing laughed loudly, then waved his hand and said:
"I came this time because I heard that Ding Ling would be fighting Dongfang Bubai at the top of Huashan. So I came two days early to watch the battle. I won’t attack you."
He glanced at Ding Ling:
"Besides, I wouldn’t dare to attack you in front of Hero Ding."
"Sect Leader Ren."

Ding Ling glanced at Ren Yingying, seeing her cheeks blushing, her eyes watery as she looked at him, her delight barely concealed; if it weren’t for Ren Woxing, Consort Yhu, and others present, she might have pounced on him right there.
Ding Ling was also secretly surprised at how Ren Yingying’s attitude toward him had changed so much in just two months.
He had no idea.
Ren Yingying had a very high opinion of him, believing that there was no comparable man like Ding Ling in the world!

Moreover, after expressing her feelings to Ren Woxing, she was unexpectedly encouraged to pursue Ding Ling, which made her ecstatic, unable to stop thinking about Ding Ling day and night, longing for her ideal man for two whole months.
Seeing Ding Ling again unexpectedly,
her feelings erupted like a volcano.
Thus Ding Ling felt Ren Yingying’s attitude toward him was unusual and somewhat abnormal.
"I appreciate the help you and Miss Ren have given me. But I hope you won’t harm my friends. Otherwise, I won’t give you face."
After Ding Ling clarified his stance,
Ren Yingying quickly said:
"Rest assured, Hero Ding. My father and I are on your side. Your friends are our friends. How could we possibly harm your friends?"
Ding Ling was skeptical.
Ren Yingying hastily shook Ren Woxing’s shoulders, and Ren Woxing, helpless, nodded and said:
"Yes, yes, what Yingying said is right!"
"That’s for the best."
Ding Ling then asked:
"You just mentioned that Dongfang Bubai will battle with me on the Huashan peak?"
"Isn’t that the case?
Ren Woxing was surprised:
"This news has spread across the Jiuzhou land. Many people know about it."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling had been on Huashan for over a month.
With Yue Buqun’s thoughtful care,
he didn’t need to go down the mountain for supplies or anything.
So he hadn’t communicated with people at the base of the mountain.

When logging out, he mainly focused on improving his strength, eating meals, or paying attention to the dynamics and situations of the Three Kingdoms and Diao Chan, so he hadn’t noticed this piece of news.
In general,
he hurriedly logged in and out recently. In over a month, he only took his laptop to connect to the internet on the mountain twice.
So it was quite normal not to know about the recent rumors and gossip.
"Is Bai Wushuang Dongfang Bubai?!"
Ding Ling was confused.
"What Bai Wushuang?"
Ren Woxing turned his head.
"It seems you don’t know either."
Ding Ling contemplated:
"In a few days, everything will be revealed."
"Your battle with Dongfang Bubai is definitely true,"
Ren Woxing confirmed:

"Xiaang Left Envoy has agents and spies within the Sun and Moon Divine Sect. These spies learned precise and specific information, Dongfang Bubai would leave Reflection Cliff for Huashan today. This might be kept from others, but not from me, Ren Woxing."
His face beamed with joy:
"If you can kill Dongfang Bubai on the Huashan peak, I could take over the Sun and Moon Divine Sect effortlessly!"
His eyes gleamed as he looked at Ding Ling:
"I know about your promise with Yingying, and we also hope that in two days, under everyone’s gaze, you can defeat or even kill Dongfang Bubai, that shameless villain."
"I will defeat him."
Ding Ling wasn’t sure if Dongfang Bubai was Bai Wushuang.
He didn’t dare guarantee that he would kill the opponent:
"I hope that after arriving at Huashan, you all won’t cause too much commotion, otherwise Sect Leader Yue will have a hard time."
At this time.
Ding Ling saw Yue Buqun and his wife bringing Yue Lingshan and a few others to visit him again.
He then brought the matter up smoothly.
Indeed.
Upon hearing Ding Ling say this, and seeing Ren Woxing and others, Yue Buqun’s expression changed slightly.

"Sect Leader Ren."

Ding Ling glanced at Ren Yingying, seeing her cheeks blushing, her eyes watery as she looked at him, her delight barely concealed; if it weren’t for Ren Woxing, Consort Yhu, and others present, she might have pounced on him right there.
Ding Ling was also secretly surprised at how Ren Yingying’s attitude toward him had changed so much in just two months.
He had no idea.
Ren Yingying had a very high opinion of him, believing that there was no comparable man like Ding Ling in the world!

Moreover, after expressing her feelings to Ren Woxing, she was unexpectedly encouraged to pursue Ding Ling, which made her ecstatic, unable to stop thinking about Ding Ling day and night, longing for her ideal man for two whole months.
Seeing Ding Ling again unexpectedly,
her feelings erupted like a volcano.
Thus Ding Ling felt Ren Yingying’s attitude toward him was unusual and somewhat abnormal.
"I appreciate the help you and Miss Ren have given me.
But I hope you won’t harm my friends.
Otherwise, I won’t give you face."
After Ding Ling clarified his stance,
Ren Yingying quickly said:
"Rest assured, Hero Ding.
My father and I are on your side.
Your friends are our friends.
How could we possibly harm your friends?"
Ding Ling was skeptical.
Ren Yingying hastily shook Ren Woxing’s shoulders, and Ren Woxing, helpless, nodded and said:
"Yes, yes, what Yingying said is right!"
"That’s for the best."
Ding Ling then asked:
"You just mentioned that Dongfang Bubai will battle with me on the Huashan peak?"
"Isn’t that the case?
Ren Woxing was surprised:
"This news has spread across the Jiuzhou land.
Many people know about it."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling had been on Huashan for over a month.
With Yue Buqun’s thoughtful care,
he didn’t need to go down the mountain for supplies or anything.
So he hadn’t communicated with people at the base of the mountain.

When logging out, he mainly focused on improving his strength, eating meals, or paying attention to the dynamics and situations of the Three Kingdoms and Diao Chan, so he hadn’t noticed this piece of news.
In general,
he hurriedly logged in and out recently.
In over a month, he only took his laptop to connect to the internet on the mountain twice.
So it was quite normal not to know about the recent rumors and gossip.
"Is Bai Wushuang Dongfang Bubai?!"
Ding Ling was confused.
"What Bai Wushuang?"
Ren Woxing turned his head.
"It seems you don’t know either."
Ding Ling contemplated:
"In a few days, everything will be revealed."
"Your battle with Dongfang Bubai is definitely true,"
Ren Woxing confirmed:
"Xiaang Left Envoy has agents and spies within the Sun and Moon Divine Sect.
These spies learned precise and specific information, Dongfang Bubai would leave Reflection Cliff for Huashan today.
This might be kept from others, but not from me, Ren Woxing."
His face beamed with joy:
"If you can kill Dongfang Bubai on the Huashan peak, I could take over the Sun and Moon Divine Sect effortlessly!"
His eyes gleamed as he looked at Ding Ling:
"I know about your promise with Yingying, and we also hope that in two days, under everyone’s gaze, you can defeat or even kill Dongfang Bubai, that shameless villain."
"I will defeat him."
Ding Ling wasn’t sure if Dongfang Bubai was Bai Wushuang.
He didn’t dare guarantee that he would kill the opponent:
"I hope that after arriving at Huashan, you all won’t cause too much commotion, otherwise Sect Leader Yue will have a hard time."
At this time.
Ding Ling saw Yue Buqun and his wife bringing Yue Lingshan and a few others to visit him again.
He then brought the matter up smoothly.
Indeed.
Upon hearing Ding Ling say this, and seeing Ren Woxing and others, Yue Buqun’s expression changed slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 379: Zhang Hex of the Three Kingdoms Arrives at Huashan
paragraphs: The Reflection Cliff of the Huashan Sect is absolutely impossible for ordinary people to access.
But for a top master like Ren Woxing, entering and leaving is unimpeded, and ordinary people simply cannot stop him from entering here.
Although Yue Buqun knows this, he still feels somewhat depressed in his heart.
Ren Woxing laughed and said:
"Sect Leader Yue, I came unannounced, and I hope you don’t mind."
Yue Buqun suppressed his inner depression and cupped his hands in salute:
"Sect Leader Ren visiting the Huashan Sect is truly an honor. How could I mind?"
"It’s best that you think that way."
Ren Woxing exchanged a few words with Sect Leader Yue, and then they each went their separate ways.
Obviously, they both understood that there was no possibility of becoming friends, but since Ding Ling was here, they could only exchange hypocritical pleasantries.
Ren Woxing left the mountain with Xiaang Wentian.
They would find a place to stay at the foot of the mountain and come up to Huashan every day to have discussions with Ding Ling and also wait for Dongfang Bubai.
As for Ren Yingying.
She stayed around Ding Ling like Qu Feiyan and wouldn’t leave.
Her bright, beautiful apricot eyes carried a romantic aura, and the way she looked at Ding Ling was different from how she looked at others. How clever was Qu Feiyan?
She could see through Ren Yingying’s feelings at a glance and couldn’t help but feel nervous about it.
But knowing that Ding Ling would not stay long in this world, she extinguished her jealousy and focus solely on Ding Ling’s well-being and considerations.
Of course, to follow in Ding Ling’s footsteps.
She also worked harder and harder.
If she didn’t understand, she would ask Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s advice from a high vantage point was incisive and straight to the point, and Qu Feiyan often understood at first hearing.
Ren Yingying watched on the side but secretly envied greatly, thinking:

"If I could accompany Ding Ling like Qu Feiyan every day, wouldn’t we have already been a couple, flying side by side? But it’s a pity, a pity. Ding Ling seems like a gentleman; if he were a bit more carefree, wouldn’t we have already had a good outcome?"
Thinking of this.
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but smile bitterly:
"If Ding Ling were too carefree, he wouldn’t be himself. Perhaps I wouldn’t be so devoted to him."
Just as Green Bamboo Elder said.
Love comes unbidden and goes deep.
Ren Yingying has feelings for Ding Ling, but not to an extreme degree.
She was merely completely captivated by Ding Ling’s talent, supreme skill, martial arts, aura, charm, character, and so on!
Subsequently, her affection increased.

To the extent that, upon discovering there’s no such good man in the world anymore, when those around her agreed with her and Ding Ling, she, although clever and decisive, felt helpless in matters of love, tangled up in it, and unable to extricate herself.
Thinking of him daily without seeing him.
When meeting again, her emotions fluctuated wildly, and she couldn’t control herself, getting consumed by it, and it became difficult to pull herself out.
She was not one to admit defeat.
The more indifferent Ding Ling was to her.
The more she had thoughts.
After dozens of hours.
Her heart and mind were already full of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling sensed it and felt odd in his heart, thinking:
"Although I’ve interacted quite a bit with Ren Yingying, the time we spent together was very brief. Why does she seem to like me? This shouldn’t be, right?"
Ding Ling’s heart is occupied by Diao Chan and other beauties.
In this world, there is hardly anyone more beautiful than Diao Chan.
Thus, although Ren Yingying is beautiful like a piece of pure white jade, Ding Ling is currently filled with thoughts about Bai Wushuang, breaking through the void, and soon leaving this world.
Where is the time to fall in love with Ren Yingying?
He isn’t the kind of gentleman Ren Yingying imagines.
It’s just that he truly has no intention of talking about love recently.
If there’s time.
He’d rather guide Qu Feiyan more.
The promise he made to Qu Yang.
Might be difficult to fulfill perfectly.
Ding Ling’s heart is filled with guilt and can only do his best to raise Qu Feiyan to the level of a first-class expert. Unless she reaches this level, Ding Ling wouldn’t feel secure leaving.
On this day.
Another person came to the Reflection Cliff of Huashan.
"Prince."
This person seemed to know him and called him Prince.
Such a title hadn’t been heard for a long time.
Ding Ling was slightly stunned, looked towards the voice, and was taken aback to see that the visitor was Zhang Hex.
"You, you..."
"Hahaha..."
Zhang Hex laughed:
"Are you surprised? Delighted?"
He was wearing a long robe, holding a spear, still heroic, but his spirit was even more exuberant.
He walked to Ding Ling’s side, looked him up and down:
"I am also pleasantly surprised. I didn’t expect to actually meet you, Prince, in this world. It’s truly lucky and coincidental."
"Indeed."
Ding Ling regained his senses, with a rather complex expression:
"Since you’re here. Where are Gao Lan and the others?"

"Gao Lan’s cultivation is not enough, still striving hard to practice. I received the Zhang Clan’s wholehearted support, plus guidance from seniors Tong Yuan and Wang Yue, so I was able to make rapid progress, breaking into the super-elite realm."
Zhang Hex was full of enthusiasm, and apparently meeting Ding Ling again was extremely pleasurable for him:
"After I ascended, I found myself in Luoyang, and tried entering the city to inquire about the world’s situation. Unexpectedly, I heard news of you, Prince.
I caught a few local thugs on Luoyang’s long street to ask about you, Prince, and didn’t expect that you’ve already become the World’s Number One Hero in this world!
I couldn’t wait, didn’t stop for a moment to come to Huashan to find you, Prince.
Indeed.
Here in this realm, there’s more news about you, Prince. Just a little inquiry, and it turns out you were at some Reflection Cliff.
I entered here borrowing a few people under the pretext of breaking through seven gateways. Then I met you here at the Reflection Cliff!"
Zhang Hex was very excited:
"Being able to meet you again, Prince, is truly a blessing! Fortunate beyond measure!"
He was sincere.
Pouring out what’s in his heart, showing that this must be an extremely thrilling mood.
Ding Ling smiled slightly, patting his shoulder:
"Alright, we’re all friends. In this world, I’m no longer a Prince, so don’t keep calling me Prince, Prince; it sounds awkward, just call me Ding Ling."
"How can that be? Etiquette cannot be discarded."
But Ding Ling insisted.
Zhang Hex had no choice but to listen to Ding Ling and change his way of addressing.
Initially, it felt awkward, like disrespecting Ding Ling, but after being reminded several times by Ding Ling, he slowly relaxed and began exchanging words with Ding Ling.
Through his narrative.
Ding Ling learned more about the detailed circumstances of Diao Chan and the others.
It was more realistic compared to what was learned online.
Compared to players, Zhang Hex has excellent relationships with Zhao Yun, Pan Feng, and naturally can gain some inside information.
According to Zhang Hex.
Diao Chan and their cultivation are also advancing swiftly, and it seems ascension might just be in the next few years.
