chapters.title: Chapter 380: Cheng Yaojin and Taishi Ci
paragraphs: Once he confirmed that his guess wasn’t far off.
Ding Ling felt a sense of relief in his heart.
He also worried that Diao Chan and the others would ascend immediately, which would be detrimental to their growth.
Without top-notch Inner Power Heart Method, it’s not easy to achieve leap-like development and progress in this world.
But since Zhang Hex came.
Ding Ling did not hesitate with him.
He imparted the Pure Yang True Skill to him.
The Pure Yang True Skill, people like Xiaang Wentian and others also know it, it’s not unique to Ding Ling.
Naturally, Ding Ling had no need to hold it as a trump card.
His trump card is the ’Divine Skill Automatic Full Level’ cheat!
Going to other worlds, as long as he came into contact with more powerful Cultivation Techniques, the Pure Yang True Skill would eventually be replaced.
So there’s no need to hide it.
He didn’t hide the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, so how could he hide the Pure Yang True Skill.
Besides, Zhang Hex is one of his own.
He’s from his own camp.
Ding Ling also hopes Zhang Hex would take care of Qu Feiyan.
He had been worried that Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, and others would be oppressed in this world. Now that Zhang Hex has arrived, having more allies would be much better.
Compared to those in this world who only cultivate Inner Power.
Those who cultivate both Breathing Technique and Inner Power, their Vigorous Qi and Inner Strength fuse, producing explosive power and speed, capable of five to ten times the force burst.
Just for this alone.
Zhang Hex’s potential is immeasurable.
Zhang Hex also did not expect that not long after ascending, upon arriving at Huashan, he would receive such a top-notch Inner Power Heart Method.
He’s not naive.
Along the way, he inquired about this world’s situation and learned that everyone in the Martial Arts world cultivates the Inner Power Heart Method.
He wanted to cultivate too, but had no path.
Ding Ling imparted to him such a superior Heart Technique, he was filled with gratitude and even more determined with the thought of ’A warrior dies for one who appreciates him.’
After all, in the Three Kingdoms World, Ding Ling had long repaid the kindness from their previous imparting of techniques, even exceeding the original kindness of imparting.

Now, receiving the Pure Yang True Skill, he resolutely decided in his heart that he must follow closely in Ding Ling’s footsteps, no matter what Ding Ling asks him to do, he would do his utmost to achieve it.
Ding Ling, with his full-level skills in acting, Observing People Skill, Stargazing Skill, naturally saw through Zhang Hex’s thoughts.
Inwardly nodding, he was quite pleased.
Regarding Zhang Hex’s arrival.
Ding Ling naturally introduced him to Qu Feiyan and the others.
Qu Feiyan and the others, upon hearing that Zhang Hex, like Ding Ling, ascended from the Lower Realm, were surprised and couldn’t help but ask about some things in the Lower Realm.
Learning that the Lower Realm is the Three Kingdoms, they were puzzled but suddenly realized that there might be more than one Three Kingdoms World in the Lower Realm.
After all, Li Yuanba can’t possibly be a character from the Three Kingdoms.
After Zhang Hex arrived for merely two hours.
At the mountain path opposite the Reflection Cliff in Huashan.
Another person arrived.
This person, over eight feet tall, sturdy and robust, carrying a giant axe, silently glanced at Ding Ling and then turned to leave.
"Cheng Yaojin, you’re just going to leave like that?"
A player heckled.
Cheng Yaojin ignored them, simply speeding up his pace with the axe in hand. In just a few breaths, he moved through the crowd and disappeared into the dense forest on one side of Huashan.
"Cheng Yaojin?"
Ding Ling, in the Innate Realm, sharp-eared and clear-eyed, could hardly miss movements within tens of meters.
The player’s voice was loud.
Ding Ling heard it clearly and couldn’t help but look in the direction of the sound, just in time to see a wide and overbearing silhouette disappearing into the green mountains.
"If it really is Cheng Yaojin. It seems he also knows about me killing Li Yuanba and seeks to avenge him?"
Ding Ling’s eyebrows raised slightly, he called over Zhang Hex, giving him a few instructions to pay special attention to warlords ascending from the Sui and Tang World.
To prevent any potential risks.
He listed all the generals from Li Shimin’s side for Zhang Hex.
After Zhang Hex remembered them thoroughly, he nodded, solemnly saying:
"P-Prince... Ding, Ding Ling, rest assured. I would give my life to ensure no one harms Qu Feiyan and the others!"
Being used to calling him Prince in the Three Kingdoms.
It’s actually difficult for Zhang Hex to call him by name.
"It’s not so serious."
Ding Ling stood with hands behind his back, looking at the slanting sunset in the west:

"Cultivate well the Pure Yang True Skill I taught you. Strive to cultivate Inner Strength as soon as possible. Once Vigorous Qi and Inner Qi merge, your power will grow explosively, and at that time, some generals who haven’t cultivated Inner Power will definitely not be your match!"
"Yes!"
"Go and cultivate well. If you have any questions, remember to ask me."
"Yes!"
The wind on Huashan was getting stronger.
More and more heroes and warriors from all over came to watch the fight, too.
Yue Buqun was tense, seeing that things couldn’t go on like this. After consulting with Ding Ling, he simply opened the door wide.
Allowing these heroes to take the main road.
Rather than sneaking in from elsewhere.
This made him very insecure, afraid that someday a master would sneak into the inner courtyard of the Huashan Sect and harm his disciples, or even himself.
And so.
The number of people on one side of the Reflection Cliff increased.
The players suddenly discovered.
Among these people, there were quite a few heroes from the Three Kingdoms, Sui and Tang, and Late Qin eras.
"That’s Taishi Ci! Did he also ascend? Look, he’s going to pay respects to Ding Ling!"
"Oh, isn’t that Yuwen Chengdu?! Why did he come to this world?"
’Even Fan Kuai from the Late Qin has come. This mighty general is here as well.’
Taishi Ci, under the watchful eyes of many, paid his respects to Ding Ling, calling him Prince.
Even though his relationship with Ding Ling wasn’t as strong as Zhang Hex’s.
But Ding Ling, being a First-Rank Prince in the Three Kingdoms World, his words equated to a Holy Decree.
As a general of the Great Wei Kingdom, naturally, he had to obey Ding Ling.
Coming to this world.
He was alone, not knowing where to go.
Until he heard about Ding Ling.
Like Zhang Hex, he resolutely joined Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s reputation, fame, and character in the Three Kingdoms World were well-known, having long impressed Zhang Hex, Sunx Ce, Taishi Ci, and many other famous generals.
Taishi Ci had competed with Ding Ling in the Three Kingdoms World.
Being easily suppressed by Ding Ling.
Later, Ding Ling even spoke with him multiple times, valuing him greatly.
Taishi Ci knew gratitude and reciprocation, a given not needing many words.
Coming here, seeking the perennially rising Ding Ling, was only natural.
What’s most feared is having no sense of direction.
Upon seeing Ding Ling.
Taishi Ci knew his goal and core remained unchanged as in the Great Wei Kingdom, centered around Ding Ling!
To become a War God like Ding Ling!
He must follow in Ding Ling’s footsteps, tirelessly!
Ding Ling accepted Taishi Ci.
Also imparted the Pure Yang True Skill to him, like Zhang Hex, to protect Qu Feiyan and the others.
Taishi Ci naturally agreed without hesitation.

He listed all the generals from Li Shimin’s side for Zhang Hex.
After Zhang Hex remembered them thoroughly, he nodded, solemnly saying:
"P-Prince...
Ding, Ding Ling, rest assured.
I would give my life to ensure no one harms Qu Feiyan and the others!"
Being used to calling him Prince in the Three Kingdoms.
It’s actually difficult for Zhang Hex to call him by name.
"It’s not so serious."
Ding Ling stood with hands behind his back, looking at the slanting sunset in the west:
"Cultivate well the Pure Yang True Skill I taught you.
Strive to cultivate Inner Strength as soon as possible.
Once Vigorous Qi and Inner Qi merge, your power will grow explosively, and at that time, some generals who haven’t cultivated Inner Power will definitely not be your match!"
"Yes!"
"Go and cultivate well.
If you have any questions, remember to ask me."
"Yes!"
The wind on Huashan was getting stronger.
More and more heroes and warriors from all over came to watch the fight, too.
Yue Buqun was tense, seeing that things couldn’t go on like this.
After consulting with Ding Ling, he simply opened the door wide.
Allowing these heroes to take the main road.
Rather than sneaking in from elsewhere.
This made him very insecure, afraid that someday a master would sneak into the inner courtyard of the Huashan Sect and harm his disciples, or even himself.
And so.
The number of people on one side of the Reflection Cliff increased.
The players suddenly discovered.
Among these people, there were quite a few heroes from the Three Kingdoms, Sui and Tang, and Late Qin eras.
"That’s Taishi Ci!
Did he also ascend?
Look, he’s going to pay respects to Ding Ling!"
"Oh, isn’t that Yuwen Chengdu?!
Why did he come to this world?"
’Even Fan Kuai from the Late Qin has come.
This mighty general is here as well.’
Taishi Ci, under the watchful eyes of many, paid his respects to Ding Ling, calling him Prince.
Even though his relationship with Ding Ling wasn’t as strong as Zhang Hex’s.
But Ding Ling, being a First-Rank Prince in the Three Kingdoms World, his words equated to a Holy Decree.
As a general of the Great Wei Kingdom, naturally, he had to obey Ding Ling.
Coming to this world.
He was alone, not knowing where to go.
Until he heard about Ding Ling.
Like Zhang Hex, he resolutely joined Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s reputation, fame, and character in the Three Kingdoms World were well-known, having long impressed Zhang Hex, Sunx Ce, Taishi Ci, and many other famous generals.
Taishi Ci had competed with Ding Ling in the Three Kingdoms World.
Being easily suppressed by Ding Ling.
Later, Ding Ling even spoke with him multiple times, valuing him greatly.
Taishi Ci knew gratitude and reciprocation, a given not needing many words.
Coming here, seeking the perennially rising Ding Ling, was only natural.
What’s most feared is having no sense of direction.
Upon seeing Ding Ling.
Taishi Ci knew his goal and core remained unchanged as in the Great Wei Kingdom, centered around Ding Ling!
To become a War God like Ding Ling!
He must follow in Ding Ling’s footsteps, tirelessly!
Ding Ling accepted Taishi Ci.
Also imparted the Pure Yang True Skill to him, like Zhang Hex, to protect Qu Feiyan and the others.
Taishi Ci naturally agreed without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 381: Huashan Peak
paragraphs: Ding Ling understood Taishi Ci and knew what kind of person he was.
He naturally felt at ease with them.
Zhang Hex and Taishi Ci were like old friends meeting far from home, and naturally, they were overjoyed.
The two of them chatted for a while.
Ding Ling listened from the side and came to know that in the past half month, the number of mighty generals from the Three Kingdoms ascending the Celestial Ladder had been increasing.
Not only the Three Kingdoms.
Other nations, such as the Xianbei, also had mighty generals traversing major lands, stepping onto the Celestial Ladder, never to return.
Those aspiring to the Martial Dao.
All would step onto the Celestial Ladder.
Taishi Ci and Zhang Hex were naturally such people, who, having settled their families without any worries, embarked on this Celestial Ladder of martial cultivation.
Qu Feiyan was also listening from the side.
Her eyes were slightly red, and amidst the gratitude and emotion for Ding Ling’s arrangements, she also made up her mind:
"Since Zhang Hex and the others can ascend to the Upper Realm, there’s no reason I can’t! I must work hard to cultivate. In the future, I will follow Brother Ding’s footsteps!"
Consort Yhu, watching and listening from the side, was astounded.
She truly did not expect Ding Ling to be a Prince, let alone a First-Rank Prince with absolute power.
No wonder Ding Ling always exuded an aura of nobility and dominance.
Consort Yhu was suddenly enlightened.
Huang Zhonggong and others sighed endlessly: What an honor it was to travel the world with a First-Rank Prince! Even in the afterlife, one could brag to the ancestors!
Ren Yingying had mixed feelings.
With Ding Ling’s noble status, her pride as the Saintess of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect instantly felt worthless!
It seemed all she could offer was beauty, intelligence, and some martial arts skills.
But Ding Ling overpowered her in martial arts.
In terms of intellect and beauty, Qu Feiyan was also growing rapidly, showing signs of surpassing her.
Ren Yingying felt anxious but couldn’t find a way to deepen her relationship with Ding Ling, feeling increasingly melancholic.
She had her heart set on Ding Ling.
Even if Ding Ling might shatter the void and leave at any moment, she wanted to experience the higher peaks of the martial path with him.
She wished for her life to be exciting.
The stories of Ding Ling’s journey were more legendary than any of the novels she had read.
She thought about the stories Qu Feiyan and Zhang Hex had told about Ding Ling recently.
In a moment, she became lost in thought.
That day.
It was finally the appointed time with Bai Wushuang.
Ding Ling walked out of Reflection Cliff and headed straight for Huashan Peak.
His speed was swift.

The special Vigorous Qi induced by merging Breathing Technique, Flying Swallow Technique, Cloud-Piercing Step, Five Animals Qigong, and Ten Thousand Miles Solo, made his Lightweight Body Technique as fast as wind and lightning.
Ding Ling’s robes fluttered as he advanced, and in just moments, he reached the summit of Luoyan Peak.
He stood atop a giant stone, gazing in all directions.
Misty clouds hovered, and white cranes fluttered gracefully within them. Cascading waterfalls appeared to fall from the mountains, magnificent and akin to an Immortal Realm.
"The scenery is truly superb."
"No wonder the ancients loved to duel atop Huashan Peak."
Ding Ling felt at ease, standing with his hands behind his back, waiting for Bai Wushuang.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Several figures ascended swiftly from the mountain’s base.
The newcomers were Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, Zhang Hex, and others.
They stood all around.
Ren Woxing, Xiaang Wentian, Yue Buqun, Ning Zhongze, and others also came.
This battle would determine the World’s Number One.
Moreover, it was a pivotal battle for the future direction of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect that no one wanted to miss.
Among these high-level figures.
There were many whom Ding Ling did not know.
But seeing their towering, robust, and formidable figures, Ding Ling knew that these people must have practiced the Breathing Technique of the Ascender!
He didn’t bother asking if any of these people were subordinates of Li Shimin.
Asking would yield no answers.
Ding Ling just waited silently.
He waited for no more than half an hour.
"Hahaha..."
A long laugh suddenly came from afar.
At first, it was several hundred meters away.
But soon after,
the laughter seemed to be right next to them.
Such was the speed of the caller.
Ding Ling turned around sharply.
Sure enough.
On one side of Luoyan Peak, a figure with a mix of domineering and elegant demeanor soared upwards like a wild goose, rising more than ten meters, before landing gently like a feather on a treetop.
It was none other than Bai Wushuang, whom Ding Ling had awaited for so long.
"Bai Wushuang!"
Ding Ling called out.
"Ding Ling, long time no see."
Bai Wushuang’s voice was stirring, and as commanding as ever, adorned in her familiar bright red robe, exuding a spirit that valued strength over gender:
"I’ve long heard that you have been waiting for me at Huashan’s Reflection Cliff, eager for our battle. Haha, I feel honored to have Hero Ding await me like this."
"It was a promise."
Ding Ling replied solemnly:
"A promise with Bai Wushuang is one I wouldn’t miss."
"Indeed, smart choice," Bai Wushuang remarked, her face veiled in gauze, her impressive brows and almond eyes visible, highlighting her unparalleled beauty that outshone other women:
"That’s why I traveled a thousand miles to meet you. Are you ready?"
Bai Wushuang remained unchanged—frank and decisive as always:
"I won’t hold back like before when I make my move this time."
"You did spare me before, indeed," Ding Ling acknowledged.
Bai Wushuang laughed heartily:
"Your inner strength was pitifully meager back then. If I had used my full strength, how many of my moves could you have endured? I just wanted to see the potential of a Void Shatterer.
I did not expect your potential would far exceed my expectations.
Within just six months, you’ve progressed enough to stand shoulder to shoulder with me. I must express my admiration."
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling was about to speak.
When suddenly Ren Woxing couldn’t hold back and shouted aloud:
"You are not Dongfang Bubai, who are you?!"
"Who I am is none of your business."
Bai Wushuang glanced at Ren Woxing and sneered coldly:
"If you dare disrespect me again, I’ll kill you!"
She maintained a good attitude only toward Ding Ling’s group.
As for Ren Woxing and his companions, she completely ignored them.
At the moment Ren Woxing spoke, she cornered him immediately.
In front of everyone, Ren Woxing felt deeply embarrassed, and in his shame and anger, couldn’t help but spring towards Bai Wushuang:
"I’d like to see how skilled you are. Let me test your strength first!"
"Courting death!"
Bai Wushuang effortlessly closed the distance as fast as lightning, traversing over a hundred meters in an instant, extending her palm to collide with Ren Woxing’s strike.
A miserable cry echoed.
Bai Wushuang was knocked back thirty meters, twisting mid-air before lightly landing on a treetop.
On the other hand, Ren Woxing was sent flying over a hundred meters by her single slap, spewing a blood mist from his mouth, barely catching himself before falling off the cliff.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Ding Ling vs. Bai Wushuang
paragraphs: Xiangg Wentian glanced, promptly dashed out, and pulled Ren Woxing back.
Ren Woxing was extremely shocked and furious!
He was about to reprimand.
But suddenly he felt intense chest pain, and upon uncovering his clothes, he saw a palm imprint on his chest.
"How did she do it?!"
Ren Woxing was aghast.
Clearly, he had only struck once.
Yet the opponent had struck twice, almost killing him directly!
This kind of unpredictable speed, skill, and palm technique!
He only realized it just now, after the fact.
If he were to make another move.
Completely infuriating this Bai Wushuang, he might really be killed by her, and absolutely wouldn’t know how he died.
Thinking of this.
Cold sweat broke out on Ren Woxing, his gaze towards Bai Wushuang becoming wary and cautious.
"Where did this Bai Wushuang come from, whose skill level has reached a state that ordinary first-class experts can’t even come close to!"
"It’s terrifying. I don’t recognize the Jianghu at all anymore."
Ren Woxing was deeply stirred.
The ascension of Zhang Hex, Fan Kuai, and Yuwen Chengdu.
Had completely confused him.
The sense of crisis in his heart had also soared endlessly.
The recent exchange with Bai Wushuang not only startled and disheartened him but also made him uneasy. Being beaten by Ding Ling was one thing, but now being beaten by a random Bai Wushuang!
He was Ren Woxing!
Sect Leader of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect!!
"What skill."
On the side, someone cheered.
It was the likes of Fan Kuai among the players.

Fan Kuai, broad-backed and stout, with a fierce face, stood there like a Door God. He too had ascended not long ago and, having heard about this battle, was curious about the so-called strength of the World’s Number One expert, so he came to have a look.
Just the first round.
Already made him feel it was worth the visit.

Bai Wushuang’s skill was so high that it was unattainable for him, sparking in his heart some fervor: ’Even a woman is so strong. I, Fan Kuai, am a man over eight feet tall, if I strive, one day I will become as strong as her. When meeting Xiang Yu again, I will definitely not be crushed!’
Regarding being crushed by Xiang Yu.
Fan Kuai had always held a grudge.
Now seeing a solution, his eyes lit up, resolving to find a way to acquire a top-notch Inner Power Heart Method.
"Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan and her group watched Bai Wushuang’s strength with tightened hearts.
People like Ren Yingying, at that moment, couldn’t see the outcome clearly either.
Just because Bai Wushuang could easily send Ren Woxing flying with a single palm. What an immensely skilled hand.
"Indeed, formidable."
Ding Ling said solemnly, but showed not a bit of fear, instead couldn’t help but smile slightly:
"But you won’t be a match for me."
"Is that so?"
Bai Wushuang’s almond-shaped eyes turned, eyeing Ding Ling:
"I too wish to see how strong you are now."
"Come."
Ding Ling positioned himself:
"Today we still fight bare-handed."
"As you wish."

Bai Wushuang shouted crisply, suddenly soaring down like a whirlwind from the treetop, lotus blossoms sprouting underfoot, treading empty space, rushing to Ding Ling, then a palm flew like a stormy wave, crashing down towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling advanced instead of retreating, his fingers like swords, the Breaking Palm Form unleashed, special Vigorous Qi permeating all around, stabbing towards the palm.
Clang!
In an instant, both sides entered a heated battle.
One palm shadow flew like a storm surge, each strike could shatter the Celestial Palace;

One finger-sword advancing rapidly, striking at the enemy’s weak points, Vigorous Qi from a finger spelled in circles mid-air, intricate as sword shadows, observers found it dazzling and bewildering, not understanding at all.
Both, absolute experts.
Obviously, their True Qi levels had reached the pinnacle of the world.
Upon the outset.
Their every move rocked the heavens and earth.
Every punch and kick causing space to ripple, creases forming everywhere.
Wherever they passed.
Xun Wind rose, thunderous claps, the earth occasionally crumbled, any large rocks nearby directly collapsed under the force.
Bam bam bam!
A palm, a finger sword.
Violently creating an Iron Cavalry charging at the enemy on a frozen river, an unstoppable, unmatched momentum!
Onlookers stepped back repeatedly.
Afraid of being caught in crossfire.
Each person watching closely, unwilling to miss a single moment.
Bam bam bam!
The battle grew fiercer.
This continued for a full half hour.
Suddenly, only heard Ding Ling shout: "Ha!"
Boom!

Both palms collided, followed by a loud boom, Ding Ling stepped back a few paces, but Bai Wushuang was blasted away over a hundred meters, whirling through the air for dozens of spins, finally landing gracefully like a maple leaf, boom! Her feet sinking three inches into the ground.
Showing just how powerful the hit was!
"Such strong Palm Power!"
Bai Wushuang was startled, her beautiful almond eyes revealed shock:

"Your previous Palm Power was also strong, but compared to this time, it’s worlds apart. Is it because your Inner Strength has evolved to True Qi? Has your Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, when merged with True Qi, become more potent?"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling admitted.
It’s normal for her to think of this.
After all, as more Ascenders emerged.
Someone was bound to know this unique quality.
"Amazing."
Bai Wushuang sighed:
"So the previous half hour exchange was you holding back?"
"Not holding back."
Ding Ling said earnestly:
"I exerted myself fully, just didn’t use this merged Vigorous Qi."
That’s quite true.
Bai Wushuang’s actual strength was much greater than Ding Ling initially estimated.
Not only had her True Qi reached six drops to the limit.
But the quality of her True Qi seemed to surpass Ding Ling’s Pure Yang Inner Power, more domineering, fierce, and turbulent.
Colliding with such Palm Power, a careless move could lead to severe injury.
Yet with Ding Ling’s mastery of Dugu Nine Swords, all of this was perfectly countered.
The battle with Bai Wushuang.
Made Ding Ling’s mastery of Dugu Nine Swords noticeably reach a higher level, becoming more effortless.
Until he noticed that continuing further wouldn’t increase his mastery of Dugu Nine Swords, decisively opting to use merged Vigorous Qi to clap a palm towards Bai Wushuang, concluding the bout.
"Your skill progression is too fast."
"You’re no exception."
Ding Ling had also seen Bai Wushuang’s potential.
In her young age, the sixth drop of True Water had indeed emerged.
Also, Ding Ling was sure six months ago.
Bai Wushuang was surely at Half-Step Innate, or just recently entering Innate Realm.
But in mere six months.
Bai Wushuang advanced so much.
Even cheating wouldn’t yield this level!
Such is Bai Wushuang’s talent!

Showing just how powerful the hit was!
"Such strong Palm Power!"
Bai Wushuang was startled, her beautiful almond eyes revealed shock:
"Your previous Palm Power was also strong, but compared to this time, it’s worlds apart.
Is it because your Inner Strength has evolved to True Qi?
Has your Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, when merged with True Qi, become more potent?"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling admitted.
It’s normal for her to think of this.
After all, as more Ascenders emerged.
Someone was bound to know this unique quality.
"Amazing."
Bai Wushuang sighed:
"So the previous half hour exchange was you holding back?"
"Not holding back."
Ding Ling said earnestly:
"I exerted myself fully, just didn’t use this merged Vigorous Qi."
That’s quite true.
Bai Wushuang’s actual strength was much greater than Ding Ling initially estimated.
Not only had her True Qi reached six drops to the limit.
But the quality of her True Qi seemed to surpass Ding Ling’s Pure Yang Inner Power, more domineering, fierce, and turbulent.
Colliding with such Palm Power, a careless move could lead to severe injury.
Yet with Ding Ling’s mastery of Dugu Nine Swords, all of this was perfectly countered.
The battle with Bai Wushuang.
Made Ding Ling’s mastery of Dugu Nine Swords noticeably reach a higher level, becoming more effortless.
Until he noticed that continuing further wouldn’t increase his mastery of Dugu Nine Swords, decisively opting to use merged Vigorous Qi to clap a palm towards Bai Wushuang, concluding the bout.
"Your skill progression is too fast."
"You’re no exception."
Ding Ling had also seen Bai Wushuang’s potential.
In her young age, the sixth drop of True Water had indeed emerged.
Also, Ding Ling was sure six months ago.
Bai Wushuang was surely at Half-Step Innate, or just recently entering Innate Realm.
But in mere six months.
Bai Wushuang advanced so much.
Even cheating wouldn’t yield this level!
Such is Bai Wushuang’s talent!

chapters.title: Chapter 383: World’s Number One! Fan Kuai’s Thoughts
paragraphs: "Haha..."
Bai Wushuang laughed loudly:
"I’m different from you."
She didn’t explain why they were different, but continued:
"The fact is, your palm power far exceeds mine. I’m not your match. Take this!"
She tossed a secret manual to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling leaped and caught it.
"Our agreement ends here, farewell! Green hills won’t change, and rivers will flow on forever. Hero Ding, until we meet again!"

Bai Wushuang finished speaking, gave Ding Ling a deep look, then without hesitation, executed a spinning move. She stepped on a white lotus, soared into the sky, and in the blink of an eye disappeared into the vast sea of clouds.
"Bai Wushuang!"
Ding Ling rushed two steps forward, attempting to call Bai Wushuang.
But nowhere could he see her figure.
"Who exactly is she?"
Ding Ling was tightly puzzled in his heart.
After all the talk.
In the end, he still couldn’t figure out Bai Wushuang’s identity.
[Achievement Medal E-level: You’ve earned the high recognition of Bai Wushuang, the world’s greatest in this Plane World.]
[Note: Bai Wushuang inherently has a sense of pride and grandness. After mastering Divine Skill, she’s overwhelmingly powerful! In domination and martial arts, she far surpasses the average man!
Her only pursuit in life is Martial Dao.
Upon hearing about your transcendence, she rushed to witness your prowess, hoping to see another path of martial arts, or perhaps a stronger Martial Dao.
You have satisfied her, especially with this duel at Huashan Peak.
You’ve completely stunned her.
She originally thought her speed of training was the World’s Number One.
But your speed is even faster than hers! Beyond her surprise, her recognition of you increased significantly.
Especially in this battle, it made her certain that combining Breathing Technique with Inner Power is the path to take. She believes that soon, when you meet her again, she will be even stronger!]
Upon hearing the prompt tone.
Ding Ling was momentarily shocked but confirmed one thing.
That Bai Wushuang is Bai Wushuang, and has nothing to do with Dongfang Bubai.
’Moreover, Bai Wushuang has the E-level medal. It seems that true Innate Realm experts carry such achievement medals.’
Tangg Ying’e, Vice Sect Leader of Mount Songh Sect, briefly stepped into the Innate Realm.
But he didn’t carry the E-level medal.
There are only two possibilities: either a player took the E-level medal ahead of time, or these forced short-term enhanced Innate experts don’t count in the E-level category.
Regardless.
Ding Ling didn’t think more about it.
Instead, he checked the task progress bar:
[2, You must defeat the world’s strongest of this Plane. Prove you are the rightful World’s Number One. Task Progress: 100%]
[3: You must make your World’s Number One title resound across the Plane World. Task Progress: 73%/100%.]
Tasks 1 and 2 were completed.
Only task 3 remained.
Even task 3 was steadily progressing during this period, but after reaching 73, the progress bar barely moved.
"Looks like I need to visit Black Wood Cliff where the Sun and Moon Divine Sect is soon."
Ding Ling glanced at the secret manual given by Bai Wushuang:
"Tai Chi Scripture"!
Indeed, it’s the Tai Chi Scripture.
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted.
This is the Divine Skill Secret Manual handwritten by the divine Zhang Sanfeng in his later years.
Ding Ling placed it in his chest, under the gaze of many, it was temporarily not appropriate to review the secret manual.
"Impressive, impressive!"
Fan Kuai couldn’t help but cheer loudly:

"No wonder Hero Ding holds the title of World’s Number One! Your palm power is unbelievably robust, that final palm clash with Bai Wushuang was explosively powerful, beyond what I can comprehend. But undoubtedly, if I’d tried to take that palm forcefully.
I’d either be dead or severely injured.
Too strong."
His eyes were filled with fervor:
"I wonder if Hero Ding accepts disciples. I, Fan Kuai, am willing to become your student."
"Haha..."
Before Ding Ling could speak loudly, Ren Woxing, despite discomfort, laughed heartily:

"Fan Kuai, you’re a renowned ancient general who ascended here, proving your abilities. But attempting to apprentice under Hero Ding, you’ve chosen the wrong approach. Don’t you see how strong Hero Ding has become now?
Perhaps soon, he will ascend again?"
Upon hearing Ren Woxing’s remark.
The crowd couldn’t help discussing.
Fan Kuai was blatant, caring little, determined to follow Ding Ling.
Ding Ling slightly smiled, not agreeing impulsively.
He hardly knew Fan Kuai, and Fan Kuai belongs to Liu Bang, Liu Bang’s side has always been enemies with Xiang Yu.
Consort Yhu and Ding Ling share a notable relationship.
Ding Ling considers interpersonal relationships, regardless of right or wrong, he’d certainly stand with Xiang Yu.
After all, Consort Yhu spent a significant time with him and became a friend.
Fan Kuai, just met him, solely because he’s a famed general, wants to follow him, and he must accept him and impart Divine Skills and Secret Techniques?
If Ding Ling knew him well, it’d be okay.
Without knowing, impulsively accepting is like trapping himself?
He’d rather accept generals from the Three Kingdoms, as he’s familiar with them, having interacted with each one. They respect him highly, revering him as a Divine Being. How to decide?
Ding Ling was clear in his mind.
Therefore.
He didn’t pay much attention to Fan Kuai.
Fan Kuai was initially a bit sullen, but he wasn’t one to give up easily, determined to learn from Ding Ling, master top-tier Inner Power Heart Method, how could he give up so easily?
He planned to blend into Ding Ling’s team.
Regarding Consort Yhu in the team, Fan Kuai chose to willfully ignore her.
Apart from Fan Kuai.
In the crowd of spectators, there were several other generals.
Each with complex emotions, ups and downs.
Generals from the Sui and Tang World pondered:

"Rumor had it Ding Ling killed the monstrous Li Yuanba, now it seems true. Ding Ling’s palm power is too strong, only Bai Wushuang could contend, if it were us, we’d be seriously injured, or killed instantly by him. Better not to provoke such a person!"
Generals from the Late Qin World thought:

"World’s Number One is incredibly strong. Our path ahead is long. But this world, the premier Inner Power Heart Methods are tightly guarded by each family, obtaining them is nigh impossible. What should be done?"
They unconsciously turned their gaze to Ding Ling.
Also considering if they should, like Fan Kuai, shamelessly abandon ’dignity,’ and hold onto the big leg first.
"Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan, at one side observed the expressions, the gazes of the people, couldn’t help feeling proud, yet amidst pride, a wave of bitterness arose.
Thinking of Ren Woxing’s words, was her Brother Ding going to leave her too?
"No wonder you’re the Master (Ding Ling)!"
Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and others all showed admiration and shared pride.
An hour later.
"Ding Ling."
Ren Woxing approached Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 384: At Black Wood Cliff
paragraphs: "Dongfang Bubai hasn’t shown up yet, so it’s unlikely that he will come."
Ren Woxing was equally puzzled and frustrated:
"The spies reported everything clearly and distinctly, it’s impossible for there to be a mistake! How could this happen?"
"Indeed."
Xiaang Wentian was also confused:

"Moreover, rumors have spread across Jiuzhou, saying Dongfang Bubai would come to battle you, Hero Ding, at Huashan Peak. Even just for the sake of face, Dongfang Bubai can’t ignore this. But he didn’t come. It’s truly strange!"
"Regardless."
Ding Ling said:
"I must fulfill the promise I made to Miss Ren."
The progress bar for Task 3 is still moving very slowly up to now.
It’s probably because Ding Ling hasn’t defeated Dongfang Bubai, who is rumored to be the number one in Jianghu.
As long as he defeats him.
Ding Ling estimates that the progress bar for Task 3 will probably shoot up.
Then breaking through the void to leave this world would be a natural occurrence.
Other than Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling has nothing left to linger for in this world.
And as for Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling will arrange things in the coming months so that when there are truly no more worries, he will depart.
He cannot waste too much time in this world.
He wants to achieve immortality.
If he wants to take Diao Chan and the others to live forever with him.
He must keep striving until the goal is achieved.
How can he stop moving forward?
"Thank you."
Ren Woxing was overjoyed:
"Then when do you plan to set off, Hero Ding?"
Seeing that Ding Ling could send Bai Wushuang flying with one palm.
Ren Woxing grew increasingly wary and cautious of Ding Ling while also becoming increasingly envious, jealous, and admiring!
Wary and cautious that Ding Ling would take over his status in Jianghu;
Envying and jealous of Ding Ling’s talent, admiring how Ding Ling could easily defeat a formidable woman like Bai Wushuang.
One must know that Bai Wushuang almost killed him, Ren Woxing, with just one move!
With this thought.
For Ding Ling to kill him, Ren Woxing, wouldn’t it be as easy as eating and drinking?
With this thought.
Ren Woxing’s heart grew cold, and he dared not to be too carefree and casual with Ding Ling.
He completely changed his previous arrogant, grand, and overbearing attitude.
In front of Ding Ling, he became much more humble and respectful. Anyone who didn’t know him would doubt whether this was the same Ren Woxing who always considered himself above everyone else!
"Now."
Ding Ling, too, was a decisive person:
"The sooner it’s resolved, the sooner we can feel at ease."
"That’s the best outcome."
Ren Woxing laughed heartily, his grin reaching behind his ears:
"Then let me lead the way."
"I appreciate the trouble, Sect Leader Ren."
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
"It’s only right, it’s only right."
Ren Woxing was flattered:
"Hero Ding is too kind."
Previously, he didn’t feel much.
As Ding Ling defeated Bai Wushuang.
Ren Woxing found himself feeling a sense of restraint in Ding Ling’s presence.
It wasn’t just him.
Many martial arts experts felt the same way.
Yue Buqun and his wife were deeply moved, experiencing for the first time the intense realization of how weak their lifelong martial arts skills seemed.
They also wanted to learn Ding Ling’s Breathing Technique and Cultivation Technique.
But couldn’t bring themselves to ask, and could only silently follow behind Ding Ling, watching his back with tumultuous emotions that couldn’t be calmed for a long time.
After everyone left Huashan Peak.

Feng Qingyang’s figure suddenly appeared at the peak, glancing at the direction Bai Wushuang left, and then looking at Ding Ling’s back, he stroked the three strands of long mustache under his chin, muttering:
"Who exactly is this Bai Wushuang? Why do their martial arts moves seem so familiar? Where have I seen them before?"
After a while, he couldn’t recall.
Feng Qingyang felt a little annoyed:

"Alas. Just like the waves of the Yangtze River pushing the waves before them, the young people these days are truly more remarkable than ever. Not to mention Ding Ling. This Bai Wushuang, a mere woman, by the look of her eyes, she must be in her young years, yet how many heroes of the world could she surpass with such youth? Ah, it truly makes one feel ashamed."
Ding Ling left with Ren Yingying and the three others.
Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, Consort Yhu, Qu Feiyan, and others went along as well.
Off to Black Wood Cliff.
The journey was long.
If they rushed using Lightweight Skill and other techniques non-stop, they might reach in a day or two.
But Ding Ling naturally wasn’t in such haste.
Just right during the journey’s gap.
He could guide Qu Feiyan, Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, and others in martial arts, techniques, and Inner Power Heart Techniques.
Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye, a few days passed.
On this day.
They arrived at Black Wood Cliff.
Because they had an insider.
Ding Ling and his group smoothly arrived at the front gate of the main hall on Black Wood Cliff and met Elder Tong Baixiong who was guarding that place.
He recognized Ren Woxing at once and was about to shout loudly.
Ren Woxing suddenly extended his hand, inhaling with a whoosh!

A gust of Xun Wind swept the ground, drawing Tong Baixiong directly in front of Ren Woxing, but it was clear that Tong Baixiong was no easy opponent. He quickly reacted, using all his might to break free from the suction, swiftly drawing his blade and slashing at Ren Woxing’s arm.
Ren Woxing had no choice but to step back.
In retreating.
Tong Baixiong gained a moment of freedom, and with a loud shout.
The sound split the air.
Before long, there was a clamor!
Groups of people rushed over, surrounding the area.
Tong Baixiong laughed heartily:
"Ren Woxing, how few of you are there? Yet you dare to boldly come to our Sun and Moon Divine Sect’s headquarters to meet your death."
"Elder Tong."
Xiaang Wentian stepped forward, saying:
"We might be few. But take a look at who’s beside me."
He pointed at Ding Ling.
Tong Baixiong glanced over, examining carefully, and couldn’t help but be greatly surprised:
"The world’s number one, Ding Ling, Hero Ding, who’s recently making waves across the world?"
"Precisely."
Ren Woxing laughed heartily, saying:
"Elder Tong, since you know it’s Hero Ding in person, you should understand his strength. Do you think these mere soldiers can harm him? Don’t invite trouble. Don’t do such suicidal things!"
"Hero Ding."

Tong Baixiong was a tall man just over eight feet, with thick eyebrows and big eyes. Though aged, his tiger-like eyes were full of vigor, and his energy was no weaker than that of young men in their prime.
He stared at Ding Ling, with caution, wariness, and a hint of warning:
"Our Sun and Moon Divine Sect and you, we do not interfere with each other, I hope you won’t wade into these muddy waters and ask for trouble!"
"I came this time to fulfill a promise."
Ding Ling said calmly:
"Elder Tong, there’s no need for excessive obstruction. After my battle with Dongfang Bubai, regardless of victory or defeat, I will leave Black Wood Cliff immediately."
In the back, Ren Yingying’s sparkling eyes were fixed only on Ding Ling.
Hearing Ding Ling say he came to fulfill a promise.
Her heart couldn’t help but stir with ripples, finding it hard to calm down for a long while.
"Heh heh."
Elder Tong sneered:
"No matter what, I can’t allow you all to break into the main hall and disturb the Sect Leader!"
"I greatly admire your integrity and character."
Ren Woxing took the initiative to strike again.

Tong Baixiong gained a moment of freedom, and with a loud shout.
The sound split the air.
Before long, there was a clamor!
Groups of people rushed over, surrounding the area.
Tong Baixiong laughed heartily:
"Ren Woxing, how few of you are there?
Yet you dare to boldly come to our Sun and Moon Divine Sect’s headquarters to meet your death."
"Elder Tong."
Xiaang Wentian stepped forward, saying:
"We might be few.
But take a look at who’s beside me."
He pointed at Ding Ling.
Tong Baixiong glanced over, examining carefully, and couldn’t help but be greatly surprised:
"The world’s number one, Ding Ling, Hero Ding, who’s recently making waves across the world?"
"Precisely."
Ren Woxing laughed heartily, saying:
"Elder Tong, since you know it’s Hero Ding in person, you should understand his strength.
Do you think these mere soldiers can harm him?
Don’t invite trouble.
Don’t do such suicidal things!"
"Hero Ding."
Tong Baixiong was a tall man just over eight feet, with thick eyebrows and big eyes.
Though aged, his tiger-like eyes were full of vigor, and his energy was no weaker than that of young men in their prime.
He stared at Ding Ling, with caution, wariness, and a hint of warning:
"Our Sun and Moon Divine Sect and you, we do not interfere with each other, I hope you won’t wade into these muddy waters and ask for trouble!"
"I came this time to fulfill a promise."
Ding Ling said calmly:
"Elder Tong, there’s no need for excessive obstruction.
After my battle with Dongfang Bubai, regardless of victory or defeat, I will leave Black Wood Cliff immediately."
In the back, Ren Yingying’s sparkling eyes were fixed only on Ding Ling.
Hearing Ding Ling say he came to fulfill a promise.
Her heart couldn’t help but stir with ripples, finding it hard to calm down for a long while.
"Heh heh."
Elder Tong sneered:
"No matter what, I can’t allow you all to break into the main hall and disturb the Sect Leader!"
"I greatly admire your integrity and character."
Ren Woxing took the initiative to strike again.

chapters.title: Chapter 385: Yang Lianting Faces Death Without Fear! The Needle Light Appears
paragraphs: "But the arrow is on the string and must be released. Elder Tong, don’t overestimate yourself and be unaware of the consequences!"
"Who doesn’t know the consequences is yet to be determined."
Elder Tong wasn’t afraid in the slightest and gave an order.
Clang clang clang!
A group of people swarmed forward, bows drawn and arrows pointed at Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling, Zhang Hex, and Consort Yhu’s group.
Ding Ling felt a flicker of anger in his heart.

Before the arrows were released, the Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique and the True Qi from the Pure Yang True Skill merged, boom! His body flashed like lightning, and a single palm swept through the air like a gale, swish swish swish!
A continuous series of slaps reverberated through the Celestial Extreme.
Looking again, there lay a terrain scattered with archers!
There were as many as a hundred archers.
Yet Ding Ling easily knocked them down with a few swift strikes.
"What just happened?!"
Tong Baixiong was in shock.
But how could he possibly understand?

Whenever Ding Ling struck a palm, the explosion of immense Vigorous Qi would send a person flying back no less than a hundred meters. This great force propelled a person horizontally, knocking over or sending flying countless others.
Because of this.
In just a few strikes.
Ding Ling killed more than ten leading archers.
The remaining dozens of archers were completely knocked into the air or swept away by the bodies of the leading archers.
But Ding Ling’s speed was too fast.
No one could see how he made his moves.
Even Ren Woxing merely knew that Ding Ling had struck, but couldn’t see how many strikes he launched.
Everyone was stunned.
Their gaze toward Ding Ling changed.
"Do you still wish to block my way?"
Ding Ling coldly stared at Tong Baixiong:
"If you block me again, I don’t mind killing you!"
They refused to listen when spoken to calmly.
They insisted on threats, even targeting Qu Feiyan and others with arrows.
This was absolutely unacceptable to Ding Ling!
"You, you, you..."
Tong Baixiong was shaken, horrified, and intimidated by Ding Ling’s gaze and aura, involuntarily retreating two steps.
"Let’s go in."
Ren Woxing exchanged a glance with Xiaang Wentian, took the opportunity to advance, knocked Tong Baixiong down, and tied him up, following them into the Main Hall.
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidate Tong Baixiong.]

[Note: As an Elder with unparalleled power and prestige within the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, Tong Baixiong rarely feared anyone. You are the first person to truly make him feel fear deep in his heart!]
Ding Ling heard the prompt.
He didn’t pay much mind to it.
He simply followed them into the Main Hall.
There he saw the impostor Sect Leader hiding behind the scenes: Yang Lianting.
Yang Lianting was tall and robust, with a full beard and an aura of manliness, extremely charismatic.
Ordinary people who took one look at him
would unconsciously be drawn to him.

When Ding Ling first saw him, he was secretly astonished. Although Yang Lianting wasn’t particularly handsome, his high Charm Value was somewhat strange; even he, as a man, felt a strange sense of attraction upon first sight.
’No wonder he could make Dongfang Bubai infatuated in the novels.’
Ding Ling realized.
Watching as Ren Yingying knocked Yang Lianting to the ground, after some intimidation.
Yang Lianting did not back down but instead laughed heartily:
"Do whatever you wish. If I, Yang Lianting, so much as frown, then I’m unworthy!"
"Yang Lianting."
Tong Baixiong seemed angry too:

"So it was you causing trouble in the sect these years! I was puzzled as to how my good brother could suddenly become so muddle-headed, turns out it was you playing tricks. Don’t worry, as long as I regain my freedom, the first person I’ll kill is you!"
"Just you?"
Yang Lianting mocked, seeming uninterested in saying more to Tong Baixiong.
"If you don’t speak, I’ll kill you."
Ren Yingying’s delicate hand raised slightly, aiming at Yang Lianting’s neck with the edge of her hand.
Yang Lianting, on the other hand, laughed and charged at the blade.
Ren Yingying was startled and quickly stepped back two steps.
Yang Lianting raised his head and laughed hysterically:
"Laozi has lived long enough, don’t you all want to kill me? Come on, do it already!"
"This..."
Ren Yingying found herself in a dilemma, unconsciously looking at Ding Ling.
Standing beside Ding Ling.
She instantly seemed indecisive.
Ding Ling was also quite perplexed; having read novels and watched TV dramas, this was not the Yang Lianting he knew, why did he appear so unusual today?
What was off?
Ding Ling couldn’t figure it out and merely said:
"Black Wood Cliff is only so large. Let’s divide and search; we should find some secret passages or the like. As long as Dongfang Bubai hasn’t left Black Wood Cliff, we will find him."
"Makes sense."
Ren Woxing’s eyes brightened:
"We have enough people, let’s equip ourselves with some weapons and clothes of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect members, blend in, and move cautiously, it’s not impossible. Let’s do it."
Yang Lianting furrowed his brows upon hearing this, seemingly wanting to say something, but in the end, he remained silent, only looking at the crowd with a resolute expression.
"Should we get rid of him?"
Xiaang Wentian glanced at Yang Lianting:
"After all, leaving this menace alive is of no use."
Ding Ling said nothing.
Xiaang Wentian then raised his knife, chopping toward Yang Lianting’s neck.
Yang Lianting didn’t even try to dodge.
He slightly raised his neck, exposing it.
Heading straight for the blade.
Slash!
As the blade’s light streaked through the air, eyes watched as Yang Lianting was about to lose his life here.
Bang!

A needle-like beam flashed through the air, accompanied by a loud bang, hitting the blade, causing Xiaang Wentian to grunt from the impact, his hand trembling, nearly dropping the large knife to the ground.
"Who?"
Xiaang Wentian yelled angrily.
It was noticed suddenly.
In the upper right corner of the Main Hall, there stood a graceful silhouette.
The owner of the silhouette was familiar to everyone.
"Bai Wushuang!"
"Why is it you?!"
Ren Woxing, Ren Yingying, and their group were startled and astonished.
"Why are you here?"
Xiaang Wentian shouted loudly.
"None of your business that I’m here."
Bai Wushuang, as always, used sharp words, snapping at Xiaang Wentian, then turned her beautiful eyes toward Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding, are you the one giving Yang Lianting a hard time?"
From the moment Bai Wushuang appeared, Ding Ling noticed.
He realized that Bai Wushuang seemed to have appeared from the very top of the Main Hall, and it was unexpectedly a secret pathway.
A secret pathway established above the Main Hall, what a brilliant, ingenious piece of architectural design!
No doubt.
The person who created all this must have been an extraordinarily skilled craftsman.
Thinking about the wide, steep, towering Black Wood Cliff.
And this Main Hall seemed embedded in the side of Black Wood Cliff’s peak, he understood. Only a place like this could have the conditions to build such a structure.
Seeing Bai Wushuang voicing her question.
Ding Ling respectfully responded:
"I came here to fulfill a promise, and that promise is to defeat Dongfang Bubai. I hope Miss Bai can assist me."
"Regrettably."
Bai Wushuang’s voice remained as powerful and overwhelming as ever, resonating like crashing waves against the beach:
"You are too late."

chapters.title: Chapter 386: Dongfang Bubai Is Dead
paragraphs: "What do you mean?"
Ren Woxing asked loudly, confused.
’Shut up.’
Bai Wushuang pointed at Ren Woxing:
’There’s no place for you to speak here!’

Ren Woxing was knocked speechless, his old face turning crimson with rage, but knowing he was utterly no match for Bai Wushuang, he could only forcefully suppress his anger, hum in annoyance, and stay silent.
He only secretly vowed in his heart: When I command the full power of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, I will muster all my strength to destroy you, this arrogant little lass!
Of course.
That’s what he thought.

He also knew it was difficult to achieve. He must come up with an impeccable plan, otherwise, if he angered Bai Wushuang, she might storm the Black Wood Cliff and most likely take his head with her unseen powers and unrivaled skills.
"I wonder what Miss Bai meant by this?"
Ding Ling asked.
Bai Wushuang spoke softly:
"Because Dongfang Bubai is already dead."
"What?!"
Almost everyone was surprised.
Tong Baixiong’s head felt as if it was struck with a heavy hammer, ringing in his ears, he suddenly seemed to know nothing, trapped in a bewildered, shocked, and unbelieving state of mind.
Yang Lianting was completely calm, as if he already knew all about it.
Ding Ling was initially quite startled, but upon seeing Yang Lianting’s demeanor and thinking about Bai Wushuang’s appearance, he pondered.
"Dongfang Bubai couldn’t possibly die?!"
Ren Woxing was incredulous:
"He was perfectly fine, he couldn’t have died for no reason!"
Ren Woxing arrived with fierce momentum and boiling blood.
Even though the current result seemed great, he hadn’t seen Dongfang Bubai, nor avenged the blood feud of being trapped at the bottom of the West Lake for over ten years!
His heart felt blocked, as if a mouthful of resentment was stuck in his throat, making him extremely uncomfortable!
Ren Woxing couldn’t help but look at Bai Wushuang, questioning:
"Was it you who killed him?!"
"Why should I tell you?"
Bai Wushuang coldly stared at Ren Woxing:
"How many times do I have to say it, there’s no place for you to speak here. One more word and I’ll break your mouth!"
Ren Woxing’s eye twitched, almost spitting out old blood.
Bai Wushuang’s different treatment was too obvious.
Her attitude towards Ding Ling was vastly different from how she treated him, it was extreme in this crowd, too over the top!
Ren Woxing couldn’t bear it!
His heart felt increasingly blocked.
But Ding Ling had ’conquered’ Bai Wushuang with strength.
Ren Woxing didn’t have that strength, so he had to play along! If he had Ding Ling’s strength, would Bai Wushuang dare to speak to him this way? Would she dare to treat him differently?
That’s what he thought.
But for some reason, Ren Woxing felt uncomfortable, depressed, aggrieved, and angry! His old face once again turned blood-red.
Ren Yingying, Xiaang Wentian, Fan Kuai, and others watched from the side, speechless, but they became wary of Bai Wushuang.

Bai Wushuang, apart from treating Ding Ling and his group well, was extremely rude to everyone else, dishing out insults without remorse was secondary, the critical point was Bai Wushuang would truly act! Where could one argue if they were killed by her then?
"How could Dongfang Bubai die?"
Ding Ling was puzzled, asking.
"It’s me who killed him."
Bai Wushuang’s eyes were deep, her words calm, as if talking about a trivial matter.
"So it was you!"
Ren Woxing was furious.
"Hmm?"
Bai Wushuang suddenly turned her gaze towards Ren Woxing, her almond-shaped eyes seemed to carry sword-like glints, as though intending to pierce Ren Woxing’s soul!

Ren Woxing trembled in fear, recalling Bai Wushuang’s earlier words, realizing he had angered her, and understanding if he spoke again, Bai Wushuang probably wouldn’t waste words anymore, she’d immediately act!
Thinking of this.
Ren Woxing felt downcast, quickly shutting his mouth but looking towards Ding Ling, hoping Ding Ling could get a rational explanation.
He asked, Bai Wushuang wouldn’t answer, and she’d threaten to beat him.
Ding Ling asked, Bai Wushuang responded, with a notably gentle manner.
This differential treatment, Ren Woxing found unbearable, but remembering the purpose of being here, he could only endure it.
"You killed Dongfang Bubai?!"
Ding Ling was shocked:
"Then who exactly are you?"
"Ha ha..."
Bai Wushuang let out a hearty laugh, her voice grand, resounding through the main hall, making the chairs and tables seem to tremble.
"I am Bai Wushuang."
Bai Wushuang abruptly ceased her sound, declaring emphatically:
"You can also call me Dongfang Bubai!"
"You’re Dongfang Bubai?!"
Ding Ling was astonished.
Ren Yingying was wide-eyed.
Ren Woxing’s eyes almost popped out, wasn’t Dongfang Bubai dead? What did Bai Wushuang mean by this? Was she trying to replace him?
"I think the name Dongfang Bubai is quite nice, too bad it was wasted on a pointless eunuch."
Bai Wushuang’s brows flashed with a quirky expression:
"The previous Sect Leader Dongfang had mutilated himself to practice the Sunflower Manual, turning into a eunuch neither man nor woman!
This could be put aside.
He day by day practiced the Sunflower Manual, becoming more and more like a woman.
I found it disgusting.
So I killed him."
Everyone was stunned.
This reason, it’s too powerful!
Why does it sound so absurd?
"Before this, you had the ability to kill Dongfang Bubai?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
"Ha ha..."
Bai Wushuang laughed:
"Ding Ling, it’s just that you don’t know my true abilities. Sect Leader Dongfang was no longer a man, he wasn’t a woman either. The more he practiced the Sunflower Manual,
the more perverted he became in his heart!
I once followed him for a time. He intended to eliminate me to fulfill his affair with Yang Lianting properly, wanting to study my skin for pleasure.
He didn’t know, Yang Lianting was my friend.
Yang Lianting told me about this.
With Yang Lianting’s help, I easily killed him. So Ding Ling, do you understand now?"
"I see."
Ding Ling comprehended.
Dongfang Bubai didn’t have the slightest guard against Yang Lianting, so killing Dongfang Bubai wasn’t surprising.
Except for Yang Lianting...
Ding Ling glanced at Yang Lianting, noticing his deep gaze towards Bai Wushuang, the look of a passionate man yearning for a goddess he had secretly admired for a long time!
Upon observing this.

Ding Ling understood, Dongfang Bubai loved Yang Lianting, Yang Lianting loved Bai Wushuang! Bai Wushuang didn’t intend to get involved, but cooperated with Yang Lianting to kill Dongfang Bubai, then replace him, becoming the new Dongfang Bubai, it seemed quite understandable.
"From today onwards, there will no longer be Bai Wushuang in the world."
Bai Wushuang’s voice was high-pitched, powerful, her eyes seemingly deep:
"I am Dongfang Bubai, the Sect Leader of this Sun and Moon Divine Sect!"
"Absurd!"
Ren Woxing was outraged:
"How can you, a woman, become the Sect Leader of this Sun and Moon Divine Sect! Besides, you’re an outsider to the Sun and Moon Divine Sect! What qualifies you to be the Sect Leader?"
"If I beat you to death, then I qualify."
Bai Wushuang, or the second generation Dongfang Bubai, suddenly glided down from the side, her jade palms danced, heavily striking towards Ren Woxing.
Ren Woxing roared ’Star Absorption Technique’!
Suddenly waved his palms, seeming to absorb Bai Wushuang’s inner strength, but couldn’t absorb it at all, and in an instant, slap!
A crisp sound.
Ren Woxing was incredibly sent flying by Bai Wushuang’s slap.
In mid-air, before he landed, he had already spurted out a bloody arrow.
Obviously, after the brief exchange.
Ren Woxing suffered severe injuries.
"Father!"
Ren Yingying cried sadly.
Flew fast wind-like, held Ren Woxing who had landed.
Bai Wushuang intended to act further.
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling.

Thinking of this.
Ren Woxing felt downcast, quickly shutting his mouth but looking towards Ding Ling, hoping Ding Ling could get a rational explanation.
He asked, Bai Wushuang wouldn’t answer, and she’d threaten to beat him.
Ding Ling asked, Bai Wushuang responded, with a notably gentle manner.
This differential treatment, Ren Woxing found unbearable, but remembering the purpose of being here, he could only endure it.
"You killed Dongfang Bubai?!"
Ding Ling was shocked:
"Then who exactly are you?"
"Ha ha..."
Bai Wushuang let out a hearty laugh, her voice grand, resounding through the main hall, making the chairs and tables seem to tremble.
"I am Bai Wushuang."
Bai Wushuang abruptly ceased her sound, declaring emphatically:
"You can also call me Dongfang Bubai!"
"You’re Dongfang Bubai?!"
Ding Ling was astonished.
Ren Yingying was wide-eyed.
Ren Woxing’s eyes almost popped out, wasn’t Dongfang Bubai dead?
What did Bai Wushuang mean by this?
Was she trying to replace him?
"I think the name Dongfang Bubai is quite nice, too bad it was wasted on a pointless eunuch."
Bai Wushuang’s brows flashed with a quirky expression:
"The previous Sect Leader Dongfang had mutilated himself to practice the Sunflower Manual, turning into a eunuch neither man nor woman!
This could be put aside.
He day by day practiced the Sunflower Manual, becoming more and more like a woman.
I found it disgusting.
So I killed him."
Everyone was stunned.
This reason, it’s too powerful!
Why does it sound so absurd?
"Before this, you had the ability to kill Dongfang Bubai?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
"Ha ha..."
Bai Wushuang laughed:
"Ding Ling, it’s just that you don’t know my true abilities.
Sect Leader Dongfang was no longer a man, he wasn’t a woman either.
The more he practiced the Sunflower Manual,
the more perverted he became in his heart!
I once followed him for a time.
He intended to eliminate me to fulfill his affair with Yang Lianting properly, wanting to study my skin for pleasure.
He didn’t know, Yang Lianting was my friend.
Yang Lianting told me about this.
With Yang Lianting’s help, I easily killed him.
So Ding Ling, do you understand now?"
"I see."
Ding Ling comprehended.
Dongfang Bubai didn’t have the slightest guard against Yang Lianting, so killing Dongfang Bubai wasn’t surprising.
Except for Yang Lianting...
Ding Ling glanced at Yang Lianting, noticing his deep gaze towards Bai Wushuang, the look of a passionate man yearning for a goddess he had secretly admired for a long time!
Upon observing this.
Ding Ling understood, Dongfang Bubai loved Yang Lianting, Yang Lianting loved Bai Wushuang!
Bai Wushuang didn’t intend to get involved, but cooperated with Yang Lianting to kill Dongfang Bubai, then replace him, becoming the new Dongfang Bubai, it seemed quite understandable.
"From today onwards, there will no longer be Bai Wushuang in the world."
Bai Wushuang’s voice was high-pitched, powerful, her eyes seemingly deep:
"I am Dongfang Bubai, the Sect Leader of this Sun and Moon Divine Sect!"
"Absurd!"
Ren Woxing was outraged:
"How can you, a woman, become the Sect Leader of this Sun and Moon Divine Sect!
Besides, you’re an outsider to the Sun and Moon Divine Sect!
What qualifies you to be the Sect Leader?"
"If I beat you to death, then I qualify."
Bai Wushuang, or the second generation Dongfang Bubai, suddenly glided down from the side, her jade palms danced, heavily striking towards Ren Woxing.
Ren Woxing roared ’Star Absorption Technique’!
Suddenly waved his palms, seeming to absorb Bai Wushuang’s inner strength, but couldn’t absorb it at all, and in an instant, slap!
A crisp sound.
Ren Woxing was incredibly sent flying by Bai Wushuang’s slap.
In mid-air, before he landed, he had already spurted out a bloody arrow.
Obviously, after the brief exchange.
Ren Woxing suffered severe injuries.
"Father!"
Ren Yingying cried sadly.
Flew fast wind-like, held Ren Woxing who had landed.
Bai Wushuang intended to act further.
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 387: Full Level Tai Chi Fist Power
paragraphs: Ding Ling felt guilty and, with a swift move, intercepted Bai Wushuang:
"Miss Bai, let’s call it a day. What do you think?"
"Hmph."

Bai Wushuang did not continue attacking Ren Woxing, merely let out a light snort. In mid-air, she executed a spinning maneuver, her body twirling three times before gracefully retreating tens of meters and landing lightly on the sect leader’s throne in the main hall.
She sat solemnly on the throne,
her phoenix eyes exuded an intimidating might, naturally giving rise to an overbearing aura.
It made people feel awed at just a glance.

"Considering Ding Ling, I won’t hold a grudge against you, Ren Woxing. But if you dare to claim that I’m unfit to be the Sect Leader of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect again, even if you run to the ends of the earth or hide deep within the Imperial Palace, I will still kill you!"
Ren Woxing, having just suffered a serious injury, remained silent in his misery.
He now had a clearer understanding of Bai Wushuang’s power.
It had only been just a few days.
Bai Wushuang seemed to have grown even stronger!
Is she even human?!

Ding Ling is like this, Bai Wushuang is like this. Yet, for him, Ren Woxing, breaking through obstacles is exceptionally challenging, why is Heaven so unfair?! Why does Mother Earth treat him this way?!
"Ding Ling."
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but look at Ding Ling once again.
Ding Ling was slightly taken aback, recalling the promise he made to Ren Yingying, and said:
"Bai Wushuang, I promised Miss Ren. I must defeat Dongfang Bubai. If you are Bai Wushuang, we have no reason to fight again. But if you’re Dongfang Bubai, I must defeat you once more."
"Haha..."
Bai Wushuang laughed heartily:
"I’ve already said it. Dongfang Bubai is a nice name. From this moment on, I am Dongfang Bubai. Hero Ding, do not call me Miss Bai anymore. Call me Sect Leader Dongfang or Miss Dongfang instead."
Ding Ling was speechless, somewhat unable to understand:
"This name change seems to hold no benefit for you, Miss Bai. Moreover, names are given by parents..."
Before Ding Ling could finish speaking.
Bai Wushuang interrupted him, laughed long, stood up, and looked at Ding Ling with bright eyes, saying:
"I cannot explain in detail the entanglements, causes, and reasons to you, Hero Ding. But I can tell you, I am Dongfang Bubai, without a doubt."
She spun around, lotus blossoms sprouting under her feet, and she flew towards Ding Ling on a trail of white lotuses:
"It’s been a few days, and I’ve already reached the entry level of the Breathing Technique. Let me show you the progress of my skills. Hero Ding, look out for my palm!
A palm strike came crashing down!
It was like a torrent wave sweeping the shore!
More like thunder roaring down to earth, giving an overwhelming sense of impossibility to block or evade.
"Indeed, she has become much stronger!"
Ding Ling grew solemn, seriously doubting whether Bai Wushuang is using some kind of cheat, as this speed of becoming stronger is truly absurd!
But his reaction was not slow either.
He casually drew a circle.
A punch was thrown towards Bai Wushuang.
This punch was seamless, flawless, and as it was unleashed, two yin-yang fish swam erratically within it.
This was none other than the Tai Chi Fist recorded in the Tai Chi Scripture!
Zhang Sanfeng’s late-life Tai Chi Scripture was extraordinarily profound, and its difficulty was no less than the Dugu Nine Swords!

While its striking power was inferior to the Dugu Nine Swords, its defensive capabilities, ability to use minimal force to move a great object, to use stillness to overcome movement, and to overcome rigidity with softness far surpassed the Dugu Nine Swords.
It can be said that the Dugu Nine Swords is the strongest sword skill Ding Ling currently masters.
While this Tai Chi Fist is the strongest fist technique he controls!
A sword, a palm, it’s hard to differentiate which reigns superior!
Kung!
Ding Ling’s Tai Chi Fist executed was like flowing clouds and water, continuous and endless, a perfect blend of hardness and softness, connotative yet understated!
The fist force, under the instigation of the integrated power, seemed to make the void emit crackling sounds.
This punch, seemingly extremely slow, like a turtle crawling, was in fact fast, landing after being launched with a loud crash, colliding almost instantly with Bai Wushuang’s palm!
In just an instant.
A surging storm erupted at the intersection of their fist and palm!
Ding Ling remained unmoving like a mountain.

Bai Wushuang, however, was drawn by a strange vigorous qi, making her spin several times in mid-air, uncontrollably flying back over ten meters. In mid-air, the massive palm power she unleashed seemed to boomerang back to her body, boom!
She was struck as if by lightning, violently retreating dozens of meters again, floating lightly like a maple leaf blown away by a fierce wind, softly landing over a hundred meters away, boom!
Her pair of jade-like feet landed on the ground, unexpectedly stamping a deep imprint on the earth.
"Tai Chi Fist!"
Bai Wushuang was astounded, looking incredulously at Ding Ling:
"You’ve achieved perfection?!"
She also practiced Tai Chi Fist.
Thus, she naturally understood the special traits of Tai Chi Fist!
Saying it’s the world’s number one fist is not an exaggeration.
This kind of fist technique superbly blends hardness and softness, yin and yang interdepend, a single punch, controls vigorous qi, using softness to subdue hardness, truly commonplace!

Her Breathing Technique vigorous qi, Inner Power True Qi merged palm power was incredibly strong and fierce, yet it also was drawn by this Tai Chi Fist’s fist force, making it uncontrollable, and blowing away!
This kind of vigorous qi, without reaching Great Perfection, how can it draw control off her like this?!
"Correct."
Ding Ling admitted.
Bai Wushuang was shaken, her heart pounded rapidly:

"It seems I’ve still underestimated you. Such an extremely hard-to-practice supreme skill in the world has been so easily comprehended and cultivated by you to the Realm of Great Perfection. Your talent far exceeds my imagination. This time, I lost. What do you want me to do?"
[You have received an Achievement Medal: Gained deep recognition from Bai Wushuang (Dongfang Bubai).]

[Note: Bai Wushuang (Dongfang Bubai) prides herself on being the fastest and most insightful in cultivation. However, you have surpassed her in these two aspects she is proud of! This has made her come to respect you even deeper recognition.]
Upon hearing the cue sound.
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly shrank.
Even the Game World acknowledges Bai Wushuang as Dongfang Bubai.
It seems Bai Wushuang’s background, cause and effect may indeed be complicated.
Perhaps she really is Dongfang Bubai in person?
Or maybe she does possess the qualification to become Dongfang Bubai?
The truth remains unknown.
Ding Ling didn’t have the mind to explore further, but now that Bai Wushuang is Dongfang Bubai, Ding Ling thought for a moment, then said:
"Miss Bai."
"Call me Miss Dongfang."
"Miss Bai, Miss Dongfang."
Ding Ling felt a bit awkward in his heart.
A perfectly fine Bai Wushuang.
Has become Dongfang Bubai!
What kind of drama is this?
And yet Bai Wushuang won’t discuss the specific causes and reasons with him.
Ding Ling could only blindly guess, unable to be sure, but his ultimate goal is for immortality, his current goal is to fulfill promises and complete tasks.
Thus, he hesitated no further:
"I hope Miss Dongfang could cooperate with me and acknowledge that Dongfang Bubai was defeated by my hands. Confirm that I am the world’s number one."

chapters.title: Chapter 388: Purple Mist Divine Skill Full Level
paragraphs: "This is easy."
Bai Wushuang, who can also be called Dongfang Bubai now, said:
"I don’t care about false reputations. My fundamental goal is to enhance my strength and pursue the exploration of the Martial Dao."
She glanced at Yang Lianting:
"Leave this matter to you. Get it done as quickly as possible."
"Please rest assured, Sect Leader, your orders are something I will follow to the death!"
Yang Lianting knelt on the ground and said in a loud voice.
"Apart from that, what else do you want me to do?"
Dongfang Bubai asked Ding Ling, while looking at him.
She had two Achievement Medals on her.
This showed that other players hadn’t started to farm Achievement Medals from her.
After Ding Ling realized this, he knew she probably wasn’t lying and could indeed have been staying inside the Sun and Moon Divine Sect all along.
And why stay here?
Thinking about how training required a vast amount of medicinal resources clarified things for Ding Ling.
Dedicated resources of the entire Sun and Moon Divine Sect were used to nurture Dongfang Bubai.

Her rapid progress in training was quite normal. Of course, even when most people have sufficient training resources, it is difficult for them to advance as rapidly as Dongfang Bubai without any barriers or setbacks. Most people stagnate once they reach a certain level.
Thinking this through,
Ding Ling didn’t want to disrupt Dongfang Bubai’s martial arts progress and said:
"When you shatter the void and move on to the Upper Realm, I hope you will hand over the Sun and Moon Divine Sect to Miss Ren for management."
She owed more people to Ren Yingying.
Of course, she wanted to repay this debt as much as possible.
After repaying,
he could face Ren Yingying more calmly. Otherwise, feeling indebted to her unsettled Ding Ling.

Ren Yingying seemed to have noticed this as well, and recently her mood had been rather gloomy. Although she didn’t want to ask Ding Ling, her father was now severely injured, and Xiaang Wentian had no power to fight Dongfang Bubai.
She could only turn to Ding Ling for help.
Yet, overusing favors drains them, and using them too often would mean that any meaningful relationship or entanglement with Ding Ling might be more difficult in the future.
Thinking of this,
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but feel a tumult of emotions, unable to calm down for a long time.
"That’s easy to say."
Dongfang Bubai, without much hesitation, responded graciously:
"If I break the boundaries and travel to another world, whether the Sun and Moon Divine Sect disbands or is run by others, it makes no difference to me."
"Thank you."
Ding Ling understood that Dongfang Bubai was speaking the truth.
Her current role as the leader of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect was definitely for the training resources.
After all, finding resources alone outside is incredibly difficult, as Ding Ling experienced in the Three Kingdoms World.
This world has even more martial artists.
Resources are equally challenging to find!
If they hadn’t defeated the Mount Songh Sect and gathered a large number of resources, Q u Feiyan, Zhang Hex, and Consort Yhu would likely face difficulties in the next stages of their training.
Fortunately, they had no worries in the short term.
"You’re welcome."
Dongfang Bubai glanced at Ren Woxing and the others:
"If there’s nothing else, we shall take our leave."
Ren Woxing walked out of Black Wood Cliff in a daze.
Accompanying him was Elder Tong Baixiong.
Dongfang Bubai was dead.
He had no reason to stay on the Black Wood Cliff.
Plus, he had grudges with Yang Lianting already, making it unsafe for him to linger on the Black Wood Cliff any longer.
As the new Dongfang Bubai, the Sect Leader clearly valued and trusted Yang Lianting more, and if Tong Baixiong went against Yang Lianting, it was very likely he’d end up dead.
Therefore,
Tong Baixiong was more disoriented and at a loss than Ren Woxing.
He had dedicated his life to the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, and suddenly stepping away, he was momentarily clueless about his next steps.
Ren Woxing was slightly better off; he was just somewhat dispirited, having been beaten and imprisoned for over a decade in the West Lake dungeon by the previous Dongfang Bubai.
He was easily defeated by the new Dongfang Bubai and humiliated several times, helplessly so.
Yet this Dongfang Bubai.
Held Ding Ling in high regard and treated him kindly, even claiming that after her ascension, the Sun and Moon Divine Sect could be handed over to Ren Yingying.
Ding Ling’s words held such sway!
This stark contrast and disconnect left Ren Woxing feeling lost, with a sense of being outdated and a relic of another era, something no longer part of his times.
The fiery blood in his heart cooled a lot.
He became like a slow-moving old man.
Ren Yingying noticed it and couldn’t help but say:
"Father, why don’t we retire to Huashan and never concern ourselves with the Sun and Moon Divine Sect matters again? How does that sound?"
"No way."
Ren Woxing instinctively retorted. This was the culmination of his life’s efforts, his dedication, and it couldn’t just be abandoned.
Ren Yingying fell silent.
Ding Ling didn’t say much regarding this.
He now just needed to hurry back to Huashan and quietly wait for the news of him defeating Dongfang Bubai to spread across the land.
Then surely his mission progress would advance dramatically!
By then.
It would be time for him to leave this world.
Thinking about his imminent departure,
Ding Ling spared no effort in instructing Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, Qu Feiyan, and Consort Yhu along the way.
Fan Kuai shamelessly followed Ding Ling, pretending not to notice, feigning ignorance, and insisted on tagging along; Ding Ling let him be.
As long as it didn’t harm his own people.

He fully leveled his Observing People Skill, and during this time with Fan Kuai, he realized this man had a tenacious character; although straightforward and crude, he was also very bold and generous.
But just that alone wasn’t enough to earn him the transmission of skills from Ding Ling.
Fan Kuai didn’t get angry, he was just enviously watching Zhang Hex and others practicing Inner Power and consuming Great Medicine every day.

Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, and others often felt warm under his gaze, and more than once they expressed gratitude for choosing the right person. Otherwise, they might have ended up like Fan Kuai, standing aside only to envy.
Upon arriving at Huashan,
Ding Ling continued to engage in teaching and guiding others.
In the meantime,
Ding Ling returned the Exorcism Sword Manual to Lin Pingzhi.

Initially, Lin Pingzhi was quite excited, but after thoroughly reviewing it and discovering that the Exorcism Sword Manual required him to castrate himself, he instinctively recoiled as if he had encountered a snake or scorpion and had the urge to tear it apart.
At that moment, he suddenly understood why his ancestor, Lin Yuantu, discouraged descendants from practicing this Technique.
It was a technique that would end his bloodline!
Who would dare to practice it?
Lin Pingzhi decisively destroyed this Technique. He had top-notch Breathing Technique and Pure Yang True Skill internal skills to practice, and various Supreme Skills to choose from at will.
Even if he had lost his mind, he wouldn’t practice such self-destructive Techniques.
Little did he know, in the original path, he was indeed such a ruthless person.
Of course,
Ding Ling wouldn’t tell him that.
He spent nearly a month at Huashan again.
During this one-month period,
Ding Ling exchanged Pure Yang True Skill, Breathing Technique, and Moon Shadow Swordsmanship with Yue Buqun and his wife for Purple Mist Divine Skill and Jade Maiden Swordsmanship.
Ding Ling merely skimmed through these two Secret Manuals.
The manuals leveled to full level.
The full-level Purple Mist Divine Skill produced a strand of Vigorous Qi which automatically merged into the True Qi of Pure Yang True Skill, enhancing its core.
