Thinking of this,
Ren Yingying couldn’t help but feel a tumult of emotions, unable to calm down for a long time.
"That’s easy to say."
Dongfang Bubai, without much hesitation, responded graciously:
"If I break the boundaries and travel to another world, whether the Sun and Moon Divine Sect disbands or is run by others, it makes no difference to me."
"Thank you."
Ding Ling understood that Dongfang Bubai was speaking the truth.
Her current role as the leader of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect was definitely for the training resources.
After all, finding resources alone outside is incredibly difficult, as Ding Ling experienced in the Three Kingdoms World.
This world has even more martial artists.
Resources are equally challenging to find!
If they hadn’t defeated the Mount Songh Sect and gathered a large number of resources, Q u Feiyan, Zhang Hex, and Consort Yhu would likely face difficulties in the next stages of their training.
Fortunately, they had no worries in the short term.
"You’re welcome."
Dongfang Bubai glanced at Ren Woxing and the others:
"If there’s nothing else, we shall take our leave."
Ren Woxing walked out of Black Wood Cliff in a daze.
Accompanying him was Elder Tong Baixiong.
Dongfang Bubai was dead.
He had no reason to stay on the Black Wood Cliff.
Plus, he had grudges with Yang Lianting already, making it unsafe for him to linger on the Black Wood Cliff any longer.
As the new Dongfang Bubai, the Sect Leader clearly valued and trusted Yang Lianting more, and if Tong Baixiong went against Yang Lianting, it was very likely he’d end up dead.
Therefore,
Tong Baixiong was more disoriented and at a loss than Ren Woxing.
He had dedicated his life to the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, and suddenly stepping away, he was momentarily clueless about his next steps.
Ren Woxing was slightly better off; he was just somewhat dispirited, having been beaten and imprisoned for over a decade in the West Lake dungeon by the previous Dongfang Bubai.
He was easily defeated by the new Dongfang Bubai and humiliated several times, helplessly so.
Yet this Dongfang Bubai.
Held Ding Ling in high regard and treated him kindly, even claiming that after her ascension, the Sun and Moon Divine Sect could be handed over to Ren Yingying.
Ding Ling’s words held such sway!
This stark contrast and disconnect left Ren Woxing feeling lost, with a sense of being outdated and a relic of another era, something no longer part of his times.
The fiery blood in his heart cooled a lot.
He became like a slow-moving old man.
Ren Yingying noticed it and couldn’t help but say:
"Father, why don’t we retire to Huashan and never concern ourselves with the Sun and Moon Divine Sect matters again?
How does that sound?"
"No way."
Ren Woxing instinctively retorted.
This was the culmination of his life’s efforts, his dedication, and it couldn’t just be abandoned.
Ren Yingying fell silent.
Ding Ling didn’t say much regarding this.
He now just needed to hurry back to Huashan and quietly wait for the news of him defeating Dongfang Bubai to spread across the land.
Then surely his mission progress would advance dramatically!
By then.
It would be time for him to leave this world.
Thinking about his imminent departure,
Ding Ling spared no effort in instructing Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, Qu Feiyan, and Consort Yhu along the way.
Fan Kuai shamelessly followed Ding Ling, pretending not to notice, feigning ignorance, and insisted on tagging along; Ding Ling let him be.
As long as it didn’t harm his own people.

He fully leveled his Observing People Skill, and during this time with Fan Kuai, he realized this man had a tenacious character; although straightforward and crude, he was also very bold and generous.
But just that alone wasn’t enough to earn him the transmission of skills from Ding Ling.
Fan Kuai didn’t get angry, he was just enviously watching Zhang Hex and others practicing Inner Power and consuming Great Medicine every day.
Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, and others often felt warm under his gaze, and more than once they expressed gratitude for choosing the right person.
Otherwise, they might have ended up like Fan Kuai, standing aside only to envy.
Upon arriving at Huashan,
Ding Ling continued to engage in teaching and guiding others.
In the meantime,
Ding Ling returned the Exorcism Sword Manual to Lin Pingzhi.

Initially, Lin Pingzhi was quite excited, but after thoroughly reviewing it and discovering that the Exorcism Sword Manual required him to castrate himself, he instinctively recoiled as if he had encountered a snake or scorpion and had the urge to tear it apart.
At that moment, he suddenly understood why his ancestor, Lin Yuantu, discouraged descendants from practicing this Technique.
It was a technique that would end his bloodline!
Who would dare to practice it?
Lin Pingzhi decisively destroyed this Technique.
He had top-notch Breathing Technique and Pure Yang True Skill internal skills to practice, and various Supreme Skills to choose from at will.
Even if he had lost his mind, he wouldn’t practice such self-destructive Techniques.
Little did he know, in the original path, he was indeed such a ruthless person.
Of course,
Ding Ling wouldn’t tell him that.
He spent nearly a month at Huashan again.
During this one-month period,
Ding Ling exchanged Pure Yang True Skill, Breathing Technique, and Moon Shadow Swordsmanship with Yue Buqun and his wife for Purple Mist Divine Skill and Jade Maiden Swordsmanship.
Ding Ling merely skimmed through these two Secret Manuals.
The manuals leveled to full level.
The full-level Purple Mist Divine Skill produced a strand of Vigorous Qi which automatically merged into the True Qi of Pure Yang True Skill, enhancing its core.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Annihilating the Qingcheng Sect! Meeting Yilin
paragraphs: Because Ding Ling’s True Qi value in this world has already reached its limit.
Therefore, even the Full Level Purple Mist Skill cannot increase the Inner Power Value.
To be able to increase a strand of Vigorous Qi is already the limit.
Ding Ling didn’t think much of it.
The subsequent Full Level Jade Maiden Swordsmanship,
left him quite intrigued, as he discovered that this nineteen-form Jade Maiden Swordsmanship seemed capable of countering Huashan Swordsmanship.
He pondered:
"Could it be that this Jade Maiden Swordsmanship is related to the Jade Maiden Pure Heart Swordsmanship of the Ancient Tomb Sect?"
Thinking that Huashan Sect was founded by Hao Datong of the Quanzhen Sect.
Ding Ling was contemplative.
But he did not dwell on it further.
This Jade Maiden Swordsmanship, while a Superior Swordsmanship,
was far inferior to the Dugu Nine Swords.
After Ding Ling reached Full Level,
it only enhanced his own foundation.
"Remarkable."
Yue Buqun and his wife were astounded when they saw Ding Ling quickly reaching the Realm of Perfection with their Martial Arts, feeling an incredible disbelief.
However, considering Ding Ling’s speed in learning the Dugu Nine Swords, they were relieved.
Without a doubt,
Ding Ling was an exceptionally gifted super genius!
Yue Buqun was ambitious, very determined to protect the Huashan Sect, and knowing that the Breathing Technique and Inner Qi fusion could enhance combat power five to tenfold.
He readily agreed to exchange Cultivation Techniques with Ding Ling.
Though his Purple Mist Divine Skill was remarkable, Ding Ling’s techniques were evidently not inferior to it, perhaps even superior, making it unreasonable not to exchange.
Although this might be somewhat disrespectful to the teachings left by his ancestors,
Yue Buqun couldn’t care less.
He was provoked.
One formidable expert after another was emerging in the Jianghu. If he didn’t keep pace with the times by learning the Breathing Technique,
he would likely be easily overwhelmed by masters trained in the Breathing Technique Inner Power in a few years.
The explosive power from the fusion of the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi and the Inner Power’s Inner Strength was terrifyingly powerful.
Yue Buqun had witnessed it several times firsthand.
How dare he underestimate it?
"A new era is about to dawn!"
Looking at Ding Ling’s distant back, Yue Buqun’s heart was stirred and it couldn’t calm for a long time.

Ding Ling, accompanied by Zhang Hex, Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, Taishi Ci, and others, made a trip to the Qingcheng Sect, eliminating local tyrants and evildoers, once again severely injuring Yu Canghai, and allowing Lin Pingzhi to finish him.

Lin Pingzhi avenged this hatred, his thoughts cleared instantly, and under the rapid operation of his Inner Strength and the Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique, he managed to breakthrough a Life and Death Pass and entered a new Martial Arts Realm.
Ding Ling and his group emptied Qingcheng Sect’s treasures.
Ding Ling finished reading the Qingcheng Sect’s library.
Over a dozen Inner Power Heart Methods were all at Full Level.
Although most were second or third-rate,
they were more than sufficient for enhancing foundation.
Various other Sword Techniques and Palm Techniques, over ten in number, also were ordinary second or third-rate ones.
But all were maxed out to Full Level.
With these techniques reaching Full Level,
Ding Ling felt his control over True Qi becoming increasingly proficient and effortless, to say it was as if his arm could command it was no exaggeration.
But Ding Ling was not satisfied with this.
Borrowing the excuse of sparring, competing, and exchanging Martial Arts,
he ascended to the Heng Mountain Sect,
Mount Tai Sect, and other major sects,
using the essence of the Five Mountains Sword Sect’s swordsmanship from Reflection Cliff to exchange for a pile of second or third-rate Sword Techniques, Palm Techniques, and so on.
Though the Mount Tai Sect and others didn’t quite understand,
as Ding Ling desired the exchange, they were willing to trade these ’useless’ techniques for top-tier Superior Swordsmanship.
Little did they know,
Ding Ling’s fundamental goal was merely to enhance his foundation.
On this day,
after exchanging Techniques with Nun Sanding of Heng Mountain Sect and instantly achieving Full Level in various Sword Techniques on the spot,
he prepared to leave.
Nun Dingyi said:
"I have yet to thank Hero Ding for the earlier rescue of Yilin."
Nun Dingyi had a guard against Ding Ling, apprehension, and fear.
After all, Ding Ling’s infamous reputation was known far and wide.
Shaolin Temple had even closed its doors to avoid him.
The followers of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect readily admitted that their Sect Leader Dongfang was defeated by Ding Ling.
Nowadays,
In the Jianghu,
Ding Ling could be said to be known by all!
He was truly the World’s Number One!
Facing such a person, Nun Dingyi and others were initially very tense.
But after genuinely interacting, they discovered Ding Ling was knowledgeable, magnanimous, generous, and calm, contrary to his rumored image!
In surprise, their fondness and appreciation for Ding Ling inadvertently rose.
This allowed Ding Ling to smoothly acquire a few Achievement Medals.
The progress bar of Task 1 moved forward a few notches under the guise of transmitting skills and sparring.
No doubt.
Nun Dingyi, Nun Dingxian, and Nun Dingjing were all plane-level powerhouses. Defeating them naturally fulfilled the task requirements.
Their survival till now was naturally due to Ding Ling. With the elimination of the Mount Songh Sect, the merger of the Five Mountains Sword Sect naturally ceased to exist.
"You are too kind."
Ding Ling smiled mildly:
"Anyone with a sense of righteousness wouldn’t ignore the filthy thief Tian Boguang’s outrageous acts!"
"Hero Ding, what you say is absolutely right."
Nun Dingyi said righteously, admiringly:

"I think the same. And I also believe that sects like the Mount Songh Sect should be eradicated. You’ve done right by removing some major malignancies from the Jianghu, truly a role model for us all."
Ding Ling smiled, leaving it ambiguous.
The world is like this.
With the strength of the World’s Number One and gaining the support and recognition of many, wherever you go, you will be a Hero!
Even if the Mount Songh Sect and Qingcheng Sect were destroyed, many see it as their just deserts, believing Hero Ding was in the right!
Of course, this also had to do with the covert assistance from Dongfang Bubai and Yang Lianting.
Ding Ling revealed ample evidence of the Qingcheng Sect and Mount Songh Sect’s harms to society, and once these were spread to the world,
the Mount Songh Sect and Qingcheng Sect were nailed to the pillar of shame!
Turning over a new leaf was essentially impossible.
After spending some time with the Heng Mountain Sect,
Ding Ling got up to bid farewell.
Nun Sanding led her disciples to personally see him off.
Among these disciples, Ding Ling saw the young nun Yilin, possessing an aura of inviolable holiness, looking akin to a Bodhisattva!
Upon meeting once again,
they both felt quite emotional.

Ding Ling felt after not seeing her for so long, Yilin’s appearance hadn’t changed, but she looked noticeably more haggard, and in her watery apricot eyes seemed engraved the words sorrow and longing.
Yilin was embarrassed and ashamed, unable to look Ding Ling directly in the eyes.
During their time apart.
Ding Ling had become the World’s Number One Hero Ding renowned throughout the world.
She was still that nameless little nun, not to mention, she had fallen into an embarrassing situation because of Brother Linghu.
She was too ashamed to face Ding Ling, so after a glance, both were silently speechless.
Ding Ling, just as when they first met, once more brushed past her shoulder.
Yilin watched Ding Ling’s silhouette, her expression dazed.

chapters.title: Chapter 390: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Ends! Settlement Rewards
paragraphs: "Why didn’t you step forward to thank Hero Ding when you saw him?"
Nun Dingyi looked at Yilin with some dissatisfaction.
Yilin was speechless, hesitant.
In her heart, she also felt some regret and remorse.
After Ding Ling left.
It was as if she finally awoke again, realizing she indeed owed Ding Ling a ’thank you’! Owed him a debt of gratitude that had not been repaid!
"What should I do?"
Her mind was in a whirlwind.
Under the urging of Nun Dingyi.
She hesitantly chased out, but when she reached the mountain gate and looked out, Ding Ling and his companions were nowhere to be seen.
"Have they already left?"
Yilin felt lost and frustrated, her eyes slightly red with shame, understanding that this parting might mean she’ll never see Ding Ling again in this life.
She hadn’t repaid the favor she owed Ding Ling.
There were several times when she could have said thank you in person.
But it was her own timidity that ruined it.
"Hero Ding, I’m sorry..."
"Thank you."
A gentle breeze blew past.
Several weak notes lingered in the air, drifting with the scattered leaves toward the distance.
Ding Ling roamed from the southern window to the north for several months.
During this time of wandering.
He was teaching Zhang Hex, Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, and their group.
Because there was no shortage of Great Medicine.
And Zhang Hex, Qu Feiyan, and others had extremely high martial talent.
Although Lin Pingzhi was weaker, Ding Ling guided him in cultivating the Breathing Technique and Inner Power, always offering precise, deeply insightful, and always on-point guidance!
This also allowed him to have almost no unresolved problems in his cultivation path.
Without taking any wrong turns.
Everything went smoothly.
And on this day.
Ding Ling traveled throughout Jiuzhou.
After visiting several major sects.
He finally heard the notification sound.
[3: You must make your name as the world’s number one resound across the entire Plane World. 100%/100%.]
[Congratulations player Ding Ling, you have completed all the tasks on the Path of the Glory War God!]
[Overachieved task! Would you like to redeem the Glory Medal now and proceed to a higher-level Martial Hero Plane World?]
Hmm?!
Ding Ling was surprised.
A few days ago, the task reached 99%.
Now it finally reached 100%.
Ding Ling was not surprised by this.
What surprised him was that the next level, that is, the Upper Realm of this world, was actually not the Xianxia World?
Still the Martial World?
"How many levels does the Martial World have?"
Ding Ling thought of the Grandmaster and Grandmaster Realm mentioned in martial novels.
And he was currently only at the Innate Realm.
His eyelid twitched twice, and he pondered:
"Could it be that the Martial World has three levels?"
If the martial world has three levels.
Then how many levels would the Xianxia have?!
"There is a long way to go."
Ding Ling didn’t think too much.
He had stayed in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World for just under a year.
For other martial worlds, progress was likely to be faster, and it was probably the same principle.
"Especially now that I have both Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi and True Qi, going to other martial worlds, even if not sweeping them, defeating typical Innate Experts poses absolutely no problem."
’In such circumstances. Accelerating progress is definitely feasible.’
Thinking so.
Ding Ling felt relieved.
There are quite a few Divine Skill Secret Manuals in the martial world, learning them and solidifying the foundation is undoubtedly beneficial for his Martial Dao journey.
Just like these past few months.
He roamed Jiuzhou.
Examining countless second-class and third-class Inner Power Secret Manuals, palm techniques, Saber Techniques, and others.
Now his True Qi could achieve a perfect state where the intent arrives with the Qi.
Better than commanding at will, reaching even a higher state!
With a mere thought.
True Qi could rise abruptly, sweeping out like a storm, its speed far surpassing before, and the utilization rate of True Qi is also far superior to before.
This is the advantage of deep foundations.
Just like a building, the more stable the foundation, the sturdier the building stands, and vice versa.
"The task is over."
Ding Ling thought for a moment.
And decided to set the path of the Celestial Ladder ten miles from Chang’an City.
When he galloped to this place, he was surprised to find.
There was also a pavilion here.
But compared to the pavilion in the Three Kingdoms World.
This one is newer and more spacious.
Ding Ling walked into the pavilion, his expression slightly dazed.

At this moment, it was as if he had returned to the Three Kingdoms, back to the moment when he first cleared the Celestial Ladder, with Diao Chan and the other girls looking at him with slightly red eyes.
Ding Ling let out a long sigh.
Without thinking much.
He turned to the message notification from earlier:
[Overachieved task! Would you like to redeem the Glory Medal now and proceed to a higher-level Martial Hero Plane World?]
"Yes!"
He clicked ’Yes’!
[Redemption successful!]
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane Experts: 63/20.]
After defeating the three from the Sword Sect and Feng Qingyang.
Ding Ling also defeated Tong Baixiong, Yue Buqun and his wife, Nun Sanding, the Mount Tai Sect experts, and so on.
So the task progress improved significantly.
[Task 1. Obtain Glory Medal 1. Honor bonus 315%. Glory Medal final count: approximately 3 pieces.]
In the Three Kingdoms, it was 375%, thus gaining 4 pieces. Here it’s directly 3 pieces. It seems the task’s Glory Medal is also rounded off.
Ding Ling saw this and continued reading.
[2, You must defeat the strongest in the plane. Prove you are the true world’s number one. Progress 100%]
[Task 2: Obtain 1 Glory Medal]
[3: You must make your name as the world’s number one resound throughout the entire plane world. 100%/100%.]
[Task 3: Obtain 1 Glory Medal]
The final number of Glory Medals obtained is: 5.
[Glory Medal settlement completed.]
[Would you like to open the Path of Glory now?]
The familiar rhythm and reminders.
Ding Ling clicked ’Yes’!
[The Path of Glory is about to open. Please choose the location to place the Path of Glory.]
[Friendly Reminder: The Path of Glory is the Tongtian Road...]
The friendly reminder was exactly the same.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate much, opened the character panel, and clicked again.
[Confirm selection of the ancient pavilion outside Chang’an City?]
Confirm!
[Selection completed. Cannot be changed again!]
Boom!
The next instant.
Thunder exploded.
The world changed color.
Heaven and Earth seemed to swirl completely at this moment! Flipping over.
Rumbling!
Dark clouds covered the sky, a Thunder Dragon appeared out of thin air in the sky, roaring amidst the rolling clouds.
A scene almost identical to the Three Kingdoms World appeared.
Everyone was shaken by it.
Although Zhang Hex and Taishi Ci had seen similar scenes, witnessing it again still gave them a feeling of being watched by a Celestial God, a sense of insignificance.
They took a deep breath, suppressed their inner discomfort, and watched with burning eyes.
Thunk!
A divine light broke through all darkness, shattered the Thunder Dragon, pierced through the clouds, and descended into the world at lightning speed!
Whoosh!
This light strikingly resembled the Celestial Ladder. It extended from the horizon to Ding Ling’s feet, landing in front of him.
Ding Ling glanced at Qu Feiyan and the others.
Qu Feiyan’s eyes were slightly red, her lips trembling, but she seemed unable to speak for a moment.
Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, and Huang Zhonggong’s group were still in shock, pale.
Ren Yingying and Ren Woxing rushed over just in time to join Ding Ling in the final moments, but did not expect to see this scene, each of them was shaken to their core.
Ren Yingying thought that this farewell might mean eternal separation between celestial beings, and couldn’t help but exclaim ’Hero Ding’!
Her cry.
Startled Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan, and others back to their senses, all calling ’Master’ ’Brother Ding’.
Ding Ling smiled gently, comforting everyone a few words, and then shifted the topic, saying:
"Cultivate well. I still have a chance to return to this world."
The Three Kingdoms has a chance to return.
There’s no reason The Smiling, Proud Wanderer wouldn’t have a chance to return.
Ding Ling had already told Zhang Hex and his group about this.
Thus, although Zhang Hex’s group was reluctant, they were better off compared to Qu Feiyan and others.
"When will we meet again?"

"You all should cultivate well. When there’s no more progress to be made in this world or when faced with something truly unsolvable, then you can consider ascension. Otherwise, you might wait. Perhaps you’ll wait for me to return."
"Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan’s expression was firm:
"I will follow in your footsteps. If you never return. I will go to the Upper Realm to find you."

Ding Ling knew Qu Feiyan’s character, once she made up her mind, it was hard to change, so he didn’t persuade her much, just comforted her a few more times, finally looked around at everyone, and stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
Boom!
At the moment he stepped onto the Celestial Ladder, the Dharma Conch sounded, faintly one could hear gods in the void chanting blessings for Ding Ling!
Golden light enveloped him.
Rainbows rose to the sky.
Various visions appeared one after another.
Boom!
The golden light surging out of the Celestial Ladder swept up Ding Ling in an instant, soaring to the Ninefold Heaven above.
This feeling, this experience, felt familiar.
Ding Ling remembered scenes from his ascension in the Three Kingdoms World.
Involuntarily sighed:
"This ascension routine, process, is really exactly the same, without any changes. Just seems like the ’special effects’ are bigger this time."
Ding Ling looked toward the world.
He could see Qu Feiyan and others’ figures, the vast Chang’an City, the entire Jiuzhou, all seemed to finally turn into a blurred shadow and disappeared.
In his vision were only white mist and the Celestial Ladder.
Only the overwhelming golden light, the rainbow light, and the white light.
Whoosh!
The Celestial Ladder pierced through layers of world barriers.
Carrying Ding Ling once again into that mysterious, unknowable dimension world.
Ding Ling saw a familiar portal.
It was woven of golden light.
It was tightly closed.
Engraved with a line of words.
[Gate of Glory!]
"Sure enough, it’s this door."
Ding Ling was slightly stunned, but quickly regained his composure,
He instinctively glanced at the character panel.
Sure enough.
The information reminder came.
[Congratulations player Ding Ling for being the first to clear the portal of the first layer of the Martial Hero Plane!]
[As the first to clear the first layer of the Martial Hero Plane, you will receive the following rewards:]
[1: A Martial Hero Plane World only you can tread upon!]
[2: Obtain one opportunity to return to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.]
[3: Reward: The right to freely choose the second layer of the Martial Hero Plane! Note: Only the first person to clear the plane world receives this reward. Others do not.]
[4: Reward: Ascension items you can carry: three weapons, three sets of clothing, three mounts, three hundred pieces of gold. Note: Other Ascenders can only have one weapon, one set of clothing.]
Ding Ling was speechless.
The rewards are almost unchanged.
Only weapons and clothing were changed from two pieces to three pieces.

sentences.text: "Why didn’t you step forward to thank Hero Ding when you saw him?"
Nun Dingyi looked at Yilin with some dissatisfaction.
Yilin was speechless, hesitant.
In her heart, she also felt some regret and remorse.
After Ding Ling left.
It was as if she finally awoke again, realizing she indeed owed Ding Ling a ’thank you’!
Owed him a debt of gratitude that had not been repaid!
"What should I do?"
Her mind was in a whirlwind.
Under the urging of Nun Dingyi.
She hesitantly chased out, but when she reached the mountain gate and looked out, Ding Ling and his companions were nowhere to be seen.
"Have they already left?"
Yilin felt lost and frustrated, her eyes slightly red with shame, understanding that this parting might mean she’ll never see Ding Ling again in this life.
She hadn’t repaid the favor she owed Ding Ling.
There were several times when she could have said thank you in person.
But it was her own timidity that ruined it.
"Hero Ding, I’m sorry..."
"Thank you."
A gentle breeze blew past.
Several weak notes lingered in the air, drifting with the scattered leaves toward the distance.
Ding Ling roamed from the southern window to the north for several months.
During this time of wandering.
He was teaching Zhang Hex, Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, and their group.
Because there was no shortage of Great Medicine.
And Zhang Hex, Qu Feiyan, and others had extremely high martial talent.
Although Lin Pingzhi was weaker, Ding Ling guided him in cultivating the Breathing Technique and Inner Power, always offering precise, deeply insightful, and always on-point guidance!
This also allowed him to have almost no unresolved problems in his cultivation path.
Without taking any wrong turns.
Everything went smoothly.
And on this day.
Ding Ling traveled throughout Jiuzhou.
After visiting several major sects.
He finally heard the notification sound.
[3: You must make your name as the world’s number one resound across the entire Plane World.
[Congratulations player Ding Ling, you have completed all the tasks on the Path of the Glory War God!]
[Overachieved task!
Would you like to redeem the Glory Medal now and proceed to a higher-level Martial Hero Plane World?]
Hmm?!
Ding Ling was surprised.
A few days ago, the task reached 99%.
Now it finally reached 100%.
Ding Ling was not surprised by this.
What surprised him was that the next level, that is, the Upper Realm of this world, was actually not the Xianxia World?
Still the Martial World?
"How many levels does the Martial World have?"
Ding Ling thought of the Grandmaster and Grandmaster Realm mentioned in martial novels.
And he was currently only at the Innate Realm.
His eyelid twitched twice, and he pondered:
"Could it be that the Martial World has three levels?"
If the martial world has three levels.
Then how many levels would the Xianxia have?!
"There is a long way to go."
Ding Ling didn’t think too much.
He had stayed in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World for just under a year.
For other martial worlds, progress was likely to be faster, and it was probably the same principle.
"Especially now that I have both Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi and True Qi, going to other martial worlds, even if not sweeping them, defeating typical Innate Experts poses absolutely no problem."
’In such circumstances.
Accelerating progress is definitely feasible.’
Thinking so.
Ding Ling felt relieved.
There are quite a few Divine Skill Secret Manuals in the martial world, learning them and solidifying the foundation is undoubtedly beneficial for his Martial Dao journey.
Just like these past few months.
He roamed Jiuzhou.
Examining countless second-class and third-class Inner Power Secret Manuals, palm techniques, Saber Techniques, and others.
Now his True Qi could achieve a perfect state where the intent arrives with the Qi.
Better than commanding at will, reaching even a higher state!
With a mere thought.
True Qi could rise abruptly, sweeping out like a storm, its speed far surpassing before, and the utilization rate of True Qi is also far superior to before.
This is the advantage of deep foundations.
Just like a building, the more stable the foundation, the sturdier the building stands, and vice versa.
"The task is over."
Ding Ling thought for a moment.
And decided to set the path of the Celestial Ladder ten miles from Chang’an City.
When he galloped to this place, he was surprised to find.
There was also a pavilion here.
But compared to the pavilion in the Three Kingdoms World.
This one is newer and more spacious.
Ding Ling walked into the pavilion, his expression slightly dazed.

At this moment, it was as if he had returned to the Three Kingdoms, back to the moment when he first cleared the Celestial Ladder, with Diao Chan and the other girls looking at him with slightly red eyes.
Ding Ling let out a long sigh.
Without thinking much.
He turned to the message notification from earlier:
[Overachieved task!
Would you like to redeem the Glory Medal now and proceed to a higher-level Martial Hero Plane World?]
"Yes!"
He clicked ’Yes’!
[Redemption successful!]
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane Experts: 63/20.]
After defeating the three from the Sword Sect and Feng Qingyang.
Ding Ling also defeated Tong Baixiong, Yue Buqun and his wife, Nun Sanding, the Mount Tai Sect experts, and so on.
So the task progress improved significantly.
[Task 1.
Obtain Glory Medal 1.
Honor bonus 315%.
Glory Medal final count: approximately 3 pieces.]
In the Three Kingdoms, it was 375%, thus gaining 4 pieces.
Here it’s directly 3 pieces.
It seems the task’s Glory Medal is also rounded off.
Ding Ling saw this and continued reading.
[2, You must defeat the strongest in the plane.
Prove you are the true world’s number one.
Progress 100%]
[Task 2: Obtain 1 Glory Medal]
[3: You must make your name as the world’s number one resound throughout the entire plane world.
[Task 3: Obtain 1 Glory Medal]
The final number of Glory Medals obtained is: 5.
[Glory Medal settlement completed.]
[Would you like to open the Path of Glory now?]
The familiar rhythm and reminders.
Ding Ling clicked ’Yes’!
[The Path of Glory is about to open.
Please choose the location to place the Path of Glory.]
[Friendly Reminder: The Path of Glory is the Tongtian Road...]
The friendly reminder was exactly the same.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate much, opened the character panel, and clicked again.
[Confirm selection of the ancient pavilion outside Chang’an City?]
Confirm!
[Selection completed.
Cannot be changed again!]
Boom!
The next instant.
Thunder exploded.
The world changed color.
Heaven and Earth seemed to swirl completely at this moment!
Flipping over.
Rumbling!
Dark clouds covered the sky, a Thunder Dragon appeared out of thin air in the sky, roaring amidst the rolling clouds.
A scene almost identical to the Three Kingdoms World appeared.
Everyone was shaken by it.
Although Zhang Hex and Taishi Ci had seen similar scenes, witnessing it again still gave them a feeling of being watched by a Celestial God, a sense of insignificance.
They took a deep breath, suppressed their inner discomfort, and watched with burning eyes.
Thunk!
A divine light broke through all darkness, shattered the Thunder Dragon, pierced through the clouds, and descended into the world at lightning speed!
Whoosh!
This light strikingly resembled the Celestial Ladder.
It extended from the horizon to Ding Ling’s feet, landing in front of him.
Ding Ling glanced at Qu Feiyan and the others.
Qu Feiyan’s eyes were slightly red, her lips trembling, but she seemed unable to speak for a moment.
Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, and Huang Zhonggong’s group were still in shock, pale.
Ren Yingying and Ren Woxing rushed over just in time to join Ding Ling in the final moments, but did not expect to see this scene, each of them was shaken to their core.
Ren Yingying thought that this farewell might mean eternal separation between celestial beings, and couldn’t help but exclaim ’Hero Ding’!
Her cry.
Startled Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan, and others back to their senses, all calling ’Master’ ’Brother Ding’.
Ding Ling smiled gently, comforting everyone a few words, and then shifted the topic, saying:
"Cultivate well.
I still have a chance to return to this world."
The Three Kingdoms has a chance to return.
There’s no reason The Smiling, Proud Wanderer wouldn’t have a chance to return.
Ding Ling had already told Zhang Hex and his group about this.
Thus, although Zhang Hex’s group was reluctant, they were better off compared to Qu Feiyan and others.
"When will we meet again?"
"You all should cultivate well.
When there’s no more progress to be made in this world or when faced with something truly unsolvable, then you can consider ascension.
Otherwise, you might wait.
Perhaps you’ll wait for me to return."
"Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan’s expression was firm:
"I will follow in your footsteps.
If you never return.
I will go to the Upper Realm to find you."

Note: Only the first person to clear the plane world receives this reward.
Others do not.]
[4: Reward: Ascension items you can carry: three weapons, three sets of clothing, three mounts, three hundred pieces of gold.

chapters.title: Chapter 391: New World Selection
paragraphs: Even though that’s the case.
Ding Ling had already mentally prepared for this, so it was still acceptable to him.
The opportunity to return to the world.
And the Martial Hero Plane World that only he could clear, were worth it.
This is a reward only the first place gets.
Even if the second place was just a second behind Ding Ling, they would still be far from this reward.
Ding Ling had experienced this once.
So the next step.
He did very smoothly.
Choosing items to take on ascension.
Ding Ling chose to carry the Heaven-Swaying Sword, the Giant Que Sword, and the Drumming Golden Hammer.
For clothing, Ding Ling chose a set of Chinese robes, a white suit, and an upper-class Celestial Silkworm Treasure Armor.
You could only choose from the items you already possessed. And after sweeping through the Qingcheng Sect and the Mount Song Sect, he had luckily acquired an upper-class Celestial Silkworm Armor.
Although called armor, it was actually very thin and worn inside.
It could be used for protection.
It was somewhat effective against general toxins, blades, and guns.
For his mount, naturally, he chose his own: two Ferghana Horses. As for the extra choice?
Ding Ling ignored it.
Without three Ferghana Horses, two were enough.
Three hundred taels of gold had already been packed into his storage pouch.
The selection just finished.
The two Ferghana Horses were once again swept up into this high sky.
They had experienced this once before, though a bit unsettled, they were much better than the first time, and upon seeing Ding Ling, they affectionately approached him as always.
Ding Ling patted their heads.
They obediently stood to the side.
Ding Ling glanced at the storage pouch.
What surprised him was.
The storage pouch that originally contained many things.
But now there were only three sets of clothes and three hundred taels of gold left.
"The second-class and third-class Cultivation Secret Manuals that were originally in the storage pouch are gone."
"Alas. It seems that this cheating method indeed isn’t viable."
"However, it seems the storage pouch can be taken along; that’s a big piece of good news."
Ding Ling discovered a ’highlight.’
"It seems that items purchased from the Gate of Glory can ignore the rules and directly ascend to other worlds!"
"If this is true, in the future, I can buy necessities with Achievement Medals!"
Ding Ling always keeps a significant portion of Achievement Medals to exchange for strength in the real world.
With the excess, he buys suitable items.
"Let’s continue onward then."
Ding Ling didn’t think any further.
He looked at the panel.
Sure enough, another message prompt appeared.
[Second Layer Martial Hero Plane: Romantic Swordsman, Dragon Gate Flying Armor, World of Divine Condor. Please choose one of the three.]
World of Divine Condor!
Ding Ling pondered for a moment and chose the World of Divine Condor.
The reason was simple.
The World of Divine Condor and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer are of the same lineage.
Ding Ling hadn’t learned the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, Nine Yang Divine Skill, Nine Yin Scripture, or Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill yet.
Moreover, he hadn’t excavated treasures from the Celestial Mountain Piaomiao Peak Lingjiu Palace ruins.
He chose this world naturally for these martial arts.
[Selection complete. The choice cannot be changed.]
[Would you like to spend 10 Achievement Medals and 1 Glory Medal to open the Gate of Glory?]
[Note 1: Once the Gate of Glory is opened, it cannot be reversed.]
The familiar routine.
The consistent reminder.
But surprisingly, the second layer of the Gate of Glory consumes the same amount of Achievement Medals and Glory Medals as the first layer.
Ding Ling pondered for a moment, then chose ’Yes’!
At the instant of making the choice.
Whoosh!
An explosion of eleven dazzling beams of light burst from Ding Ling’s body.
Exactly like what happened in the Three Kingdoms World.
Ten silver light medals formed a strange array imprint around a gold light medal, and with a thunderous sound, it branded onto the Gate of Glory.
Crack!
The Gate of Glory opened.
Ding Ling was slightly startled, this routine, these ’special effects,’ haven’t changed at all?
He stepped forward and pushed the great door open, taking a look.
What appeared before him were three boundless, profound, vast Heaven-Reaching Daos.
In the sky above the Daos, large golden characters hung in suspension.
From left to right, the golden characters clearly read: Romantic Swordsman, Dragon Gate Flying Armor, World of Divine Condor.
Ding Ling was engulfed in golden light, swept to the front of the World of Divine Condor Dao.
Accompanying him were the two Ferghana Horses.
"This process is really identical, only a bit more grandiose."
[Player is about to enter the World of Divine Condor Plane World.]
[Before entering, would you like to exchange for storage space or bone treasure?]
The prompt sounded again.
Ding Ling chose ’Yes.’
Whoosh!
In just an instant, beside the Heaven-Reaching Dao, unexpectedly appeared rows upon rows of endless Seven-Colored Glazed Chaos Counters.
Ding Ling had experienced this scene before.
He walked forward to take a familiar look.
As expected.
Not much different from the first time.
The majority of the treasures were still sealed with restrictions.
Ding Ling didn’t look at the other counters.
He went straight to the first counter.
’True First-Order Pill: 5 Glory Medals’
’True Second-Order Pill: 10 Glory Medals’
Even the treasures were exactly the same.
Without any changes.
Ding Ling felt slightly disappointed.
He glanced at his ’balance.’
[Achievement Medals: Common 48, E-level 7]
[Glory Medals: 4]
Not even enough to buy the most basic First-Order Pill.
He already had a storage pouch.
This time, Ding Ling didn’t buy anything.
He decided to save for now, and later use it for the second counter’s items or for stronger second-grade pills.
However, from this scenario, Ding Ling confirmed one thing.
"The treasures here are indeed limited. Once exchanged by someone, they cannot regenerate!"
Seeing the empty slot where he exchanged a ’First-Order Pill’ in the Three Kingdoms World, it remained empty, without regenerating.
It proves these treasures are truly non-renewable resources.
Truly first-come, first-served!
"Whoever can afford it first, buys it first, gains the profit."
Ding Ling breathed deeply, thinking:
"Looks like in the next world, I should conserve more Achievement Medals."
The Achievement Medals Ding Ling gained were actually quite a lot.
But exchanging strength to return to the real world consumes many.
Currently, having this many Achievement Medals left is already the result of Ding Ling’s efforts in farming medals.
"Let’s leave it at that then."
Ding Ling turned and stepped onto the Heaven-Reaching Dao leading to the World of Divine Condor.
[Player is about to enter the World of Divine Condor Plane. Please prepare.]
[Countdown.]
Boom!

Golden light surges mightily like a brocade piercing through the void, sweeping Ding Ling directly to the end of the Dao, then with a thundering sound, broke through a Plane Barrier, transmitting Ding Ling inside.
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
Outside Chang’an City.
At the pavilion.
Many people came upon hearing the commotion.
Seeing a Heavenly Ladder materialize out of thin air, they were astonished and shaken.
Qu Feiyan’s expression was somewhat dazed, gazing slightly upward at the Heavenly Ladder, her Heart Lake surging to its peak, she murmured softly:
"Brother Ding..."
She didn’t hear the familiar, comforting response.
Qu Feiyan thought of this farewell, unsure of when they might meet again, tears welled up in her eyes involuntarily.
Ren Yingying wasn’t much better off than Qu Feiyan.
She just held back more, but carried more regret within her heart:
"If I had been more proactive, would there have been a better outcome?"
"A hero of an era departs through the barrier."
Xiaang Wentian sighed deeply: "Perhaps when we meet again, Hero Ding will have indeed become a Human Martial God. Or maybe by then, we’ll already be old?"

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Zhang Hex vs Cheng Yaojin
paragraphs: Ren Woxing stroked his long, white beard, feeling exceedingly forlorn in his heart.
He was old now.
How long could he hold on?
Could he truly see Ding Ling again?
If he couldn’t witness the true pinnacle of the Martial Dao before dying, he would die with regrets.
"I wonder if I can set foot on this Celestial Ladder?"
Ren Woxing’s heart stirred, and he suddenly stepped forward, finding that he was really ascending the Celestial Ladder. His heart surged with excitement.
He stepped up the Celestial Ladder continuously for dozens of layers before turning back and laughing aloud:
"Looks like my journey hasn’t ended yet!"
Just thinking about the Sun and Moon Divine Sect.
He felt conflicted and hesitant again.
The Sun and Moon Divine Sect was his heart’s knot, compelling him to give up, which he really couldn’t do with ease.
"I’ll give it a try too."
Xiaang Wentian, Zhang Hex, and others all tried one after another and found they could do it too.
Even some passersby who caught up tried it.
Everyone discovered a fact.
That only those who reached First-class strength could set foot on this Celestial Ladder.
Zhang Hex and Taishi Ci exchanged glances, thinking:
"In the Lower Realm, we needed Super-Elite strength to step on this Celestial Ladder. But Super-Elite strength is equivalent to a First-class martial arts expert in this world.
And First-class martial arts experts, like Super-Elite Fierce Generals in the Lower Realm, vary in strength, some strong and some weak.
Now First-class experts can set foot on this Celestial Ladder.
We Super-Elite Fierce Generals can as well.
So it seems.
Ascenders from the Lower Realm have no fortune in this world. Can they continue following the Prince to ascend to an even higher realm?!"
This was something Zhang Hex and his group couldn’t have imagined.
Originally, they thought that a stronger power was needed for another ascension to the Upper Realm.
Now they found it unnecessary.
Their thoughts became more agile.
But at the sight of Qu Feiyan, they quelled the thought of immediate ascension. Even if they were to ascend, they must first comply with the promise made to the Prince!
Tap-tap-tap!
On the Celestial Ladder, someone was tap-tap-tapping all the way up, racing upwards at extreme speed, like Xun Wind flickering.
It was a Super-Elite Fierce General.
"It’s that guy Yuwen Chengdu."
Some players recognized:
"Unexpectedly, he’s in Chang’an City too. Is this because he found no fortune in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and abandoned the search to head to an even upper realm?"
"Not just Yuwen Chengdu. Some other fierce generals have also arrived. Judging by their expressions, they probably won’t stay in this world for long either."
Everyone was talking incessantly.
Zhang Hex and his companions no longer had the interest to stay here.
They immediately decided to return to Huashan together.
Huashan has Feng Qingyang.
Because Feng Qingyang greatly valued Ding Ling, and during discussions with Ding Ling, they often listened in, and over time, their relationship with Feng Qingyang became pretty good too.
Returning to Huashan this time,
Zhang Hex also had hopes of getting some guidance in sword skills from Feng Qingyang.
After all, Ding Ling earlier especially asked Feng Qingyang to look after Qu Feiyan and them.
Feng Qingyang also agreed.
Wheee-neeeigh!
Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, and Qu Feiyan rode horses together.
On the way.

Consort Yhu was absent-minded, her beautiful eyes occasionally looking towards the direction of the Celestial Ladder. Qu Feiyan glanced at her and understood that Consort Yhu was thinking about Xiang Yu, hoping to see Xiang Yu soon.
But at the moment, her heart was also lost and sad, and she lacked the energy to comfort Consort Yhu, just sitting listlessly on horseback, letting the top-class steed carry her forward.
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a sharp arrow flew from the sidelong, aiming straight at Qu Feiyan’s forehead!
"How daring!"
Taishi Ci had kept Ding Ling’s instructions in mind, and though eager on the journey, he stayed vigilant, his eyes and ears constantly attentive.

At this moment, seeing a sneak attack with an arrow, he immediately burst with rage, activating the Flying Swallow Technique, Ascending Skill, combining the inner qi of Pure Yang True Skill and the vigorous qi of the Breathing Technique, boom!
His speed rapidly increased by tenfold, making Taishi Ci seem like a ghost, leaping from the horseback, a long spear quivering!
Clang, clang, clang!
The spear blossomed into flower-like flourish and blocked right in front of Qu Feiyan, bang!
A crisp sound.
The spear flower shattered the hidden arrow.
Hmm?!
Zhang Hex then saw the attacker, a brawny man wielding a massive axe:
"Seeking death!"
He was furious, thrusting his spear and rushing forward on his horse.
"Humph!"
The brawny man wasn’t afraid and casually hung his bow at the side of his horse, wielding a giant axe, riding towards Zhang Hex as well.
They soon approached each other.
They swung their weapons simultaneously.
One had a sharp spear, thrusting with nine blossoming spear flowers, each seeming to captivate the soul, targeting the opponent’s vital points!

The other had an intimidating giant axe, hacking directly at Zhang Hex’s head. After Zhang Hex dodged the first move, it unpredictably swung up again like Ghost Tooth-Picking, seemingly about to scrape away Zhang Hex’s face!
Zhang Hex broke into a cold sweat, but after dodging the second move, the opponent’s axe spun yet again, smoothly swiveling the axe blade towards Zhang Hex’s ear!
Seeing Zhang Hex about to lose an ear.
Whoosh!
Taishi Ci pulled back his bowstring, the arrow bursting forth like a storm, blasting straight towards the brawny man’s forehead.
Clearly.
Taishi Ci was repaying the combat style with its own method!
The brawny man was startled, hastily blocking with his axe!
Bang!
Arrow and giant axe collided.
The brawny man’s giant axe slightly trembled yet remained unscathed.
But he seemed to realize the futility of the sneak attack this time, cast a deep glance at Zhang Hex and Taishi Ci, decisively turned his horse to leave.
"You think you can leave!"
Zhang Hex, furious beyond measure, spun his spear and gave chase on horseback:
"Cheng Yaojin, since you’re here today, don’t even think of leaving!"
Zhang Hex recognized the attacker.
Ding Ling had once specially advised them.
Mentioning the characteristics of the fierce generals from Li Shimin’s faction in the Sui and Tang World.
Among them, Cheng Yaojin’s Three Axes: Split Head, Ghost Tooth-Picking, Ear Gouging!
Each move was lethal, incredibly exquisite.
Like the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, it was an extremely similar axe technique!
Zhang Hex had exchanged battle experiences with Pan Feng.
He was extremely familiar with the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
But unexpectedly faced with this storm-like trio of attacks, he was caught off guard!
Thinking of Ding Ling’s advice and almost being defeated by Cheng Yaojin right now, he felt ashamed and mortified!
Since receiving the Divine Skill from Ding Ling, his power had improved rapidly, yet he nearly got careless and injured by the opponent.
How could he tolerate it?
The most intolerable was the opponent’s attempt to kill Qu Feiyan, which truly touched Zhang Hex’s inverted scale!
Qu Feiyan was someone the Prince protected!
If anything happened to her.
How could Zhang Hex face the Prince!
Thinking this,
Zhang Hex let out a long roar, suddenly leapt off his horse, kicking off the horse’s back, activating the special vigorous qi from the fusion of vigorous qi and inner qi!
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 393: Taishi Ci vs Six Immortals of Peach Valley
paragraphs: Zhang Hex utilized the Lightweight Ascension Technique and Flying Swallow Technique, his entire being shot out like a cannonball, flying over dozens of meters. In mid-air, his long spear aimed directly at Cheng Yaojin!
Clang clang clang!
Zhang Hex performed his signature skill, the Five-Tiger Soul-Devouring Spear!
As the spear thrust forward, the faint sound of tiger roars and thunder could be heard, showcasing the spear’s ultimate potential!
Cheng Yaojin turned to glance at Zhang Hex, seated on horseback, he let out a loud shout and swung his axe back, clang clang clang!
The long spear and giant axe clashed briefly.
Cheng Yaojin, struggling, tilted over, finding it difficult to sit steadily, rolled off his saddle and fell to one side.
Thud thud!
Zhang Hex, unyielding, landed, his unique Fusion Qi of Vigorous and Inner Qi operating wildly, his spear trembling with a remarkable force, igniting fireworks from the void.
Cheng Yaojin was shocked, realizing he had been too reckless, but he wasn’t without options, he shouted loudly, ’Brother Linghu’!
Whoosh!
A sword was thrown from a slanting angle, straight toward Zhang Hex’s back.
Taishi Ci, arriving on horseback, was furious at this sight, but was too late to save, he could only warn Zhang Hex to be careful.
Zhang Hex was poised to strike Cheng Yaojin with his spear, but upon hearing Taishi Ci’s voice, he leaped aside like a flying swallow, narrowly evading the sword.
He looked to where the sword came from and saw a young man, ragged and desolate, standing behind a large tree.
The man held another sword in his hand.
Evidently, it was this man who had thrown the sword.
Qu Feiyan recognized him and couldn’t help but scold:
"Linghu Chong, you scoundrel!"
"Ha ha..."
Linghu Chong, with a wine gourd at his waist, coldly regarded Qu Feiyan and her group:
"I’m shameless? You outnumber us and want to kill my friend Cheng Yaojin. And you call me shameless? Who’s truly shameless?"
"I didn’t expect the Huashan Sect to produce a disciple like you. No wonder Yue Buqun expelled you from the sect!"
Huang Zhonggong frowned:
"With such unruly behavior, unable to distinguish right from wrong, how could your master and his wife not be heartbroken or angry?"
"Don’t talk to me about Huashan Sect."
Linghu Chong gripped his treasure sword, his eyes like lightning, scanning the crowd, both sorrowful and bitterly saying:
"Due to your reckless interference, I can never return to the Huashan Sect."
"What does that have to do with us?"
Consort Yhu was stunned, utterly puzzled.
"Stop wasting words with him."
Zhang Hex, full of killing intent:
"If you want to kill us, be prepared to be killed by us. Let’s finish them off first before talking!"
"Ha ha..."
Linghu Chong laughed:
"Don’t think you have more people."
He clapped his hands.
Swish swish!
From behind other trees, or atop them, figures leaped and emerged.
Among them were the renowned Six Immortals of Peach Valley and the Black and White Heroes.
Each of them exuded ominous Killing Qi.
Some had striking appearances, others were fierce and evil, widely known among martial heroes through player exaggeration, few in the martial arts world didn’t recognize them!
Zhang Hex, having traveled Jiuzhou with Ding Ling, naturally recognized these people, he was both angry and furious, and with no more restraint, he charged forward with his spear:
"I want to see if you’re stronger, or if we are!"
Taishi Ci didn’t hesitate either, charging toward the Six Immortals of Peach Valley.
Huang Zhonggong and the others exchanged glances and, with no hesitation, rushed at the Black and White Heroes!
Boom!
A fierce battle ensued.
Once the fight began.
It immediately entered a white-hot phase.
Looking around.
On the left battlefield, Cheng Yaojin and Linghu Chong cooperated to fight Zhang Hex.
Linghu Chong’s treasure sword dazzled, each move was like antelope’s horns, striking from unimaginable angles!
The sword technique of Dugu Nine Swords!
Attacking wherever the enemy can be saved!
To the utmost sharpness!

Every time Zhang Hex clashed hard with Cheng Yaojin, making Cheng Yaojin’s palm tremble, Linghu Chong would suddenly thrust at Zhang Hex’s weak spot, causing Zhang Hex to struggle, forced to shift between attack and retreat.
Momentarily, it was an evenly matched battle.
Meanwhile, Taishi Ci was fiercely dominant, his talent and aptitude extremely high!
Having learned true skills and lightweight techniques from Ding Ling, constantly receiving Ding Ling’s guidance, his abilities now reached the Transformation Realm.

He entered the group of Six Immortals of Peach Valley, although each had deep Inner Strength and bizarre moves, Taishi Ci, with his long spear, charged left and right, and his breathing technique and fusion of Inner Power and Vigorous Qi adhered to the spear, explosively emerging, causing the Six Immortals to stagger back, shouting strangely.
"There!

Taishi Ci’s spear trembled, the spear flower dazzling as the fusion Qi explosively intensified tenfold, boom! A mighty force pierced into Peach Root Immortal’s skull, shattering it on the spot, leaving him dead without a scream.
"Ah!"
The other Five Immortals were enraged, crazily charged at Taishi Ci, as if to tear his limbs apart!
"Ha!"
Taishi Ci glared like a tiger, erupting with his ancestral Divine Spear Technique, boom boom boom! Together with tenfold power, sweeping horizontally, crackle snap!
Several Peach Valley Immortals flew out on the spot.
Another immortal rushed, but Taishi Ci swung his spear, killing him under the horse.
"Ha ha..."
Taishi Ci let out a long howl, galloping toward the fallen immortals the six Peach Valley. With his mastery, now explosively exerting tenfold Qi, he was unstoppable, invincible.
Within breaths, he caught up with the others, killing them all with one or several thrusts.
The Six Immortals of Peach Valley.
Each was a first-class expert of the time!
Yet they were killed so easily.
The Black and White Heroes were aghast and turned to flee.
Taishi Ci nocked an arrow, wielded the special fusion Qi technique, an arrow burst forth like a storm, with a whizz, nailing the Black and White Heroes, killing them instantly.
But just a moment.
The situation reversed.
Our side greatly improved.
Zhang Hex refreshed with vigor, wielding his spear with increasing ease, his sporadic explosive Qi pressured Cheng Yaojin.
If not for Linghu Chong’s occasional surprise attack with the Dugu Nine Swords on Zhang Hex, Cheng Yaojin might have been killed already.
But now Linghu Chong, seeing the Six Immortals all dead.
Taishi Ci ready to point his spear and charge, felt fear, quickly said:
"Brother Cheng, it seems we’re having a hard time."
"You retreat!"
Cheng Yaojin gritted his teeth:
A tiger’s roar, he charged at Zhang Hex:
"I’ll hold Zhang Hex! You must leave quickly!"

chapters.title: Chapter 394: Linghu Chong Is Bound and Brought Before Feng Qingyang
paragraphs: Linghu Chong hesitated.
However, Cheng Yaojin was already locked in a life-and-death struggle with Zhang Hex.

He looked like a mad bull, wielding the giant axe with the unpredictability of an antelope’s horns, mastering the Three Axes of the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques to perfection and using them with a transcendental skill, executed with exquisite precision.
Yet, no matter how exceptional his skills are.

Zhang Hex’s Spear Technique was equally formidable, combined with the various Divine Skills and Secret Techniques taught by Ding Ling. The fusion of the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi and Inner Power exploded his combat strength by five or tenfold.
Cheng Yaojin couldn’t withstand it at all!

During each clash and collision of weapons, Cheng Yaojin felt as if he were struck by lightning, his palm trembling violently. After several rounds, his tiger’s mouth had already fractured, unable to hold on, his weapon was swept away, and Zhang Hex’s spear, lightning-fast, executed a spinning thrust!
Thud!
It pierced through the chest!
Cheng Yaojin clutched the spear tightly with one hand, reaching out to grab Zhang Hex’s face with the other. Zhang Hex took a step back and forcefully pulled out the spear!
Thud!
Another crisp sound.

A gaping, bloody hole appeared on Cheng Yaojin’s chest. He glanced at Zhang Hex and then at Linghu Chong, who was rushing over with a sword and a face full of horror, and gave a bitter smile. His towering body knelt to the ground like a collapsing mountain, slowly closed his eyes.
He had ascended to achieve great deeds with Li Yuanba, Qin Qiong, and others, but failed to find Qin Qiong, only to receive news of Li Yuanba’s demise.
No matter what.
He had to avenge Li Yuanba.
But he was far from Ding Ling’s match.
Therefore, after leaving Huashan, he befriended heroes and joined forces with figures like the Six Immortals of Peach Valley, the Black and White Heroes, and Linghu Chong.
Believing this ambush would certainly succeed.
To kill Qu Feiyan and others.
It would have been a significant blow to Ding Ling.
Unfortunately...
He overestimated their strength and underestimated Zhang Hex and Taishi Ci’s capabilities.
These two were personally taught by Ding Ling for months, and with ample Great Medicine, their combat power was probably several times greater than in the past!
But Cheng Yaojin had no such expert guidance, groping his way along, his Inner Strength disastrously lacking, how could he withstand Zhang Hex’s spear?
"To die like this, I truly feel unwilling."
Cheng Yaojin’s mind became increasingly ethereal.
"If I too had guidance from such an expert like Ding Ling, I definitely wouldn’t have lost to Zhang Hex!"
This was his final thought before death.
"Ah!"
In his trance, he seemed to hear Linghu Chong roaring:
"Zhang Hex, I’ll fight you to the end!"
Linghu Chong ah...
Cheng Yaojin sighed softly.
Then he completely perished, returned to darkness.
Ah!
Linghu Chong roared, charging at Zhang Hex, swinging a treasure sword, the sword light shining brilliantly, the sword moves wondrous and strange!
Clang clang clang!
But Zhang Hex remained unfazed, raised his spear, and thrust it straight ahead, nearly knocking Linghu Chong’s sword out of his hand in an instant!
Without Cheng Yaojin to mainly attack Zhang Hex.
Only providing support, relying on the Dugu Nine Swords to roam the world, how could Linghu Chong be a match for Zhang Hex?
Zhang Hex raised his hand, used a bit of force, and thrust again.
Clang clang clang!
This thrust was ever-changing, spear flowers blossomed as he chose to clash hard with the opponent’s treasure sword!
Whoosh whoosh!

The enormous force transferred from the spear’s shaft to the sword’s blade, and in an instant, Linghu Chong’s palm couldn’t hold steady, the sword flew from his hand, and then in another instant, thud!
He was already pinned to the ground by Zhang Hex’s spear.
His entire arm was pierced through, blood gushed out, and the intense pain caused Linghu Chong to cry out.
Zhang Hex was about to finish him off.
But Qu Feiyan suddenly spoke up:
"Zhang Hex, he’s a disciple of Elder Feng, and this, I think it’s better to leave him for Elder Feng to handle."
"...Fine."
Zhang Hex thought about it and agreed.
After all, they were going to seek sword instruction from Feng Qingyang.
At Huashan for a period of secluded practice.
It would be unwise to antagonize Feng Qingyang because of this fool Linghu Chong.
"Bind him to a horse and send him back to Huashan."
The group made the decision.
They tied up Linghu Chong.
Linghu Chong wanted to struggle, but was knocked unconscious by a hand chop from Zhang Hex!
He wouldn’t indulge Linghu Chong.
Because of Feng Qingyang’s connection, Linghu Chong escaped death.
Others didn’t have this connection.
Chased and killed by Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, and others, they all were wiped out like falling leaves in the autumn wind.
"A group of Green Forest bandits that rampage and harm one side, or Black Dao experts who kill like flies! Or insane old men.
Even dared to ambush us.
Really ignorant!
Zhang Hex looked at the bodies all around him and snorted coldly.

"This Cheng Yaojin had such great ability, able to gather so many heroes in just a few months, which shows his extraordinary charisma and eloquence. Having killed him, we must be even more cautious now."
Taishi Ci thought of the instructions from Ding Ling.
Zhang Hex nodded, and on the way back to Huashan.
They remained exceptionally vigilant, without a moment of slackness!
Who knows if more enemies will emerge secretly?
After all, there are plenty who want Ding Ling’s friends and family dead.
Fortunately, perhaps due to the previous slaughter deterring enemies from all sides, they dared not act rashly anymore.
Zhang Hex’s group smoothly returned to Huashan.
After handing Linghu Chong to Feng Qingyang,
They began their closed-door cultivation.
Feng Qingyang looked at the dejected, pale Linghu Chong and was very disappointed:

"Both learned the Dugu Nine Swords, Ding Ling’s fame spreads throughout the world, subduing all directions, the Shaolin Temple tightly shut its mountain gate, ten forces jointly honor him as the world’s number one!
And you?
Daily drunkenness, decay.
Linghu Chong, you really disappoint me."
"Martial Uncle."
Linghu Chong was ashamed, had no place to hide, he opened his mouth, seemingly wanting to explain.
"I don’t want to hear your explanations."
Feng Qingyang waved his hand:
"What you did was outrageous. Associating with a group of evil demons and even mixing with Demon Dao people who dared to eat people. Are you still a righteous disciple?
What about your standards?
Your integrity?!
Previously, you were close to people like Tian Boguang and that was it. But now you conspired with a group of evil demons to kill Ding Ling’s friends, what do you mean by that?!"
"Cheng Yaojin wasn’t an evil demon outcast."
Linghu Chong couldn’t help but say:
"He was righteous and brave, generous and open-minded, a rare good man. He was besieged and chased by Zhang Hex and others, and seeing that, I couldn’t stand it..."
"Enough, enough."
Feng Qingyang waved, sighing:
"Enemies and us are irreconcilable. No matter how good Cheng Yaojin was, he was still our enemy. You stood with the enemy, which means you disregarded me, Feng Qingyang.
You may leave now."

chapters.title: Chapter 395: Quanzhen Sect
paragraphs: Feng Qingyang stood with his hands behind his back, letting out a long sigh, seemingly disinterested:
"I don’t want to see you anymore."
"But, Elder Martial Uncle, Cheng Yaojin is Ding Ling’s enemy. How could he be our enemy?!"
Linghu Chong fell to his knees, unwilling to leave, even more unwilling to believe this fact.
"Ding Ling and I have long become confidants through Sword Dao. His enemies are my enemies, do you understand?"
There was a period of daily discussions on the Dao with Ding Ling.
Feng Qingyang was completely won over by Ding Ling.
From the bottom of his heart, he regarded Ding Ling as a friend, a confidant, rather than a disciple.
"Elder Martial Uncle, Ding Ling is not your disciple?"
Linghu Chong was shocked.
"I am not qualified to be his master."
Feng Qingyang frowned and reminded him:

"Ding Ling’s talent is unparalleled in the world, few can match him, no, it should be said that from ancient times to the present, it’s almost impossible for anyone to surpass Ding Ling’s talent in Sword Dao.
He is such a prodigy.
How dare I be his master? Being able to discuss the Dao with him is a blessing of three lifetimes."
Hearing Feng Qingyang praise Ding Ling so highly,
Linghu Chong’s body trembled violently, his face turning increasingly pale and ugly.
He found Ding Ling displeasing to the eye and had several times thought of competing in sword fighting with him.
But now hearing Feng Qingyang’s words.
If they really competed in sword fighting.
Wouldn’t Linghu Chong just be humiliating himself?
Thinking of this,
Linghu Chong felt incredibly uncomfortable and oppressed, nearly spitting out a mouthful of thick blood.
"Take care of yourself."
Feng Qingyang waved his sleeve, his figure shifted, and in an instant, he was gone like a breeze from the spot.
"Elder Martial Uncle!"
Linghu Chong shouted several times, but Feng Qingyang’s figure was nowhere to be seen.
He rose dejectedly, stumbling down the mountain, encountering Fan Kuai midway.
Fan Kuai scanned Linghu Chong disdainfully and contemptuously, brushing past him.
Linghu Chong, agitated, instinctively called out ’you’, but was sent flying a yard away by a backhand palm wind from Fan Kuai:
"Seeing you makes me sick, get lost!"
Fan Kuai shouted:
"If it weren’t for Elder Feng’s sake, you’d be a corpse by now!"
Linghu Chong’s expression changed slightly, but he knew Fan Kuai wasn’t lying.
Staying here indeed made him neither fish nor fowl.
His heart was bitter.
Yet he didn’t think he was wrong.
The Cheng Yaojin he befriended was such a hero. Now even he was dead.
What more could he do?!
Shortly after leaving Reflection Cliff.
He encountered his little martial sister. Before he could speak, she brightened up, and charmingly called out:
"Senior Brother."
"Little Martial Sister."
Linghu Chong felt a slight joy and was about to step forward when he saw Yue Buqun coldly watching from the side, making him feel as if doused in cold water, and he turned to leave resentfully.
"Is this okay?"
Ning Zhongze felt for Linghu Chong:
"After all, we raised him. Can’t we forgive him just this time?"
"How many times have we forgiven him?"
Yue Buqun thundered in anger:
"I long decided to designate him as the next Sect Leader of the Huashan Sect! But how did he repay me? Befriending that filthy thief Tian Boguang was bad enough.
Entangled with Yilin of the Heng Mountain Sect, causing all sorts of foolish, reckless matters was dismissible.
Mixing with various Demon Dao people of the Jianghu!
Now he has even reached the point of intending to lay hands on Hero Ding’s friends and family!
If Hero Ding found out? It’d be intolerable!!
Hmph! He has long since fallen! I advised him over and over again. But he just wouldn’t listen.
I have no such disciple!
He’s not a member of the Huashan Sect!"
Ning Zhongze opened her mouth to say something, but in the end, couldn’t say anything.
For Linghu Chong had done indeed too many foolish things.
Wantonly and recklessly, disregarding consequences, only caring for his own carefree enjoyment.
Without thinking how hard it was for the Huashan Sect standing behind him.
"Alas."
Ning Zhongze sighed deeply.
Yue Lingshan stood in place, looking at the Yue couple, then back at Linghu Chong’s departing figure, feeling an unspeakable sadness and helplessness.
At this moment.
She thought of Ding Ling. If Ding Ling were here, wouldn’t this matter be easily resolved?
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World did not cease to operate because of Ding Ling’s departure.
On the contrary, it became more tumultuous and unpredictable.
Without Ding Ling, the world’s number one, to suppress!
And with Ascenders increasing in number.
The competition for Martial Arts Secret Manuals and Great Medicine occurred frequently, making the Jianghu increasingly chaotic.
As for this.
Ding Ling was unaware.
At this moment.
He had ascended to the world of the Divine Condor.
Neighing!
Two Ferghana Horses neighed loudly, echoing in all directions!
Ding Ling looked around.
He was surprised to find that this time, the place of ascension was different from the first time in the wilds.
It seemed to be within the Main Hall of a Daoist Temple.
This main hall was extremely spacious and magnificent, with the high rear enshrining the statues of The Three Pristine Ones.
Ding Ling held a Drumming Golden Hammer, pondering for just a few seconds, secretly guessing where this place might be.
Thump, thump, thump!
A series of rapid footsteps approached from not far away.
And the distance grew ever closer.
Ding Ling turned to the sound.
He saw the tightly closed main hall door suddenly pushed open, revealing daoists holding swords beyond the hall.
Their numbers were uncertain.
But at this moment, everyone’s faces bore indignant expressions.
The leading person’s chin had three strands of drifting long whiskers, his visage yin-soft, his eyes were slightly narrowed, emitting cold glints as if a venomous snake ready to strike.
Ding Ling saw him.
And he naturally saw Ding Ling. Compared to other daoists, he was much more composed, calmly remarking:
"Form the array."
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!

The daoists behind him quickly leapt out with their swords, and in no time, they set up a continuously and smoothly flowing Sword Array, concealed with killing intents and surging with Evil Qi to the sky!
Ding Ling’s foundational knowledge of Array Dao was extraordinary; with a mere glance, he recognized this Sword Array as a top-level Array among Middle Tier Sword Arrays.
Even as a Middle Tier Array Dao Full Level person like him, deciphering it might not be an immediate thing.
With this in mind.
Ding Ling let out a long howl, his voice piercing the heavens, causing the daoist’s ears to resound like thunder, and in that instant, everyone present changed their expressions.
Ding Ling seized the moment to ask:
"Who are you? And how have I offended you?"
"Heh heh."
The leading daoist sneered unapologetically, pointing his sword at Ding Ling, and instead of answering, scornfully said:

"For someone as young as you with such formidable skills, regardless of your prowess, today you won’t withstand our Quanzhen Sect’s Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array! Don’t think that by shouting loudly, I’ll be afraid of you. Attack!"
With his command,
The daoists swiftly ran within the array, moment after moment, sword qi surged like a sea, transforming into dazzling sword lights shooting towards Ding Ling from a distance.
Ding Ling frowned, raising the Drumming Golden Hammer in his hand. Under the fusion of Vigorous Qi and True Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 396: Zhao Zhijing’s Death! Quanzhen Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: Boom!
The Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique was fully activated, turning into what seemed like Mjolnir descending from the skies, smashing forward with a boom!
It shattered the streams of sword light rushing towards it.
"This?!"
The leading Daoist was shocked:
"Such hammer technique."
In his astonishment, he shouted loudly in feigned confidence:
"Attack! Give it your all, you must kill him! He’s young, there’s no way he could reach Guo Jing’s level of mastery! Do not fear, charge!"
Quanzhen Sect.
Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array.
Guo Jing...
Names flickered across his mind.
Ding Ling understood.
The Daoists before him were likely Zhao Zhijing, Yin Zhiping, and others.
He didn’t expect that upon ascension, he would land here.
Moreover, these Daoists were shouting to attack, not letting him explain.
Clang clang clang!

The Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array was fully activated, the sound of swords resonating continuously, and streams of sword light crisscrossed in the void, weaving into a net, pressing down on Ding Ling!
"Good!"
The leading Daoist was delighted at this, laughed aloud, and joined the sword array himself, leading the charge against Ding Ling with swift, aggressive attacks!
With momentum to pierce and shatter everything, accompanied by the rushing sword light, it surged towards Ding Ling as if intending to smash him to pieces!
"What a vicious person, he really intends to kill me."
Ding Ling saw clearly.
The leading Daoist showed no mercy, his moves aimed to kill, which meant...
There could be no blame for Ding Ling’s lack of compassion.

Ding Ling snorted coldly, the Breathing Technique’s vigorous qi and True Qi fused together and infused into the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, making the Drumming Golden Hammer in his grip feel weightless yet solid.
Ding Ling even sensed that the Drumming Golden Hammer harbored a frenzy power capable of destroying heaven and earth.
"This is the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!"
Ding Ling shouted clearly.
The Drumming Golden Hammer smashed heavily forward.
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
An enormous invisible phantom hammer manifested in the void, transforming into countless small mountains, crashing towards the sword array, accompanied by intense roaring sounds, crack!
The sword array’s death gate was the first to shatter.
With Ding Ling’s formidable cultivation?
How could a mere sword array formed by third-rate, second-rate warriors withstand his Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique?!
Once truly angered, when he unleashed his fury, even the death gate faced the brunt of his power, and was shattered instantly!
Ding Ling pressed his advantage relentlessly.
Now that enmity was established, there was no reason to hold back.
Bam bam bam!
He activated Ascending Skill, Flying Swallow Technique, wielding the Drumming Golden Hammer, charged left and right, overcoming all obstacles, leaving a trail of bloodshed!
No one was his match, not even for a single round.
Anyone struck by the Drumming Golden Hammer couldn’t even scream before turning into a pile of broken flesh!
With the leading Daoist’s terrified expression, Ding Ling advanced quickly like ’sailing through waves,’ killing his way to his front, and swung the hammer down on him.
"Ah!"
The leading Daoist couldn’t help but scream shrilly:
"I am Zhao Zhijing, number one among Quanzhen Sect’s third-generation disciples, you cannot kill me!"
Zhao Zhijing?!
Ding Ling hesitated slightly, and his hammer slowed somewhat.
Zhao Zhijing noticed clearly, hastily suppressing his fear, he quickly said:

"I am apprenticed under one of the Quanzhen Seven Elders, Wang Chuyi, and am Wang Chuyi’s chief disciple, the future Sect Leader of Quanzhen Sect. If you kill me, Jianghu will have no place for you in the future, sir, think carefully before acting!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling glanced at the scene, noticing there were scarcely any Daoists left, the ground covered with corpses and ’broken mud’!
The grand hall stained with a layer of filth and blood.
At this point.
Ding Ling was certain he was an enemy of the Quanzhen Sect.
Is there any reason to hold back?
Thinking this.

Ignoring Zhao Zhijing’s incessant chatter, he casually swung his hammer down, boom! With a fierce gust of strength, it instantly sent Zhao Zhijing flying ten zhang away, his body being ’ravaged’ by great force, unrecognizable.
Thud!
When he hit the ground, he had already become a heap of broken flesh.
Unless facing a body-refining giant.
Anyone daring to take the Drumming Golden Hammer head-on ended this way.
"Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array, merely so."
Initially, Ding Ling was shocked by the grand, surging momentum of the Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array.
Now it seemed.
It was merely a façade, appearing impressive but ultimately unimpressive.
Yet Ding Ling understood.
It wasn’t the Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array that was weak.
It was the people arranging the array that were too feeble.
He scanned the area, noticing a torn secret manual protruding from the clothing of a dismembered corpse.
He flicked it with his toe, sending the secret manual flying.
Ding Ling grabbed it, flipping through it swiftly.
In just a few breaths, he read through it page by page, scanning thoroughly.
A book instantly materialized in Ding Ling’s library.
In an instant.
[Quanzhen Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Dexterity +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Concepts, esoteric truths, and principles of Quanzhen Swordsmanship surged in his mind.
And soon after, they fused into instinct, ingrained in Ding Ling’s limbs and bones, throughout his body.
Ding Ling quickly mastered this Quanzhen Swordsmanship.
And smoothly reached the realm of Great Perfection.
"It’s actually a superior swordsmanship."
Ding Ling looked at the secret manual before him and casually tossed it into his Storage Pouch.
He hadn’t expected to gain a Quanzhen Swordsmanship here.

Moreover, judging by the sword technique’s essence and esoteric truth, it was indeed remarkable. Yet none of the Daoists truly unleashed the power of this superior swordsmanship, otherwise, Ding Ling wouldn’t have won so easily.

He glanced at the few remaining Daoists. Their faces were pale with terror, some pretended to be dead on the ground, others paralyzed with incontinence, and some with pale faces and darting eyes, contemplating escape.
But upon catching Ding Ling’s gaze, they instantly followed suit, sitting down to show their weakness and absence of hostility.
No one dared to move.
Afraid that if they moved, they’d be hammered by Ding Ling, and while being hammered wasn’t the worst, the issue was that once struck, they wouldn’t be recognized in death.
"Where did this murderous fiend come from? He kills without blinking!"
"It’s terrifying! Such an astonishing hammer technique, never heard of in the martial arts world! Who is he?!"
"That idiot Zhao Zhijing. He should’ve asked clearly earlier, yet didn’t even inquire before attacking this ferocious man, such foolishness!"
The remaining Daoists were deeply resentful towards Zhao Zhijing.
They recalled Zhao Zhijing’s earlier confrontation with Guo Jing, it seemed similar, resulting in a great battle.
Now, facing this peerless savage, he did the same.
