chapters.title: Chapter 397: Medical Saint Breathing Technique at Full Level! Level Up Again
paragraphs: This fiend lacks Guo Jing’s mercy and does not show any leniency.
Even after knowing Zhao Zhijing is the top disciple of Quanzhen Sect’s third generation and the future Sect Leader, he dared to kill him mercilessly.
This is too aggressive!
Too ruthless!
The remaining Daoists, some of whom are also third generation disciples, are now filled with extreme hatred towards Zhao Zhijing!
Even boasting about being the future Sect Leader couldn’t change his fate of being killed.
If they dare to make a move, how could they end up well?
They can only hope this fiend doesn’t notice them, either lying flat on the ground or showing extreme fear and anxiety.
"The Quanzhen Seven Elders seem to lack such earth-shattering techniques! Who exactly is this person?"
They rack their brains but can’t figure out the answer.
Ding Ling, however, doesn’t care about any of this.
After achieving full level Quanzhen Swordsmanship.
He became aware of the differences in this world.
After carefully sensing.
Sure enough.
The world is more solid now.
Even with his current level, it’s hard to cause the void to shake. In The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, at later stages, his every move could create ripples in space!
Yet, in this world, that’s not the case. It shows the stability, firmness, and other aspects are stronger.
Otherwise.
His four-dimensional attributes wouldn’t have grown again.
"I just don’t know what the limit of the four-dimensional attributes will be this time."
After realizing the growth in his four-dimensional attributes.
Ding Ling started considering collecting high-tier martial arts.

This Quanzhen Swordsmanship is clearly superior swordsmanship that is easy to learn but hard to master. In Wang Chongyang’s hands, it must be astonishingly powerful, but in these people’s hands, it proves to be vulnerable.
And Wang Chongyang’s martial arts are not limited to just Quanzhen Swordsmanship!
Ding Ling thought of the Path of Glory.
He couldn’t help but glance at the character panel.
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 26
Race: Human
Faction: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (Great Wei Kingdom) The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World (None) Divine Eagle World (None)
Occupation: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (First-Rank Prince) The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World (Hero) Divine Eagle World (Freelancer)
Level: 3 (Note: Congratulations on leveling up! Only qualified to continue unlocking paths to other worlds.)
Strength: [Bone Structure 2 (1 for ordinary people), Intelligence 3, Power 40.1, Agility 40.1, Constitution 40.1, Defense 40, Charisma 11. True Power Value: 6 points]
Weapons: Heaven-Swaying Sword, Giant Que Sword, Drumming Golden Hammer, Upper-Class Celestial Silkworm Armor, Tier Four Mortal Storage Pouch...
Mount: Ferghana Horse

Skills: Pine Wind Swordsmanship, Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship, Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, Gale Blade Technique, Lion’s Roar, Pure Yang True Skill, Absorption Technique, Seven-string Invisible Sword, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Taiyue Three Cyan Peaks Swordsmanship, Dugu Nine Swords, Tai Chi Scripture, Quanzhen Swordsmanship... ]
[Achievement Medal: Ordinary 48, E-grade 7]
[Glory Medal: 4]
[Path of Glory in World of Divine Condor not yet activated, activate now?]
Ding Ling saw the last line, thinking to himself, ’It’s the same pattern as before.’
He directly activated it.
[Activation Successful!]
[Since the player has chosen the Path of the War God. Once again opening the Path of War God Glory for the player!]
[The rules of the Path of the War God World here are as follows:
1, You must defeat more than twenty strong people of the Plane World. The more you defeat, the more glory bonus.
2, You must defeat the strongest person in the Plane World. To prove you are the genuine World’s Number One.
3, Your name as the World’s Number One must resound throughout the Plane World.
About a dozen rules in total.
Similar to the other two worlds before.
"Again, the World’s Number One. But it shouldn’t be too difficult."
Ding Ling remembered the first time he saw the task list during the Three Kingdoms. It really gave him a cold sweat then. It was too hard!
But thinking about it now.
One can only say.
Starting is the hardest.
After overcoming the initial hurdle, with his Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat, as long as he stays stable, nothing can truly challenge him.
"Time to leave."
Ding Ling glanced around the grand hall.
Casually picked up a few decent-looking treasure swords and put them in the storage bag.
He was about to leave.
But suddenly he remembered that in this world, he should still be able to cultivate another Breathing Technique.
He glanced at the library in his mind.
Sure enough.
The elusive ’Breathing Technique Secret Manual’ once again began to shine.
This time he chose the Medical Saint Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
Instantly.
[Medical Saint Breathing Technique Full Level]
[Charisma +0.7]
With an additional full level breathing technique.
Ding Ling could clearly sense the enhancement in his poison resistance, healing capability, and recovery ability once more.
Not only that.

With the operation of Five Great Breathing Techniques simultaneously, Ding Ling’s Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi is increasingly balanced and harmonious, perfectly meeting his needs! The enhancement in cultivation technique, swordsmanship, and others have improved significantly.
"Very good."
Ding Ling is quite satisfied.
Before having the constitution immune to all poisons.
Ding Ling hoped to crazily stack similar ’anti-poison, healing’ techniques!
In The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, he almost capsized in a gutter and deeply felt this.
One must stay stable!
"This time, it’s really time to leave."
From Ding Ling taking action against Zhao Zhijing and his group to achieving full level Medical Saint Breathing Technique.
The time spent was merely a fleeting moment.
No significant time was expended.
In such a brief period, it seems that other disciples of Quanzhen Sect haven’t yet realized the significant events that happened here.
Ding Ling, not wanting to engage further with the people of Quanzhen Sect, led his Ferghana Horse directly out of the grand hall.
Sitting on the ground, the unharmed disciples watched.
Excited and joyful to the point of nearly rising to thank the Ancestral Master Sanqing!
So many people dead, yet they survived; it’s simply a miracle of life!
However, they don’t know.
Ding Ling himself is not a bloodthirsty person.
As long as he is not provoked or angered, he won’t easily kill.
Zhao Zhijing harbored murderous intent towards Ding Ling and attacked extremely fiercely and aggressively; how could Ding Ling spare him?
Clip-clop!
Just as he stepped out of the main hall onto a small path, ready to leap onto his horse and leave.
A series of hurried footsteps approached from ahead.
Ding Ling looked in the direction of the sound, and saw a crowd of Daoists quickly running toward him, the leading chubby Daoist pointing at Ding Ling, his complexion pale, shouting sharply:
"That’s him! He’s the one who killed my master!"
"Lul Qingdu? Are you sure it’s him?"
The lead Daoist, seemingly handsome with a touch of righteous aura, scrutinized Ding Ling twice, somewhat incredulous:
"He’s so young."
"It’s him!"
Lul Qingdu pointed firmly at Ding Ling, saying confidently:
"After my master entered the main hall, he never came out again, and now he’s walked out; my master must have encountered misfortune. Just smell it."
Lul Qingdu sniffed, seeming to catch a scent, his pupils suddenly widened, and he exclaimed in fear:
"This thick smell of blood, many people must have died, he, he, he must have killed them!"
"Sir."
The handsome Daoist blocked Ding Ling:
"Who are you? Why did you suddenly appear in my Quanzhen Sect? Also, did you kill Lul Qingdu’s master Zhao Zhijing?"
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling looked askance.
"I am Yin Zhiping of Quanzhen Sect."
The handsome Daoist said seriously:
"Please clarify before leaving."
"You are Yin Zhiping."
Ding Ling thought of Yin Zhiping, the Dragon Knight, who was repeatedly cursed by countless netizens.
Is it him standing before me?
"Sir, do you know me?"
Yin Zhiping paused:
"It seems I’ve never met you."
Ding Ling did not respond, simply said:
"Indeed. I did kill Zhao Zhijing and his group. So what? Do you intend to stop me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 398: Battle at the Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array Once More
paragraphs: "Did you truly kill Zhao Zhijing and the others?"
Yin Zhiping took a step back, his face pale and his eyes filled with anger:
"Our Quanzhen Sect has never offended you, so why did you kill Zhao Zhijing and the others?!"
He waved his hand.
Swish, swish!
The daoists behind him drew their swords in unison, quickly forming a sword array that blocked Ding Ling’s path.
"Today, unless you clearly explain yourself and give an account to our Quanzhen Sect, don’t even think about leaving."
Yin Zhiping gestured for Lul Qingdu to check the direction of the Main Hall.
Lul Qingdu glanced at Ding Ling with fear, detoured three feet, and ran swiftly towards the Main Hall from a distance.
Ding Ling sighed.
If it had been Yin Zhiping who came to the Main Hall earlier.
Perhaps he wouldn’t have fought with the daoists of Quanzhen Sect at all.
Compared to the sinister and ruthless Zhao Zhijing, who would resort to killing without a word.
Yin Zhiping was obviously more reasonable, more refined, more civilized.
If he had initially met Yin Zhiping and explained everything, Ding Ling might already be close to walking out of Quanzhen Sect’s mountain gate.
Naturally, there wouldn’t have been all these absurdities.
But as for killing Zhao Zhijing.
Ding Ling did not regret it.
Zhao Zhijing wanted to kill him.
If he just stood there and let him kill, he wouldn’t be Ding Ling!
Therefore, at this moment, he faced Yin Zhiping with calm, only raising his Drumming Golden Hammer slightly, glanced at the daoists, and said:
"I’ve made it very clear already. I killed Zhao Zhijing. He wanted to kill me, so I naturally killed him. It’s that simple. You’re here with your array to kill me now?"
Ding Ling took a step forward.
Yin Zhiping, however, took a step back and shouted loudly, swish, swish!

The Celestial Spirit North Dipper Sword Array instantly activated, a mighty Sword Qi surged from the void, rushing back and forth within the sword array, stronger than the one formed around Zhao Zhijing.

"You killed someone from our Quanzhen Sect, not only do you not regret it, but you remain so composed, showing your heavy killing intent! I’m afraid your nature is beyond redemption. I, Yin Zhiping, and all the disciples of Quanzhen Sect will not let you leave today. Will you surrender willingly, or will we engage in battle?"
Yin Zhiping, with a stern face, said:
"If it’s fight, you’re likely to end up with broken limbs! If you surrender, perhaps you’ll have a better outcome."
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed loudly three times:
"To want me to surrender, that’s absolutely impossible. I advise you, if I do fight, I certainly won’t hold back.
"Hmph!"
Yin Zhiping, in fury, his handsome face turned blood red:
"You don’t repent, stubborn and unreasonable, showing you’re beyond hope. Since that’s the case, we have nothing to say."
He shouted, pointing his sword at Ding Ling.
Swish, swish, swish!
All daoists shouted together, their voice piercing the Nine Heavens, causing all the birds in the mountains to flap their wings and fly into the sky, clanging sounds!
The loud shout had barely landed.
A crowd of daoists pointed their swords at Ding Ling, the full power of the sword array activated, a torrent of Sword Qi converged into a Sword Sea pouring over Ding Ling.
It was like the Milky Way falling from the Nine Heavens, roaring, seemingly capable of destroying everything.
Ding Ling stood his ground, calmly watching.
To him.
This Celestial Spirit North Dipper Sword Array composed of numerous third-rate and second-rate experts was simply no match.
Moreover, his strength had now increased.

The Five Great Breathing Techniques and Pure Yang True Skill were simultaneously operating, amplifying the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, the explosive special Vigorous Qi seemed uncontrollable for Ding Ling.
"I’ve indeed become much stronger."
Ding Ling felt it clearly, the special Vigorous Qi infused into the Drumming Golden Hammer’s power had increased to a higher level than before.
At this level.
An increase of one level.
Was enough to easily destroy a group of second-rate experts!
"Ha!"
Ding Ling didn’t show any courtesy to Yin Zhiping and the others, Ascending Skill and Flying Swallow Technique activated by the special Fusion Qi, his speed was like lightning!
Whoosh, whoosh!

Ding Ling directly charged into the Celestial Spirit North Dipper Sword Array with his Drumming Golden Hammer, boom! The hammer collided with the Sword Sea of the Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array, erupting in thunderous explosive sounds.
The sound was so loud.
It drew many to watch from all around.
Among them was a graceful young teenager who had recently stepped out of an ancient tomb.
He was planning to descend the mountain to buy some ’rice’, after all, he had to cook every day, and his food in the tomb was running low.
Today happened to be his day to leave the tomb for groceries.
Unexpectedly.
Just after leaving the tomb, he heard the commotion on Zhongnan Mountain, something big was happening in Quanzhen Sect, numerous daoists gathered and headed there.
The sudden thunderous explosions and angry shouts made the young boy extremely curious.
He was evidently very familiar with Zhongnan Mountain’s terrain, in no time, he reached a hidden spot, climbed a tree, and watched from there.
What he saw.
Made his pupils shrink and gasp in shock.
He was utterly astonished; his handsome face was marked with ’incredible’ and ’unbelievable’!
He clearly saw.
A strapping young man only a few years older than him, holding a huge hammer, unstoppable, sweeping through the daoists in the Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array!
Wherever he went.
It was truly gruesome, bloody to the extreme!
With a random hammer swing, there wasn’t even a scream, and a daoist was directly smashed into a pulp!
Pow, pow, pow!
The young boy could clearly hear the booming sound of bodies being hammered with tremendous tension!
After a loud crash, a person was not just hammered flying, but when they flew, they would inevitably crash into five or six, seven or eight more.
This young man alone.
The unstoppable momentum was akin to the towering bravery of a massive iron cavalry charge!
At a glance, it made one instinctively fearful, then alarmed, fear arising from deep within.
It was the same for the young boy.
After watching.
He was more excited, thrilled, couldn’t help but silently clench his fists and cheer inwardly:
"Well done, well done! Truly satisfying! That’s how it should be!"
He had wanted to do this more than once or twice.
But his strength didn’t allow it, so he could only be beaten and chased away.
Recalling the humiliation and oppression suffered by Quanzhen Sect, and the death of his own Granny Sun.
The young boy gritting his teeth with hatred.
Seeing someone sweeping away the daoists of Quanzhen Sect like a sweep through an army.
Among them was Lul Qingdu, whom he detested most.
"Haha..."
The young boy almost burst into laughter:

"Good to see them dead, good to see them dead! These villains only bully the weak when there’s no strong presence, and now confronted by a mighty one, they’re nothing but slaughtered prey, ultimately, the world is survival of the fittest, the law of the jungle."
At this moment, the young boy seemed to comprehend deeply.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: Qiu Chuji
paragraphs: The young lad was naturally gifted and had an extraordinary comprehension ability.
At this moment, witnessing this battle.

He thought about the suffering and indignities he had endured for the past seventeen years; emotions surged in his heart, whether sadness, exhilaration, anger, warmth, or vigor...it was truly a whirlwind of emotions, an overwhelming mix of feelings!
But it was undeniable.
This battle.
Made him soberly realize one thing. In the face of absolute strength, what great sects, what Quanzhen Sect, what Celestial Spirit North Dipper Array, they were all like paper!
"This person is much more powerful than Uncle Guo."
The young lad watched as his Heart Lake was stirred with a thousand waves:

"I don’t even know where such a hero sprang from. Truly amazing, incredibly formidable. What is this Hammer Technique? With one strike, it’s as if even the Celestial Palace could be shattered, so overbearing. This is the martial arts a man should learn!"
The young lad clenched his fists, cheering loudly in his heart.
The martial arts he practiced with his aunt every day seemed effeminate in comparison, lacking any masculine spirit!
It’s this kind of Hammer Technique, Body Technique, that truly possesses a heroic spirit!
"This hero avenged my past enmities. I must find a way to invite him to the Ancient Tomb Sect as a guest!"
Thinking this way, the young lad stared with rapt attention, becoming more and more absorbed.
Boom!
Ding Ling slammed the final hammer down, amidst the shouts of "Spare him beneath the hammer!" he paid no heed—boom!
With one hammer strike.

Yin Zhiping was sent flying more than ten zhang away, crashing and knocking over more than ten people before collapsing to the ground, half of his body completely caved in, his chest not rising or falling, evidently breathing in but not breathing out.
"You, you..."
A man darted out from the side.

This man exuded Righteous Qi, his face firm and resolute, temples flecked with white, appearing around sixty or seventy years old, wielding a Treasure Sword. At this moment, he looked at Yin Zhiping with a face full of sorrow, then suddenly raised his head to look at Ding Ling:
"Beast, why do you massacre the innocent at my Quanzhen Sect!"
"They wanted to kill me. So, I killed them."
Ding Ling spoke the truth.
However, after a moment of sorrow, the old Daoist’s anger erupted, drawing his sword as he charged at Ding Ling:
"Fine, fine, fine. Today, let Qiu Chuji experience your great skill!"
Clang, clang, clang!

With his sword, the changes were ingeniously subtle, steadiness and precision; at times swift as lightning, at times dividing into nine sword shadows! Each sword appeared capable of piercing through a person’s body!

His movements were as fluid as flowing clouds and water, with high proficiency in Lightweight Skill. The sword in his hand was like his arm, striking wherever he intended, truly resembling an antelope’s horns, reaching the utmost divinity!
For ordinary people encountering this sword.
They might only retreat to reassess their strategy.
But not Ding Ling, he just stepped forward, placing the Drumming Golden Hammer horizontally in front of him, Peng!
Blocking this exquisite move.
Then swung the hammer down.
Ominous rumblings!
Phantom-like giant hammers fell densely from the sky, as if dozens of small mountains were simultaneously pressing down on Qiu Chuji!
Qiu Chuji was utterly astonished in his heart, at this moment, he seemed to awaken, his heart filled with regret and self-reproach, hating himself for being too careless and foolish.
Knowing well how fierce and formidable the opponent was, yet attempting to kill him single-handedly.
Utterly reckless.
But there was no time to retreat now.
He could only let out a tiger’s howl.
Channeling all his Inner Strength into the sharp sword, regardless of his own safety, he aimed a sword thrust at Ding Ling’s eyes, clearly with the intent of perishing together.
Ding Ling could not let him have his way.
With a strike from his right hand hammer.
His left hand slightly flickered, the Heaven-Swaying Sword was unsheathed, clang clang! A sword flicked out, the blade slanted upwards, precisely blocking the oncoming sword tip from Qiu Chuji.
And the Drumming Golden Hammer was also hammering down at that time.
Amidst the audience’s shrieks, roars, the mournful cries of ’Spare him beneath the hammer’.
Boom!
Qiu Chuji was knocked to the ground, half of his body caved in, his eyes turning from lively to ashen in an instant, he was struck dead on the spot.
The young lad watching from the tree was left utterly dumbfounded, awestruck like a Celestial Being!
In his eyes.

Qiu Chuji was already an almost god-like existence, yet now, a single hammer strike from this young man had killed him, what kind of earth-shaking power was this?! What kind of marvelous martial arts?!
All the other disciples of the Quanzhen Sect were consumed with grief, anger, and terror.
At this point.
Someone fiercely charged out:
"Avenge Daoist Qiu!"
Some retreated.
The fierce one got struck a few times by Ding Ling’s hammer and dropped dead on the spot.
Ding Ling’s resolute killing caused the entire scene to fall silent in fear.
"Wretched brigand!"

An elderly man, slightly stout but exuding Righteous Qi, with a carefree demeanor, around sixty or seventy years old, flew out from the side, witnessing this scene, he could not restrain his anger, letting out a long cry to the sky, then drew his sword to charge at Ding Ling:
"Face your death!"
Ding Ling frowned, moved his foot lightly, the fusion of Vigorous Qi erupted, boom! He suddenly appeared before the stout Daoist like a phantom, slamming down the hammer.
Boom!

It landed right on the Daoist’s Treasure Sword, shattering it into three pieces on the spot, not only that, the hammer’s Vigorous Qi erupted, smashing down, Peng! It struck the Daoist’s shoulder, instantly crushing the shoulder and also sinking half of his body.
"Senior Brother Hao!"
Someone screamed.
It was an aged female Daoist with a paper-white face but outstanding bearing.
She lifted her Treasure Sword, ready to charge forward, but was stopped by an elder with a long white beard, exuding an immortal and sage-like aura:
"Junior Sister Sun, cease!"
"Master Brother."
Junior Sister Sun glanced at the elder Daoist, her body trembling, uncertain if it was out of fear or anger, her face full of hatred as she looked at Ding Ling:
"He killed Senior Brother Qiu, Senior Brother Hao, we must seek revenge."
"Ugh!"
Her response was a sword drawn from its sheath.

It was the Heaven-Swaying Sword, which Ding Ling threw like lightning, in less than an instant, it struck Junior Sister Sun’s abdomen, the power attached to the Heaven-Swaying Sword was excessively immense, directly shooting Junior Sister Sun out for more than ten meters, pinning her onto a wall before coming to a stop.
"Rogue, rogue..."
Junior Sister Sun looked at Ding Ling with shock and unwillingness, struggled to utter a few words, then breathed her last.
The elder Daoist looked on with deep sorrow in his eyes, gripping the sword hilt, contemplating, taking a deep breath, then holding back, he looked at Ding Ling:
’Young Hero, please stop committing senseless slaughters!’
He paused, then spoke quickly:
"If there is anything we have offended you with, our Quanzhen Sect is willing to compensate you!"
"Hand over all the Martial Arts Secret Manuals of your Quanzhen Sect, and I’ll leave now."
"Don’t you think you’re going too far?"
The old Daoist was furious.
"Killing all of you, I can still search for those Martial Arts Secret Manuals."

chapters.title: Chapter 400: Sect Leader Ma Yu
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s expression was indifferent.
In any case, he’s already offended them to death.
He wasn’t afraid of offending them even more.
Both sides could be said to be at daggers drawn, and if the old Daoist dared to shout for a fight, Ding Ling would definitely strike first.
The old Daoist seemed to have noticed this too, and dared not say anything that might further anger Ding Ling, fearing he would start killing again without a word.
Too many people have died in the Quanzhen Sect today.
A great upheaval unprecedented in a century!
It opened in such a manner.
The old Daoist looked mournfully around the scene and saw several familiar figures swiftly approaching from one side of the side hall, and knew that a decision had to be made immediately.
Otherwise.
The sadness and anger of other junior brothers could provoke this fiend, and it wouldn’t be surprising if the Quanzhen Sect’s legacy ended in Ma Yu’s hands!
How could he face his master’s spirit in heaven?
How could he face the ancestors?
With these thoughts in mind.
Ma Yu made a decisive decision and solemnly said:
"The Martial Arts Secret Manual can be given to you. I just hope you don’t kill anyone anymore afterward. I’ll even beg you for this."
"As long as there’s no thought of killing me. I won’t kill anyone."
Ding Ling, holding the Drumming Golden Hammer, stood in place, emanating an aura vast and profound as the sea, with the demeanor of a Grandmaster:
"But if you intend to kill me, then be prepared to be killed by me!"
This has always been his principle.
If one doesn’t wrong me, I won’t wrong them.
If someone intends to kill him.
He will kill them!
"Very well."
Ma Yu suppressed the grief, sorrow, and anger in his heart:
"Let it be as you say!"
"Let it be as you say."
"Wait here for a moment."
Ma Yu scanned the remaining disciples of the Quanzhen Sect and shouted angrily:
"Why are you all standing there stunned, quickly gather the bodies of the deceased!"
After saying this.
He turned and dashed towards several of the old Daoists, intercepting them in time and dragging them to a corner.
What happened during this time.
Ding Ling did not know.
But he waited for less than half an hour.
Ma Yu came to him with a stack of Secret Manuals:
"These are all the Secret Manuals of our Quanzhen Sect replicas. Once you accept them, I hope you keep your word. Don’t kill anyone in our Quanzhen Sect."
Ding Ling accepted them and placed them into his Storage Bag.

Ma Yu watched as Ding Ling casually tucked them into his waist, and the stack of Secret Manuals vanished without a trace, his pupils shrunk, feeling even more alarmed and apprehensive, raising his guard against Ding Ling a hundredfold, daring not to anger or belittle him anymore.
The Daoists behind Ma Yu felt the same way, each one’s Heart Lake swirling with turbulent waves, unable to calm.
At this moment, they secretly rejoiced that they didn’t tamper with the Secret Manuals.
Otherwise.
This fiend might have once again massacred. Just thinking about it made them shiver all over.
"Da Da!"
After receiving the Secret Manuals, Ding Ling didn’t say a single word to Ma Yu and the others; he turned and left.
Two Ferghana Horses followed Ding Ling as he went, their hoofs clacking.
Until Ding Ling’s figure completely disappeared at the Quanzhen Sect’s mountain gate.
Whew!
Only then did Ma Yu and the others completely let out a breath of relief.
But soon.
They were submerged in immense grief, feeling so sorrowful they almost suffocated.
Ma Yu was already unwell, and after such a blow, he nearly fainted but knew he absolutely couldn’t collapse now; otherwise, the formidable Quanzhen Sect could disintegrate overnight.
With this in mind.
Ma Yu forced himself to endure the discomfort, returned to the main hall, and dealt with the remains of Qiu Chuji and the others.
Afterward.
He began investigating the cause of the incident.
Upon realizing it was Zhao Zhijing who made the first move.
He was both angry and anxious, and couldn’t help but cough a dry cough.
Seeing this, a dignified, elderly Daoist standing by with gray hair and beard felt overwhelming guilt:
"Alas. It’s I, Wang Chuyi, who caused the death of Senior Brother Qiu, Junior Brother Hao, and Junior Sister Sun. I have no face to continue living, Elder Brother, I..."
He was about to speak decisively.
Ma Yu raised his hand to stop him and said:
"It’s not your fault, we also bear some responsibility. We clearly knew Zhao Zhijing, although with exceptional talent and bone structure, is insidious and deceitful, vengeful and narrow-minded!
Regarding Yang Guo, Zhao Zhijing was excessively harsh!
We are all aware of this.
Yet we turned a blind eye.
Which led to the tragedy that happened today!
If we had punished Zhao Zhijing earlier, or simply expelled him from the Quanzhen Sect, today’s catastrophic disaster might not have occurred!"
"Alas."
Another old Daoist was also deeply ashamed and remorseful:
"The Quanzhen Sect belongs to all of us, and when someone like Zhao Zhijing, with an incorrect temperament, appears within our sect, we should have dealt with it a long time ago.
Yet we were hoping he would change for the better.
Not realizing that habits are hard to change!
How can we expect someone with a flawed character to return to the right path?

Previously, our Quanzhen Sect was so renowned and formidable that no one dared provoke us, thus even though Zhao Zhijing was arrogant and domineering, no one truly dared to discipline him or kill him!
And now we’ve encountered some merciless person emerging out of nowhere, destined to face this disaster!"
"From today onwards."
Ma Yu ordered:
"Anyone with blemished behavior shall be immediately expelled from the Quanzhen Sect! Within our inner sect disciples of Quanzhen, we absolutely do not allow such people to seize high positions!
Wang Chuyi and the others nodded in agreement.
"Who exactly is the person who appeared suddenly in the main hall? We do not know. But it cannot be denied that their appearance here might be accidental or intentional.
No matter which it is.
Starting with shouting for a fight.
And even after the person politely asked questions and loudly warned, the shouting and fighting continued, which is truly foolish and senseless!"
Ma Yu was deeply saddened:
"From the way our surviving disciples spoke, it’s not hard to judge that this person is not bloodthirsty, Zhao Zhijing provoked him, which led him to unleash the massacre!
If he were bloodthirsty.
The entire main hall would not have a single person left standing!"
"Indeed."
Wang Chuyi felt suffocated with grief:

"Such a formidable individual is rarely seen through the ages. His martial arts cultivation is overwhelmingly domineering, even our master would struggle to deal with him. Zhao Zhijing dared to strike even after being warned by the opponent, which is utterly foolish and hopelessly irredeemable.
From today onwards.
Zhao Zhijing will no longer be my disciple. I shall completely erase his name from the Quanzhen Sect’s record!"
[Achievement Medal Earned: Awed Ma Yu.]
[Note: As the current Sect Leader of Quanzhen Sect, Ma Yu is knowledgeable and his martial power cultivation has reached the First-class Transformation Realm.
However, in front of you.
He still feels a powerless sense like an ant trying to shake a tree!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Awed Qiu Chuji.]
[Note: Qiu Chuji had ventured north and south, his life experiences were full of ups and downs, leaving legendary tales everywhere.
However, facing you, he was not an opponent even for one blow. Till his death, he remained in disbelief!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Awed Zhao Zhijing.]

[Note: Zhao Zhijing is sinister and malicious, scheming, and eager for power. Upon seeing you, he thought of Guo Jing, envisioned himself flying higher with your help, wanting to use you as a stepping stone, a punching bag.

But clearly, he chose the wrong target. Until his death, Zhao Zhijing was confused, regretting, and at a loss. He couldn’t believe someone would dare wreak havoc and kill freely in a place like Quanzhen Sect!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Awed Yin Zhiping.]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Awed Wang Chuyi.]
A total of 13 Achievement Medals were earned from the Quanzhen Sect.
Clearly.
These 13 included second-generation disciples of Quanzhen, third-generation named disciples, and also fourth-generation disciples like Lul Qingdu.
Besides these 13 Achievement Medals.
Ding Ling unexpectedly found an Achievement Medal distinct from the others:
[Achievement Medal Earned: You won Yang Guo’s high admiration!]
[Note: Yang Guo witnessed your display of prowess almost in its entirety! He holds both admiration and reverence for you! It’s his first time encountering someone like you.
His worldview seemed overturned, rewritten in that instant.
In his hot-blooded excitement, he feels that a man should indeed be like this.]
Ding Ling saw this.
